01Getting started

Using Vite

Is section me hum Using Vite ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya?

  • Tailwind CSS ko Vite plugin ke roop me lagana Laravel, SvelteKit, React Router, Nuxt aur SolidJS jaise frameworks ke saath jodne ka sabse aasan tareeka hai.
  • Core model (har installation page par yahi dohraaya gaya hai): Tailwind CSS tumhari saari HTML files, JavaScript components aur baaki templates ko class names ke liye scan karta hai, unke hisaab ki styles banata hai, aur phir unhe ek static CSS file me likh deta hai. Ye tez, lachila (flexible) aur bharosemand hai — aur iska runtime zero hai.

Steps (6, kram se)

  1. Apna project banao — agar pehle se project nahi hai to naya Vite project banao; sabse aam tareeka hai Create Vite (vite.dev):
bash
   npm create vite@latest my-project
   cd my-project
  1. Tailwind CSS install karo — npm se tailwindcss aur @tailwindcss/vite lagao:
bash
   npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite
  1. Vite plugin configure karo — apni Vite configuration (vite.config.ts) me @tailwindcss/vite plugin jodo:
ts
   import { defineConfig } from 'vite'
   import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite'

   export default defineConfig({
     plugins: [
       tailwindcss(),
     ],
   })
  1. Tailwind CSS import karo — apni CSS file me ek @import jodo:
css
   @import "tailwindcss";
  1. Build process shuru karo — npm run dev chalao, ya jo bhi command package.json me set hai.
  2. Apne HTML me Tailwind istemal shuru karo — pakka karo ki tumhari compiled CSS <head> me shaamil hai (ho sakta hai tumhara framework ye kaam khud kar de), phir Tailwind ki utility classes istemal karo. Example:
html
   <!doctype html>
   <html>
   <head>
     <meta charset="UTF-8">
     <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
     <link href="/src/style.css" rel="stylesheet">
   </head>
   <body>
     <h1 class="text-3xl font-bold underline">
       Hello world!
     </h1>
   </body>
   </html>

Notes + Interview ki baatein

  • Vite plugin wala raasta hi Vite-based frameworks (Laravel, SvelteKit, React Router, Nuxt, SolidJS) ke liye salaah diya gaya raasta hai.
  • v4 me is raaste ke liye koi tailwind.config.js / PostCSS config nahi chahiye — plugin + @import "tailwindcss" hi poora setup hai.
  • Agar atak jao: setup har build tool par alag ho sakta hai — apne setup ke khaas nirdeshon ke liye framework guides dekho.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/installation/using-vite

02Getting started

Using PostCSS

Is section me hum Using PostCSS ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya?

  • Tailwind CSS ko PostCSS plugin ke roop me lagana Next.js aur Angular jaise frameworks ke saath jodne ka sabse aasan tareeka hai.
  • Upar wala hi core model: HTML/JS components/templates ko class names ke liye scan karo → unke hisaab ki styles banao → ek static CSS file me likho; runtime zero.

Steps (5, kram se)

  1. Tailwind CSS install karo — npm se tailwindcss, @tailwindcss/postcss aur postcss lagao:
bash
   npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/postcss postcss

Teeno packages par dhyan do: framework khud, Tailwind ka PostCSS plugin, aur PostCSS khud.

  1. Apni PostCSS configuration me Tailwind jodo — postcss.config.mjs me @tailwindcss/postcss jodo, ya jahan bhi project me PostCSS configure hai:
js
   export default {
     plugins: {
       "@tailwindcss/postcss": {},
     }
   }
  1. Tailwind CSS import karo — apni CSS file me ek @import jodo:
css
   @import "tailwindcss";
  1. Build process shuru karo — npm run dev (ya jo command package.json me configured hai).
  2. Apne HTML me Tailwind istemal shuru karo — pakka karo ki compiled CSS <head> me shaamil hai (ho sakta hai framework ye khud sambhal le), phir utility classes istemal karo. Example me stylesheet link ke roop me /dist/styles.css hai (Vite wale /src/style.css se alag):
html
   <!doctype html>
   <html>
   <head>
     <meta charset="UTF-8">
     <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
     <link href="/dist/styles.css" rel="stylesheet">
   </head>
   <body>
     <h1 class="text-3xl font-bold underline">
       Hello world!
     </h1>
   </body>
   </html>

Notes + Interview ki baatein

  • PostCSS wala raasta hi Next.js aur Angular ke liye salaah diya gaya raasta hai.
  • Packages me farak samjho: @tailwindcss/postcss (PostCSS plugin) banam @tailwindcss/vite (Vite plugin) banam @tailwindcss/cli (CLI). Inhe ulat-pulat kar dena setup ki ek aam galti hai.
  • Agar atak jao: setup ke khaas nirdeshon ke liye framework guides dekho.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/installation/using-postcss

03Getting started

Tailwind CLI

Is section me hum Tailwind CLI ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya?

  • Shuruaat se Tailwind CSS chalane ka sabse saral aur sabse tez tareeka hai Tailwind CLI tool.
  • CLI ek standalone executable ke roop me bhi milta hai (page se GitHub par link hai) — agar tum Node.js install kiye bina ise istemal karna chahte ho.

Steps (4, kram se)

  1. Install Tailwind CSS — tailwindcss aur @tailwindcss/cli npm se install karo:
bash
   npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/cli
  1. Apni CSS me Tailwind import karo — apni main CSS file (src/input.css) me import jodo:
css
   @import "tailwindcss";
  1. Tailwind CLI ka build process shuru karo — CLI chalao taaki wo source files ko classes ke liye scan kare aur tumhari CSS banaye:
bash
   npx @tailwindcss/cli -i ./src/input.css -o ./src/output.css --watch

Flags: -i input CSS, -o output CSS, --watch badlav par dobara build.

  1. Apne HTML me Tailwind istemal shuru karo — compiled CSS file ko <head> me jodo aur utility classes istemal karo (src/index.html):
html
   <!doctype html>
   <html>
   <head>
     <meta charset="UTF-8">
     <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
     <link href="./output.css" rel="stylesheet">
   </head>
   <body>
     <h1 class="text-3xl font-bold underline">
       Hello world!
     </h1>
   </body>
   </html>

Notes + Interview ki baatein

  • CLI shuruaat se bane / bina-framework wale project ke liye sabse sahi chunav hai, aur ye iklauta raasta hai jo bina Node.js ke standalone executable deta hai.
  • --watch flag hi development me live-rebuild karata hai; iske bina CLI ek baar ka build karke ruk jata hai.
  • Aam galti: -i/-o paths bhool jana, ya HTML me compiled output file ki jagah input file link kar dena.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/installation/tailwind-cli

04Getting started

Framework Guides

Is section me hum Framework Guides ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya?

  • Framework ke hisaab ki guides — kai mashhoor environments me Tailwind CSS lagane ka salaah diya gaya tareeka inme diya hai.
  • Ye akela page khud ek index hai: ye frameworks ki list deta hai, har ek ki ek-line ki jaankari ke saath, aur har framework ke alag guide page par link karta hai. Isme har framework ke install steps yahin nahi diye hain.

Shaamil frameworks (19, page par diye gaye kram me)

  1. Next.js — Poori suvidhaon wala React framework, badhiya developer experience ke saath.
  2. Laravel — PHP web application framework, saaf-suthre aur asar-daar syntax ke saath.
  3. Nuxt — Universal applications banane ke liye aasani se samajh aane wala Vue framework.
  4. SolidJS — Saral, tez aur reactive user interfaces banane ka tool.
  5. SvelteKit — Svelte.js ke saath har aakaar ke apps banane ka sabse tez tareeka.
  6. Gatsby — React aur GraphQL ke saath static sites banane ka framework.
  7. Angular — Mobile aur desktop web applications banane ka platform.
  8. Ruby on Rails — Full-stack framework, shandaar web apps banane ke saare tools ke saath.
  9. React Router — Standards par kendrit router, jise tum kahin bhi deploy kar sakte ho.
  10. TanStack Start — Full-stack framework, React aur Solid ke liye TanStack Router par chalta hai.
  11. Phoenix — Elixir ke saath bharpoor, interactive applications banane ka framework.
  12. Parcel — Web ke liye zero-configuration build tool.
  13. Symfony — Websites aur web applications banane ka PHP framework.
  14. Meteor — Cross-platform apps banane ka full-stack JavaScript framework.
  15. AdonisJS — Node.js ke liye poori suvidhaon wala web framework.
  16. Ember.js — Bade sapno wale web developers ke liye JavaScript framework.
  17. Astro — All-in-one web framework, raftaar ke liye bana hua.
  18. Qwik — Bina mehnat ke turant-interactive web apps banao.
  19. Rspack — Tez, Rust par bana web bundler.

Scope wali baat

  • Ye page har framework ke alag guide page par link KARTA hai (upar har framework ke liye ek link). Is SPA me wo 19 alag guide pages bhi apne-apne sections me shaamil hain — har framework ke steps usi ke section me dekho.
  • Cross-reference: Vite page pehle hi Laravel, SvelteKit, React Router, Nuxt, SolidJS ko Vite-plugin ke liye sahi batata hai; PostCSS page Next.js aur Angular ko PostCSS ke liye sahi batata hai.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/installation/framework-guides

05Getting started

Play CDN

Is section me hum Play CDN ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya?

  • Play CDN istemal karke Tailwind ko seedha browser me aazmao — bina kisi build step ke.
  • Ye sirf development ke liye bana hai, production ke liye nahi. Yahi is page ki sabse badi chetaavni hai — Play CDN ko production me mat bhejo.

Steps (2)

  1. Apne HTML me Play CDN script jodo — script tag ko <head> me jodo aur utility classes istemal shuru karo:
html
   <!doctype html>
   <html>
     <head>
       <meta charset="UTF-8" />
       <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
       <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tailwindcss/browser@4"></script>
     </head>
     <body>
       <h1 class="text-3xl font-bold underline">
         Hello world!
       </h1>
     </body>
   </html>

v4 ke browser package par dhyan do: jsDelivr se @tailwindcss/browser@4.

  1. Kuch custom CSS jodkar dekho — type="text/tailwindcss" istemal karo taaki aisi custom CSS jod sako jo Tailwind ki saari CSS suvidhaon ko support kare:
html
   <!doctype html>
   <html>
     <head>
       <meta charset="UTF-8" />
       <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
       <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tailwindcss/browser@4"></script>
       <style type="text/tailwindcss">
         @theme {
           --color-clifford: #da373d;
         }
       </style>
     </head>
     <body>
       <h1 class="text-3xl font-bold underline text-clifford">
         Hello world!
       </h1>
     </body>
   </html>

Isme @theme directive ek custom rang --color-clifford: #da373d tay karta hai, jo text-clifford utility ke roop me istemal hota hai.

Notes + Interview ki baatein

  • Play CDN = Tailwind aazmane / prototype / demo ka sabse tez tareeka; build step zero, lekin sirf dev ke liye.
  • type="text/tailwindcss" (saada text/css nahi) hi Play CDN ke saath inline <style> block ke andar Tailwind features (@theme wagera) chalu karta hai.
  • Aam galti: Play CDN ko production me istemal karna — ye browser me compile hota hai, isliye dheema hai aur live sites ke liye bana hi nahi hai.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/installation/play-cdn
← Previous04 · Framework Guides→ Next06 · Editor setup
06Getting started

Editor setup

Is section me hum Editor setup ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya?

  • Tailwind CSS ke saath kaam karte samay developer experience behtar banane wale tools.
  • Sandarbh: Tailwind CSS @theme, @variant aur @source jaisa custom CSS syntax istemal karta hai, aur kuch editors me jahan ye rules pehchane nahi jate, wahan ye warnings ya errors dikha sakta hai.

Tooling covered

  • VS Code — Tailwind CSS IntelliSense (official extension): isme ek khaas Tailwind CSS language mode hai jo Tailwind ke saare custom at-rules aur functions ko support karta hai. Kuch mamlo me, agar tumhara editor CSS files ke syntax ko lekar bahut sakht hai, to tumhe native CSS linting/validations band karne pad sakte hain. IntelliSense ki suvidhayein:
    • Autocomplete — utility classes ke saath-saath CSS functions aur directives ke samajhdaar sujhav.
    • Linting — tumhari CSS aur markup dono me galtiyon aur sambhaavit bugs ko ujagar karna.
    • Hover previews — utility classes par hover karte hi unki poori CSS dikh jana.
    • Syntax highlighting — taaki custom CSS syntax istemal karne wali Tailwind features sahi tareeke se highlight hon.
    • Project GitHub par hai; VS Code Marketplace se install karo.
  • Cursor: ek AI-native code editor, context ke hisaab ke autocomplete aur andar-bane coding agents ke saath. Kyunki ye VS Code extensions ko support karta hai, saari jaani-pehchani Tailwind tooling seedha chalti hai — official Tailwind CSS IntelliSense extension aur class sorting ke liye Prettier plugin samet.
  • Zed: ek tez, aadhunik code editor jo naye-zamane ke workflows ke liye bana hai, AI ke saath agentic editing samet. Isme Tailwind CSS autocompletions, linting aur hover previews ka support pehle se bana hai — alag se extension install/configure karne ki zaroorat nahi. Ye Prettier ke saath bhi gehrai se juda hai, to official Prettier plugin install hote hi Zed me aasani se chalta hai.
  • Prettier plugin (official): tumhari classes ko salaah diye gaye class order ke hisaab se apne aap sort kar deta hai. Custom Tailwind configurations ke saath bhi aasani se chalta hai, aur kyunki ye bas ek Prettier plugin hai, ye wahan-wahan chalta hai jahan Prettier chalta hai — har mashhoor editor aur IDE me, aur command line par bhi. Iske reordering ka example:
html
  <!-- Before -->
  <button class="text-white px-4 sm:px-8 py-2 sm:py-3 bg-sky-700 hover:bg-sky-800">Submit</button>
  <!-- After -->
  <button class="bg-sky-700 px-4 py-2 text-white hover:bg-sky-800 sm:px-8 sm:py-3">Submit</button>

"After" wale example me salaah diye gaye kram par dhyan do: background, padding, text ka rang, phir hover: variant, aur sabse ant me sm: responsive variants.

  • JetBrains IDEs (WebStorm, PhpStorm, aur dusre): HTML me samajhdaar Tailwind CSS completions ka support shaamil hai (detail ke liye JetBrains docs se link hai).

Notes + Interview ki baatein

  • Agar editor @theme / @variant / @source ko error kehkar underline kare, to ilaaj hai Tailwind language mode / IntelliSense, ya native CSS validation band karna — at-rules ko hatana nahi.
  • Class sorting sirf dikhawa nahi hai: Prettier plugin salaah diya gaya class order lagu karta hai, jisse diffs saaf rehte hain aur variant ordering (base → hover → responsive) har jagah ek jaisi rehti hai.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/editor-setup
← Previous05 · Play CDN→ Next07 · Compatibility
07Getting started

Compatibility

Is section me hum Compatibility ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya?

  • Browser support aur dusri tooling ke saath compatibility (sangatata).

Browser support (Tailwind CSS v4.0)

  • Aadhunik browsers ke liye bana aur unhi par test kiya gaya; iski core suvidhayein khaas taur par in versions par nirbhar hain:
    • Chrome 111 (March 2023 me release)
    • Safari 16.4 (March 2023 me release)
    • Firefox 128 (July 2024 me release)
  • Tailwind me kai ekdum-nayi platform features ka support bhi hai, jaise field-sizing: content, @starting-style aur text-wrap: balance, jinka browser support abhi seemit hai. In aadhunik features ko istemal karna ya na karna tum par hai — agar tumhare target browsers inhe support nahi karte, to bas wo utilities aur variants istemal mat karo. Yakeen na ho to Can I Use database par support check karo.

CSS preprocessors (Sass / Less / Stylus) — Tailwind ke saath istemal MAT karo

  • Tailwind CSS v4.0 ek poori suvidhaon wala CSS build tool hai jo ek khaas workflow ke liye bana hai — ye Sass, Less ya Stylus jaise CSS preprocessors ke saath istemal ke liye bana hi nahi hai.
  • Tailwind CSS ko hi apna preprocessor samjho — tumhe Tailwind ko Sass ke saath istemal nahi karna chahiye, bilkul usi wajah se jis wajah se tum Sass ko Stylus ke saath istemal nahi karoge.
  • Kyunki Tailwind aadhunik browsers ko target karta hai, tumhe in cheezon ke liye preprocessor ki zaroorat nahi:
    • Nesting ya variables: Tailwind tumhare imports ko bundle karta hai aur vendor prefixes khud jod deta hai. Saare aadhunik browsers bina preprocessor ke native CSS variables ko support karte hain.
    • Imports ko bundle karna: Tailwind @import se shaamil dusri CSS files ko apne aap bundle kar deta hai — Sass ya postcss-import jaise alag tool ke bina:
css
    /* app.css */
    @import "tailwindcss";
    @import "./typography.css";

Is example me typography.css ko Tailwind compiled CSS ke andar bundle kar deta hai.

  • Variables asal istemal me:
css
    /* typography.css */
    .typography {
      font-size: var(--text-base);
      color: var(--color-gray-700);
    }

Tailwind andar hi andar CSS variables par bahut zyada nirbhar hai — to agar tum Tailwind istemal kar sakte ho, to native CSS variables bhi istemal kar sakte ho.

  • Nesting: andar se Tailwind nested CSS ko process karne ke liye Lightning CSS istemal karta hai:
css
    .typography {
      p { font-size: var(--text-base); }
      img { border-radius: var(--radius-lg); }
    }

Tailwind use is roop me seedha (flatten) kar deta hai:

css
    .typography p { font-size: var(--text-base); }
    .typography img { border-radius: var(--radius-lg); }

Aajkal native CSS nesting ka support bhi bahut achha hai, to Tailwind ke bina bhi nesting ke liye preprocessor ki zaroorat nahi.

  • Loops: jo classes tum pehle loops se banate the (jaise col-span-1, col-span-2), wo Tailwind maang par (on-demand) bana deta hai jab bhi tum unhe istemal karte ho — pehle se tay karne ki zaroorat nahi. Aur kyunki zyada tar styling HTML me hoti hai, CSS files me nahi, tumhe program se dher saare custom CSS rules banane wali loop features ki bhi zaroorat nahi.
  • Colour functions (darken/lighten): salaah diya gaya workflow hai pehle se tay rangon ki palette, jisme har rang ke halke aur gehre shades hon — bilkul default colour palette ki tarah:
html
    <button class="bg-indigo-500 hover:bg-indigo-600 ...">
      <!-- ... -->
    </button>

Tum aadhunik CSS color-mix() istemal karke browser me run-time par rang bhi badal sakte ho — isse tum CSS variables se tay rangon ya currentcolor keyword ko bhi badal sakte ho, jo preprocessors se sambhav nahi hai. Isi tarah, browsers ab min(), max(), round() jaise math functions ko natively support karte hain.

CSS Modules — compatible hai, lekin saath istemal ki salaah NAHI hai

  • Tailwind CSS modules ke saath compatible hai aur agar tum Tailwind ko kisi aise project me la rahe ho jo pehle se CSS modules istemal karta hai, to dono saath reh sakte hain — lekin agar bach sakte ho, to CSS modules aur Tailwind ko saath istemal karne ki salaah nahi hai.
  • Wajah: CSS modules un scoping samasyaon ko hal karte hain jo HTML me utility classes jodne par hoti hi nahi. Tailwind me styles kudrati taur par scoped rehti hain kyunki har utility class hamesha wahi kaam karti hai, chahe kahin bhi istemal ho — is baat ka koi khatra nahi ki UI ke ek hisse me utility class jodne se kahin aur anchaaha asar pad jayega.
  • Performance ka jaal: Vite, Parcel aur Turbopack jaise build tools har CSS module ko alag se process karte hain. 50 CSS modules hon to Tailwind ko 50 alag baar chalna padega — builds bahut dheemi aur developer experience kharab.
  • Kyunki har CSS module alag se process hota hai, unke paas koi @theme nahi hota jab tak tum khud import na karo. @apply jaisi features ummeed ke hisaab se kaam nahi karengi jab tak tum global styles ko saaf taur par reference ke roop me import na karo:
css
  /* Button.module.css */
  @reference "../app.css";
  button {
    @apply bg-blue-500;
  }

Vikalp (performance ke liye behtar): @apply ke bajaye bas CSS variables istemal karo — isse Tailwind un files ko process karna chhod sakta hai aur build performance behtar hoti hai:

css
  /* Button.module.css */
  button {
    background: var(--color-blue-500);
  }

Vue / Svelte / Astro ke <style> blocks — wahi savdhaani

  • Vue, Svelte aur Astro component files me <style> blocks ko support karte hain, jo bilkul CSS modules ki tarah bartav karte hain: har ek ko build tooling alag se process karta hai, unhi saari kamiyon ke saath.
  • Salaah: components me <style> blocks se bacho aur markup me seedha utility classes se style karo — bilkul waise jaise Tailwind istemal karne ke liye bana hai.
  • Agar tum <style> blocks istemal karte hi ho, to global styles ko reference ke roop me import karo taaki @apply kaam kare:
vue
  <!-- Button.vue -->
  <template>
    <button><slot /></button>
  </template>
  <style scoped>
    @reference "../app.css";
    button {
      @apply bg-blue-500;
    }
  </style>

Ya phir globally tay CSS variables istemal karo, jinme Tailwind ko component CSS process karne ki zaroorat hi nahi padti:

vue
  <template>
    <button><slot /></button>
  </template>
  <style scoped>
    button {
      background-color: var(--color-blue-500);
    }
  </style>

Notes + Interview ki baatein

  • Teeno minimum browser versions (Chrome 111, Safari 16.4, Firefox 128) aur unki wajah yaad rakho: v4 ka core aadhunik CSS features par nirbhar hai.
  • "Tailwind khud apna preprocessor hai" — yahi "Kya main Tailwind ko Sass ke saath istemal kar sakta hoon?" ka standard interview jawab hai — nahi; uske bajaye native variables, color-mix(), native nesting aur on-demand utilities istemal karo.
  • @reference CSS Modules / scoped <style> blocks ke liye bachne ka raasta hai; saada CSS variables (var(--color-...)) usse tez vikalp hain.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/compatibility
← Previous06 · Editor setup→ Next08 · Upgrade guide
08Getting started

Upgrade guide

Is section me hum Upgrade guide ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Taaza dobara-padhaai se verified (saari lines) — ye asal docs ka poora saransh hai.

Ye hai kya?

  • Tailwind CSS projects ko v3 se v4 par upgrade karne ki guide. v4 ek naya major version hai; upgrade tool zyada tar kaam apne aap kar deta hai, lekin kuch badlav haath se karne padte hain.
  • Browser support: v4 Safari 16.4+, Chrome 111+, Firefox 128+ ko target karta hai (@property aur color-mix() jaise aadhunik CSS par nirbhar hai). Agar puraane browsers ko support karna hi hai, to v3.4 par hi raho.

Upgrade tool

  • npx @tailwindcss/upgrade — zyada tar kaam apne aap kar deta hai: dependencies update karta hai, JS config file ko CSS me badal deta hai, template files ke badlav sambhal leta hai.
  • Node.js 20+ chahiye. Ise ek nayi branch me chalao, diff dhyan se dekho, aur browser me test karo — jatil projects me kuch haath ke badlav pad sakte hain.
  • Neeche diye breaking changes bhi padh lo, kahin tool se kuch chhoot gaya ho to.

Package / setup ke badlav

  • PostCSS plugin badal gaya: v3 ka tailwindcss PostCSS plugin → v4 ka khaas @tailwindcss/postcss package. postcss-import aur autoprefixer ab apne aap sambhal liye jate hain — inhe postcss.config.mjs se hata do.
  • Vite: performance aur sabse achhe DX ke liye PostCSS plugin se khaas Vite plugin (vite.config.ts me @tailwindcss/vite) par aa jao.
  • Tailwind CLI badal gaya: tailwindcss -i input.css -o output.css → @tailwindcss/cli (npx @tailwindcss/cli -i input.css -o output.css).
  • CSS import ne directives ki jagah le li: v3 @tailwind base; @tailwind components; @tailwind utilities; → v4 @import "tailwindcss";.

Hatayi gayi purani (deprecated) utilities (unki jagah ke vikalpon ke saath)

DeprecatedReplacement
bg-opacity-*Opacity modifiers, e.g. bg-black/50
text-opacity-*Opacity modifiers, e.g. text-black/50
border-opacity-*Opacity modifiers
divide-opacity-*Opacity modifiers
ring-opacity-*Opacity modifiers
placeholder-opacity-*Opacity modifiers
flex-shrink-*shrink-*
flex-grow-*grow-*
overflow-ellipsistext-ellipsis
decoration-slicebox-decoration-slice
decoration-clonebox-decoration-clone

Naam badli hui utilities (v3 → v4)

v3v4
shadow-smshadow-xs
shadowshadow-sm
drop-shadow-smdrop-shadow-xs
drop-shadowdrop-shadow-sm
blur-smblur-xs
blurblur-sm
backdrop-blur-smbackdrop-blur-xs
backdrop-blurbackdrop-blur-sm
rounded-smrounded-xs
roundedrounded-sm
outline-noneoutline-hidden
ringring-3
  • Default shadow, radius aur blur scales ke naam isliye badle gaye taaki har utility ki ek naam-wali value ho. Saade (bare) versions peeche ki sangatata ke liye ab bhi chalte hain, lekin <utility>-sm utilities alag dikhengi jab tak unhe unke -xs versions me na badla jaye.

outline changes

  • outline ab default roop se outline-width: 1px set karta hai (border/ring ke saath sangat); outline-<number> utilities outline-style ko default solid rakhti hain, to outline outline-2 ab bas outline-2 ban gaya hai.
  • v3 me outline-none asal me outline-style: none set NAHI karta tha — ye ek adrishya outline set karta tha jo forced-colors mode me phir bhi dikhti thi. Iska naam badalkar outline-hidden ho gaya hai; naya outline-none asal me outline-style: none set karta hai. focus:outline-none ko focus:outline-hidden se badlo.

ring changes

  • ring ki chaudaai 3px → 1px ho gayi aur default rang blue-500 → currentColor. ring ki jagah ring-3 lagao aur jahan puraane default rang par bharosa tha, wahan ring-blue-500 jodo. Sangatata ke liye bachav ka raasta (v4 ka asal tareeka nahi): @theme { --default-ring-width: 3px; --default-ring-color: var(--color-blue-500); }.
  • border-* / divide-* ka default rang bhi gray-200 se currentColor ho gaya hai — rang saaf taur par batao, ya ek base layer rule jodo jo *, ::after, ::before, ::backdrop, ::file-selector-button par border-color: var(--color-gray-200, currentColor) set kare.

space-x / space-y aur divide-x / divide-y ke selector ka badlav

  • Purana selector: .space-y-4 > :not([hidden]) ~ :not([hidden]) { margin-top: 1rem; } — naya: .space-y-4 > :not(:last-child) { margin-bottom: 1rem; }. Yahi badlav divide-y-4 ke liye bhi (border-top-width → border-bottom-width). Ye bade pages par performance ke liye kiya gaya hai. Inline elements ya bachon ke extra margins ke saath bartav badal sakta hai — uske bajaye flex/grid + gap par aa jao.

Gradients

  • v3 me, variant se gradient ke kisi hisse ko badalna poore gradient ko "reset" kar deta tha (jaise dark:from-blue-500 to-* ko transparent bana deta tha). v4 me values surakshit rehti hain. Kisi state me teen-stop gradient ko saaf taur par do stops par wapas lane ke liye via-none istemal karo (dark:via-none).

container

  • v3 ke container options center aur padding ab nahi hain. @utility se customise karo: @utility container { margin-inline: auto; padding-inline: 2rem; }.

v4 me Preflight ke badlav

  • Placeholder text: v3 ka default gray-400 → v4 me current text rang 50% opacity par (v3 wala bartav chahiye to base-layer rule lagao jo placeholders par color: var(--color-gray-400) set kare).
  • Buttons ab cursor: pointer ki jagah cursor: default istemal karte hain (browser ka default). Pointer wapas lane ke liye: @layer base { button:not(:disabled), [role="button"]:not(:disabled) { cursor: pointer; } }.
  • <dialog> ke margins ab reset ho jate hain; @layer base { dialog { margin: auto; } } se use centre karo.
  • block/flex jaisi display classes ab hidden attribute par haavi nahi hoti (sirf hidden="until-found" apvaad hai).

Prefix ab variants ban gaye hain

  • Prefix kisi variant ki tarah shuruaat me lagta hai: tw:flex tw:bg-red-500 tw:hover:bg-red-600. Theme variables ko aise configure karo jaise koi prefix hai hi nahi; lekin bane hue CSS variables me prefix SHAAMIL hota hai (--tw-font-display, --tw-breakpoint-3xl, --tw-color-avocado-100).

Important modifier ki jagah badal gayi

  • v3: ! shuruaat me (!flex). v4: ! bilkul ant me (flex!, bg-red-500!, hover:bg-red-600/50!). Purana tareeka ab bhi chalta hai lekin deprecated hai.

@layer utilities/components → @utility

  • v4 native cascade layers istemal karta hai aur ab @layer ko hijack nahi karta, isliye custom utilities @utility API par chali gayi hain: @utility tab-4 { tab-size: 4; } ne @layer utilities { .tab-4 { tab-size: 4; } } ki jagah le li hai. Custom utilities unke dwara tay properties ki sankhya ke hisaab se sort hoti hain, to .btn jaisi component utilities ko dusri Tailwind utilities override kar sakti hain.

Stacked variants ka kram

  • v3 stacked variants ko daayein-se-baayein lagu karta tha; v4 unhe baayein-se-daayein lagu karta hai (CSS syntax ki tarah). Kram par nirbhar stacked variants ko ulta karo: first:*:pt-0 last:*:pb-0 → *:first:pt-0 *:last:pb-0.

CSS variable wale arbitrary values

  • Purana shorthand bg-[--brand-color] → naya koshthak (parenthesis) wala shorthand bg-(--brand-color).

Arbitrary values me commas

  • grid-cols-*, grid-rows-*, object-* ke arbitrary values me commas ab spaces nahi bante (v3 wali sangatata hata di gayi hai). Underscores istemal karo: grid-cols-[max-content,auto] nahi, grid-cols-[max-content_auto].

hover variant

  • hover ab sirf tab lagu hota hai jab primary input hover ko support karta ho (@media (hover: hover)). Touch devices par tap karne se ab ye trigger nahi hota. Zaroorat pade to @custom-variant hover (&:hover); se purana bartav wapas lao; aam taur par hover ko ek enhancement ki tarah hi samjho.

transition me ab outline-color bhi shaamil hai

  • transition / transition-colors me ab outline-color bhi shaamil hai. Agar outline ka rang sirf focus par joda jaye, to wo default se transition karega — outline ka rang bina shart set karo ya dono states me set karo.

rotate / scale / translate ab alag-alag CSS properties hain

  • transform-none ab inhe reset nahi karta — uske bajaye alag property ko reset karo (focus:scale-none).
  • transition-[opacity,transform] ab inhe transition nahi karta — alag-alag properties ki list do: transition-[opacity,scale].

JavaScript config

  • corePlugins option poori tarah hata diya gaya hai.
  • JS config files peeche ki sangatata ke liye ab bhi supported hain lekin ab apne aap detect nahi hoti — @config "../../tailwind.config.js"; se saaf taur par load karo. corePlugins, safelist, separator options supported nahi hain; safelist ke liye @source inline() istemal karo.
  • resolveConfig hata diya gaya hai — bane hue CSS variables ko seedha istemal karo (jaise var(--color-blue-500)), ya JS se getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue("--shadow-xl") istemal karo.
  • theme() function ke bajaye CSS variables ko prathmikta do; media queries me CSS variable ka naam istemal karo: theme(screens.xl) nahi, theme(--breakpoint-xl).

Alag stylesheets aur CSS modules

  • Alag se bundle hone wali stylesheets (CSS Modules, Vue/Svelte/Astro ke <style> blocks) ko dusri files se theme variables, custom utilities ya custom variants NAHI milte. CSS ko dohraye bina unhe import karne ke liye @reference "../../app.css"; istemal karo, ya @apply ke bajaye seedha CSS theme variables istemal karo.

Sass/Less/Stylus nahi chalega

  • v4 Sass, Less ya Stylus ke saath istemal ke liye bana hi nahi hai — Tailwind khud hi preprocessor hai.

Aam galtiyaan / interview points

  • Upgrade tool zyada tar migration sambhal leta hai, lekin naam-badlav (shadow → shadow-sm, rounded → rounded-sm, blur → blur-sm, ring → ring-3, outline-none → outline-hidden) sabse zyada baar haath se theek karne padte hain.
  • ! class name ki shuruaat se ant me chala gaya; prefix variants ban gaye; stacked variants baayein-se-daayein ho gaye.
  • Default ring ab 1px + currentColor hai, aur border-*/divide-* ka default currentColor hai — isliye bina-style wale borders/rings upgrade ke baad alag dikhte hain.
  • transform-none ab rotate-*/scale-*/translate-* ko reset nahi karta; transition-[...transform] bhi inhe animate nahi karta.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/upgrade-guide
← Previous07 · Compatibility→ Next09 · Styling with utility classes
09Core concepts

Styling with utility classes

Is section me hum Styling with utility classes ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya?

  • Seemit (constrained) primitive utilities ke set se jatil components banana. Tum seedha apne markup me kai ek-kaam-wali sajawati classes (utility classes) ko jodkar cheezon ko style karte ho.
  • Sabse jaana-pehchana example (ChitChat card):
html
  <div class="mx-auto flex max-w-sm items-center gap-x-4 rounded-xl bg-white p-6 shadow-lg outline outline-black/5 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:shadow-none dark:-outline-offset-1 dark:outline-white/10">
    <img class="size-12 shrink-0" src="/img/logo.svg" alt="ChitChat Logo" />
    <div>
      <div class="text-xl font-medium text-black dark:text-white">ChitChat</div>
      <p class="text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">You have a new message!</p>
    </div>
  </div>

Wahan istemal hui utilities: flex, shrink-0, p-6 (display/padding/layout); max-w-sm, mx-auto (max-width/margin, seemit karna + centre); bg-white, rounded-xl, shadow-lg (background/border-radius/box-shadow); size-12 (logo ki width+height); gap-x-4 (gap); text-xl, text-black, font-medium (font-size/rang/weight).

Fayde (kyon ye paramparik best practices se ulta hai, phir bhi kaam karta hai)

  • Tez — class names sochne, selectors tay karne, ya HTML aur CSS files ke beech idhar-udhar jaane me samay barbaad nahi hota.
  • Surakshit badlav — utility jodna/hatana sirf usi element ko prabhavit karta hai; wahi CSS istemal karne wale dusre page par kuch tootne ki chinta kabhi nahi.
  • Aasan rakh-rakhav — badlav matlab element dhoondo aur uski classes badal do; chhah mahine se chhui bhi nahi gayi custom CSS ko ulta samajhne ki zaroorat nahi.
  • Zyada portable — structure + styling ek saath rehte hain, to UI ke poore hisse copy/paste kiye ja sakte hain, projects ke beech bhi.
  • CSS badhna ruk jata hai — utilities dobara istemal ho sakti hain, isliye CSS har naye feature ke saath seedhi rekha me nahi badhti. Lambe samay tak chalne wale bade projects par teams ke liye ye khaas taur par keemti hai.

"Ye to bas inline styles hi hain?" — Nahi. Inline styles par fayde

  • Seemaon ke saath design — inline styles me har value ek jaadui number (magic number) hoti hai. Utilities me tum pehle se tay design system se chunte ho, isliye UIs dikhne me ek-jaise rehte hain.
  • Hover, focus aur dusri states — inline styles hover/focus ko target nahi kar sakte; Tailwind ke state variants kar sakte hain.
  • Media queries — inline styles me namumkin; Tailwind ke responsive variants responsive interfaces ko aasan bana dete hain.
  • Hover/active button ke saath poora responsive example (Erin Lindford card): flex flex-col gap-2 p-8 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:gap-6 sm:py-4, image mx-auto block h-24 rounded-full sm:mx-0 sm:shrink-0, button border-purple-200 text-purple-600 hover:border-transparent hover:bg-purple-600 hover:text-white active:bg-purple-700.

Variants (asal tantra / core mechanism)

  • Hover/focus wagera ko style karne ke liye, kisi bhi utility ke aage state ka prefix lagao: hover:bg-sky-700:
html
  <button class="bg-sky-500 hover:bg-sky-700 ...">Save changes</button>

Generated CSS:

css
  .hover\:bg-sky-700 {
    &:hover {
      background-color: var(--color-sky-700);
    }
  }

Khaas baat: class tab tak kuch nahi karti jab tak hover na ho — uska ekmatra kaam hover styles hain. Paramparik CSS kai states ko ek hi class me rakhta hai (.btn jiske andar &:hover); Tailwind har state ke liye alag class banata hai.

  • Variants ko stack karna: shartein jodo, jaise disabled:hover:bg-sky-500 (sirf tab jab disabled AUR hovered dono hon):
html
  <button class="bg-sky-500 disabled:hover:bg-sky-500 ...">Save changes</button>

Responsive variants

  • Kisi bhi utility ke aage breakpoint lagao: sm:grid-cols-3 sirf sm aur usse upar trigger hota hai, jo seedha-box-se 40rem hai:
html
  <div class="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3"><!-- ... --></div>
css
  .sm\:grid-cols-3 {
    @media (width >= 40rem) {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
    }
  }

Dark mode variant

  • Kisi bhi utility par dark: jodo taaki jab dark mode active ho to ye lagu ho:
html
  <div class="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg px-6 py-8 ring shadow-xl ring-gray-900/5">
    <h3 class="text-gray-900 dark:text-white mt-5 text-base font-medium tracking-tight">Writes upside-down</h3>
    <p class="text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 mt-2 text-sm">The Zero Gravity Pen can be used to write in any orientation, including upside-down. It even works in outer space.</p>
  </div>

Ek hi utility kabhi light aur dark dono styles nahi rakhti — tum kai classes istemal karte ho, har mode ke liye ek. Bani hui CSS (default strategy):

css
  .dark\:bg-gray-800 {
    @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
      background-color: var(--color-gray-800);
    }
  }

Ek hi CSS property ke liye kai utilities ko jodna (CSS variables wali chaal)

  • jaise kai filters: <div class="blur-sm grayscale">. Dono filter par nirbhar hain, isliye Tailwind inhe jodne ke liye CSS variables istemal karta hai:
css
  .blur-sm {
    --tw-blur: blur(var(--blur-sm));
    filter: var(--tw-blur,) var(--tw-brightness,) var(--tw-grayscale,);
  }
  .grayscale {
    --tw-grayscale: grayscale(100%);
    filter: var(--tw-blur,) var(--tw-brightness,) var(--tw-grayscale,);
  }

(Bani hui CSS page par thodi saral karke dikhayi gayi hai.) Har utility sirf apna variable set karti hai; filter un sabko padhta hai, aur jo set na ho uske liye kuch nahi leta. Yahi tareeka gradients, shadow ke rangon, transforms aur kai cheezon par lagu hota hai.

Theme variables aur arbitrary values

  • Kai utilities theme variables se chalti hain: bg-blue-500, text-xl, shadow-md — rangon ki palette, type scale aur shadows se jude hain.
  • Arbitrary values — theme se bahar ki ek-baar-wali values ke liye square-bracket syntax:
html
  <button class="bg-[#316ff6] ...">Sign in with Facebook</button>
  <div class="grid grid-cols-[24rem_2.5rem_minmax(0,1fr)]"><!-- ... --></div>
  <div class="max-h-[calc(100dvh-(--spacing(6)))]"><!-- ... --></div>

Istemaal: ek-baar-wale rang (Facebook blue), bahut khaas grids, theme values ke saath calc() bhi (calc ke andar --spacing(6) par dhyan do).

  • Arbitrary properties — poori tarah man-maani CSS banao, man-maana property naam samet; CSS variables set karne ke liye kaam ki hai, aur responsive bhi chalti hai:
html
  <div class="[--gutter-width:1rem] lg:[--gutter-width:2rem]"><!-- ... --></div>

Tailwind CSS kaise banata hai (maang par / on-demand)

  • Tailwind ek badi static stylesheet NAHI hai. Ye compile karte samay asal me istemal hui classes ke hisaab se zaroori CSS banata hai.
  • Ye project ki saari files ko scan karke har us nishan (symbol) ko dhoondhta hai jo class name jaisa lage — JS objects ke andar poori class strings samet, jaise Button.jsx:
jsx
  export default function Button({ size, children }) {
    let sizeClasses = {
      md: "px-4 py-2 rounded-md text-base",
      lg: "px-5 py-3 rounded-lg text-lg",
    }[size];
    return (
      <button type="button" className={`font-bold ${sizeClasses}`}>
        {children}
      </button>
    );
  }

Saari sambhaavit classes milne ke baad, ye har ek ke liye CSS banata hai aur sirf asal me zaroori styles ki ek stylesheet compile karta hai. Kyunki generation naam par aadharit hai, bg-[#316ff6] jaise arbitrary values bhi pehchane jate hain aur ban jate hain, chahe wo theme me na hon.

Variants ko jodna, group variants, arbitrary variants

  • Jodi hui shartein — example: dark mode + breakpoint + data attribute + hover:
html
  <button class="dark:lg:data-current:hover:bg-indigo-600 ...">...</button>

Saral CSS: @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) and (width >= 64rem) { button[data-current]:hover { background-color: var(--color-indigo-600); } }

  • Group variants — kisi khaas parent par hover hone par element ko style karo:
html
  <a href="#" class="group rounded-lg p-8">
    <span class="group-hover:underline">Read more…</span>
  </a>

Saral CSS: @media (hover: hover) { a:hover span { text-decoration-line: underline; } }. Dusre variants ke saath bhi kaam karta hai: group-focus, group-active, aur kai aur.

  • Arbitrary variants — jatil paristhitiyon ke liye (khaas taur par us HTML ko style karne ke liye jise tum control nahi karte), koi bhi selector seedha class name me likh do:
html
  <div class="[&>[data-active]+span]:text-blue-600 ...">
    <span data-active><!-- ... --></span>
    <span>This text will be blue</span>
  </div>

Saral CSS: div > [data-active] + span { color: var(--color-blue-600); }

Inline styles ki bhi apni jagah hai

  • Jab koi value kisi dynamic source (database/API) se aati ho:
jsx
  export function BrandedButton({ buttonColor, textColor, children }) {
    return (
      <button
        style={{ backgroundColor: buttonColor, color: textColor }}
        className="rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 font-medium"
      >
        {children}
      </button>
    );
  }
  • Bahut jatil arbitrary values ke liye, jo class name ke roop me padhna mushkil hon, inline style zyada saaf ho sakta hai (example: grid-template-columns: 2fr max(0, var(--gutter-width)) calc(var(--gutter-width) + 10px)).
  • Sabse achha pattern: dynamic sources se CSS variables ko inline styles ke zariye set karo, phir utilities se unhe istemal karo:
jsx
  export function BrandedButton({ buttonColor, buttonColorHover, textColor, children }) {
    return (
      <button
        style={{ "--bg-color": buttonColor, "--bg-color-hover": buttonColorHover, "--text-color": textColor }}
        className="bg-(--bg-color) text-(--text-color) hover:bg-(--bg-color-hover) ..."
      >
        {children}
      </button>
    );
  }

Kisi CSS variable ko utility value ke roop me istemal karne ke liye bg-(--bg-color) wale parenthesis syntax par dhyan do.

Dohrana / duplication sambhalna

  • Utility lists ka dohrana (jaise wahi avatar classes paanch baar) samasya lagta hai lekin aam taur par hota nahi:
    • Loop me render hone wale elements ek hi baar likhe jate hain — class list ek baar likhi jati hai, asal duplication hai hi nahi.
    • Ek hi file ke andar sthaniya duplication: multi-cursor editing se saari class lists ko ek saath select/edit karo (nav example: chaar links jo font-medium rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100 hover:text-gray-900 saajha karte hain). Aksar yahi sabse achha hal hai — kisi abstraction ki zaroorat nahi.
    • Kai files me dobara istemal: ek component (React/Svelte/Vue) ya template partial (Blade, ERB, Twig, Nunjucks) banao. React me VacationCard example image/text/pricing styles ko ek hi component me band kar deta hai — sach ka ek hi srot (single source of truth).
    • Agar ek akeli element ke liye (jaise ERB/Twig me ek button) template partial zyada bhari lage, to kuch custom CSS likhna bilkul theek hai. Theme variables istemal karke @layer components me btn-primary ka example:
css
    @import "tailwindcss";
    @layer components {
      .btn-primary {
        border-radius: calc(infinity * 1px);
        background-color: var(--color-violet-500);
        padding-inline: --spacing(5);
        padding-block: --spacing(2);
        font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
        color: var(--color-white);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
        &:hover {
          @media (hover: hover) {
            background-color: var(--color-violet-700);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  • Ek akeli HTML element se zyada jatil kisi bhi cheez ke liye template partials ko prathmikta do, taaki styles + structure ek saath band (encapsulated) rahein.

Takraav, !important aur prefix

  • Takraati classes: jab do classes ek hi CSS property ko target karti hain, to stylesheet me baad me aane wali class jeet-ti hai — class attribute me baad wali NAHI. <div class="grid flex"> ko display: grid milta hai kyunki bani hui stylesheet me .grid, .flex ke baad aata hai. Usool: ek hi element par do takraati classes kabhi mat jodo — sirf wahi jodo jo chahiye; code me conditional istemal karo:
jsx
  export function Example({ gridLayout }) {
    return <div className={gridLayout ? "grid" : "flex"}>{/* ... */}</div>;
  }

Component libraries me, styling customisations ke liye khaas props do — istemal karne walon ko bahar se extra classes jodne mat do, kyunki wo aksar takraati hain.

  • Utility ko zabardasti lagu karna: class name ke ant me ! jodo taaki saari declarations !important ho jayein: <div class="bg-teal-500 bg-red-500!"> → .bg-red-500\! { background-color: var(--color-red-500) !important; }. Sirf tab jab specificity sambhalne ka koi aur tareeka na ho.
  • Global important flag: @import "tailwindcss" important; SAAARI utilities ko !important bana deta hai — tab kaam ka hai jab Tailwind ko kisi aise project me jod rahe ho jahan pehle se jatil, high-specificity CSS hai. Compile hone par: @layer utilities { .flex { display: flex !important; } .gap-4 { gap: 1rem !important; } ... }.
  • Prefix option: agar project ke class names Tailwind utilities se takraate hain, to Tailwind ki bani saari classes aur CSS variables par prefix lagao: @import "tailwindcss" prefix(tw); → compile hone par .tw\:text-red-500 { color: var(--tw-color-red-500); } aur @layer theme me :root { --tw-color-red-500: oklch(...); }.

Interview me kaam ki baatein

  • "Ye to bas inline styles hi hain?" — jawab teeno farkon se do: design-system ki seemayein, state variants, media queries.
  • Takraav me faisla stylesheet ka kram karta hai, class-attribute ka kram nahi — ye classic chaal hai.
  • ! suffix (v4 syntax: bg-red-500!, ant me) banam global important import flag; naam-takraav ke liye prefix(tw).
  • Duplication ki ran-neeti: loops → multi-cursor → components/partials → (kabhi-kabhar) @layer components custom classes. Sabse pehle @apply-bhari custom classes ki taraf mat badho.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/styling-with-utility-classes
← Previous08 · Upgrade guide→ Next10 · Hover, focus, and other states
10Core concepts

Hover, focus, and other states

Is section me hum Hover, focus, and other states ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Coverage note: all 1507 lines read fully. Lines 1160–1507 (tail of the variant reference table + pseudo-class examples) were filled by a fresh re-read on 2026-11-21 ~20:37 UTC.

Core idea

  • Har utility class ko class name ki shuruaat me shart batane wala ek variant jodkar shart ke saath lagu kiya ja sakta hai: hover:bg-sky-700.
  • Paramparik CSS: ek class har state me alag kaam karti hai (.btn-primary { background: #0ea5e9; } .btn-primary:hover { background: #0369a1; }). Tailwind: har state ke liye alag classes (.bg-sky-500 + .hover\:bg-sky-700:hover { background-color: #0369a1; }). hover: class sirf :hover styles tay karti hai; default roop se ye kuch nahi karti.
  • Variants in sab ko cover karte hain: pseudo-classes (:hover, :focus, :first-child, :required); pseudo-elements (::before, ::after, ::placeholder, ::selection); media/feature queries (responsive breakpoints, dark mode, prefers-reduced-motion); attribute selectors ([dir="rtl"], [open]); child selectors (& > *, & *). Inhe stack bhi kiya ja sakta hai, jaise dark:md:hover:bg-fuchsia-600 (dark + medium breakpoint + hover).

Interactive states: hover / focus / active

html
<button class="bg-violet-500 hover:bg-violet-600 focus:outline-2 focus:outline-offset-2 focus:outline-violet-500 active:bg-violet-700 ...">
  Save changes
</button>

Dusre interactive variants: :visited, :focus-within, :focus-visible, aur kai aur (pseudo-class reference dekho).

Structural: first / last / odd / even / nth-*

  • first / last — first-child / last-child. odd / even — zebra-striping, jaise table rows:
html
  <tr class="odd:bg-white even:bg-gray-50 dark:odd:bg-gray-900/50 dark:even:bg-gray-950">…</tr>
  • nth-* / nth-last-* — position par aadharit, default roop se koi bhi number, jatil expressions ke liye arbitrary values jaise nth-[2n+1_of_li]:
html
  <div class="nth-3:underline"><!-- ... --></div>
  <div class="nth-last-5:underline"><!-- ... --></div>
  <div class="nth-of-type-4:underline"><!-- ... --></div>
  <div class="nth-last-of-type-6:underline"><!-- ... --></div>
  • Ye bhi hain: :only-child, :first-of-type, :empty, wagera.

Form states: required / invalid / disabled / checked …

  • States ko jodta hua example input (stack kiye hue focus:invalid: par dhyan do):
html
  <input type="text" value="tbone" disabled
    class="invalid:border-pink-500 invalid:text-pink-600 focus:border-sky-500 focus:outline focus:outline-sky-500 focus:invalid:border-pink-500 focus:invalid:outline-pink-500 disabled:border-gray-200 disabled:bg-gray-50 disabled:text-gray-500 disabled:shadow-none dark:disabled:border-gray-700 dark:disabled:bg-gray-800/20 ..." />
  • Fayda: variants templates me conditional logic kam kar dete hain — state kuch bhi ho, class set wahi rehta hai; browser sahi styles lagu kar deta hai.
  • Ye bhi hain: :read-only, :indeterminate, :checked, aur kai aur.

has-* — descendants ke hisaab se style

  • Kisi element ko uske descendants (neeche ke elements) ke state/content ke hisaab se style karo:
html
  <label class="has-checked:bg-indigo-50 has-checked:text-indigo-900 has-checked:ring-indigo-200 dark:has-checked:bg-indigo-950 dark:has-checked:text-indigo-200 dark:has-checked:ring-indigo-900 ...">
    <svg fill="currentColor"><!-- ... --></svg>
    Google Pay
    <input type="radio" class="checked:border-indigo-500 ..." />
  </label>
  • Pseudo-class ke saath: has-[:focus]; element selectors ke saath: has-[img], has-[a].
  • group-has-* — group se nishaan lage parent ke descendants par aadharit (example: icon sirf tab dikhao jab card me link ho: chhupe hue svg par group-has-[a]:block).
  • peer-has-* — peer se nishaan lage sibling ke descendants par aadharit (example: jab peer label ka checkbox checked ho to svg chhupao: peer-has-checked:hidden).

not- — negation (ulta karna)

  • Tab style karo jab koi shart sahi NA ho; dusre variants ke saath jodkar shaktishali, jaise hover sirf tab jab focused na ho:
html
  <button class="bg-indigo-600 hover:not-focus:bg-indigo-700"><!-- ... --></button>
  • Media variants ke saath bhi: not-supports-[display:grid]:flex, not-forced-colors:appearance-none.

group-* — parent ke state ke hisaab se style

html
<a href="#" class="group ...">
  <svg class="stroke-sky-500 group-hover:stroke-white ..." fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><!-- ... --></svg>
  <h3 class="text-gray-900 group-hover:text-white ...">New project</h3>
  <p class="text-gray-500 group-hover:text-white ...">Create a new project from a variety of starting templates.</p>
</a>
  • Har pseudo-class variant ke saath kaam karta hai: group-focus, group-active, group-odd, wagera.
  • Naam wale groups: parent ko group/{name} se ek anokha naam do, use group-hover/{name} ke roop me istemal karo — groups ko nest karte samay ye zaroori hai:
html
  <li class="group/item ...">
    <a class="group/edit invisible group-hover/item:visible ..." href="tel:{person.phone}">
      <span class="group-hover/edit:text-gray-700 ...">Call</span>
      <svg class="group-hover/edit:translate-x-0.5 group-hover/edit:text-gray-500 ..."><!-- ... --></svg>
    </a>
  </li>

Naam man-maane hain, koi configuration nahi chahiye.

  • Ek-baar-wale group variants: brackets me arbitrary selector: <div class="group is-published"><div class="hidden group-[.is-published]:block">Published</div></div>. .group kahan jayega ye batane ke liye & istemal karo: group-[:nth-of-type(3)_&]:block.

in-* — group jaisa, lekin parent ko mark kiye bina

html
<div tabindex="0">
  <div class="opacity-50 in-focus:opacity-100"><!-- ... --></div>
</div>
  • Ye KISI BHI parent ke state badlav par pratikriya deta hai, isliye bareek control ke liye iske bajaye group istemal karo.

peer-* — sibling ke state ke hisaab se style

html
<form>
  <label class="block">
    <span class="...">Email</span>
    <input type="email" class="peer ..." />
    <p class="invisible peer-invalid:visible ...">Please provide a valid email address.</p>
  </label>
</form>
  • Bina JS ke floating labels jaisi chaalein sambhav banata hai. Har pseudo-class ke saath kaam karta hai: peer-focus, peer-required, peer-disabled.
  • Sabse badi seema: peer marker sirf pichhle siblings par istemal ho sakta hai (CSS me subsequent-sibling combinator ~). Baad wale sibling ko mark karna kaam NAHI karta:
html
  <!-- Won't work, only previous siblings can be marked as peers -->
  <label>
    <span class="peer-invalid:text-red-500 ...">Email</span>
    <input type="email" class="peer ..." />
  </label>
  • Naam wale peers: peer/{name} + peer-checked/{name} (radio-group example: peer/draft, peer/published, saath me samjhane wale divs dikhane/chhupane ke liye peer-checked/draft:text-sky-500, peer-checked/draft:block). Koi configuration nahi chahiye.
  • Ek-baar-wale peer variants: peer-[.is-dirty]:peer-required:block; & ki jagah: peer-[:nth-of-type(3)_&]:block.

Pseudo-elements: before / after / placeholder / file / marker / selection / first-line / first-letter / backdrop

  • before / after — ::before/::after. Tailwind default roop se content: '' apne aap jod deta hai; sirf tab alag value do jab tum kuch aur chahte ho, jaise required-field ke asterisk ke liye after:content-['*']:
html
  <span class="text-gray-700 after:ml-0.5 after:text-red-500 after:content-['*'] ...">Email</span>

Highlight example: ek relative span ke peeche before:absolute before:-inset-1 before:block before:-skew-y-3 before:bg-pink-500.

Salaah: zyada tar cheezon ke liye tumhe asal me ::before/::after ki zaroorat nahi — ek asal HTML element aam taur par aasan hota hai aur code bhi kam lagta hai. Pseudo-elements ko tab ke liye bachakar rakho jab content ko DOM me NAHI hona chahiye / user use select na kar sake.

  • placeholder — ::placeholder: <input class="placeholder:text-gray-500 placeholder:italic ..." placeholder="Search for anything..." />
  • file — ::file-selector-button (file inputs ka button), hover/dark ke saath stack ho sakta hai:
html
  <input type="file" class="file:mr-4 file:rounded-full file:border-0 file:bg-violet-50 file:px-4 file:py-2 file:text-sm file:font-semibold file:text-violet-700 hover:file:bg-violet-100 dark:file:bg-violet-600 dark:file:text-violet-100 dark:hover:file:bg-violet-500 ..." />
  • marker — ::marker (list counters/bullets); ye inherit hota hai, isliye dohrane se bachne ke liye ye parent <ul> par lag sakta hai: <ul class="list-disc marker:text-sky-400 ...">.
  • selection — ::selection; inherit hota hai, poori site ke brand selection rang ke liye <body> par ek baar set ho sakta hai: <body class="selection:bg-pink-300">. Example: selection:bg-fuchsia-300 selection:text-fuchsia-900.
  • first-line / first-letter — drop-cap pattern: first-letter:float-left first-letter:mr-3 first-letter:text-7xl first-letter:font-bold first-letter:text-gray-900 first-line:tracking-widest first-line:uppercase.
  • backdrop — kisi native <dialog> ka ::backdrop: <dialog class="backdrop:bg-gray-50">. Khule/band states ke liye open variant bhi dekho.

Responsive aur container variants (saransh yahan; poori detail Responsive design page par)

  • Breakpoints: grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6.
  • Container queries: parent par @container, child par @md:flex-row — viewport ke bajaye kisi parent element ki chaudaai ke hisaab se style:
html
  <div class="@container"><div class="flex flex-col @md:flex-row"><!-- ... --></div></div>

Dark mode, motion, contrast, forced colours, pointer, orientation, noscript, print

  • Dark: koi variant nahi = light mode; dark: = overrides. <div class="bg-white dark:bg-gray-900 ...">.
  • Motion: prefers-reduced-motion. motion-reduce: tab styles jodta hai jab reduced motion maanga gaya ho (jaise spinner par motion-reduce:hidden); motion-safe: sirf tab jab NA maanga gaya ho — kam code lagta hai jab motion-reduce ka matlab styles ko "ulta karna" hota:
html
  <button class="transition hover:-translate-y-0.5 motion-reduce:transition-none motion-reduce:hover:translate-y-0 ...">Save changes</button>
  <button class="motion-safe:transition motion-safe:hover:-translate-x-0.5 ...">Save changes</button>
  • Contrast: prefers-contrast. contrast-more: (jaise contrast-more:border-gray-400 contrast-more:placeholder-gray-500, koi hint dikhane ke liye contrast-more:opacity-100); kam contrast ke liye contrast-less:.
  • Forced colours: forced-colors: jab user ne forced-colour mode chalu kiya ho (rang user ki palette se override ho jate hain). Example: kisi radio par forced-colors:appearance-auto, content badalne ke liye forced-colors:block / forced-colors:hidden. Ulta ke liye not-forced-colors:. Isse judi forced-color-adjust utilities bhi hain.
  • Ulte rang: inverted-colors: — jaise inverted-colors:shadow-none.
  • Pointer: pointer-fine (mouse/trackpad), pointer-coarse (touchscreen — bade click targets ke liye kaam ka: pointer-coarse:p-4 pointer-coarse:grid-cols-3), pointer-none; any-pointer-fine / any-pointer-coarse (kam se kam ek juda hua device); any-pointer-none. pointer sirf primary device ko target karta hai; any-pointer kisi bhi uplabdh device ko.
  • Orientation: portrait: / landscape: — jaise portrait me content chhupao, aur sirf-landscape wale experiences me "apna device ghumao" wala sandesh dikhao.
  • Noscript: noscript: — jaise <div class="hidden noscript:block"><p>This experience requires JavaScript…</p></div>.
  • Print: print: — jaise kisi gupt recipe article par print:hidden, "Are you seriously trying to print this?" wale sandesh par hidden print:block.

supports-* — feature queries

  • supports-[...] @supports rules banata hai; @supports (...) me istemal ho sakne wali har cheez leta hai, and/or samet:
html
  <div class="flex supports-[display:grid]:grid ..."><!-- ... --></div>
  • Chhota roop — sirf property ka naam (property ka support check karta hai, value nahi): supports-backdrop-filter:bg-black/25 supports-backdrop-filter:backdrop-blur.
  • Negation (ulta): not-supports-[display:grid]:flex.
  • supports-* namespace me custom shortcut:
css
  @custom-variant supports-grid {
    @supports (display: grid) {
      @slot;
    }
  }

Phir <div class="supports-grid:grid">.

starting variant

  • Jab koi element DOM me pehli baar render ho, ya display: none se dikhne lage (jaise popovers) tab ki dikhawat: popover div par starting:open:opacity-0.

aria-* variants

  • ARIA attributes ke hisaab se style: aria-checked:bg-sky-700 tab lagu hota hai jab aria-checked="true" ho.
  • Andar-bane boolean ARIA variants (sab ="true" se match karte hain): aria-busy (&[aria-busy="true"]), aria-checked, aria-disabled, aria-expanded, aria-hidden, aria-pressed, aria-readonly, aria-required, aria-selected.
  • Custom: @custom-variant aria-asc (&[aria-sort="ascending"]); @custom-variant aria-desc (&[aria-sort="descending"]);
  • Ek-baar-wale / value-khaas: arbitrary brackets, jaise aria-[sort=ascending]:bg-[url('/img/down-arrow.svg')] aria-[sort=descending]:bg-[url('/img/up-arrow.svg')].
  • Parent/sibling roop: group-aria-*, peer-aria-* (jaise group-aria-[sort=ascending]:rotate-0 group-aria-[sort=descending]:rotate-180).

data-* variants

  • Data attributes par aadharit. Sirf maujoodgi: data-active:border-purple-500 (agar data-active maujood ho to lagu, value kuch bhi ho). Khaas value: arbitrary brackets data-[size=large]:p-8.
  • data-* namespace me custom shortcut:
css
  @import "tailwindcss";
  @custom-variant data-checked (&[data-ui~="checked"]);

Phir <div data-ui="checked active" class="data-checked:underline">.

rtl / ltr variants

  • Kai dishaon wale layouts ke liye: ltr:ml-3 rtl:mr-3. Sirf tab kaam ke hain jab site DONO dishaon ko support karti ho; ek-disha wali sites ko inki zaroorat nahi.

open variant

  • Jab koi <details> ya <dialog> khula ho; popovers ke liye :popover-open ko bhi target karta hai:
html
  <details class="border border-transparent open:border-black/10 open:bg-gray-100 ..." open>…</details>
  <div popover id="my-popover" class="opacity-0 open:opacity-100 ..."><!-- ... --></div>

inert variant

  • inert attribute se nishaan lage elements ko style karo (jaise disabled fieldset par inert:opacity-50) — ye dikhne wala sanket hai ki content interactive nahi hai.

* aur ** — un bachon ko style karna jinhe tum control nahi karte

  • * — sirf seedhe (direct) children (:is(& > *)): <ul class="*:rounded-full *:border *:border-sky-100 *:bg-sky-50 *:px-2 *:py-0.5 ...">.
  • Chaal: kisi * style ko child par seedha utility lagakar override karna kaam NAHI karta — children rules aam rules ke baad bante hain aur unki specificity wahi hoti hai (<ul class="*:bg-sky-50"> ke andar <li class="bg-red-50"> sky hi rehta hai).
  • ** — SAARE descendants (:is(& *)), khaas taur par kisi dusre variant ke saath jodkar kaam ka: **:data-avatar:size-12 **:data-avatar:rounded-full.
  • Utilities ko seedha child elements par lagane ko prathmikta do; */** sirf un bachon ke liye istemal karo jinhe tum control nahi karte.

Arbitrary variants

  • Selector ko batane wale format strings, square brackets me; & = wo element khud. Underscore = space:
html
  <li class="[&.is-dragging]:cursor-grabbing">{item}</li>
  <li class="[&.is-dragging]:active:cursor-grabbing">{item}</li>
  <div class="[&_p]:mt-4"><!-- selects all p elements within --></div>
  • At-rules bhi kaam karte hain: <div class="flex [@supports(display:grid)]:grid">. At-rule custom variants ke saath & placeholder ki zaroorat nahi.
  • Agar dobara istemal ho, to uske bajaye use ek custom variant bana lo:
css
  @custom-variant theme-midnight (&:where([data-theme="midnight"] *));

Usage: <html data-theme="midnight"><button class="theme-midnight:bg-black ..."></button></html>.

(Table taaza dobara-padhaai se poori ki gayi hai — ab saari lines cover hain.)

Pseudo-class variant examples (page ke ant se)

  • hover — gehre div par hover:bg-white; focus — input par focus:border-blue-400; focus-within — wrapper div par focus-within:shadow-lg; focus-visible — button par focus-visible:outline-2 (sirf keyboard focus); active — active:bg-blue-600; visited — link par visited:text-purple-600; target — target:shadow-lg jab element ki ID URL fragment se match kare.
  • Structural: first (first:pt-0), last (last:pb-0), only (only:py-0), odd/even (zebra table rows: odd:bg-gray-100), first-of-type / last-of-type / only-of-type, nth-3 / nth-[3n+1], nth-last-3, nth-of-type-3, nth-last-of-type-3, empty (empty:hidden).
  • Form states: disabled (disabled:opacity-75), enabled (enabled:hover:border-gray-400), checked (checked:bg-blue-500), indeterminate (indeterminate:bg-gray-300), default (default:outline-2), optional / required, valid / invalid (valid:border-green-500, invalid:border-red-500), user-valid / user-invalid (sirf tab jab user pehle interact kar chuka ho), in-range / out-of-range (min/max attributes ke hisaab se), placeholder-shown, autofill (autofill:bg-yellow-200), read-only (read-only:bg-gray-100).
  • details-content — kisi <details> element ke content ko style karta hai: details-content:bg-gray-100.

Interview me kaam ki baatein

  • Tailwind me hover: asal me @media (hover: hover) { &:hover } hai — hover styles sirf-touch wale devices par default roop se chalte hi nahi.
  • peer sirf pichhle siblings par kaam karta hai; group ko parent par group class chahiye; in-* ko koi marker nahi chahiye lekin ye kam sateek hai.
  • * wali child styles ko child par lagi utilities se override nahi kiya ja sakta (specificity wahi, stylesheet me baad me aati hain).
  • has-* / group-has-* / peer-has-* tumhe kisi descendant ke state se parent ko style karne dete hain — yahi CSS :has() ka classic istemal hai.
  • Class name me stacking ka kram matlab ke liye mayne nahi rakhta, lekin dark:md:hover: wagera ko jodna mili-juli shartein batane ka standard tareeka hai.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/hover-focus-and-other-states
← Previous09 · Styling with utility classes→ Next11 · Responsive design
11Core concepts

Responsive design

Is section me hum Responsive design ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Core idea

  • Har utility class ko alag-alag breakpoints par shart ke saath lagu kiya ja sakta hai — HTML chhode bina jatil responsive interfaces banao.
  • Pehle ye zaroori hai: <head> me viewport meta tag jodo:
html
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  • Kisi utility ke aage breakpoint ka naam + : lagao: <img class="w-16 md:w-32 lg:w-48" src="..." /> (chaudaai default 16, medium par 32, large par 48).

Default breakpoints (5, mobile-first)

Breakpoint prefixMinimum widthCSS
sm40rem (640px)@media (width >= 40rem) { ... }
md48rem (768px)@media (width >= 48rem) { ... }
lg64rem (1024px)@media (width >= 64rem) { ... }
xl80rem (1280px)@media (width >= 80rem) { ... }
2xl96rem (1536px)@media (width >= 96rem) { ... }
  • Har utility class par kaam karta hai — tum kisi breakpoint par shabdasha kuch bhi badal sakte ho, letter spacing ya cursor styles tak.

Kaam karke dikhaya gaya example (marketing card)

html
<div class="mx-auto max-w-md overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-white shadow-md md:max-w-2xl">
  <div class="md:flex">
    <div class="md:shrink-0">
      <img class="h-48 w-full object-cover md:h-full md:w-48" src="/img/building.jpg" alt="Modern building architecture" />
    </div>
    <div class="p-8">
      <div class="text-sm font-semibold tracking-wide text-indigo-500 uppercase">Company retreats</div>
      <a href="#" class="mt-1 block text-lg leading-tight font-medium text-black hover:underline">Incredible accommodation for your team</a>
      <p class="mt-2 text-gray-500">Looking to take your team away on a retreat to enjoy awesome food and take in some sunshine? We have a list of places to do just that.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

Ye kaise kaam karta hai: bahari div default roop se display: block hai, md:flex use medium+ par flex bana deta hai; md:shrink-0 image ko md+ par sikudne se rokta hai (saada shrink-0 bhi kaam karta kyunki chhoti screens par ye kuch karta hi nahi, lekin prefix lagane se iraada saaf ho jata hai); image default roop se poori chaudaai ki hai, md:h-full md:w-48 use md+ par seemit kar deta hai.

Mobile-first — yahi hai asal soch (mental model)

  • Tailwind ek mobile-first breakpoint system istemal karta hai (Bootstrap ki tarah). Bina-prefix wali utilities (jaise uppercase) SAARE screen sizes par lagu hoti hain; prefix wali utilities (jaise md:uppercase) sirf us breakpoint aur usse upar lagu hoti hain.
  • Classic galti: sm: ka matlab "chhoti screens par" NAHI hai — iska matlab hai "small breakpoint par" (640px aur usse chaudi screens). Mobile ko target karne ke liye sm: istemal mat karo:
html
  <!-- Only centers text on screens 640px and wider, NOT on small screens -->
  <div class="sm:text-center"></div>
  <!-- Centers on mobile, left-aligns on 640px+ -->
  <div class="text-center sm:text-left"></div>
  • Kaam ka tareeka: pehle mobile layout banao, phir sm ke liye, phir md ke liye badlav jodte jao.

Breakpoint range ko target karna (max-* variants)

  • Default roop se md:flex md par lagu hota hai aur bade breakpoints par bhi lagu rehta hai. Use ek range tak seemit karne ke liye, ek responsive variant ko max-* variant ke saath stack karo:
html
  <div class="md:max-xl:flex"><!-- ... --></div>
  • max-* variants (har breakpoint ke liye ek):
VariantMedia query
max-sm@media (width < 40rem) { ... }
max-md@media (width < 48rem) { ... }
max-lg@media (width < 64rem) { ... }
max-xl@media (width < 80rem) { ... }
max-2xl@media (width < 96rem) { ... }
  • Ek hi (SINGLE) breakpoint ko target karne ke liye, breakpoint ko AGLE breakpoint ke max-* ke saath stack karo: <div class="md:max-lg:flex">.

Breakpoints ko customise karna (--breakpoint-* theme variables)

css
@import "tailwindcss";
@theme {
  --breakpoint-xs: 30rem;
  --breakpoint-2xl: 100rem;
  --breakpoint-3xl: 120rem;
}
  • 2xl ko 100rem kar deta hai (96rem se) aur markup me istemal ke liye naye xs aur 3xl breakpoints banata hai: <div class="grid xs:grid-cols-2 3xl:grid-cols-6">.
  • Zaroori baat: breakpoints ke liye hamesha ek hi unit istemal karo, warna bani hui utilities anchaahe kram me sort ho sakti hain aur breakpoint classes ek-dusre ko anchaahe dhang se override kar sakti hain. Defaults rem istemal karte hain, to custom walon ko bhi rem hi istemal karna chahiye.
  • Kisi default breakpoint ko initial par reset karke hatao: --breakpoint-2xl: initial;. Sab reset karke shuruaat se tay karo:
css
  @theme {
    --breakpoint-*: initial;
    --breakpoint-tablet: 40rem;
    --breakpoint-laptop: 64rem;
    --breakpoint-desktop: 80rem;
  }

Ek-baar-wale breakpoints (arbitrary values)

  • min / max variants turant (on the fly) ek custom breakpoint bana dete hain:
html
  <div class="max-[600px]:bg-sky-300 min-[320px]:text-center"><!-- ... --></div>

Container queries (viewport nahi, parent ke size se style)

  • Aadhunik CSS suvidha: viewport ke bajaye kisi parent element ke size ke hisaab se style karo — components portable/reusable ban jate hain kyunki wo asal uplabdh jagah ke hisaab se badalte hain.
  • Kisi element ko @container se inline-size container ke roop me nishaan lagao, phir bachon par @sm / @md variants istemal karo:
html
  <div class="@container">
    <div class="flex flex-col @md:flex-row"><!-- ... --></div>
  </div>
  • Container queries bhi mobile-first hain: target container size aur usse upar lagu hoti hain.
  • Below a size: @max-sm / @max-md: <div class="flex flex-row @max-md:flex-col">.
  • Range ko target karo: regular + max ko stack karo: @sm:@max-md:flex-col.
  • Naam wale containers (nested containers ke liye): @container/{name} + @sm/{name} / @md/{name} — sirf sabse paas wale par nahi, door ke container ke hisaab se style karo:
html
  <div class="@container/main">
    <div class="flex flex-row @sm/main:flex-col"><!-- ... --></div>
  </div>
  • Size containers: @container-size kisi element ko size container ke roop me nishaan lagata hai (sirf inline-size nahi) jab tumhe block size par nirbhar container query length units chahiye hon, jaise cqb: <div class="@container-size"><div class="h-[50cqb]"></div></div>. Naam bhi diya ja sakta hai: @container-size/{name}.
  • --container-* theme variables se custom container sizes:
css
  @theme { --container-8xl: 96rem; }

Phir <div class="flex flex-col @8xl:flex-row">.

  • Ek-baar-wale container sizes: @min-[475px] / @max-[960px]: <div class="flex flex-col @min-[475px]:flex-row">.
  • Container query length units arbitrary values ke roop me: w-[50cqw] (cqw/cqi istemal karta hai); inline size se zyada maangne wali units (cqb, cqh) ke liye, @container-size istemal karo.
  • Default container sizes (13): @3xs 16rem (256px), @2xs 18rem (288px), @xs 20rem (320px), @sm 24rem (384px), @md 28rem (448px), @lg 32rem (512px), @xl 36rem (576px), @2xl 42rem (672px), @3xl 48rem (768px), @4xl 56rem (896px), @5xl 64rem (1024px), @6xl 72rem (1152px), @7xl 80rem (1280px) — sab @container (width >= …) par.

Interview me kaam ki baatein

  • Mobile-first: bina prefix = mobile; sm: = 640px aur UPAR. sm:text-center wala jaal interview ki pasandeeda chaal hai.
  • Range targeting = md: ko max-lg: ke saath stack karo; single-breakpoint targeting = breakpoint + agle breakpoint ka max-*.
  • Container queries banam media queries: viewport banam parent ka size; @container + @md:; nesting ke liye naam wale containers; block-size units (cqb/cqh) ke liye @container-size.
  • Custom breakpoints sab ek hi unit (rem) istemal karein, warna sort order bigad jata hai.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/responsive-design
← Previous10 · Hover, focus, and other states→ Next12 · Dark mode
12Core concepts

Dark mode

Is section me hum Dark mode ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Core idea

  • Dark mode kai operating systems ki ek pramukh suvidha hai; Tailwind me dark variant shaamil hai taaki dark mode chalu hone par site ko alag tareeke se style kiya ja sake.
  • Pattern: bina-prefix wali utilities = light mode; dark: utilities = dark overrides:
html
  <div class="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg px-6 py-8 ring shadow-xl ring-gray-900/5">
    <h3 class="text-gray-900 dark:text-white mt-5 text-base font-medium tracking-tight">Writes upside-down</h3>
    <p class="text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 mt-2 text-sm">The Zero Gravity Pen can be used to write in any orientation, including upside-down. It even works in outer space.</p>
  </div>
  • Default roop se dark variant prefers-color-scheme CSS media feature istemal karta hai (OS-level ki pasand).

Class-based dark mode (haath se toggle)

  • dark variant ko prefers-color-scheme ke bajaye ek CSS selector se chalne ke liye override karo:
css
  @import "tailwindcss";
  @custom-variant dark (&:where(.dark, .dark *));
  • Phir dark:* utilities tab lagu hoti hain jab bhi dark class HTML tree me kahin upar maujood ho:
html
  <html class="dark">
    <body>
      <div class="bg-white dark:bg-black"><!-- ... --></div>
    </body>
  </html>
  • dark class <html> par kaise aayegi, ye tum par hai; ek aam tareeka hai JS jo class attribute ko update kare aur pasand ko localStorage ke saath sync kare.

Data-attribute dark mode

  • Uske bajaye attribute selector se override karo:
css
  @import "tailwindcss";
  @custom-variant dark (&:where([data-theme=dark], [data-theme=dark] *));
html
  <html data-theme="dark">
    <body>
      <div class="bg-white dark:bg-black"><!-- ... --></div>
    </body>
  </html>

Teen-tarfa toggle: light / dark / system

  • Ek custom dark-mode selector + window.matchMedia() istemal karke system theme ko pehchano aur zaroorat padne par <html> ko update karo. Example script (FOUC — bina-style content ki jhalak — se bachne ke liye ise <head> me inline jodna sabse achha hai):
js
  // On page load or when changing themes, best to add inline in `head` to avoid FOUC
  document.documentElement.classList.toggle(
    "dark",
    localStorage.theme === "dark" ||
      (!("theme" in localStorage) && window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches),
  );
  // Whenever the user explicitly chooses light mode
  localStorage.theme = "light";
  // Whenever the user explicitly chooses dark mode
  localStorage.theme = "dark";
  // Whenever the user explicitly chooses to respect the OS preference
  localStorage.removeItem("theme");
  • Logic: dark tab jab rakhi hui (stored) theme "dark" ho, YA jab koi stored theme na ho aur OS dark pasand karta ho. Light/dark chunna use store kar deta hai; system chunna stored value ko hata deta hai.
  • Tum ise jaise chaho sambhal sakte ho — pasand ko server-side database me rakhkar class ko server par render karna bhi chalega.

Interview me kaam ki baatein

  • Default dark: = prefers-color-scheme: dark media query; class/attribute wali strategies ke liye @custom-variant dark (...) chahiye — v4 me koi config flag nahi hai, ye ek variant override hai.
  • &:where(.dark, .dark *) — dhyan do, :where() specificity ko kam rakhta hai, aur , .dark * wala hissa descendants (neeche ke elements) ko cover karta hai.
  • FOUC: toggle script ko paint se pehle <head> me inline chalna chahiye.
  • Ek hi utility kabhi dono themes nahi rakhti; dark styling hamesha ek doosri, dark:-prefix wali class hoti hai.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/dark-mode
← Previous11 · Responsive design→ Next13 · Theme variables
13Core concepts

Theme variables

Is section me hum Theme variables ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Core idea

  • Tailwind custom designs ke liye hai; alag designs ko alag typography, rang, shadows, breakpoints chahiye hote hain. In buniyaadi design faislon ko design tokens kehte hain, jo theme variables me rakhe jate hain.
  • Theme variables wo khaas CSS variables hain jo @theme directive se tay hote hain aur ye tay karte hain ki tumhare project me kaunsi utility classes maujood hongi. Example — ek rang jodna:
css
  @import "tailwindcss";
  @theme {
    --color-mint-500: oklch(0.72 0.11 178);
  }

Ab bg-mint-500, text-mint-500, fill-mint-500 wagera maujood hain:

html
  <div class="bg-mint-500"><!-- ... --></div>
  • Tailwind theme variables ke liye aam CSS variables bhi banata hai, to tokens arbitrary values / inline styles me istemal ho sakte hain: <div style="background-color: var(--color-mint-500)">.

@theme banam :root

  • Theme variables sirf CSS variables nahi hain — ye Tailwind ko nayi utility classes banane ka nirdesh bhi dete hain. Khaas syntax inhe tay karna saaf banata hai; inhe top-level par tay karna hota hai, selectors ya media queries ke neeche nest karke nahi.
  • @theme tab istemal karo jab koi design token kisi utility class se judna chahiye; :root un aam CSS variables ke liye istemal karo jinki samkaksh utilities NAHI honi chahiye.

Static banam theme-driven utilities

  • Kuch utilities static hain aur hamesha waisi hi rehti hain (flex, object-cover). Kai dusri theme variables se chalti hain aur sirf isliye maujood hain kyunki wo variables tay kiye gaye hain.
  • Example: --font-* namespace saari font-family utilities tay karta hai. Default theme (tailwindcss/theme.css) --font-sans (system stack), --font-serif (ui-serif, Georgia…), --font-mono (ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo…) tay karta hai. font-sans/font-serif/font-mono sirf isliye hain kyunki ye variables hain.
  • --font-poppins: Poppins, sans-serif; jodne se font-poppins uplabdh ho jata hai: <h1 class="font-poppins">This headline will use Poppins.</h1>. Kisi namespace ke andar variables ke naam azaadi se rakho; usi naam ki utility ban jayegi.
  • Kuch namespaces utilities ki jagah variants tay karte hain: --breakpoint-* responsive variants tay karta hai — --breakpoint-3xl: 120rem; 3xl:* ko chalu karta hai (<div class="3xl:grid-cols-6 grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4">).

Namespace → utility mapping (page se poori table)

NamespaceUtility classes
--color-*Colour utilities like bg-red-500, text-sky-300, and many more
--font-*Font family utilities like font-sans
--text-*Font size utilities like text-xl
--font-weight-*Font weight utilities like font-bold
--tracking-*Letter spacing utilities like tracking-wide
--leading-*Line height utilities like leading-tight
--tab-size-*Tab size utilities like tab-github
--breakpoint-*Responsive breakpoint variants like sm:*
--container-*Container query variants like @sm:* and size utilities like max-w-md
--spacing-*Spacing/sizing utilities like px-4, max-h-16, and many more
--radius-*Border radius utilities like rounded-sm
--shadow-*Box shadow utilities like shadow-md
--inset-shadow-*Inset box shadow utilities like inset-shadow-xs
--drop-shadow-*Drop shadow filter utilities like drop-shadow-md
--blur-*Blur filter utilities like blur-md
--perspective-*Perspective utilities like perspective-near
--zoom-*Zoom utilities like zoom-compact
--aspect-*Aspect ratio utilities like aspect-video
--ease-*Transition timing utilities like ease-out
--animate-*Animation utilities like animate-spin

@import "tailwindcss" asal me kya import karta hai

css
@layer theme, base, components, utilities;
@import "./theme.css" layer(theme);
@import "./preflight.css" layer(base);
@import "./utilities.css" layer(utilities);
