  • theme.css = default colour palette, type scale, shadows, fonts, wagera. bg-red-200, font-serif, shadow-sm jaisi utilities seedha box se isliye maujood hain kyunki default theme inhe tay karta hai — flex-col ya pointer-events-none ki tarah hardcoded nahi hain.

Customise karna: badhana (extend), badalna (override), reset karna

  • Extend (jodo): @theme { --font-script: Great Vibes, cursive; } → nayi font-script utility, defaults bane rehte hain.
  • Ek value override karo: use @theme me dobara tay karo — --breakpoint-sm: 30rem; sm:* ko 40rem ki jagah 30rem par trigger karta hai.
  • Poora namespace override karo: asterisk syntax se use initial set karo, phir apne values tay karo:
css
  @theme {
    --color-*: initial;
    --color-white: #fff;
    --color-purple: #3f3cbb;
    --color-midnight: #121063;
    --color-tahiti: #3ab7bf;
    --color-bermuda: #78dcca;
  }

Us namespace ko istemal karne wali saari default utilities (jaise bg-red-500) hat jati hain; sirf custom values (jaise bg-midnight) rehti hain.

  • Poora default theme band karo: --*: initial; phir sirf custom values tay karo:
css
  @theme {
    --*: initial;
    --spacing: 4px;
    --font-body: Inter, sans-serif;
    --color-lagoon: oklch(0.72 0.11 221.19);
    --color-coral: oklch(0.74 0.17 40.24);
    --color-driftwood: oklch(0.79 0.06 74.59);
    --color-tide: oklch(0.49 0.08 205.88);
    --color-dusk: oklch(0.82 0.15 72.09);
  }

Koi default theme-driven utility nahi bachti; sirf custom variables se milti classes (font-body, text-dusk) kaam karti hain.

Animations: @theme ke andar @keyframes

css
@theme {
  --animate-fade-in-scale: fade-in-scale 0.3s ease-out;
  @keyframes fade-in-scale {
    0% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.95); }
    100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
  }
}
  • Bani hui CSS me shaamil karne ke liye @keyframes ko @theme ke andar tay karo. Custom keyframes ko hamesha shaamil karne ke liye — bina kisi --animate-* variable ke bhi — unhe @theme ke bahar tay karo.

@theme inline — dusre variables ko reference karne wale variables

css
@theme inline {
  --font-sans: var(--font-inter);
}
  • inline ke saath, utility variable ko reference karne ke bajaye theme variable ki value istemal karti hai: .font-sans { font-family: var(--font-inter); }.
  • inline ke bina, resolution chaunka sakta hai: var(--font-sans) wahan resolve hota hai jahan --font-sans tay hai (jaise #parent par), aur agar --font-inter sirf tree me gehraai par tay ho (jaise #child par), to text Inter ke bajaye sans-serif par wapas gir jata hai. Jab koi theme variable dusre variable ko reference kare, to inline istemal karo.

@theme static — saare variables hamesha nikalo

  • Default roop se antim output me sirf istemal hue CSS variables bante hain. @theme static hamesha saare banata hai:
css
  @theme static {
    --color-primary: var(--color-red-500);
    --color-secondary: var(--color-blue-500);
  }

Theme variables ko projects ke beech saajha karna

  • Theme variables CSS hain, isliye unhe unki apni CSS file ke zariye saajha karo jo har project me import ho (monorepo package ya NPM par published):
css
  /* ./packages/brand/theme.css */
  @theme {
    --*: initial;
    --spacing: 4px;
    --font-body: Inter, sans-serif;
    --color-lagoon: oklch(0.72 0.11 221.19);
    /* ... */
  }
css
  /* ./packages/admin/app.css */
  @import "tailwindcss";
  @import "../brand/theme.css";

Theme variables ka istemal — compiled CSS, custom CSS, arbitrary values, JS me

  • Compile hone par saare theme variables :root par aam CSS variables ban jate hain (page par poora :root dump hai) — kisi bhi design token ko custom CSS ya inline styles me istemal karo.
  • Custom CSS me (us HTML ke liye kaam ka jise tum control nahi karte, jaise DB/API se aaya Markdown):
css
  @layer components {
    .typography {
      p { font-size: var(--text-base); color: var(--color-gray-700); }
      h1 { font-size: var(--text-2xl--line-height); font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold); color: var(--color-gray-950); }
      h2 { font-size: var(--text-xl); font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold); color: var(--color-gray-950); }
    }
  }

Kisi font-size variable ke saath judi line-height ke liye --text-2xl--line-height wale roop par dhyan do.

  • calc() ke saath arbitrary values me — concentric border radius example: kisi nested inset element par rounded-[calc(var(--radius-xl)-1px)] (--radius-xl se 1px ghatao).
  • JS me: CSS variables seedha istemal karo (jaise Motion library: <motion.div animate={{ backgroundColor: "var(--color-blue-500)" }} />). Hal ki hui (resolved) value ke liye: getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue("--shadow-xl").

Default theme reference (page par diya gaya, tailwindcss/theme.css)

  • Fonts: --font-sans system stack; --font-serif ui-serif/Georgia/Cambria/Times; --font-mono ui-monospace/SFMono-Regular/Menlo/Monaco/Consolas.
  • Rang (oklch): red, orange, amber, yellow, lime, green, emerald, teal, cyan, sky, blue, indigo, violet, purple, fuchsia, pink, rose, slate, gray, zinc, neutral, stone ke poore 50–950 scales, saath me mauve, olive, mist, taupe (default theme dump me maujood extra parivaar); --color-black: #000; --color-white: #fff;. Example values: --color-red-500: oklch(63.7% 0.237 25.331), --color-sky-500: oklch(68.5% 0.169 237.323).
  • Spacing: --spacing: 0.25rem (mool ikai / base unit; spacing utilities isi ke multiples hain).
  • Breakpoints: sm 40rem, md 48rem, lg 64rem, xl 80rem, 2xl 96rem. Containers: 3xs 16rem … 7xl 80rem.
  • Text sizes (+ saath judi line-heights): xs 0.75rem (lh calc(1/0.75)), sm 0.875rem (1.25/0.875), base 1rem (1.5/1), lg 1.125rem (1.75/1.125), xl 1.25rem (1.75/1.25), 2xl 1.5rem (2/1.5), 3xl 1.875rem (2.25/1.875), 4xl 2.25rem (2.5/2.25), 5xl 3rem (lh 1), 6xl 3.75rem (1), 7xl 4.5rem (1), 8xl 6rem (1), 9xl 8rem (1).
  • Font weights: thin 100, extralight 200, light 300, normal 400, medium 500, semibold 600, bold 700, extrabold 800, black 900.
  • Tracking: tighter -0.05em, tight -0.025em, normal 0em, wide 0.025em, wider 0.05em, widest 0.1em. Leading: tight 1.25, snug 1.375, normal 1.5, relaxed 1.625, loose 2.
  • Radius: xs 0.125rem, sm 0.25rem, md 0.375rem, lg 0.5rem, xl 0.75rem, 2xl 1rem, 3xl 1.5rem, 4xl 2rem.
  • Shadows: 2xs 0 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05), xs, sm, md, lg, xl, 2xl 0 25px 50px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25); inset-shadow 2xs/xs/sm; drop-shadow xs–2xl; text-shadow 2xs–lg.
  • Blur: xs 4px, sm 8px, md 12px, lg 16px, xl 24px, 2xl 40px, 3xl 64px.
  • Perspective: dramatic 100px, near 300px, normal 500px, midrange 800px, distant 1200px.
  • Aspect: --aspect-video: 16 / 9. Ease: in cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1), out (0, 0, 0.2, 1), in-out (0.4, 0, 0.2, 1).
  • Animations: spin spin 1s linear infinite, ping ping 1s cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite, pulse pulse 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite, bounce bounce 1s infinite; keyframes: spin → rotate(360deg); ping 75%/100% par scale(2), opacity 0; pulse 50% par opacity 0.5; bounce 0%/100% par cubic-bezier(0.8, 0, 1, 1) ke saath translateY(-25%), 50% par cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1) ke saath koi nahi.

Interview me kaam ki baatein

  • @theme utilities banata hai; :root nahi. Yahi tay karne wala fark hai.
  • Kisi namespace ko reset karna (--color-*: initial) uski default utilities mita deta hai; --*: initial poora default theme mita deta hai.
  • --spacing: 0.25rem poori spacing scale ke peeche ki ekmatra base unit hai.
  • inline banam default: variable-reference ke resolution ka kram (parent banam child definition) ek bareek chaal hai.
  • Default theme theme layer me theme.css ke zariye import hota hai — cascade layers hain theme, base, components, utilities.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/theme
← Previous12 · Dark mode→ Next14 · Colors
14Core concepts

Colors

Is section me hum Colors ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Default palette

  • Seedha box se ek vishal palette, maahir designers ke dwara dhyan se banayi gayi, kai design styles ke liye sahi. Values OKLCH me hain (OKLCH value copy karne ke liye click karo, sabse kareeb wala hex copy karne ke liye shift+click).
  • 26 rang-parivaar: red, orange, amber, yellow, lime, green, emerald, teal, cyan, sky, blue, indigo, violet, purple, fuchsia, pink, rose, slate, gray, zinc, neutral, stone, taupe, mauve, mist, olive — saath me black (#000) aur white (#fff).
  • Har rang ke 11 steps hain: 50, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 700, 800, 900, 950 — 50 sabse halka, 950 sabse gehra. Example (sky):
html
  <div>
    <div class="bg-sky-50"></div><div class="bg-sky-100"></div><div class="bg-sky-200"></div>
    <div class="bg-sky-300"></div><div class="bg-sky-400"></div><div class="bg-sky-500"></div>
    <div class="bg-sky-600"></div><div class="bg-sky-700"></div><div class="bg-sky-800"></div>
    <div class="bg-sky-900"></div><div class="bg-sky-950"></div>
  </div>
  • Poori palette rang se judi saari utilities me uplabdh hai.

Colour utilities (page se poori list)

UtilityDescription
bg-*Background color
text-*Text color
decoration-*Text decoration color
border-*Border color
outline-*Outline color
shadow-*Color of box shadows
inset-shadow-*Color of inset box shadows
ring-*Color of ring shadows
inset-ring-*Color of inset ring shadows
accent-*Accent color of form controls
caret-*Caret color in form controls
scrollbar-thumb-*Thumb color of an element's scrollbar
scrollbar-track-*Track color of an element's scrollbar
fill-*Fill color of SVG elements
stroke-*Stroke color of SVG elements

Example usage:

html
<div class="flex items-center gap-4 rounded-lg bg-white p-6 shadow-md outline outline-black/5 dark:bg-gray-800">
  <span class="inline-flex shrink-0 rounded-full border border-pink-300 bg-pink-100 p-2 dark:border-pink-300/10 dark:bg-pink-400/10">
    <svg class="size-6 stroke-pink-700 dark:stroke-pink-500"><!-- ... --></svg>
  </span>
  <div>
    <p class="text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-400"><span class="font-medium text-gray-950 dark:text-white">Tom Watson</span> mentioned you in <span class="font-medium text-gray-950 dark:text-white">Logo redesign</span></p>
    <time class="mt-1 block text-gray-500" datetime="9:37">9:37am</time>
  </div>
</div>

Opacity modifier (/alpha)

  • bg-black/75 alpha channel ko 75% set karta hai. Steps ka example: bg-sky-500/10 … bg-sky-500/100.
  • Arbitrary values aur CSS variable shorthand dono ko support karta hai:
html
  <div class="bg-pink-500/[71.37%]"><!-- ... --></div>
  <div class="bg-cyan-400/(--my-alpha-value)"><!-- ... --></div>

Dark mode ke rang

  • dark: variant: dark:bg-gray-800 sirf tab lagu hota hai jab dark mode active ho (Dark mode page wala wahi Zero Gravity Pen card example).

Rang CSS variables ke roop me

  • Rang --color-* namespace me CSS variables ke roop me milte hain — CSS me var(--color-blue-500), var(--color-pink-700) ke roop me istemal karo:
css
  @layer components {
    .typography {
      color: var(--color-gray-950);
      a {
        color: var(--color-blue-500);
        &:hover { color: var(--color-blue-800); }
      }
    }
  }
  • Utilities me arbitrary values ke roop me, jaise bg-[light-dark(var(--color-white),var(--color-gray-950))] (native light-dark() function).
  • --alpha() function — CSS me kisi rang ko variable ke roop me istemal karte samay uski opacity turant badlo:
css
  @layer components {
    .DocSearch-Hit--Result {
      background-color: --alpha(var(--color-gray-950) / 10%);
    }
  }

Palette ko customise karna

  • --color-* ke neeche custom rang jodo:
css
  @theme {
    --color-midnight: #121063;
    --color-tahiti: #3ab7bf;
    --color-bermuda: #78dcca;
  }

Phir bg-midnight, text-tahiti, fill-bermuda defaults ke saath uplabdh ho jate hain.

  • Kisi default rang ko wahi naam dobara tay karke override karo — page ka example poori gray scale ko OKLCH me dobara tay karta hai (jaise --color-gray-500: oklch(0.554 0.046 257.417), --color-gray-950: oklch(0.129 0.042 264.695)).
  • Kisi default rang-parivaar ko uske namespace ko initial set karke band karo — ye uske CSS variables ko bhi output se hata deta hai:
css
  @theme {
    --color-lime-*: initial;
    --color-fuchsia-*: initial;
  }
  • SAARE default rang band karke apni palette tay karo:
css
  @theme {
    --color-*: initial;
    --color-white: #fff;
    --color-purple: #3f3cbb;
    --color-midnight: #121063;
    --color-tahiti: #3ab7bf;
    --color-bermuda: #78dcca;
  }
  • Dusre rangon ko istemal karne wale rang: @theme inline istemal karo:
css
  :root { --acme-canvas-color: oklch(0.967 0.003 264.542); }
  [data-theme="dark"] { --acme-canvas-color: oklch(0.21 0.034 264.665); }
  @theme inline {
    --color-canvas: var(--acme-canvas-color);
  }

Ye pattern kisi token ko ek saadhe CSS variable ke zariye har theme (light/dark) ke hisaab se value badalne deta hai.

Default rangon ki values (reference)

  • Page saare 26 parivaaron ke har 50–950 step ki poori OKLCH value deta hai (Theme variables page ke dump jaisi hi values — upar Theme variables section me "Default theme reference" dekho; ~280 values yahan dobara nahi di gayi hain). Khaas anchor values: --color-red-500: oklch(63.7% 0.237 25.331), --color-sky-500: oklch(68.5% 0.169 237.323), --color-blue-500: oklch(62.3% 0.214 259.815), --color-gray-950: oklch(13% 0.028 261.692), --color-black: #000, --color-white: #fff.
  • Page ki antim baat: poori list tab kaam ki hai jab tum kisi scale ko dusre naam se dobara istemal karna chahte ho, jaise --color-gray-* ko naye sire se tay karke --color-slate-* scale istemal karna.

Interview me kaam ki baatein

  • Har rang ke 11 steps (50–950), 26 parivaar; values OKLCH me hain, hex me nahi.
  • /<number> suffix se opacity kisi bhi colour utility par kaam karti hai, arbitrary [71.37%] aur variable (--my-alpha-value) wale roopon samet.
  • --alpha(var(--color-x) / N%) CSS ki taraf ka /N modifier ke barabar hai.
  • Jo theme rang dusre (jaise theme-switching) variables ko reference karte hain, unke liye @theme inline zaroori hai.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/colors
← Previous13 · Theme variables→ Next15 · Adding custom styles
15Core concepts

Adding custom styles

Is section me hum Adding custom styles ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Overview

  • Tailwind projects me apni custom styles jodne ke best practices. Tailwind shuruaat se hi is tareeke se bana hai ki use badhaya/customise kiya ja sake, taaki tumhe kabhi framework se ladna na pade.
  • Isme shaamil hai: design tokens ko customise karna, zaroorat padne par seemaon se bahar nikalna, custom CSS jodna, aur plugins se framework ko badhana.

1. @theme se design tokens customise karo

  • @theme ke zariye colour palette, spacing scale, typography scale, breakpoints wagera badlo:
css
  @theme {
    --font-display: "Satoshi", "sans-serif";
    --breakpoint-3xl: 120rem;
    --color-avocado-100: oklch(0.99 0 0);
    --color-avocado-200: oklch(0.98 0.04 113.22);
    --color-avocado-300: oklch(0.94 0.11 115.03);
    --color-avocado-400: oklch(0.92 0.19 114.08);
    --color-avocado-500: oklch(0.84 0.18 117.33);
    --color-avocado-600: oklch(0.53 0.12 118.34);
    --ease-fluid: cubic-bezier(0.3, 0, 0, 1);
    --ease-snappy: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1);
    /* ... */
  }

2. Arbitrary values — seemaon se bahar niklo

  • Jab tumhe ek-baar-wali pixel-perfect value chahiye ho (jaise top: 117px), to square-bracket notation istemal karke turant ek class banao:
html
  <div class="top-[117px]"><!-- ... --></div>
  • Inline styles ki tarah, lekin interactive/responsive modifiers ke saath joda ja sakta hai:
html
  <div class="top-[117px] lg:top-[344px]"><!-- ... --></div>
  <div class="bg-[#bada55] text-[22px] before:content-['Festivus']"><!-- ... --></div>

Har cheez par kaam karta hai: background ke rang, font sizes, pseudo-element content, wagera.

  • CSS variable shorthand: fill-(--my-brand-color) fill-[var(--my-brand-color)] ka shorthand hai — var() apne aap jod deta hai.

3. Arbitrary properties — wo CSS properties jinki koi utility nahi

html
<div class="[mask-type:luminance]"><!-- ... --></div>
<div class="[mask-type:luminance] hover:[mask-type:alpha]"><!-- ... --></div>
  • Un CSS variables ke liye bhi kaam ka jo sharton ke hisaab se badalte hain: <div class="[--scroll-offset:56px] lg:[--scroll-offset:44px]">.

4. Arbitrary variants

  • Arbitrary values ki tarah, lekin turant selector badalne ke liye (andar-bane hover: / md: ke muqable):
html
  <li class="lg:[&:nth-child(-n+3)]:hover:underline">{item}</li>

5. Arbitrary values me underscores = spaces

  • Space ki jagah _ istemal karo; Tailwind build time par use badal deta hai: grid-cols-[1fr_500px_2fr].
  • Jahan underscores aam hain lekin spaces nahi chalte, wahan Tailwind underscore ko surakshit rakhta hai (URLs): bg-[url('/what_a_rush.png')].
  • Jahan space bhi valid ho wahan ek shabdik underscore majboor karne ke liye, use escape karo: before:content-['hello\_world']. JSX me (render hue HTML se backslash hat jata hai), String.raw istemal karo: <div className={String.rawbefore:content-['hello\_world']`}>.

6. Uljhe hue (ambiguous) namespaces aur type hints

  • Utilities sharing a namespace map to different properties (text-lg = font-size, text-black = colour). Tailwind usually infers from the value: text-[22px] → font-size; text-[#bada55] → colour.
  • CSS variables ke saath ye asal me uljha hua hai: text-(--my-var). Value se pehle ek CSS data type dekar type ka sanket do:
html
  <!-- font-size --><div class="text-(length:--my-var)">...</div>
  <!-- color --><div class="text-(color:--my-var)">...</div>

7. Saadi CSS hamesha chalti hai

css
@import "tailwindcss";
.my-custom-style { /* ... */ }
  • Page defaults: sabse aasan hai html/body par classes: <html lang="en" class="bg-gray-100 font-serif text-gray-900"> — isse base faisle markup me rehte hain, kisi file me chhupe nahi.
  • Base layer (@layer base): khaas HTML elements ke liye default base styles:
css
  @layer base {
    h1 { font-size: var(--text-2xl); }
    h2 { font-size: var(--text-xl); }
  }
  • Components layer (@layer components): zyada jatil classes jinhe tum phir bhi utilities se override karwana chahte ho — paramparik roop se card, btn, badge:
css
  @layer components {
    .card {
      background-color: var(--color-white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: --spacing(6);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
    }
  }

Utilities inhe ab bhi override kar sakti hain: <div class="card rounded-none"> → chaukor konon wala card. Tumhe shayad in classes ki utni zaroorat nahi jitni tum sochte ho ("managing duplication" wali salaah dekho). Components layer third-party components ki custom styles ke liye bhi achhi jagah hai (jaise .select2-dropdown).

8. @variant — custom CSS ke andar variants

css
.my-element {
  background: white;
  @variant dark {
    background: black;
  }
}

Compile hone par: .my-element { background: white; @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { background: black; } }

  • Kai variants stack karo (HTML jaisa hi syntax): @variant hover:focus { background: black; } → compile hone par &:hover { @media (hover: hover) { &:focus { background: black; } } }.
  • Kai variants (OR): comma se alag karo — @variant hover, focus { background: black; } → alag &:hover aur &:focus rules.

9. @utility — custom utilities

  • Un CSS features ke liye jinki Tailwind ke paas koi utility nahi. Saral utility:
css
  @utility content-auto {
    content-visibility: auto;
  }

Istemaal: <div class="content-auto">; variants ke saath kaam karta hai: hover:content-auto. Custom utilities andar-bani utilities ke saath utilities layer me ghusayi jati hain.

  • Nesting ke saath jatil utility:
css
  @utility scrollbar-hidden {
    &::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
  }
  • Functional utilities (jo argument leti hain) — --value() function value ko resolve karta hai:
css
  @utility tab-* {
    tab-size: --value(--tab-size-*);
  }
  • --value(--theme-key-*) — theme keys ke hisaab se resolve karo. @theme { --tab-size-2: 2; --tab-size-4: 4; --tab-size-github: 8; } ke saath, tab-2, tab-4, tab-github match karte hain.
  • --value({type}) — bare value ko data type ke roop me jaancha gaya: --value(integer) tab-1, tab-76 se match karta hai. Bare value data types: number, integer, ratio, percentage.
  • --value('literal') — literal values (quotes par dhyan do): --value("inherit", "initial", "unset") tab-inherit, tab-initial, tab-unset se match karta hai.
  • --value([{type}]) — arbitrary values (square brackets par dhyan do): --value([integer]) tab-[1], tab-[76] se match karta hai. Arbitrary value data types: absolute-size, angle, bg-size, color, family-name, generic-name, image, integer, length, line-width, number, percentage, position, ratio, relative-size, url, vector, *.
  • Kai declarations: teeno roop ek hi rule me kai declarations ke roop me istemal ho sakte hain; jo declarations resolve nahi hotin, wo chhod di jati hain:
css
    @utility tab-* {
      tab-size: --value([integer]);
      tab-size: --value(integer);
      tab-size: --value(--tab-size-*);
    }

Isse tum har case me value ko alag tareeke se le sakte ho, jaise kisi bare integer ko percentage me badalna:

css
    @utility opacity-* {
      opacity: --value([percentage]);
      opacity: calc(--value(integer) * 1%);
      opacity: --value(--opacity-*);
    }
  • Kai arguments (baayein se daayein): --value(--tab-size-*, integer, [integer]) agar tumhe har case ki alag handling nahi chahiye.
  • --default(): jab bina saaf value ke istemal ho to default value:
css
    @utility tab-* {
      tab-size: --value(integer, --default(4));
    }

tab-2, tab-4, aur saade tab (= 4) se match karta hai. Compile hone par: .tab { tab-size: 4; } .tab-2 { tab-size: 2; }.

  • --modifier(): --value() ki tarah, lekin modifier (/ ke baad wale hisse) par kaam karta hai:
css
    @utility text-* {
      font-size: --value(--text-*, [length]);
      line-height: --modifier(--leading-*, [length], [*]);
    }

Agar koi modifier maujood na ho, to us par nirbhar declarations chhod di jati hain. --default() --modifier() ke andar bhi kaam karta hai: line-height: --modifier(integer, --default(1)); → tab-2/3 ki line-height 3 hai, tab-2 ki line-height 1.

  • ratio ke zariye fractions: ratio ke saath --value() value + modifier ko ek hi value maanta hai:
css
    @utility aspect-* {
      aspect-ratio: --value(--aspect-ratio-*, ratio, [ratio]);
    }

aspect-square, aspect-3/4, aspect-[7/9] se match karta hai.

  • Negative values: alag positive aur negative utilities register karo:
css
    @utility inset-* {
      inset: --spacing(--value(integer));
      inset: --value([percentage], [length]);
    }
    @utility -inset-* {
      inset: --spacing(--value(integer) * -1);
      inset: calc(--value([percentage], [length]) * -1);
    }

10. @custom-variant — custom variants

css
@custom-variant theme-midnight {
  &:where([data-theme="midnight"] *) {
    @slot;
  }
}

Usage: <html data-theme="midnight"><button class="theme-midnight:bg-black ..."></button></html>.

  • Jab nesting na chahiye to shorthand: @custom-variant theme-midnight (&:where([data-theme="midnight"] *));
  • Kai nested rules: @custom-variant any-hover { @media (any-hover: hover) { &:hover { @slot; } } } — @slot wo jagah hai jahan utility ki declarations jati hain.

Interview me kaam ki baatein

  • Bachne ke raaste, pasand ke kram me: @theme tokens → arbitrary values […] → arbitrary properties [prop:value] → layers me saadi CSS → dobara-istemal yogya framework-level jod ke liye @utility / @custom-variant.
  • @layer base banam components banam utilities: base = element defaults, components = override ho sakne wali classes, utilities = ek-kaam-wali (custom utilities apne aap yahin aati hain).
  • --value() / --modifier() / --default() wo teen functions hain jo functional utilities ko chalate hain; bare-value types sirf number, integer, ratio, percentage hain.
  • CSS me @variant HTML ke variant prefixes ki parchhai hai — stacking (hover:focus) aur comma se alag OR (hover, focus) samet.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/adding-custom-styles
← Previous14 · Colors→ Next16 · Detecting classes in source files
16Core concepts

Detecting classes in source files

Is section me hum Detecting classes in source files ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Detection kaise kaam karta hai

  • Tailwind tumhare project ko utility classes ke liye scan karta hai, phir asal me istemal hui classes ke hisaab se saari zaroori CSS banata hai — isse CSS jitni ho sake chhoti rehti hai, aur arbitrary values jaisi features sambhav hoti hain.
  • Ye saari source files ko saada text maanta hai aur unhe kisi bhi tareeke se code ki tarah parse nahi karta. Ye bas un tokens ko dhoondhta hai jo classes ho sakte hain, class names me ummeed kiye jaane wale characters ke hisaab se. Example (JSX):
jsx
  export function Button({ color, children }) {
    const colors = {
      black: "bg-black text-white",
      blue: "bg-blue-500 text-white",
      white: "bg-white text-black",
    };
    return (
      <button className={`${colors[color]} rounded-full px-2 py-1.5 font-sans text-sm/6 font-medium shadow`}>
        {children}
      </button>
    );
  }

Phir ye un saare tokens ke liye CSS banata hai, aur jo tokens kisi jaani utility se nahi judte unhe phenk deta hai.

Sunahra usool: class names kabhi dynamically mat banao

  • Saade-text ki scanning string concatenation ya interpolation ko samajh hi nahi sakti.
  • Aisa mat karo — text-red-600 / text-green-600 kabhi poori strings ke roop me dikhte hi nahi, isliye ye bante NAHI hain:
html
  <div class="text-{{ error ? 'red' : 'green' }}-600"></div>
  • Aisa karo — poore class names poori tarah likho:
html
  <div class="{{ error ? 'text-red-600' : 'text-green-600' }}"></div>
  • Props se class names dynamically mat banao (React/Vue):
jsx
  function Button({ color, children }) {
    return <button className={`bg-${color}-600 hover:bg-${color}-500 ...`}>{children}</button>;
  }
  • Props ko poore, statically pehchane ja sakne wale class names se jodo:
jsx
  function Button({ color, children }) {
    const colorVariants = {
      blue: "bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500",
      red: "bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-500",
    };
    return <button className={`${colorVariants[color]} ...`}>{children}</button>;
  }

Bonus: alag prop values alag shades se jud sakti hain:

jsx
  const colorVariants = {
    blue: "bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white",
    red: "bg-red-500 hover:bg-red-400 text-white",
    yellow: "bg-yellow-300 hover:bg-yellow-400 text-black",
  };
  • Jab tak tum hamesha poore class names istemal karte ho, Tailwind har baar saari CSS bilkul sahi banata hai.

Default roop se kya scan hota hai / kya ignore hota hai

  • Tailwind project ki har file ko scan karta hai, INKE ALAWA:
    • .gitignore me padi files
    • node_modules me padi files
    • Binary files (images, videos, zip files)
    • CSS files
    • Aam package-manager lock files

Saaf taur par diye sources: @source

  • Sources ko saaf taur par register karo (paths stylesheet ke saapeksh hain) — kisi bahari Tailwind-built library ko scan karne ke liye kaam ka, kyunki dependencies aam taur par .gitignore me hoti hain aur default roop se ignore ho jati hain:
css
  @import "tailwindcss";
  @source "../node_modules/@acmecorp/ui-lib";
  • Base path: Tailwind default roop se current working directory ko shuruaat ka bindu maanta hai. Import par source() function se use saaf taur par set karo (monorepos me kaam ka, jahan build commands monorepo root se chalte hain):
css
  @import "tailwindcss" source("../src");
  • Paths ko ignore karo: @source not (stylesheet ke saapeksh) — un badi directories ke liye kaam ka jin ke baare me pata hai ki wo Tailwind istemal nahi karti (purane components, third-party libs):
css
  @import "tailwindcss";
  @source not "../src/components/legacy";
  • Auto-detection poori tarah band karo: source(none), phir saare sources saaf taur par register karo — kai Tailwind stylesheets ke saath kaam ka, taaki har ek me sirf wahi classes hon jinki use zaroorat hai:
css
  @import "tailwindcss" source(none);
  @source "../admin";
  @source "../shared";

Zabardasti generation: @source inline()

  • Wo class names banao jo content files me hain hi nahi:
css
  @import "tailwindcss";
  @source inline("underline");

→ .underline { text-decoration-line: underline; }

  • Variants ke saath: source input me {hover:,focus:,} jodo:
css
  @source inline("{hover:,focus:,}underline");

.underline, .hover\:underline:hover (@media (hover: hover) ke andar), .focus\:underline:focus (@media (focus: focus) ke andar) banata hai — dhyan do, page ki bani CSS me shabdasha @media (focus: focus) dikhta hai.

  • Brace expansion: source input brace-expand hota hai, isliye kai classes ek saath ban sakti hain — ranges samet:
css
  @source inline("{hover:,}bg-red-{50,{100..900..100},950}");

Laal backgrounds banata hai — 50, 100–900 (100 ke steps me), aur 950, har ek hover: variant ke saath.

  • Classes ko bahar rakhna: @source not inline(...) khaas classes ko banne se rokta hai, chahe wo source files me mili bhi hon:
css
  @source not inline("{hover:,focus:,}bg-red-{50,{100..900..100},950}");

Laal background utilities + hover/focus variants ko bahar rakhta hai.

Interview me kaam ki baatein

  • Tailwind debugging ka #1 sawaal: "meri dynamically bani class kaam nahi karti" — jawab: scanner sirf saada text dekhta hai; hamesha poore class names / static maps istemal karo.
  • .gitignore wali files aur node_modules scan NAHI hote — isiliye UI libraries ke liye @source maujood hai.
  • source(none) + spasht @source = multi-stylesheet projects me har-stylesheet scoping.
  • Brace expansion ({100..900..100}) ke saath @source inline() purane safelist khayal ki v4-wali jagah hai.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/detecting-classes-in-source-files
← Previous15 · Adding custom styles→ Next17 · Functions and directives
17Core concepts

Functions and directives

Is section me hum Functions and directives ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye page hai kya

  • Tailwind tumhari CSS ke liye jo custom functions aur directives deta hai, unka reference. Directives Tailwind ke khaas custom at-rules hain jinhe tum apni CSS me istemal kar sakte ho; ye Tailwind projects ke liye khaas suvidhayein dete hain.

Directives (v4)

DirectivePurposeExample
@importInline-import CSS files, including Tailwind itself@import "tailwindcss";
@themeDefine custom design tokens (fonts, colours, breakpoints)@theme { --font-display: "Satoshi", "sans-serif"; --breakpoint-3xl: 120rem; --color-avocado-100: oklch(0.99 0 0); /* ... */ --ease-fluid: cubic-bezier(0.3, 0, 0, 1); }
@sourceExplicitly specify source files not picked up by automatic content detection@source "../node_modules/@my-company/ui-lib";
@utilityAdd custom utilities that work with variants (hover, focus, lg)@utility tab-4 { tab-size: 4; }
@variantApply a Tailwind variant to styles in your CSS.my-element { background: white; @variant dark { background: black; } }
@custom-variantAdd a custom variant@custom-variant theme-midnight (&:where([data-theme="midnight"] *)); → enables theme-midnight:bg-black, theme-midnight:text-white
@applyInline existing utility classes into custom CSS.select2-dropdown { @apply rounded-b-lg shadow-md; } .select2-search { @apply rounded border border-gray-300; } .select2-results__group { @apply text-lg font-bold text-gray-900; }
@referenceImport a stylesheet for reference only, without including its styles in outputSee below

@apply — detail

  • Tab kaam ka hai jab custom CSS likh rahe ho (jaise kisi third-party library ki styles override karna) lekin phir bhi design tokens aur HTML jaisa hi syntax istemal karna chahte ho.
  • Vue/Svelte <style> blocks aur CSS Modules: wahan @apply ya @variant istemal karne ke liye, tumhe theme variables, custom utilities aur custom variants import karne honge taaki wo values us context me uplabdh hon. Output me CSS dohraye bina main stylesheet ko reference ke liye import karne ke liye @reference istemal karo:
vue
  <template><h1>Hello world!</h1></template>
  <style>
    @reference "../../app.css";
    h1 { @apply text-2xl font-bold text-red-500; }
  </style>
  • Agar bina kisi customisation ke sirf default theme istemal kar rahe ho, to tailwindcss ko seedha reference kar sakte ho: @reference "tailwindcss";.

Subpath imports

  • CLI, Vite ya PostCSS ke saath, @import, @reference, @plugin aur @config subpath imports ko support karte hain (bundler/TypeScript path aliases ki tarah):
json
  { "imports": { "#app.css": "./src/css/app.css" } }
vue
  <style>
    @reference "#app.css";
    h1 { @apply text-2xl font-bold text-red-500; }
  </style>

Build-time functions

  • --alpha() — kisi rang ki opacity badlo:
css
  /* Input */
  .my-element { color: --alpha(var(--color-lime-300) / 50%); }
  /* Compiled */
  .my-element { color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-lime-300) 50%, transparent); }
  • --spacing() — tumhari theme ke hisaab se ek spacing value banao:
css
  /* Input */
  .my-element { margin: --spacing(4); }
  /* Compiled */
  .my-element { margin: calc(var(--spacing) * 4); }

calc() ke saath arbitrary values me kaam ka: <div class="py-[calc(--spacing(4)-1px)]">.

Sirf purani v3 sangatata ke liye

  • Neeche wale sirf Tailwind CSS v3.x ke saath sangatata ke liye hain.
  • @config — ek purani JS-based config file load karo: @config "../../tailwind.config.js";. Ise @theme, @utility wagera ke saath istemal karke theme/config/utilities/variants/presets ko dheere-dheere CSS me laya ja sakta hai. CSS me tay cheezein jahan ho sake merge hoti hain, warna configs, presets, plugins par haavi rehti hain.
    • JS config se v4.0 me supported NAHI: corePlugins, safelist, separator. v4 me utilities ko safelist karne ke liye @source inline() istemal karo.
  • @plugin — ek legacy JS-based plugin load karo: @plugin "@tailwindcss/typography";. Ek package naam ya local path svikaar karta hai.
  • theme() function — dot notation se theme values lo: .my-element { margin: theme(spacing.12); }. Deprecated hai — uske bajaye CSS theme variables istemal karo.

Interview me kaam ki baatein

  • v4 CSS-first hai: @theme, @utility, @custom-variant, @source purane JS config ki jagah lete hain; @config/@plugin/theme() sirf purane pul (legacy bridges) hain.
  • --alpha() color-mix(in oklab, …) me compile hota hai; --spacing(n) calc(var(--spacing) * n) me compile hota hai.
  • Output ko dohraye bina scoped <style> blocks / CSS Modules me @apply ki chaabi hai @reference.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/functions-and-directives
← Previous16 · Detecting classes in source files→ Next18 · Preflight
18Base styles

Preflight

Is section me hum Preflight ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya?

  • Tailwind projects ke liye apni raay wali (opinionated) base styles ka set, modern-normalize ke upar bana hua. Ye alag-alag browsers ki asangatiyon ko mitane aur tumhare design system ke andar kaam aasan karne ke liye bana hai.
  • Jab tum tailwindcss import karte ho, Preflight apne aap base layer me ghus jata hai:
css
  @layer theme, base, components, utilities;
  @import "tailwindcss/theme.css" layer(theme);
  @import "tailwindcss/preflight.css" layer(base);
  @import "tailwindcss/utilities.css" layer(utilities);
  • Zyada tar Preflight styles par dhyan hi nahi jata (cheezein ummeed ke hisaab se bartav karti hain); kuch apni-raay wale hain aur naye logon ko chaunka sakte hain. Poora reference: GitHub par Preflight stylesheet (page se link hai).

Preflight kya karta hai (khaas rules)

  • Saare elements se saare default margins/padding hata deta hai (headings, blockquotes, paragraphs wagera):
css
  *, ::after, ::before, ::backdrop, ::file-selector-button {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
  }

Isse un user-agent margin values par galti se nirbhar hona mushkil ho jata hai jo tumhari spacing scale ka hissa nahi hain.

  • Border reset (taaki border bas kaam kare):
css
  *, ::after, ::before, ::backdrop, ::file-selector-button {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    border: 0 solid;
  }

Kyunki border class sirf border-width set karti hai, ye pakka karta hai ki use jodne se hamesha currentColor istemal karke ek solid 1px border bane. Side effect: third-party libraries (jaise Google Maps) jodne par anchaahe nateeje aa sakte hain. Hal — apni CSS se Preflight ko override karo:

css
  @layer base {
    .google-map * {
      border-style: none;
    }
  }
  • Headings bina-style ke: saari headings ka font size aur weight aam text jaisa hota hai:
css
  h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 {
    font-size: inherit;
    font-weight: inherit;
  }

Wajahen: (1) galti se apni type scale se bhatakne se bacho — browser ke heading sizes Tailwind ki type scale me hote hi nahi aur tumhari apni scale me bhi pakke nahi hain; (2) UI development me headings ko aksar dikhne me halka rakhna chahiye — headings par lagi styling soch-samajhkar aur jaan-boojhkar honi chahiye. Chaho to apni base styles se default header styles jodo.

  • Lists bina-style ke: na bullets, na numbers:
css
  ol, ul, menu {
    list-style: none;
  }

Lists ko list-style-type / list-style-position utilities se style karo: <ul class="list-inside list-disc"><li>One</li>…</ul>. Accessibility note: bina-style wali lists ko VoiceOver lists ke roop me ghoshit nahi karta — agar content asal me list hai lekin tum use bina-style rakhna chahte ho, to role="list" jodo: <ul role="list">…</ul>.

  • Images/replaced elements display: block hote hain:
css
  img, svg, video, canvas, audio, iframe, embed, object {
    display: block;
    vertical-align: middle;
  }

Browser ke default display: inline se hone wali anchaahi alignment samasyaon se bachata hai. Kisi ko inline karna ho to inline utility istemal karo: <img class="inline" src="..." alt="..." />.

  • Images/videos parent ki chaudaai tak seemit, aspect surakshit:
css
  img, video {
    max-width: 100%;
    height: auto;
  }

Overflow rokta hai, inhe default roop se responsive banata hai. max-w-none se override karo: <img class="max-w-none" src="..." />.

  • Hidden attribute lagu kiya gaya:
css
  [hidden]:where(:not([hidden="until-found"])) {
    display: none !important;
  }

hidden wale elements adrishya rehte hain, jab tak hidden="until-found" na istemal ho. Kisi element ko dikhana ho to hidden attribute hata do.

Preflight ke upar apni base styles jodna

css
@layer base {
  h1 { font-size: var(--text-2xl); }
  h2 { font-size: var(--text-xl); }
  h3 { font-size: var(--text-lg); }
  a { color: var(--color-blue-600); text-decoration-line: underline; }
}

Preflight ko poori tarah band karna

  • Agar Tailwind ko kisi maujooda project me jod rahe ho ya tum apni base styles pasand karte ho, to sirf wahi hisse import karo jinki zaroorat hai. Default @import "tailwindcss" theme + preflight + utilities ghusaata hai (upar wala block); Preflight disable karne ke liye, baaki sab rakhte hue iske import ko chhod do.
  • Page ki asal baat: Preflight disable karne ke liye bas @import "tailwindcss/preflight.css" layer(base); wali line hata do, baaki imports waise hi rakho.
  • Jab Tailwind ki files alag-alag import karo, to import flags unke apne-apne imports par lagte hain:
    • source(…) bani hui utilities ko prabhavit karta hai → utilities.css wale import par: @import "tailwindcss/utilities.css" layer(utilities) source(none);
    • important utilities ko prabhavit karta hai → utilities.css wale import par: ... layer(utilities) important;
    • theme(static) / theme(inline) bane hue theme variables ko prabhavit karte hain → theme.css wale import par: @import "tailwindcss/theme.css" layer(theme) theme(static);
    • prefix(tw) utilities AUR variables dono ko prabhavit karta hai → DONO imports par: @import "tailwindcss/theme.css" layer(theme) prefix(tw); @import "tailwindcss/utilities.css" layer(utilities) prefix(tw);

Interview me kaam ki baatein

  • Preflight = base layer me modern-normalize + apni-raay wale resets; yahi wajah hai ki Tailwind projects me h1 body text jaisa dikhta hai aur ul me bullets nahi hote — naye logon ki bahut aam uljhan.
  • Har cheez par border: 0 solid + box-sizing: border-box hi wajah hai ki akela border 1px solid currentColor border deta hai.
  • role="list" bina-style wali lists ke liye VoiceOver ghoshna wali samasya theek karta hai.
  • Preflight disable karna = alag-alag imports ghata preflight.css; flags sahi import par lagne chahiye.
Live check — docs table se zyada

Docs page par "disable Preflight" wala code block galti se pura three-import block dobara dikhata hai — preflight wali line samet (ye docs ki apni rendering galti hai). Page ki prose saaf kehti hai: Preflight disable karne ke liye bas uski import hata do, baaki sab waisa hi rakho. Sahi disabled version ye hai:

css
@layer theme, base, components, utilities;
@import "tailwindcss/theme.css" layer(theme);
@import "tailwindcss/utilities.css" layer(utilities);
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/preflight
← Previous17 · Functions and directives→ Next19 · aspect-ratio
19Layout

aspect-ratio

Ye utilities kisi element ke aspect ratio ko control karne ke liye hoti hain — ye asal me CSS ki aspect-ratio property ko set karti hain. Neeche is page ki har class, uska exact CSS aur use karne ka tareeka diya hai.

Ye hai kya?

  • Ye utilities aspect ratio of an element (aspect-ratio CSS property). ko control karne ke liye hain.

Classes — saari utilities

ClassStyles
aspect-<ratio>aspect-ratio: <ratio>;
aspect-squareaspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
aspect-videoaspect-ratio: var(--aspect-video); /* 16 / 9 */
aspect-autoaspect-ratio: auto;
aspect-(<custom-property>)aspect-ratio: var(<custom-property>);
aspect-[<value>]aspect-ratio: <value>;

Use kaise karein — Usage

  • Khaas ratio: <img class="aspect-3/2 object-cover ..." src="/img/villas.jpg" />
  • Video 16/9: <iframe class="aspect-video ..." src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/dQw4w9WgXcQ"></iframe>
  • Poori custom value: <img class="aspect-[calc(4*3+1)/3] ..." src="/img/villas.jpg" />
  • CSS variable shorthand: <img class="aspect-(--my-aspect-ratio) ..." /> — aspect-[var(--my-aspect-ratio)] ka shorthand, var() apne aap jod deta hai.
  • Responsive: <iframe class="aspect-video md:aspect-square ..."> (default video ratio, md+ par square).
  • --aspect-* theme variables se customise karo:
css
  @theme { --aspect-retro: 4 / 3; }

Phir <iframe class="aspect-retro" …>. Default theme --aspect-video: 16 / 9 tay karta hai.

Interview me kaam ki baatein

  • aspect-video bas ek theme variable hai (--aspect-video: 16 / 9); koi bhi ratio aspect-<n>/<m> (bare values) ya arbitrary values se kaam karta hai.
  • Aam jodi: images par aspect-* + object-cover, iframes/embeds par aspect-video.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/aspect-ratio
← Previous18 · Preflight→ Next20 · columns
20Layout

columns

Ye page un utilities ke baare me hai jo controlling the number of columns within an element (CSS multi-column layout — `columns` property) ke kaam aati hain. Neeche har class apne exact CSS ke saath di hai.

Ye hai kya?

  • Kisi element ke andar columns ki sankhya ko control karne ki utilities (CSS multi-column layout — columns property). Content ek column me neeche behta hai, phir agle me (masonry-jaise image grids, newspaper text).

Classes — saari utilities

ClassStyles
columns-<number>columns: <number>;
columns-3xscolumns: var(--container-3xs); /* 16rem (256px) */
columns-2xscolumns: var(--container-2xs); /* 18rem (288px) */
columns-xscolumns: var(--container-xs); /* 20rem (320px) */
columns-smcolumns: var(--container-sm); /* 24rem (384px) */
columns-mdcolumns: var(--container-md); /* 28rem (448px) */
columns-lgcolumns: var(--container-lg); /* 32rem (512px) */
columns-xlcolumns: var(--container-xl); /* 36rem (576px) */
columns-2xlcolumns: var(--container-2xl); /* 42rem (672px) */
columns-3xlcolumns: var(--container-3xl); /* 48rem (768px) */

Use kaise karein — Usage

  • Ginti se: columns-3 columns ki sankhya set karta hai; column ki chaudaai us ginti ke hisaab se apne aap adjust ho jati hai.
  • Chaudaai se: columns-xs / columns-sm aadarsh column chaudaai set karte hain; columns ki sankhya apne aap adjust ho jati hai taaki wo zyada sankre na hon:
html
  <div class="columns-3xs ...">
    <img class="aspect-3/2 ..." src="/img/mountains-1.jpg" />
    <img class="aspect-square ..." src="/img/mountains-2.jpg" />
    <img class="aspect-square ..." src="/img/mountains-3.jpg" />
    <!-- ... -->
  </div>
  • Columns ke beech gap: gap-* utilities (gap docs dekho).
  • Custom value: columns-[30vw]; CSS variable shorthand: columns-(--my-columns) (= columns-[var(--my-columns)]).
  • Responsive: <div class="columns-2 gap-4 sm:columns-3 sm:gap-8 ...">.
  • Customise: width utilities --container-* theme variables se aati hain: @theme { --container-4xs: 14rem; } → columns-4xs.

Interview me kaam ki baatein

  • Do modes: ginti (columns-3) banam chaudaai (columns-sm) — width mode ginti ko apne aap adjust karta hai. Grid grid-cols-* se uljho mat (grid rows+columns hai; columns behta hua multi-column text/media layout hai).
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/columns
← Previous19 · aspect-ratio→ Next21 · break-after
21Layout

break-after

Ye page un utilities ke baare me hai jo kisi column ya page ke kisi element ke baad break hone (break-after property) ke kaam aati hain — multi-column (columns-*) ya paged-media layouts ke andar istemal hoti hain. Neeche har class apne exact CSS ke saath di hai.

Ye hai kya?

  • Ek column ya page kisi element ke baad kaise break hona chahiye, ise control karne ki utilities (break-after property) — multi-column (columns-*) ya paged-media layouts ke andar istemal hoti hain.

Classes — saari utilities

ClassStyles
break-after-autobreak-after: auto;
break-after-avoidbreak-after: avoid;
break-after-allbreak-after: all;
break-after-avoid-pagebreak-after: avoid-page;
break-after-pagebreak-after: page;
break-after-leftbreak-after: left;
break-after-rightbreak-after: right;
break-after-columnbreak-after: column;

Use kaise karein — Usage

html
<div class="columns-2">
  <p>Well, let me tell you something, ...</p>
  <p class="break-after-column">Sure, go ahead, laugh...</p>
  <p>Maybe we can live without...</p>
  <p>Look. If you think this is...</p>
</div>
  • Responsive: <div class="break-after-column md:break-after-auto ..."> (iske baad zabardasti column break, lekin md+ par auto).
  • Matlab: auto default; avoid iske baad break mat karo; all sabke baad break; avoid-page page break se bacho; page zabardasti page break; left/right baayein/daayein page par break (print); column zabardasti column break.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/break-after
← Previous20 · columns→ Next22 · break-before
22Layout

break-before

Ye page un utilities ke baare me hai jo kisi column ya page ke kisi element se pehle break hone (break-before property) ke kaam aati hain. Neeche har class apne exact CSS ke saath di hai.

Ye hai kya?

  • Ek column ya page kisi element se pehle kaise break hona chahiye, ise control karne ki utilities (break-before property). Break-after ki parchhai, us element par lagu jo break ke baad shuru hota hai.

Classes — saari utilities

ClassStyles
break-before-autobreak-before: auto;
break-before-avoidbreak-before: avoid;
break-before-allbreak-before: all;
break-before-avoid-pagebreak-before: avoid-page;
break-before-pagebreak-before: page;
break-before-leftbreak-before: left;
break-before-rightbreak-before: right;
break-before-columnbreak-before: column;

Use kaise karein — Usage

html
<div class="columns-2">
  <p>Well, let me tell you something, ...</p>
  <p class="break-before-column">Sure, go ahead, laugh...</p>
  <p>Maybe we can live without...</p>
  <p>Look. If you think this is...</p>
</div>
  • Responsive: <div class="break-before-column md:break-before-auto ...">.
  • break-after jaisi hi value ke matlab (auto / avoid / all / avoid-page / page / left / right / column), lekin break is element se pehle hota hai.

Interview ke kaam ki baatein (break-after / break-before)

  • Dono isliye hain kyunki tum break ko seema ke kisi bhi taraf se majboor kar sakte ho; element N par break-after-column ≡ asar me element N+1 par break-before-column.
  • Mukhya roop se columns-* layouts aur print (page/left/right) ke liye mayne rakhta hai; avoid ajeeb breaks rokta hai (jaise column ke neeche akeli reh gayi heading).
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/break-before
← Previous21 · break-after→ Next23 · break-inside
23Layout

break-inside

Ye page un utilities ke baare me hai jo kisi column ya page ke kisi element ke andar break hone (break-inside property) ke kaam aati hain. Neeche har class apne exact CSS ke saath di hai.

Ye hai kya?

  • Ek column ya page kisi element ke andar kaise break hona chahiye, ise control karne ki utilities (break-inside property) — matlab kya element khud columns/pages me bant sakta hai.

Classes (page ki table me di gayi)

ClassStyles
break-inside-autobreak-inside: auto;
break-inside-avoidbreak-inside: avoid;
break-inside-avoid-pagebreak-inside: avoid-page;
break-inside-avoid-columnbreak-inside: avoid-column;

Use kaise karein — Usage

html
<div class="columns-2">
  <p>Well, let me tell you something, ...</p>
  <p class="break-inside-avoid-column">Sure, go ahead, laugh...</p>
  <p>Maybe we can live without...</p>
  <p>Look. If you think this is...</p>
</div>
  • Responsive: <div class="break-inside-avoid-column md:break-inside-auto ...">.
  • Note: page ki prose break-inside-avoid-page ke saath break-inside-column ka zikr karti hai, lekin uski class table sirf auto / avoid / avoid-page / avoid-column deti hai — table jaisi hai waisi hi di gayi hai.
  • Classic istemal: columns-* layout ke andar cards/images par break-inside-avoid-column (ya break-inside-avoid), taaki koi item kabhi do columns me na bante.
Live check — docs table se zyada

Page ka apna example break-inside-column use karta hai ("Use utilities like break-inside-column and break-inside-avoid-page...") — ye bhi valid utility hai, table me listed nahi hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/break-inside
← Previous22 · break-before→ Next24 · box-decoration-break
24Layout

box-decoration-break

Ye page un utilities ke baare me hai jo controlling how element fragments should be rendered across multiple lines, columns, or pages (`box-decoration-break` property) ke kaam aati hain. Neeche har class apne exact CSS ke saath di hai.

Ye hai kya?

  • Ye utilities ye control karne ke liye hain ki kaise element fragments should be rendered across multiple lines, columns, or pages (box-decoration-break property).

Classes — saari utilities

ClassStyles
box-decoration-clonebox-decoration-break: clone;
box-decoration-slicebox-decoration-break: slice;

Use kaise karein — Usage

  • Ye control karta hai ki background, border, border-image, box-shadow, clip-path, margin aur padding jaisi properties aise render hon jaise element ek hi lagaatar tukda ho (slice, default) ya har tukde ke liye alag blocks ki tarah (clone):
html
  <span class="box-decoration-slice bg-linear-to-r from-indigo-600 to-pink-500 px-2 text-white ...">Hello<br />World</span>
  <span class="box-decoration-clone bg-linear-to-r from-indigo-600 to-pink-500 px-2 text-white ...">Hello<br />World</span>

slice ke saath, gradient line break ke paar lagaatar chalta hai; clone ke saath, har line ("Hello", "World") ko apna poora gradient, background, padding aur border milta hai — classic istemal hai multi-line highlighted text / gradient text spans.

  • Responsive: <div class="box-decoration-clone md:box-decoration-slice ...">.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/box-decoration-break
← Previous23 · break-inside→ Next25 · box-sizing
25Layout

box-sizing

Ye page un utilities ke baare me hai jo controlling how the browser calculates an element's total size (`box-sizing` property) ke kaam aati hain. Neeche har class apne exact CSS ke saath di hai.

Ye hai kya?

  • Ye utilities ye control karne ke liye hain ki kaise the browser calculates an element's total size (box-sizing property).

Classes — saari utilities

ClassStyles
box-borderbox-sizing: border-box;
box-contentbox-sizing: content-box;

Use kaise karein — Usage

  • box-border — di gayi height/width me borders aur padding shaamil karo. Ek 100px × 100px element, chaaron taraf 2px border aur 4px padding ke saath, 100px × 100px hi render hota hai, andar ka content area 88px × 88px hota hai:
html
  <div class="box-border size-32 border-4 p-4 ..."><!-- ... --></div>

Tailwind Preflight base styles ke zariye ise saare elements ke liye default banata hai.

  • box-content — tay width/height ke upar borders aur padding jodo. Ek 100px × 100px element, 2px border aur 4px padding ke saath, 112px × 112px render hota hai, content area 100px × 100px:
html
  <div class="box-content size-32 border-4 p-4 ..."><!-- ... --></div>
  • Responsive: <div class="box-content md:box-border ...">.

Interview me kaam ki baatein

  • border-box Preflight ka default hai — box-content tab ka opt-out hai jab tumhe purana CSS default bartav chahiye (jaise kisi third-party component ki sizing ummeedon se mail khana).
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/box-sizing
← Previous24 · box-decoration-break→ Next26 · display
26Layout

display

Ye page un utilities ke baare me hai jo controlling the display box type of an element (`display` property) ke kaam aati hain. Neeche har class apne exact CSS ke saath di hai.

Ye hai kya?

  • Ye utilities display box type of an element (display property). ko control karne ke liye hain.

Classes (page par table)

ClassStyles
inlinedisplay: inline;
blockdisplay: block;
inline-blockdisplay: inline-block;
flow-rootdisplay: flow-root;
flexdisplay: flex;
inline-flexdisplay: inline-flex;
griddisplay: grid;
inline-griddisplay: inline-grid;
contentsdisplay: contents;
tabledisplay: table;

Page table se aage (prose/examples me) inhe bhi document karta hai: table-row, table-cell, table-caption, table-column, table-column-group, table-header-group, table-row-group, table-footer-group, hidden, sr-only, not-sr-only.

Use kaise karein — Usage

  • inline / inline-block / block — text aur elements ka behna: inline → text aam taur par lapet-ta hai; inline-block → element lapet-ta hai taaki andar ka text parent se bahar na phale; block → element apni line par, parent ko bharta hai:
html
  <p>… <span class="inline">display: inline</span> …</p>
  <p>… <span class="inline-block">display: inline-block</span> …</p>
  <p>… <span class="block">display: block</span> …</p>
  • flow-root — block-level element apne khud ke block formatting context ke saath (floats ko andar rakhta hai / margin collapse rokta hai):
html
  <div class="p-4">
    <div class="flow-root ..."><div class="my-4 ...">Well, let me tell you something, ...</div></div>
    <div class="flow-root ..."><div class="my-4 ...">Sure, go ahead, laugh if you want...</div></div>
  </div>
  • flex — block-level flex container:
html
  <div class="flex items-center">
    <img src="path/to/image.jpg" />
    <div><strong>Andrew Alfred</strong><span>Technical advisor</span></div>
  </div>
  • inline-flex — inline flex container jo text ke saath behta hai (example: paragraph me avatar + naam "Kramer" inline, inline-flex items-baseline, avatar mx-1 size-5 self-center rounded-full).
  • grid — grid container: <div class="grid grid-cols-3 grid-rows-3 gap-4">.
  • inline-grid — inline grid container: <span class="inline-grid grid-cols-3 gap-4"><span>01</span>…<span>06</span></span>.
  • contents — "phantom" container jiske bachche parent ke seedhe bachon ki tarah bartav karte hain (kisi wrapper ko DOM se hataye bina flex/grid layout se hatane ke liye kaam ka):
html
  <div class="flex ...">
    <div class="flex-1 ...">01</div>
    <div class="contents"><div class="flex-1 ...">02</div><div class="flex-1 ...">03</div></div>
    <div class="flex-1 ...">04</div>
  </div>
  • Table utilities — table ke hisson ki tarah bartav karne wale elements (table, table-row, table-cell, table-caption, table-column, table-column-group, table-header-group, table-row-group, table-footer-group):
html
  <div class="table w-full ...">
    <div class="table-header-group ...">
      <div class="table-row">
        <div class="table-cell text-left ...">Song</div>
        <div class="table-cell text-left ...">Artist</div>
        <div class="table-cell text-left ...">Year</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="table-row-group">
      <div class="table-row">
        <div class="table-cell ...">The Sliding Mr. Bones (Next Stop, Pottersville)</div>
        <div class="table-cell ...">Malcolm Lockyer</div>
        <div class="table-cell ...">1961</div>
      </div>
      <!-- Witchy Woman / The Eagles / 1972; Shining Star / Earth, Wind, and Fire / 1975 -->
    </div>
  </div>
  • hidden — element ko document se hata deta hai: <div class="flex ..."><div class="hidden ...">01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div></div>. Dikhne me chhupana ho lekin document me rakhna ho, to iske bajaye visibility istemal karo.
  • sr-only — screen readers se chhupaye bina dikhne me chhupao:
html
  <a href="#"><svg><!-- ... --></svg><span class="sr-only">Settings</span></a>
  • not-sr-only — sr-only ko ulta karo: <span class="sr-only sm:not-sr-only">Settings</span> — chhoti screens par dikhne me chhupane lekin badi screens par dikhane ke liye kaam ka.
  • Responsive: <div class="flex md:inline-flex ...">.

Interview me kaam ki baatein

  • hidden banam invisible (visibility page): hidden = display: none (layout se hata hua); invisible = phir bhi jagah leta hai.
  • contents box ko hata deta hai lekin bachon ko parent ke flex/grid me rakhta hai — wrapper divs ke liye ek aam chaal; dhyan do ye kuch browsers me element ko accessibility semantics se bhi hata deta hai.
  • flow-root aadhunik clearfix hai (naya block formatting context).
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/display
← Previous25 · box-sizing→ Next27 · float
27Layout

float

Ye page un utilities ke baare me hai jo controlling the wrapping of content around an element (`float` property) — the classic text-wrap-around-image technique ke kaam aati hain. Neeche har class apne exact CSS ke saath di hai.

Ye hai kya?

  • Ye utilities wrapping of content around an element (float property) — the classic text-wrap-around-image technique. ko control karne ke liye hain.

Classes — saari utilities

ClassStyles
float-rightfloat: right;
float-leftfloat: left;
float-startfloat: inline-start;
float-endfloat: inline-end;
float-nonefloat: none;

Use kaise karein — Usage

  • Float right: <article><img class="float-right ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" /><p>Maybe we can live without libraries, people like you and me. ...</p></article>
  • Float left: wahi, float-left ke saath.
  • Logical variants: float-start / float-end logical properties istemal karte hain, text ki disha ke hisaab se left/right se judte hain — page float-start ko LTR me aur dir="rtl" (Arabic text) me dikhata hai jahan ye taraf badal deta hai.
  • Reset: float-none.
  • Responsive: <img class="float-right md:float-left" src="/img/mountains.jpg" />.

Interview me kaam ki baatein

  • float-start/float-end disha ke hisaab se hain (RTL-safe); float-left/float-right bhautik (physical) hain aur nahi palatte.
  • Layout ke liye floats ki jagah zyada tar flex/grid ne le li hai, lekin kisi image ke ird-gird text lapetne ke liye ye ab bhi sahi auzaar hai; lapetna rokne ke liye clear-* (agla section) ke saath jodo.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/float
← Previous26 · display→ Next28 · clear
28Layout

clear

Ye page un utilities ke baare me hai jo controlling the wrapping of content around an element (`clear` property) — companion to `float`: forces an element below floated elements ke kaam aati hain. Neeche har class apne exact CSS ke saath di hai.

Ye hai kya?

  • Ye utilities wrapping of content around an element (clear property) — companion to float: forces an element below floated elements. ko control karne ke liye hain.

Classes — saari utilities

ClassStyles
clear-leftclear: left;
clear-rightclear: right;
clear-bothclear: both;
clear-startclear: inline-start;
clear-endclear: inline-end;
clear-noneclear: none;

Use kaise karein — Usage

  • clear-left — peeche ke kisi bhi left-floated elements ke neeche position:
html
  <article>
    <img class="float-left ..." src="/img/snow-mountains.jpg" />
    <img class="float-right ..." src="/img/green-mountains.jpg" />
    <p class="clear-left ...">Maybe we can live without libraries...</p>
  </article>
  • clear-right — peeche ke right-floated elements ke neeche (wahi structure, images ulta-pulta).
  • clear-both — peeche ke SAARE floated elements ke neeche.
  • clear-start / clear-end — logical (disha ke hisaab wale) versions; page dir="rtl" article me clear-end dikhata hai.
  • clear-none — saare clears reset karo.
  • Responsive: <p class="clear-left md:clear-none ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/clear
← Previous27 · float→ Next29 · isolation
29Layout

isolation

Ye page un utilities ke baare me hai jo controlling whether an element should explicitly create a new stacking context (`isolation` property) ke kaam aati hain. Neeche har class apne exact CSS ke saath di hai.

Ye hai kya?

  • Ye utilities whether an element should explicitly create a new stacking context (isolation property). ko control karne ke liye hain.

Classes — saari utilities

ClassStyles
isolateisolation: isolate;
isolation-autoisolation: auto;

Use kaise karein — Usage

html
<div class="isolate ..."><!-- ... --></div>
  • Responsive: <div class="isolate md:isolation-auto ...">.

Ye kyon mayne rakhta hai

  • Ek naya stacking context z-index aur blend modes (mix-blend-*) ko element ke subtree tak seemit kar deta hai — bachche uske bahar ke elements ke saath z-order me ghul nahi sakte. isolate ise banane ka jaan-boojhkar kiya gaya tareeka hai, side-effect walon ke muqable (jaise transform, opacity < 1, filter). z-index page ke saath jodo: isolate + z-* hi wo tareeka hai jisse stacking kisi component (jaise modal ya dropdown) tak scope hoti hai, bina uske bachon ko page ke asambandhit content ke upar/neeche bhaage.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/isolation
← Previous28 · clear→ Next30 · object-fit
30Layout

object-fit

Ye page un utilities ke baare me hai jo ek replaced element ke content (img, video) ko uske box ke andar kaise resize hona chahiye (object-fit property) ke kaam aati hain. Neeche har class apne exact CSS ke saath di hai.

Ye hai kya?

  • Ye utilities ye control karne ke liye hain ki kaise a replaced element's content (img, video) should be resized within its box (object-fit property).

Classes — saari utilities

ClassStyles
object-containobject-fit: contain;
object-coverobject-fit: cover;
object-fillobject-fit: fill;
object-noneobject-fit: none;
object-scale-downobject-fit: scale-down;

Istemaal (sab <img class="h-48 w-96 object-* ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" /> ke saath)

  • object-cover — content ko apne container ko dhakne ke liye resize karo (box bharta hai, overflow kaat deta hai, aspect ratio surakshit rakhta hai). Fixed-size image tiles / avatars / cards ke liye standard chunav.
  • object-contain — content ko container ke andar rehne ke liye resize karo (poori image dikhti hai, letterbox hota hai, aspect ratio surakshit rehta hai).
  • object-fill — content ko container me fit karne ke liye kheench do (aspect ratio bigad jata hai).
  • object-scale-down — asal size par dikhao, lekin zaroorat pade to fit hone ke liye chhota karo (kabhi bada nahi karta; none jaisa lekin contain se seemit).
  • object-none — asal size par dikhao, container size ki parwah kiye bina (overflow kaat deta hai, koi scaling nahi).
  • Responsive: <img class="object-contain md:object-cover" src="/img/mountains.jpg" /> (mobile par contain, md+ par cover).

Interview me kaam ki baatein

  • cover banam contain hi asal fark hai: cover = bharo + kaato; contain = fit + letterbox. fill bigaad deta hai; scale-down = none lekin kabhi overflow nahi; none = kudrati size, kata hua.
  • Sirf replaced elements par kaam karta hai (img/video); object-position (agla page) ke saath jodo taaki chun sako ki cover ke saath kaunsa hissa katega.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/object-fit
← Previous29 · isolation→ Next31 · object-position
31Layout

object-position

Ye page un utilities ke baare me hai jo ek replaced element ke content ko uske container ke andar kaise position hona chahiye (object-position property) — object-cover ke kaatne par image ka kaunsa hissa dikhai deta rehta hai — ke kaam aati hain. Neeche har class apne exact CSS ke saath di hai.

Ye hai kya?

  • Ek replaced element ka content uske container ke andar kaise position hona chahiye, ise control karne ki utilities (object-position property) — object-cover ke kaatne par image ka kaunsa hissa dikhai deta rehta hai.

Classes — saari utilities

ClassStyles
object-top-leftobject-position: top left;
object-topobject-position: top;
object-top-rightobject-position: top right;
object-leftobject-position: left;
object-centerobject-position: center;
object-rightobject-position: right;
object-bottom-leftobject-position: bottom left;
object-bottomobject-position: bottom;
object-bottom-rightobject-position: bottom right;
object-(<custom-property>)object-position: var(<custom-property>);
object-[<value>]object-position: <value>;

Use kaise karein — Usage

  • Saari nau positions size-24 images par dikhayi gayi hain (object-top-left, object-top, object-top-right, object-left, object-center, object-right, object-bottom-left, object-bottom, object-bottom-right).
  • Custom value: <img class="object-[25%_75%] ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" /> (underscore = space).
  • CSS variable shorthand: object-(--my-object) (= object-[var(--my-object)]).
  • Responsive: <img class="object-center md:object-top ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />.

Interview me kaam ki baatein

  • Sirf object-cover/object-contain (ya ek fixed-size box) ke saath hi arth rakhta hai: ye cropping ke liye anchor point chunta hai. object-top avatar tiles me chehre katne ki classic theek (fix) hai.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/object-position
← Previous30 · object-fit→ Next32 · overflow
32Layout

overflow

Ye page un utilities ke baare me hai jo koi element container ke liye bahut bade content ko kaise sambhalta hai (overflow property) ke kaam aati hain. Neeche har class apne exact CSS ke saath di hai.

Ye hai kya?

  • Ye utilities ye control karne ke liye hain ki kaise an element handles content that is too large for the container (overflow property).

Classes — saari utilities

ClassStyles
overflow-autooverflow: auto;
overflow-hiddenoverflow: hidden;
overflow-clipoverflow: clip;
overflow-visibleoverflow: visible;
overflow-scrolloverflow: scroll;
overflow-x-auto / overflow-y-autooverflow-x/y: auto;
overflow-x-hidden / overflow-y-hiddenoverflow-x/y: hidden;
overflow-x-clip / overflow-y-clipoverflow-x/y: clip;
overflow-x-visible / overflow-y-visibleoverflow-x/y: visible;
overflow-x-scroll / overflow-y-scrolloverflow-x/y: scroll;

Use kaise karein — Usage

  • overflow-visible — kaato mat; overflow karta content dikhta rehta hai (default bartav, bahar nikalte profile card ke saath dikhaya gaya).
  • overflow-hidden — seema se bahar nikalne wali har cheez ko kaat do.
  • overflow-auto — scrollbars sirf tab jab content overflow kare (overflow-scroll se alag, jo inhe hamesha dikhata hai). Example: logon ki vertical scrolling list (Andrew Alfred, Debra Houston, Jane White, Ray Flint).
  • overflow-x-auto — zaroorat pade to horizontal scrolling (example: logon ki horizontal katar — Andrew, Emily, Whitney, David, Kristin, Sarah).
  • overflow-y-auto — zaroorat pade to vertical scrolling: <div class="h-32 overflow-y-auto ...">.
  • overflow-x-scroll / overflow-y-scroll — us axis me scrolling ki anumati do aur scrollbars hamesha dikhao, jab tak OS ne hamesha-dikhne wale scrollbars band na kiye hon.
  • overflow-scroll — dono axes par scrollbars, hamesha dikhte hain. Note: kuch OS (jaise macOS) is setting ke bawajood bekaar ke scrollbars chhupa dete hain.
  • Responsive: <div class="overflow-auto md:overflow-scroll ...">.

Interview me kaam ki baatein

  • auto banam scroll: auto = scrollbars sirf zaroorat par; scroll = hamesha. hidden banam clip: clip bhi kaat-ta hai lekin (CSS spec ke hisaab se) scroll container nahi banata — program se scrolling nahi hoti; page use bina aur detail ke list karta hai.
  • overflow-x-auto mobile par horizontally scroll hone wali tables/carousels ka standard pattern hai; overflow-hidden gol konon ko kaatne ka standard tareeka hai (rounded-* + overflow-hidden taaki child images bahar na jhanken).
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/overflow
← Previous31 · object-position→ Next33 · overscroll-behavior
33Layout

overscroll-behavior

Ye page un utilities ke baare me hai jo kisi scrolling area ki seema par pahunchne par browser kaise vyavhaar karta hai (overscroll-behavior property) — matlab scroll chaining — ke kaam aati hain. Neeche har class apne exact CSS ke saath di hai.

Ye hai kya?

  • Kisi scrolling area ki seema par pahunchne par browser kaise vyavhaar karta hai, ise control karne ki utilities (overscroll-behavior property) — matlab scroll chaining: kya kisi andar wale scroll area ke ant se aage scroll karna parent/page ko scroll karta hai (aur rubber-band bounce dikhata hai)?

Classes — saari utilities

ClassStyles
overscroll-autooverscroll-behavior: auto;
overscroll-containoverscroll-behavior: contain;
overscroll-noneoverscroll-behavior: none;
overscroll-x-auto / overscroll-y-autooverscroll-behavior-x/y: auto;
overscroll-x-contain / overscroll-y-containoverscroll-behavior-x/y: contain;
overscroll-x-none / overscroll-y-noneoverscroll-behavior-x/y: none;

Use kaise karein — Usage

  • overscroll-contain — target area ki scrolling ko parent me scrolling trigger karne se roko, lekin ant se aage scroll karne par "bounce" effects surakshit rakho (un OS par jo support karte hain):
html
  <div class="overscroll-contain ...">Well, let me tell you something, ...</div>
  • overscroll-none — scroll chaining roko AUR bounce effects bhi roko:
html
  <div class="overscroll-none ...">Well, let me tell you something, ...</div>
  • overscroll-auto (default) — user andar wale scroll area ki seema par pahunchkar parent scroll area ko scroll karna jaari rakh sakta hai.
  • Responsive: <div class="overscroll-auto md:overscroll-contain ...">.

Interview me kaam ki baatein

  • Classic istemal: apne scroll wala ek modal / dropdown / chat panel — overscroll-contain panel ke kinare par pahunchne par uske peeche ke page ko scroll hone se rokta hai; overscroll-none iOS ke rubber-band bounce ko bhi khatm kar deta hai. Per-axis variants (overscroll-y-contain) tumhe horizontal ko chhodkar sirf vertical chaining rokne dete hain.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/overscroll-behavior
← Previous32 · overflow→ Next34 · position
34Layout

position

Ye page un utilities ke baare me hai jo controlling how an element is positioned in the document (`position` property) ke kaam aati hain. Neeche har class apne exact CSS ke saath di hai.

Ye hai kya?

  • Ye utilities ye control karne ke liye hain ki kaise an element is positioned in the document (position property).

Classes — saari utilities

ClassStyles
staticposition: static;
fixedposition: fixed;
absoluteposition: absolute;
relativeposition: relative;
stickyposition: sticky;

Har value, uske rules ke saath

  • static — aam document behva. Offsets ignore ho jate hain, aur element absolutely positioned bachon ke liye position reference ka kaam NAHI karta:
html
  <div class="static ...">
    <p>Static parent</p>
    <div class="absolute bottom-0 left-0 ..."><p>Absolute child</p></div>
  </div>

(Example me absolute child is static parent ke bajaye kisi upar wale non-static ancestor ke hisaab se position leta hai.)

  • relative — aam behva, lekin offsets element ki aam position ke saapeksh ginay jate hain, aur ye absolutely positioned bachon ke liye position reference ka kaam KARTA hai:
html
  <div class="relative ...">
    <p>Relative parent</p>
    <div class="absolute bottom-0 left-0 ..."><p>Absolute child</p></div>
  </div>

Ye relative parent + absolute child ki jodi badges, overlays, tooltips aur corner pins ke liye standard pattern hai.

  • absolute — aam behva se hata hua; bagal ke elements aise bartav karte hain jaise ye hai hi nahi. Offsets sabse paas ke us parent ke saapeksh ginay jate hain jiski position static ke alawa ho; ye dusre absolutely positioned bachon ke liye position reference ka kaam bhi karta hai. Page ek static child (jagah leta hai, sibling ko dhakel-ta hai) ki tulna ek absolute child (overlap karta hai, sibling use ignore karta hai) se karta hai.
  • fixed — browser window (viewport) ke saapeksh positioned. Offsets viewport ke saapeksh; absolutely positioned bachon ke liye position reference ka kaam karta hai. Example: ek "Contacts" header bar fixed top-0 right-0 left-0 jo dikhta rehta hai jabki ek contact list (Andrew Alfred, Debra Houston, …) uske neeche scroll hoti hai.
  • sticky — ek tay seema paar karne tak relative ki tarah, phir parent ke screen se bahar hone tak fixed ki tarah bartav karta hai. Offsets element ki aam position ke saapeksh; absolutely positioned bachon ke liye position reference ka kaam karta hai. Example: varnamaala (alphabetical) contact list jisme section headers sticky top-0 hain ("A" Andrew Alfred, Aisha Houston, Anna White, Andy Flint ke saath; "B" Bob Alfred, Bianca Houston, Brianna White, Bert Flint ke saath; "C" Colton Alfred, Cynthia Houston, Cheyenne White, Charlie Flint ke saath) — har akshar ka header upar chipka rehta hai jab tak uska section scroll hokar door na ho jaye.
  • Responsive: <div class="relative md:absolute ...">.

Interview me kaam ki baatein

  • static default hai aur IKLAUTI value hai jo offsets ko ignore karti hai aur absolute bachon ka aadhar nahi ban sakti.
  • sticky ko kuch karne ke liye ek threshold offset (jaise top-0) chahiye, aur ye sirf apne parent ke andar chipakta hai — parent ke scroll hokar nikalte hi ye chhoot jata hai.
  • fixed viewport ke saapeksh hai (asal me transformed ancestors se bahar nikal aata hai — ek transformed ancestor containing block ban jata hai; page ye cover nahi karta, lekin ye ek jaani chaal hai).
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/position
← Previous33 · overscroll-behavior→ Next35 · top / right / bottom / left
35Layout

top / right / bottom / left

Ye page un utilities ke baare me hai jo positioned elements ki placement (top, right, bottom, left, aur inset shorthand) ke kaam aati hain. Neeche har class apne exact CSS ke saath di hai.

Ye hai kya?

  • Ye utilities placement of positioned elements (top, right, bottom, left, and the inset shorthand). ko control karne ke liye hain.

Classes (page par table — inset-* forms)

ClassStyles
inset-<number>inset: calc(var(--spacing) * <number>);
-inset-<number>inset: calc(var(--spacing) * -<number>);
inset-<fraction>inset: calc(<fraction> * 100%);
-inset-<fraction>inset: calc(<fraction> * -100%);
inset-pxinset: 1px;
-inset-pxinset: -1px;
inset-fullinset: 100%;
-inset-fullinset: -100%;
inset-autoinset: auto;
inset-(<custom-property>)inset: var(<custom-property>);

Wahi numeric/fraction/px/full/auto/negative/arbitrary roop top-*, right-*, bottom-*, left-*, inset-x-*, inset-y-*, inset-s-*, inset-e-*, inset-bs-*, inset-be-* har ek par lagu hote hain.

Istemaal — 9-position grid (sab relative size-32 parents ke andar)

  • Upar baayein pin karo: absolute top-0 left-0 size-16 (01)
  • Upar wale kinare tak phailao: absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-16 (02) — inset-x-0 left+right ko 0 set karta hai
  • Upar daayein pin karo: absolute top-0 right-0 size-16 (03)
  • Baayein kinare tak phailao: absolute inset-y-0 left-0 w-16 (04) — inset-y-0 top+bottom ko 0 set karta hai
  • Poora parent bharo: absolute inset-0 (05) — inset-0 chaaron taraf 0 set karta hai
  • Daayein kinare tak phailao: absolute inset-y-0 right-0 w-16 (06)
  • Neeche baayein pin karo: absolute bottom-0 left-0 size-16 (07)
  • Neeche wale kinare tak phailao: absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-16 (08)
  • Neeche daayein pin karo: absolute right-0 bottom-0 size-16 (09)
  • Negative values: aage dash lagao — <div class="absolute -top-4 -left-4 size-14 ..."> (element apne parent ke kone se bahar offset hai).
  • Logical properties: inset-s-* / inset-e-* inset-inline-start / inset-inline-end set karte hain, jo text ki disha ke hisaab se left/right se judte hain (page LTR aur RTL me inset-s-0 dikhata hai — ye taraf badal deta hai). inset-bs-* / inset-be-* block-axis ke barabar hain. Zyada control ke liye LTR/RTL modifiers istemal karo.
  • Custom values: inset-[3px], top-[<value>]; CSS variable shorthand inset-(--my-position) (= inset-[var(--my-position)]).
  • Responsive: <div class="top-4 md:top-6 ..."> — page responsive-prefix lag sakne walon ki list deta hai: inset, inset-x, inset-y, inset-s, inset-e, inset-bs, inset-be, top, left, bottom, right.

Spacing scale

  • Ye utilities --spacing theme variable se chalti hain (default --spacing: 0.25rem), customise ho sakta hai: @theme { --spacing: 1px; }. Fractions (inset-1/2 wagera) containing block ke percentages ke roop me hal hote hain.

Interview me kaam ki baatein

  • inset-0 "parent ko bharo" ka rivaj wala tareeka hai (overlays/backdrops ke liye istemal); inset-x-0 / inset-y-0 ek axis tak phailte hain.
  • Offsets sirf positioned elements (relative/absolute/fixed/sticky) par kaam karte hain — static par ye ignore ho jate hain (position page dekho).
  • inset-s/e/bs/be RTL-safe logical roop hain; top/left wagera bhautik (physical) hain.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/top-right-bottom-left
← Previous34 · position→ Next36 · visibility
36Layout

visibility

Ye page un utilities ke baare me hai jo controlling the visibility of an element (`visibility` property) ke kaam aati hain. Neeche har class apne exact CSS ke saath di hai.

Ye hai kya?

  • Ye utilities visibility of an element (visibility property). ko control karne ke liye hain.

Classes — saari utilities

ClassStyles
visiblevisibility: visible;
invisiblevisibility: hidden;
collapsevisibility: collapse;

Use kaise karein — Usage

  • invisible — element ko chhupao lekin document me uski jagah rakho (dusre elements ka layout prabhavit hota hai / jagah surakshit rehti hai):
html
  <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
    <div>01</div>
    <div class="invisible ...">02</div>
    <div>03</div>
  </div>

Kisi element ko document se poori tarah hatane ke liye, iske bajaye display (hidden) istemal karo.

  • collapse — table rows, row groups, columns aur column groups ko aise chhupao jaise display: none ho, lekin dusri rows/columns ke size ko prabhavit kiye BINA. Page ki invoice table fark dikhati hai: row #101 (Kruger Industrial Smoothing, $545.00) ko collapse se chhupane par table layout sthir rehta hai, jabki hidden row ko hatakar layout hila deta hai:
html
  <tr class="collapse">
    <td>#101</td>
    <td>Kruger Industrial Smoothing</td>
    <td>$545.00</td>
  </tr>

Isse table layout ko prabhavit kiye bina rows/columns ko dynamically toggle karna sambhav hota hai.

  • visible — kisi element ko dikhne yogya banao; zyada tar alag-alag screen sizes par invisible ko ulta karne ke liye kaam ka.
  • Responsive: <div class="visible md:invisible ...">.

Interview me kaam ki baatein
