  • Teen-tarfa fark (classic interview sawaal): hidden (display: none) layout se hata deta hai; invisible (visibility: hidden) layout ki jagah rakhta hai lekin content chhupata hai; collapse table-khaas roop hai jo dusri rows/columns ko reflow kiye bina chhupata hai.
  • invisible elements accessibility tree ke vichaaron me ab bhi hote hain — display: none ke vipreet, visibility: hidden wala content aam taur par ghoshit nahi hota, lekin ye phir bhi jagah gherta hai.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/visibility
← Previous35 · top / right / bottom / left→ Next37 · z-index
37Layout

z-index

Ye page un utilities ke baare me hai jo controlling the stack order of an element (`z-index` property) ke kaam aati hain. Neeche har class apne exact CSS ke saath di hai.

Ye hai kya?

  • Ye utilities stack order of an element (z-index property). ko control karne ke liye hain.

Classes — saari utilities

ClassStyles
z-<number>z-index: <number>;
z-autoz-index: auto;
z-[<value>]z-index: <value>;
z-(<custom-property>)z-index: var(<custom-property>);

Use kaise karein — Usage

  • Numeric utilities (z-10, z-50, …) DOM order ki parwah kiye bina stack order control karti hain — page ka example paanch boxes ko ulte DOM order me stack karta hai:
html
  <div class="z-40 ...">05</div>
  <div class="z-30 ...">04</div>
  <div class="z-20 ...">03</div>
  <div class="z-10 ...">02</div>
  <div class="z-0 ...">01</div>

(05 sabse upar, DOM me pehle hone ke bawajood.)

  • Negative values: aage dash lagao — -z-10 (example box 03 ko dusron ke peeche rakhta hai).
  • Custom value: <div class="z-[calc(var(--index)+1)] ...">; CSS variable shorthand: z-(--my-z) (= z-[var(--my-z)]).
  • Responsive: <div class="z-0 md:z-50 ...">.

Interview me kaam ki baatein

  • z-index sirf positioned elements (ya flex/grid items) par lagu hota hai — static element par ye kuch nahi karta; relative/absolute/fixed/sticky ke saath jodo.
  • Stacking contexts mayne rakhte hain: kam z-index (ya isolate kiye) parent ke andar ka uncha z-index bagal wale stacking context ke upar nahi nikal sakta — isolation page dekho (isolate jaan-boojhkar ek naya stacking context banata hai). Aam bug: modal overlay ke neeche, kyunki kisi parent ne stacking context bana diya.
  • v4 me koi fixed scale nahi hai (v3 ke 0/10/20/30/40/50 naam wale steps ke vipreet) — koi bhi number z-<number> (bare value) se kaam karta hai.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/z-index
← Previous36 · visibility→ Next38 · flex-basis
38Flexbox & Grid

flex-basis

Is section me hum flex-basis ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Flex items ke shuruwaati size ko control karne ki utilities (flex-basis). Basis main axis par item ka shuruwaati size hai, isse pehle ki badhna/sikudna baaki jagah baante.

ClassStyles
basis-<number>flex-basis: calc(var(--spacing) * <number>);
basis-<fraction>flex-basis: calc(<fraction> * 100%);
basis-fullflex-basis: 100%;
basis-autoflex-basis: auto;
basis-pxflex-basis: 1px;
basis-3xsflex-basis: var(--container-3xs); /* 16rem (256px) */
basis-2xsflex-basis: var(--container-2xs); /* 18rem (288px) */
basis-xsflex-basis: var(--container-xs); /* 20rem (320px) */
basis-smflex-basis: var(--container-sm); /* 24rem (384px) */
basis-mdflex-basis: var(--container-md); /* 28rem (448px) */

(Class table container sizes ko basis-md tak deti hai; poori scale ke liye header me container-scale note dekho.)

  • Spacing scale: basis-64, basis-128:
html
  <div class="flex flex-row">
    <div class="basis-64">01</div>
    <div class="basis-64">02</div>
    <div class="basis-128">03</div>
  </div>
  • Container scale: basis-3xs, basis-2xs, basis-xs, basis-sm:
html
  <div class="flex flex-row">
    <div class="basis-3xs">01</div>
    <div class="basis-2xs">02</div>
    <div class="basis-xs">03</div>
    <div class="basis-sm">04</div>
  </div>
  • Fractions: basis-1/3, basis-2/3:
html
  <div class="flex flex-row">
    <div class="basis-1/3">01</div>
    <div class="basis-2/3">02</div>
  </div>
  • Arbitrary value: <div class="basis-[30vw] ...">
  • CSS variable: <div class="basis-(--my-basis) ..."> (= basis-[var(--my-basis)])
  • Responsive: <div class="basis-1/4 md:basis-1/3">01</div> etc. — basis-1/4 md:basis-1/3 / basis-1/2 md:basis-1/3.
  • Customise karna: @theme { --container-4xs: 14rem; } basis-4xs chalu karta hai; --spacing basis-<number> utilities ko chalata hai (@theme { --spacing: 1px; }).
  • Interview ki baatein: basis sirf shuruaati size hai — antim size flex-grow/flex-shrink aur uplabdh jagah par bhi nirbhar karta hai. basis-auto item ke content se size leta hai; basis-0 (number 0) aur flex-1/grow classic "content size ko ignore karo, jagah barabar baanto" pattern hai. basis-* (flex-item ki main-axis shuruaati size) ko w-* (width, jo basis ko sirf tab set karti hai jab flex-basis auto ho) se uljho mat.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/flex-basis
← Previous37 · z-index→ Next39 · flex-direction
39Flexbox & Grid

flex-direction

Is section me hum flex-direction ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities direction of flex items (flex-direction). This sets the main axis. ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
flex-rowflex-direction: row;
flex-row-reverseflex-direction: row-reverse;
flex-colflex-direction: column;
flex-col-reverseflex-direction: column-reverse;
  • flex-row — items horizontally, text ki disha me:
html
  <div class="flex flex-row ..."><div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div></div>
  • flex-row-reverse — items horizontally, ulti disha me:
html
  <div class="flex flex-row-reverse ..."><div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div></div>
  • flex-col — items vertically:
html
  <div class="flex flex-col ..."><div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div></div>
  • flex-col-reverse — items vertically, ulti disha me:
html
  <div class="flex flex-col-reverse ..."><div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div></div>
  • Responsive: <div class="flex flex-col md:flex-row ..."> — the standard mobile-column → desktop-row pattern.
  • Interview ki baatein: direction tay karta hai ki kaunsi axis "main" (justify) hai aur kaunsi "cross" (align). row-reverse/col-reverse sirf dikhne wala order ulta karte hain — DOM/tab order nahi badalta, jo accessibility ke liye mayne rakhta hai. RTL layouts me, row text ki disha ko follow karta hai.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/flex-direction
← Previous38 · flex-basis→ Next40 · flex-wrap
40Flexbox & Grid

flex-wrap

Is section me hum flex-wrap ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities ye control karne ke liye hain ki kaise flex items wrap (flex-wrap).

ClassStyles
flex-nowrapflex-wrap: nowrap;
flex-wrapflex-wrap: wrap;
flex-wrap-reverseflex-wrap: wrap-reverse;
  • flex-nowrap — wrapping roko; zaroorat pade to na-jhukne wale items container se overflow karte hain:
html
  <div class="flex flex-nowrap"><div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div></div>
  • flex-wrap — items ko wrap hone do:
html
  <div class="flex flex-wrap"><div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div></div>
  • flex-wrap-reverse — ulti disha me wrap karo:
html
  <div class="flex flex-wrap-reverse"><div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div></div>
  • Responsive: <div class="flex flex-wrap md:flex-wrap-reverse ...">
  • Interview ki baatein: default flex bartav nowrap hai — items lapetne ke bajaye sikudte hain (agar sikud sakte hon), to overflow tab hota hai jab items kaafi nahi sikud sakte. Wrapping sirf tab mayne rakhti hai jab items ki basis/width container se zyada ho. wrap-reverse lapeti hui lines ke cross-axis stacking ko ulta karta hai, ek line ke andar ke item order ko nahi.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/flex-wrap
← Previous39 · flex-direction→ Next41 · flex
41Flexbox & Grid

flex

Is section me hum flex ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities ye control karne ke liye hain ki kaise flex items both grow and shrink — the flex shorthand (flex-grow flex-shrink flex-basis in one value).

ClassStyles
flex-<number>flex: <number>;
flex-<fraction>flex: calc(<fraction> * 100%);
flex-autoflex: auto;
flex-initialflex: 0 auto;
flex-noneflex: none;
flex-(<custom-property>)flex: var(<custom-property>);
flex-[<value>]flex: <value>;
  • flex-1 (number) — kisi item ko uske shuruaati size ki parwah kiye bina (basis 0) zaroorat ke hisaab se badhne aur sikudne do:
html
  <div class="flex">
    <div class="w-14 flex-none ...">01</div>
    <div class="w-64 flex-1 ...">02</div>
    <div class="w-32 flex-1 ...">03</div>
  </div>

Items 02 aur 03 alag w-* values ke bawajood khali jagah barabar baant-te hain.

  • flex-initial — kisi item ko uske shuruaati size ko dhyan me rakhkar sikudne do lekin badhne mat do (flex: 0 1 auto):
html
  <div class="flex">
    <div class="w-14 flex-none ...">01</div>
    <div class="w-64 flex-initial ...">02</div>
    <div class="w-32 flex-initial ...">03</div>
  </div>
  • flex-auto — kisi item ko uske shuruaati size ko dhyan me rakhkar badhne aur sikudne do (flex: 1 1 auto):
html
  <div class="flex ...">
    <div class="w-14 flex-none ...">01</div>
    <div class="w-64 flex-auto ...">02</div>
    <div class="w-32 flex-auto ...">03</div>
  </div>

flex-1 ke vipreet, flex-auto items apne w-* size se shuru hote hain aur phir anupaat me badhte hain.

  • flex-none — kisi item ko badhne ya sikudne se roko (flex: none = 0 0 auto):
html
  <div class="flex ...">
    <div class="w-14 flex-none ...">01</div>
    <div class="w-32 flex-none ...">02</div>
    <div class="flex-1 ...">03</div>
  </div>
  • Arbitrary value: <div class="flex-[3_1_auto] ..."> (underscores = spaces: flex: 3 1 auto).
  • CSS variable: <div class="flex-(--my-flex) ..."> (= flex-[var(--my-flex)]).
  • Responsive: <div class="flex-none md:flex-1 ...">
  • Interview ki baatein — classic uljhan, ye table yaad kar lo:
    • flex-1 = 1 1 0% — shuruaati size ko ignore karta hai; barabar bantwara.
    • flex-auto = 1 1 auto — shuruaati size ki izzat karta hai, phir badhta hai.
    • flex-initial = 0 1 auto — shuruaati size ki izzat karta hai, sirf sikudta hai, kabhi badhta nahi. (Ye flex items ke liye CSS ka default bhi hai.)
    • flex-none = 0 0 auto — fixed size, kabhi badhta ya sikudta nahi.
    • flex-<fraction> flex shorthand ko ek percentage basis par set karta hai.
    • flex-1 ko grow se uljho mat: grow sirf flex-grow: 1 set karta hai aur basis ko auto par chhod deta hai.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/flex
← Previous40 · flex-wrap→ Next42 · flex-grow
42Flexbox & Grid

flex-grow

Is section me hum flex-grow ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities ye control karne ke liye hain ki kaise flex items grow (flex-grow) — how free space on the main axis is distributed.

ClassStyles
growflex-grow: 1;
grow-<number>flex-grow: <number>;
grow-[<value>]flex-grow: <value>;
grow-(<custom-property>)flex-grow: var(<custom-property>);
  • grow — kisi item ko uplabdh jagah bharne ke liye badhne do:
html
  <div class="flex ...">
    <div class="size-14 flex-none ...">01</div>
    <div class="size-14 grow ...">02</div>
    <div class="size-14 flex-none ...">03</div>
  </div>
  • grow-<number> — growth factor ke anupaat me badho, saathiyon ke saapeksh. grow-3 / grow-7 / grow-3 beech wale item ko khali jagah ka 7/(3+7+3) deta hai:
html
  <div class="flex ...">
    <div class="size-14 grow-3 ...">01</div>
    <div class="size-14 grow-7 ...">02</div>
    <div class="size-14 grow-3 ...">03</div>
  </div>
  • grow-0 — kisi item ko badhne se roko:
html
  <div class="flex ...">
    <div class="size-14 grow ...">01</div>
    <div class="size-14 grow-0 ...">02</div>
    <div class="size-14 grow ...">03</div>
  </div>
  • Arbitrary value: <div class="grow-[25vw] ..."> (note: docs ka example yahan length value istemal karta hai; grow aam taur par bina-unit wala factor leta hai).
  • CSS variable: <div class="grow-(--my-grow) ..."> (= grow-[var(--my-grow)]).
  • Responsive: <div class="grow md:grow-0 ...">
  • Interview ki baatein: grow sirf tab asar karta hai jab khali jagah ho; container pehle se bhara ho to ye kuch nahi karta. Badhotri factor ke anupaat me hoti hai, pakki (absolute) nahi. grow basis ko nahi badalta — agar content size ignore karna hai to basis-0/flex-1 ke saath jodo.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/flex-grow
← Previous41 · flex→ Next43 · flex-shrink
43Flexbox & Grid

flex-shrink

Is section me hum flex-shrink ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities ye control karne ke liye hain ki kaise flex items shrink (flex-shrink) — how overflow on the main axis is absorbed.

ClassStyles
shrinkflex-shrink: 1;
shrink-<number>flex-shrink: <number>;
shrink-[<value>]flex-shrink: <value>;
shrink-(<custom-property>)flex-shrink: var(<custom-property>);
  • shrink — zaroorat pade to kisi item ko sikudne do:
html
  <div class="flex ...">
    <div class="h-14 w-14 flex-none ...">01</div>
    <div class="h-14 w-64 shrink ...">02</div>
    <div class="h-14 w-14 flex-none ...">03</div>
  </div>
  • shrink-0 — kisi item ko sikudne se roko (ye apni chaudaai rakhta hai aur overflow kar sakta hai):
html
  <div class="flex ...">
    <div class="h-16 flex-1 ...">01</div>
    <div class="h-16 w-32 shrink-0 ...">02</div>
    <div class="h-16 flex-1 ...">03</div>
  </div>
  • Arbitrary value: <div class="shrink-[calc(100vw-var(--sidebar))] ...">
  • CSS variable: <div class="shrink-(--my-shrink) ..."> (= shrink-[var(--my-shrink)]).
  • Responsive: <div class="shrink md:shrink-0 ...">
  • Interview ki baatein: default flex-shrink 1 hai, to items default roop se sikudte hain; shrink-0 flex row me icons/avatars/buttons ke kuchle jaane ki aam theek hai. Shrink factors saapeksh hain — shrink-2 wala item shrink-1 se dugna chhodta hai. Shrink sirf tab lagu hota hai jab items overflow karein; ye kisi item ko uske minimum content size se chhota kabhi nahi karta jab tak min-w-0/min-h-0 bhi set na ho (flex children me classic text-truncation bug).
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/flex-shrink
← Previous42 · flex-grow→ Next44 · order
44Flexbox & Grid

order

Is section me hum order ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities order of flex and grid items (order) — visual order, independent of DOM order. ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
order-<number>order: <number>;
-order-<number>order: calc(<number> * -1);
order-firstorder: -9999;
order-lastorder: 9999;
order-(<custom-property>)order: var(<custom-property>);
order-[<value>]order: <value>;
  • Number wala order — items ko document se alag order me render karo:
html
  <div class="flex justify-between ...">
    <div class="order-3 ...">01</div>
    <div class="order-1 ...">02</div>
    <div class="order-2 ...">03</div>
  </div>

02, 03, 01 dikhata hai.

  • order-first / order-last — pehle ya aakhir me render karo:
html
  <div class="flex justify-between ...">
    <div class="order-last ...">01</div>
    <div class="...">02</div>
    <div class="order-first ...">03</div>
  </div>
  • Negative values: aage dash lagao: <div class="-order-1">
  • Arbitrary value: <div class="order-[min(var(--total-items),10)] ...">
  • CSS variable: <div class="order-(--my-order) ..."> (= order-[var(--my-order)]).
  • Responsive: <div class="order-first md:order-last ..."> — jaise, mobile par kisi element ko pehle, desktop par aakhiri le jao.
  • Interview ki baatein: default order 0 hai; ek hi order wale items DOM order banaye rakhte hain. order sirf dikhne wala order badalta hai — screen readers aur keyboard tab order ab bhi DOM ko follow karte hain, isliye arthpoorn content ko dobara kram dene ke liye ise istemal mat karo. Flex aur grid dono containers me kaam karta hai.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/order
← Previous43 · flex-shrink→ Next45 · grid-template-columns
45Flexbox & Grid

grid-template-columns

Is section me hum grid-template-columns ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities the columns in a grid layout (grid-template-columns). tay karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
grid-cols-<number>grid-template-columns: repeat(<number>, minmax(0, 1fr));
grid-cols-nonegrid-template-columns: none;
grid-cols-subgridgrid-template-columns: subgrid;
grid-cols-[<value>]grid-template-columns: <value>;
grid-cols-(<custom-property>)grid-template-columns: var(<custom-property>);
  • Barabar columns: grid-cols-2, grid-cols-4 n barabar size ke columns banate hain. minmax(0, 1fr) par dhyan do — 0 minimum hi wo hai jo columns ko content size se neeche sikudne deta hai (grid blowout rokta hai):
html
  <div class="grid grid-cols-4 gap-4">
    <div>01</div>
    <!-- ... -->
    <div>09</div>
  </div>
  • Subgrid: grid-cols-subgrid kisi nested grid ko uske parent ke tay column tracks apnane par majboor karta hai:
html
  <div class="grid grid-cols-4 gap-4">
    <div>01</div>
    <!-- ... -->
    <div>05</div>
    <div class="col-span-3 grid grid-cols-subgrid gap-4">
      <div class="col-start-2">06</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  • Arbitrary value: <div class="grid-cols-[200px_minmax(900px,_1fr)_100px] ..."> (underscores = spaces).
  • CSS variable: <div class="grid-cols-(--my-grid-cols) ..."> (= grid-cols-[var(--my-grid-cols)]).
  • Responsive: <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-6 ..."> — the standard 1-column mobile → multi-column desktop pattern.
  • Interview ki baatein: 1fr ka matlab hai khali jagah ka ek hissa; repeat(n, minmax(0, 1fr)) hi wajah hai ki grid-cols-* columns barabar hote hain. grid-cols-none ek saaf template ko hata deta hai (columns implicit/auto ho jate hain). Subgrid kisi nested grid ke tracks ko parent ke tracks se milane ke liye hai — ek aam interview topic; iske bina, nested grids ke tracks azaad hote hain.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/grid-template-columns

46Flexbox & Grid

grid-column

Is section me hum grid-column ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye section asal docs ko taaza padhkar verify kiya gaya hai.

Class table

ClassStyles
col-span-<number>grid-column: span <number> / span <number>;
col-span-fullgrid-column: 1 / -1;
col-span-(<custom-property>)grid-column: span var(<custom-property>) / span var(<custom-property>);
col-span-[<value>]grid-column: span <value> / span <value>;
col-start-<number>grid-column-start: <number>;
-col-start-<number>grid-column-start: calc(<number> * -1);
col-start-autogrid-column-start: auto;
col-start-(<custom-property>)grid-column-start: var(<custom-property>);
col-start-[<value>]grid-column-start: <value>;
col-end-<number>grid-column-end: <number>;
col-end-* other formsNot shown in the fetched text — the page's col-end table was cut off after col-end-<number> in the extraction. By symmetry with the col-start table above and the verified grid-row page, expect col-end-auto, -col-end-<number>, col-end-(<custom-property>), col-end-[<value>] — but confirm against the live page before building.

How it works

  • col-span-<number> (jaise col-span-2, col-span-4) kisi element ko n columns tak phailata hai; col-span-full poore grid tak phailta hai (1 / -1).
  • col-start-<number> / col-end-<number> kisi element ko n-vi grid line par rakhte hain, jaise col-start-2, col-end-3; ye col-span-* ke saath judkar kisi khaas line se khaas sankhya me columns tak phailte hain. Example: <div class="grid grid-cols-6 gap-4"> ke saath col-span-4 col-start-2, col-start-1 col-end-3, col-span-2 col-end-7, col-start-1 col-end-7.
  • Arbitrary values: col-[<value>], col-span-[<value>], col-start-[<value>], col-end-[<value>] — jaise col-[16_/_span_16] (underscores spaces ban jate hain).
  • CSS variables: col-(--my-columns) col-[var(--my-columns)] ka shorthand hai.
  • Responsive: breakpoint variant aage lagao, jaise col-span-2 md:col-span-6.

Aam galtiyaan / interview points

  • col-span-* grid-column: span n / span n set karta hai — ye auto-placement wali jagah se n tracks tak phailta hai; jab sahee grid line mayne rakhti ho to col-start-*/col-end-* istemal karo.
  • Negative col-start (-col-start-<number>) grid lines ko ant se ginta hai.
  • Ye grid-row ka column wala saathi hai (row-span-*, row-start-*, row-end-*).
Live check — docs table se zyada

Live table me col-end-* ki sirf col-end-<number> row dikhti hai, lekin source se verify kiya gaya poora set col-start ko mirror karta hai: col-end-<number>, -col-end-<number>, col-end-auto, col-end-(<custom-property>), col-end-[<value>]. Page ki prose col-end-[<value>] aur col-(--my-columns) ko confirm karti hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/grid-column

47Flexbox & Grid

grid-template-rows

Is section me hum grid-template-rows ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities the rows in a grid layout (grid-template-rows). The exact row mirror of grid-template-columns. tay karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
grid-rows-<number>grid-template-rows: repeat(<number>, minmax(0, 1fr));
grid-rows-nonegrid-template-rows: none;
grid-rows-subgridgrid-template-rows: subgrid;
grid-rows-[<value>]grid-template-rows: <value>;
grid-rows-(<custom-property>)grid-template-rows: var(<custom-property>);
  • Barabar rows: grid-rows-2, grid-rows-4. Rows barabar tracks ke roop me sirf tab dikhti hain jab column flow ke saath jodein (items pehle columns me neeche bharte hain):
html
  <div class="grid grid-flow-col grid-rows-4 gap-4">
    <div>01</div>
    <!-- ... -->
    <div>09</div>
  </div>
  • Subgrid: grid-rows-subgrid parent ke row tracks apnata hai:
html
  <div class="grid grid-flow-col grid-rows-4 gap-4">
    <div>01</div>
    <!-- ... -->
    <div>05</div>
    <div class="row-span-3 grid grid-rows-subgrid gap-4">
      <div class="row-start-2">06</div>
    </div>
    <div>07</div>
    <!-- ... -->
    <div>10</div>
  </div>
  • Arbitrary value: <div class="grid-rows-[200px_minmax(900px,1fr)_100px] ...">
  • CSS variable: <div class="grid-rows-(--my-grid-rows) ..."> (= grid-rows-[var(--my-grid-rows)]).
  • Responsive: <div class="grid grid-rows-2 md:grid-rows-6 ...">
  • Interview ki baatein: rows kabhi-kabhar hi saaf taur par set hoti hain — zyada tar grids columns tay karte hain aur rows ko implicit rehne dete hain (grid-auto-rows dekho). grid-rows-* ke dikhne ke liye aam taur par grid-flow-col chahiye, warna items ek row bharkar lapet jate hain. Columns jaisa hi minmax(0, 1fr) wala tark.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/grid-template-rows

48Flexbox & Grid

grid-row

Is section me hum grid-row ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities ye control karne ke liye hain ki kaise elements are sized and placed across grid rows (grid-row, grid-row-start, grid-row-end).

ClassStyles
row-span-<number>grid-row: span <number> / span <number>;
row-span-fullgrid-row: 1 / -1;
row-span-(<custom-property>)grid-row: span var(<custom-property>) / span var(<custom-property>);
row-span-[<value>]grid-row: span <value> / span <value>;
row-start-<number>grid-row-start: <number>;
-row-start-<number>grid-row-start: calc(<number> * -1);
row-start-autogrid-row-start: auto;
row-start-(<custom-property>)grid-row-start: var(<custom-property>);
row-start-[<value>]grid-row-start: <value>;
row-end-<number>grid-row-end: <number>;
(and, by the same pattern, row-end-auto, row-end-(...), row-end-[...] — see the page's arbitrary/CSS-variable notes)
  • Rows tak phailna: row-span-2, row-span-4 kisi element ko n rows tak phailate hain:
html
  <div class="grid grid-flow-col grid-rows-3 gap-4">
    <div class="row-span-3 ...">01</div>
    <div class="col-span-2 ...">02</div>
    <div class="col-span-2 row-span-2 ...">03</div>
  </div>
  • Start / end lines: row-start-2, row-end-3 kisi element ko n-vi grid line par rakhte hain:
html
  <div class="grid grid-flow-col grid-rows-3 gap-4">
    <div class="row-span-2 row-start-2 ...">01</div>
    <div class="row-span-2 row-end-3 ...">02</div>
    <div class="row-start-1 row-end-4 ...">03</div>
  </div>

Inhe row-span-<number> ke saath jodkar kisi khaas line se khaas sankhya me rows tak phailaya ja sakta hai.

  • Arbitrary values: row-[<value>], row-span-[<value>], row-start-[<value>], row-end-[<value>], jaise <div class="row-[span_16_/_span_16] ...">
  • CSS variable: <div class="row-(--my-rows) ..."> (= row-[var(--my-rows)]).
  • Responsive: <div class="row-span-3 md:row-span-4 ...">
  • Interview ki baatein: grid lines 1-indexed hain; line -1 aakhiri line hai, isiliye row-span-full grid-row: 1 / -1 hai. span tracks ginta hai, start/end lines ginte hain — row-start-2 + row-span-2 har haal me row-end-4 ke barabar nahi hai (end exclusive hai). Negative line numbers ant se ginay jate hain.
Live check — docs table se zyada

Usi mirror logic se row-end ka poora set hai: row-end-<number>, -row-end-<number>, row-end-auto, row-end-(<custom-property>), row-end-[<value>] — bilkul row-start ki tarah (Tailwind v4 source se verify).

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/grid-row

grid-auto-flow

Is section me hum grid-auto-flow ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities ye control karne ke liye hain ki kaise elements in a grid are auto-placed (grid-auto-flow) — the placement algorithm for items without an explicit position.

ClassStyles
grid-flow-rowgrid-auto-flow: row;
grid-flow-colgrid-auto-flow: column;
grid-flow-densegrid-auto-flow: dense;
grid-flow-row-densegrid-auto-flow: row dense;
grid-flow-col-densegrid-auto-flow: column dense;
  • Example — grid-cols-3 grid-rows-3 ke saath grid-flow-row-dense:
html
  <div class="grid grid-flow-row-dense grid-cols-3 grid-rows-3 ...">
    <div class="col-span-2">01</div>
    <div class="col-span-2">02</div>
    <div>03</div>
    <div>04</div>
    <div>05</div>
  </div>
  • Responsive: <div class="grid grid-flow-col md:grid-flow-row ...">
  • Interview ki baatein: default row hai — items har row me aade bharte hain, phir agli row me lapet-te hain. col pehle har column me neeche bharta hai (grid-rows-* layouts ke liye chahiye). dense spanning items ke chhode chhedon ko peeche se bharta hai: dense ke bina, auto-placement algorithm gaps chhod deta hai, baad wale chhote item ko pehle ke khali cell me upar kheenchne ke bajaye. dense items ko dikhne me DOM order se bahar kar sakta hai — order ki tarah ek accessibility savdhaani.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/grid-auto-flow

grid-auto-columns

Is section me hum grid-auto-columns ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Apne aap bane grid columns ke size ko control karne ki utilities (grid-auto-columns) — un columns ka size jo grid khud banata hai jab items spasht template ke bahar rakhe jate hain.

ClassStyles
auto-cols-autogrid-auto-columns: auto;
auto-cols-mingrid-auto-columns: min-content;
auto-cols-maxgrid-auto-columns: max-content;
auto-cols-frgrid-auto-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
auto-cols-<number>grid-auto-columns: calc(var(--spacing) * <number>);
auto-cols-(<custom-property>)grid-auto-columns: var(<custom-property>);
auto-cols-[<value>]grid-auto-columns: <value>;
  • Example — column flow ke saath auto-cols-min / auto-cols-max:
html
  <div class="grid auto-cols-max grid-flow-col">
    <div>01</div>
    <div>02</div>
    <div>03</div>
  </div>
  • Arbitrary value: <div class="auto-cols-[minmax(0,2fr)] ...">
  • CSS variable: <div class="auto-cols-(--my-auto-cols) ..."> (= auto-cols-[var(--my-auto-cols)]).
  • Responsive: <div class="grid grid-flow-col auto-cols-max md:auto-cols-min ...">
  • Interview ki baatein: saaf tracks grid-cols-* se aate hain; implicit tracks tab bante hain jab template ki tay sankhya se zyada items hon (ya template se aage ka col-start ho). auto-cols-fr implicit columns ko khali jagah barabar baantne par majboor karta hai; min/max unhe content ke hisaab se size dete hain (min-content = sabse chhota jo content overflow kiye bina ho sakta hai, max-content = poora kudrati content size). Sirf grid-flow-col ya template se aage ki saaf placement ke saath dikhta hai.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/grid-auto-columns

grid-auto-rows

Is section me hum grid-auto-rows ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities size of implicitly-created grid rows (grid-auto-rows). The exact row mirror of grid-auto-columns. ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
auto-rows-autogrid-auto-rows: auto;
auto-rows-mingrid-auto-rows: min-content;
auto-rows-maxgrid-auto-rows: max-content;
auto-rows-frgrid-auto-rows: minmax(0, 1fr);
auto-rows-<number>grid-auto-rows: calc(var(--spacing) * <number>);
auto-rows-(<custom-property>)grid-auto-rows: var(<custom-property>);
auto-rows-[<value>]grid-auto-rows: <value>;
  • Example:
html
  <div class="grid grid-flow-row auto-rows-max">
    <div>01</div>
    <div>02</div>
    <div>03</div>
  </div>
  • Arbitrary value: <div class="auto-rows-[minmax(0,2fr)] ...">
  • CSS variable: <div class="auto-rows-(--my-auto-rows) ..."> (= auto-rows-[var(--my-auto-rows)]).
  • Responsive: <div class="grid grid-flow-row auto-rows-max md:auto-rows-min ...">
  • Interview ki baatein: ek aam grid (jahan rows implicit hain) me row heights control karne ka ye roz ka tareeka hai: barabar-unchaai wali rows ke liye auto-rows-fr, content-sized rows ke liye auto-rows-min/auto-rows-max, spacing scale se fixed row heights ke liye auto-rows-<number>. auto-rows-fr rows ko sirf tab barabar karta hai jab grid container ke paas baantne ke liye ek tay unchaai ho.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/grid-auto-rows

gap

Is section me hum gap ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities gutters between grid and flexbox items (gap, column-gap, row-gap). ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
gap-<number>gap: calc(var(--spacing) * <value>);
gap-pxgap: 1px;
gap-(<custom-property>)gap: var(<custom-property>);
gap-[<value>]gap: <value>;
gap-x-<number>column-gap: calc(var(--spacing) * <value>);
gap-x-pxcolumn-gap: 1px;
gap-x-(<custom-property>)column-gap: var(<custom-property>);
gap-x-[<value>]column-gap: <value>;
gap-y-<number>row-gap: calc(var(--spacing) * <value>);
gap-y-pxrow-gap: 1px;
gap-y-(<custom-property>)row-gap: var(<custom-property>);
gap-y-[<value>]row-gap: <value>;
  • Dono axes: gap-2, gap-4 rows aur columns dono ke beech gap set karte hain:
html
  <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
    <div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div><div>04</div>
  </div>
  • Alag axes: gap-x-8 (columns) aur gap-y-4 (rows):
html
  <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-x-8 gap-y-4">
    <div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div><div>04</div><div>05</div><div>06</div>
  </div>
  • Arbitrary value: <div class="gap-[10vw] ..."> (gap-x-[...], gap-y-[...] bhi).
  • CSS variable: <div class="gap-(--my-gap) ..."> (= gap-[var(--my-gap)]).
  • Responsive: <div class="grid gap-4 md:gap-6 ...">
  • Interview ki baatein: gap flexbox aur grid (aur multi-column layout) me kaam karta hai; margins ke vipreet, gap jagah sirf items ke beech jodta hai — container ke kinaron par koi extra jagah nahi, koi margin-collapsing nahi, :last-child wale jugaad ki zaroorat nahi. Isiliye margin page grids aur wrapping layouts ke liye space-x-*/space-y-* utilities par gap ki salaah deta hai. gap-x = column-gap, gap-y = row-gap.

justify-content

Is section me hum justify-content ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities ye control karne ke liye hain ki kaise flex and grid items are positioned along a container's main axis (justify-content).

ClassStyles
justify-startjustify-content: flex-start;
justify-endjustify-content: flex-end;
justify-end-safejustify-content: safe flex-end;
justify-centerjustify-content: center;
justify-center-safejustify-content: safe center;
justify-betweenjustify-content: space-between;
justify-aroundjustify-content: space-around;
justify-evenlyjustify-content: space-evenly;
justify-stretchjustify-content: stretch;
justify-baselinejustify-content: baseline;
justify-normaljustify-content: normal;
  • justify-start — items ko main axis ke start ke saath bandho:
html
  <div class="flex justify-start ..."><div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div></div>
  • justify-center / justify-center-safe — items ko main axis par centre karo. Docs safe variant ke liye ek resizable-container demo dikhate hain:
html
  <div class="flex justify-center ..."><div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div><div>04</div></div>
  <div class="flex justify-center-safe ..."><div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div><div>04</div></div>

Jab kaafi jagah na ho, justify-center-safe items ko centre ke bajaye start se align karta hai (taaki content dono taraf se kat na jaye / scroll karke apahunch na ho).

  • justify-end / justify-end-safe — main axis ke ant ke saath bandho; safe variant usi tarah jagah kam padne par start par wapas jaata hai:
html
  <div class="flex justify-end ..."><div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div><div>04</div></div>
  <div class="flex justify-end-safe ..."><div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div><div>04</div></div>
  • justify-between — items ke beech barabar jagah, kinaron par koi nahi:
html
  <div class="flex justify-between ..."><div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div></div>
  • justify-around — har item ke har taraf barabar jagah (to do items ke beech ka gap kinare wali jagah ka dugna hota hai):
html
  <div class="flex justify-around ..."><div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div></div>
  • justify-evenly — har item ke chaaron or barabar jagah, justify-around se milne wale dugne ko ginate hue — matlab items aur kinaron ke beech ke gaps asal me sab barabar hain:
html
  <div class="flex justify-evenly ..."><div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div></div>
  • justify-stretch — auto-sized items main axis ke saath uplabdh jagah bharte hain:
html
  <div class="grid grid-cols-[4rem_auto_4rem] justify-stretch ..."><div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div></div>
  • justify-normal — items ko unki default position me bandho, jaise koi justify-content set hi na ho:
html
  <div class="flex justify-normal ..."><div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div></div>
  • (justify-baseline class table me justify-content: baseline; ke saath aata hai, lekin page par iske liye koi alag example nahi hai.)
  • Responsive: <div class="flex justify-start md:justify-between ...">
  • Interview ki baatein: between/around/evenly ka fark ek pasandeeda interview sawaal hai — use banakar dikhao: between = kinare par koi jagah nahi; around = aadhe size ki kinare wali jagah; evenly = har jagah barabar. *-safe variants overflow ki suraksha ke liye hain: saada center/end content ko pahunch se bahar dhakel sakta hai (negative overflow) jab items container se chaade hon; safe start par wapas gir jata hai. "Main axis" flex-direction par nirbhar hai: flex-row ke liye horizontal, flex-col ke liye vertical.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/justify-content

justify-items

Is section me hum justify-items ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Grid items apni inline axis ke saath kaise align hote hain, ise control karne ki utilities (justify-items). Container-level — grid ke saare items ke liye default set karta hai.

ClassStyles

justify-items-endjustify-items: end;
justify-items-end-safejustify-items: safe end;
justify-items-centerjustify-items: center;
justify-items-center-safejustify-items: safe center;
justify-items-stretchjustify-items: stretch;
justify-items-normaljustify-items: normal;
  • justify-items-start:
html
  <div class="grid justify-items-start ..."><div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div><div>04</div><div>05</div><div>06</div></div>
  • justify-items-end / justify-items-end-safe (page par resizable-container demo):
html
  <div class="grid grid-flow-col justify-items-end ..."><div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div></div>
  <div class="grid grid-flow-col justify-items-end-safe ..."><div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div></div>

Jab kaafi jagah na ho, safe variant items ko end ke bajaye start se align karta hai.

  • justify-items-center / justify-items-center-safe:
html
  <div class="grid grid-flow-col justify-items-center ..."><div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div></div>
  <div class="grid grid-flow-col justify-items-center-safe ..."><div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div></div>

Jagah kam ho to safe variant start par wapas gir jata hai. (Note: class table aur examples saaf karte hain ki ye centre karte hain.)

  • justify-items-stretch — items ko unki inline axis ke saath kheenchon:
html
  <div class="grid justify-items-stretch ..."><div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div><div>04</div><div>05</div><div>06</div></div>
  • Responsive: <div class="grid justify-items-start md:justify-items-center ...">
  • Interview ki baatein: justify-items sirf grid ke liye hai (flexbox me iska koi asar nahi — wahan justify-content istemal karo). Ye container-level default hai jise justify-self har item ke liye override karta hai. stretch default bartav hai — items apne grid area ko bharte hain jab tak unka apna aantarik size na ho. Inline axis = LTR writing mode me horizontal; RTL me ye palat jata hai.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/justify-items
← Previous53 · justify-content→ Next55 · justify-self
55Flexbox & Grid

justify-self

Is section me hum justify-self ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities ye control karne ke liye hain ki kaise an individual grid item is aligned along its inline axis (justify-self). Per-item override of justify-items.

ClassStyles
justify-self-autojustify-self: auto;
justify-self-startjustify-self: start;
justify-self-centerjustify-self: center;
justify-self-center-safejustify-self: safe center;
justify-self-endjustify-self: end;
justify-self-end-safejustify-self: safe end;
justify-self-stretchjustify-self: stretch;
  • justify-self-auto — grid ki justify-items value ke hisaab se align karo (default; container ki setting virasat me leta hai):
html
  <div class="grid justify-items-stretch ...">
    <!-- ... -->
    <div class="justify-self-auto ...">02</div>
    <!-- ... -->
  </div>
  • justify-self-start — item ko uski inline axis ke start se align karo:
html
  <div class="grid justify-items-stretch ...">
    <!-- ... -->
    <div class="justify-self-start ...">02</div>
    <!-- ... -->
  </div>
  • justify-self-center / justify-self-center-safe (size badal sakne wale container ka demo):
html
  <div class="grid justify-items-stretch ..."><!-- ... --><div class="justify-self-center ...">02</div><!-- ... --></div>
  <div class="grid justify-items-stretch ..."><!-- ... --><div class="justify-self-center-safe ...">02</div><!-- ... --></div>

Jab kaafi jagah na ho, safe variant item ko centre ke bajaye start se align karta hai. (Saathi pages par bataya bartav start par wapas girna hi hai.)

  • justify-self-end / justify-self-end-safe:
html
  <div class="grid justify-items-stretch ..."><!-- ... --><div class="justify-self-end ...">02</div><!-- ... --></div>
  <div class="grid justify-items-stretch ..."><!-- ... --><div class="justify-self-end-safe ...">02</div><!-- ... --></div>

Safe variant jagah kam padne par start par wapas jaata hai.

  • justify-self-stretch — item ko uski inline axis par uske grid area ko bharne ke liye kheenchon:
html
  <div class="grid justify-items-start ..."><!-- ... --><div class="justify-self-stretch ...">02</div><!-- ... --></div>
  • Responsive: <div class="justify-self-start md:justify-self-end ...">
  • Interview ki baatein: *-self = ek item; *-items = container ke saare items; *-content = tracks/items ka poora set ek saath. auto ka matlab hai "container jo kahe wahi karo". Sirf grid ke liye — flexbox me, iske barabar per-item cross-axis control align-self hai, aur main-axis par per-item spacing margin: auto se hoti hai (jaise ml-auto).
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/justify-self
← Previous54 · justify-items→ Next56 · align-content
56Flexbox & Grid

align-content

Is section me hum align-content ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Kai-row wale flex aur grid containers me rows kaise position hoti hain, ise control karne ki utilities (align-content). Note karo class prefix content-* hai, align-content-* nahi.

ClassStyles
content-normalalign-content: normal;
content-centeralign-content: center;
content-startalign-content: flex-start;
content-endalign-content: flex-end;
content-betweenalign-content: space-between;
content-aroundalign-content: space-around;
content-evenlyalign-content: space-evenly;
content-baselinealign-content: baseline;
content-stretchalign-content: stretch;

Saare examples ek fixed-height multi-row grid istemal karte hain (grid h-56 grid-cols-3 ... gap-4 5 items ke saath, to baantne ke liye 2 rows hain):

  • content-start — rows ko cross axis ke start ke saath bandho:
html
  <div class="grid h-56 grid-cols-3 content-start gap-4 ..."><div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div><div>04</div><div>05</div></div>
  • content-center — rows ko cross axis ke centre me bandho (wahi aakaar, content-center).
  • content-end — rows ko cross axis ke ant ke saath bandho (wahi aakaar, content-end).
  • content-between — har line ke beech barabar jagah, kinaron par kuch nahi (wahi aakaar, content-between).
  • content-around — har line ke chaaron or barabar jagah (wahi aakaar, content-around).
  • content-evenly — har item ke chaaron or barabar jagah, content-around se milne wale dugne ko ginate hue (wahi aakaar, content-evenly).
  • content-stretch — content items cross axis ke saath uplabdh jagah bhar dete hain (wahi aakaar, content-stretch).
  • content-normal — default position, jaise koi align-content set hi na ho (wahi aakaar, content-normal).
  • Responsive: <div class="grid content-start md:content-around ...">
  • Interview ki baatein: align-content ka dikhne wala asar sirf tab hota hai jab cross axis par extra jagah ho AUR ek se zyada rows/lines hon — ek row ke saath ye kuch nahi karta (yahi classic "align-content kaam kyon nahi kar raha?" sawaal hai; jawab aam taur par hai ki iske bajaye align-items istemal karo, ya container ko h-56 jaisi fixed height aur wrapped content chahiye). Ye lines ko baant-ta hai, jabki align-items items ko ek line ke andar align karta hai. justify-content jaisa hi between/around/evenly spacing logic, lekin cross axis par.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/align-content
← Previous55 · justify-self→ Next57 · align-items
57Flexbox & Grid

align-items

Is section me hum align-items ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye section asal docs ko taaza padhkar verify kiya gaya hai.

Ye utilities ye control karne ke liye hain ki kaise flex and grid items are positioned along a container's cross axis.

Class table

ClassStyles
items-startalign-items: flex-start;
items-endalign-items: flex-end;
items-end-safealign-items: safe flex-end;
items-centeralign-items: center;
items-center-safealign-items: safe center;
items-baselinealign-items: baseline;
items-baseline-lastalign-items: last baseline;
items-stretchalign-items: stretch;

How it works

  • items-stretch (default) items ko container ki cross axis bharne ke liye kheenchta hai.
  • items-start items ko cross axis ke start se align karta hai; items-end end se; items-center unhe centre karta hai.
  • items-baseline items ko aise align karta hai ki unki saari baselines ek line me aa jayein; items-baseline-last unhe container ki aakhiri baseline se align karta hai — isliye kaam ka taaki text items alag unchaaiyon ke bawajood ek-dusre se align rahein (example: ek grid grid-cols-[1fr_auto] items-baseline-last jisme ek taraf image + heading + paragraph hai aur dusri taraf ek link).
  • items-end-safe / items-center-safe safe alignment keyword istemal karte hain, taaki kaafi jagah na hone par content container ke kinare se bahar na nikle.
  • Responsive: breakpoint variant aage lagao, jaise flex items-stretch md:items-center.

Aam galtiyaan / interview points

  • align-items container par kaam karta hai (cross axis); per-item wala roop align-self (self-*) hai.
  • items-center sirf cross axis par centre karta hai — main axis ke liye justify-* istemal karo.
  • items-baseline-last aakhiri baseline par align karne ke liye naya variant hai (jaise kisi link ke paas multi-line text blocks).
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/align-items
← Previous56 · align-content→ Next58 · align-self
58Flexbox & Grid

align-self

Is section me hum align-self ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities ye control karne ke liye hain ki kaise an individual flex or grid item is positioned along its container's cross axis (align-self). Per-item override of align-items.

ClassStyles
self-autoalign-self: auto;
self-startalign-self: flex-start;
self-endalign-self: flex-end;
self-end-safealign-self: safe flex-end;
self-centeralign-self: center;
self-center-safealign-self: safe center;
self-stretchalign-self: stretch;
self-baselinealign-self: baseline;
self-baseline-lastalign-self: last baseline;
  • self-auto — container ki align-items value ke hisaab se align karo:
html
  <div class="flex items-stretch ..."><div>01</div><div class="self-auto ...">02</div><div>03</div></div>
  • self-start — container ke align-items ke bawajood cross axis ke start se align karo:
html
  <div class="flex items-stretch ..."><div>01</div><div class="self-start ...">02</div><div>03</div></div>
  • self-center — container ki value ke bawajood cross axis par centre (wahi aakaar, item 02 par self-center).
  • self-end — container ki value ke bawajood cross axis ke end se align karo (wahi aakaar, item 02 par self-end).
  • self-stretch — container ki value ke bawajood cross axis bharne ke liye kheenchon (wahi aakaar, item 02 par self-stretch).
  • self-baseline — aise align karo ki item ki baseline container ki cross-axis baseline se mil jaye. Example alag top/bottom padding wale items istemal karta hai (pt-2 pb-6, pt-8 pb-12, pt-12 pb-4):
html
  <div class="flex ...">
    <div class="self-baseline pt-2 pb-6">01</div>
    <div class="self-baseline pt-8 pb-12">02</div>
    <div class="self-baseline pt-12 pb-4">03</div>
  </div>
  • self-baseline-last — aise align karo ki item ki baseline container ki aakhiri baseline se mil jaye. Docs ka example ek card hai jisme ek image, ek heading "Spencer Sharp", ek paragraph "Working on the future of astronaut recruitment at Space Recruit." aur ek link "spacerecruit.com" hai, paragraph aur link par self-baseline-last ke saath taaki text items alag unchaaiyon ke bawajood align rahein:
html
  <div class="grid grid-cols-[1fr_auto]">
    <div>
      <img src="img/spencer-sharp.jpg" />
      <h4>Spencer Sharp</h4>
      <p class="self-baseline-last">Working on the future of astronaut recruitment at Space Recruit.</p>
    </div>
    <p class="self-baseline-last">spacerecruit.com</p>
  </div>

Is baat ko pakka karne ke liye kaam ka ki text items ek-dusre se align rahein chahe unki unchaai alag ho.

  • Responsive: <div class="self-auto md:self-end ...">
  • Interview ki baatein: self-* sirf ek item ke liye items-* ko override karta hai; auto container par chhod deta hai. self-baseline banam self-baseline-last: pehli baseline banam aakhiri baseline — multi-line text blocks ke liye mayne rakhta hai. Safe variants (self-center-safe, self-end-safe) justify parivaar jaisa hi overflow-fallback logic follow karte hain.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/align-self
← Previous57 · align-items→ Next59 · place-content
59Flexbox & Grid

place-content

Is section me hum place-content ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Content ek hi samay me kaise justified aur aligned hota hai, ise control karne ki utilities — place-content align-content + justify-content ka ek-saath shorthand hai. (Fetched page koi prose intro line nahi dikhata; neeche wali class table aur examples hi poora page content hain.)

ClassStyles
place-content-centerplace-content: center;
place-content-center-safeplace-content: safe center;
place-content-startplace-content: start;
place-content-endplace-content: end;
place-content-end-safeplace-content: safe end;
place-content-betweenplace-content: space-between;
place-content-aroundplace-content: space-around;
place-content-evenlyplace-content: space-evenly;
place-content-baselineplace-content: baseline;
place-content-stretchplace-content: stretch;

Saare examples 4 items ke saath grid h-48 grid-cols-2 ... gap-4 istemal karte hain:

  • place-content-center — items ko inline aur block axes ke centre me band karo.
  • place-content-start — items ko inline aur block axes ke start ke saath band karo.
  • place-content-end — items ko inline aur block axes ke end ke saath band karo.
  • place-content-between — items ko dono axes ke saath baanto, har axis par kramasha har row aur column ke beech barabar jagah ke saath.
  • place-content-around — har axis par kramasha har row aur column ke ird-gird barabar jagah.
  • place-content-evenly — inline aur block axes par barabar doori.
  • place-content-stretch — grid items ko inline aur block axes par unke grid areas ke saath kheenchon.
  • Example ka aakaar (har value ke liye wahi):
html
  <div class="grid h-48 grid-cols-2 place-content-center gap-4 ..."><div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div><div>04</div></div>
  • Responsive: <div class="grid place-content-start md:place-content-center ...">
  • Interview ki baatein: place-content: center kisi grid ke content ko dono axes par ek saath centre karne ka ek-class wala tareeka hai; ye align-content aur justify-content ko ek hi value par set karne ka place-* roop hai. Dhyan do values start/end hain (flex-start/flex-end nahi) kyunki ye ek grid/box-alignment shorthand hai. Dikhne ke liye dono axes par extra jagah chahiye — align-content wali wahi multi-row savdhaani.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/place-content
← Previous58 · align-self→ Next60 · place-items
60Flexbox & Grid

place-items

Is section me hum place-items ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Items ek hi samay me kaise justified aur aligned hote hain, ise control karne ki utilities — place-items align-items + justify-items ka ek-saath shorthand hai.

ClassStyles
place-items-startplace-items: start;
place-items-endplace-items: end;
place-items-end-safeplace-items: safe end;
place-items-centerplace-items: center;
place-items-center-safeplace-items: safe center;
place-items-baselineplace-items: baseline;
place-items-stretchplace-items: stretch;
  • place-items-start — grid items ko dono axes par unke grid areas ke start par rakho:
html
  <div class="grid grid-cols-3 place-items-start gap-4 ..."><div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div><div>04</div><div>05</div><div>06</div></div>
  • place-items-end — items ko dono axes par unke grid areas ke end par rakho:
html
  <div class="grid h-56 grid-cols-3 place-items-end gap-4 ..."><div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div><div>04</div><div>05</div><div>06</div></div>
  • place-items-center — items ko dono axes par unke grid areas ke centre me rakho (classic ek-class wala "har cheez ko uske cell me centre karo"):
html
  <div class="grid h-56 grid-cols-3 place-items-center gap-4 ..."><div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div><div>04</div><div>05</div><div>06</div></div>
  • place-items-stretch — items ko dono axes par unke grid areas ke saath kheenchon:
html
  <div class="grid h-56 grid-cols-3 place-items-stretch gap-4 ..."><div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div><div>04</div><div>05</div><div>06</div></div>
  • Responsive: <div class="grid place-items-start md:place-items-center ...">
  • Interview ki baatein: place-items: center har grid item ko uske apne cell ke andar dono axes par centre karne ka sabse chhota tareeka hai — ek bahut aam interview/layout jawab. Sirf grid ke liye, justify-items ki tarah. *-safe variants baaki alignment parivaar jaisa hi overflow-fallback logic follow karte hain.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/place-items
← Previous59 · place-content→ Next61 · place-self
61Flexbox & Grid

place-self

Is section me hum place-self ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ek vyaktigat item ek hi samay me kaise justified aur aligned hota hai, ise control karne ki utilities — place-self align-self + justify-self ka ek-saath shorthand hai.

ClassStyles
place-self-autoplace-self: auto;
place-self-startplace-self: start;
place-self-endplace-self: end;
place-self-end-safeplace-self: safe end;
place-self-centerplace-self: center;
place-self-center-safeplace-self: safe center;
place-self-stretchplace-self: stretch;

Saare examples 6 items ke saath 3-column grid (grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 ...) istemal karte hain, utility sirf item 02 par lagakar:

  • place-self-auto — container ki place-items value ke hisaab se align karo:
html
  <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 ..."><div>01</div><div class="place-self-auto ...">02</div><div>03</div><div>04</div><div>05</div><div>06</div></div>
  • place-self-start — item ko dono axes par start se align karo (wahi aakaar, 02 par place-self-start).
  • place-self-center — item ko dono axes par centre me align karo (wahi aakaar, 02 par place-self-center).
  • place-self-end — item ko dono axes par end se align karo (wahi aakaar, 02 par place-self-end).
  • place-self-stretch — item ko dono axes par kheenchon (wahi aakaar, 02 par place-self-stretch).
  • Responsive: <div class="place-self-start md:place-self-end ...">
  • Interview ki baatein: place-* parivaar ka per-item sadasya — poori seedhi hai place-content (poora grid, dono axes) → place-items (saare items, dono axes) → place-self (ek item, dono axes), jo justify-*/align-* ke content / items / self bantware ki parchhai hai. auto container ke place-items par chhod deta hai.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/place-self
← Previous60 · place-items→ Next62 · padding
62Spacing

padding

Is section me hum padding ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities kisi element ki padding (padding and its logical properties). ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
p-<number>padding: calc(var(--spacing) * <number>);
p-pxpadding: 1px;
p-(<custom-property>)padding: var(<custom-property>);
p-[<value>]padding: <value>;
px-<number>padding-inline: calc(var(--spacing) * <number>);
px-pxpadding-inline: 1px;
px-(<custom-property>)padding-inline: var(<custom-property>);
px-[<value>]padding-inline: <value>;
py-<number>padding-block: calc(var(--spacing) * <number>);
py-pxpadding-block: 1px;
(and by the same pattern: pt-*, pr-*, pb-*, pl-*, ps-*, pe-*, pbs-*, pbe-* — see below)
  • Chaaron taraf: p-4, p-8:
html
  <div class="p-8 ...">p-8</div>
  • Ek taraf: pt-6 (top), pr-4 (right), pb-8 (bottom), pl-2 (left):
html
  <div class="pt-6 ...">pt-6</div><div class="pr-4 ...">pr-4</div><div class="pb-8 ...">pb-8</div><div class="pl-2 ...">pl-2</div>
  • Horizontal (left-right): px-4, px-8 — sets padding-inline (left + right in LTR):
html
  <div class="px-8 ...">px-8</div>
  • Vertical (upar-neeche): py-4, py-8 — sets padding-block (top + bottom):
html
  <div class="py-8 ...">py-8</div>
  • Logical inline start/end: ps-4 / pe-8 padding-inline-start / padding-inline-end set karte hain, jo text ki disha ke hisaab se left ya right se judte hain. Docs dono dishayein dikhate hain: LTR me, ps-8 baayein pad karta hai aur pe-8 daayein; RTL me ye palat jate hain:
html
  <div>
    <div dir="ltr">
      <div class="ps-8 ...">ps-8</div>
      <div class="pe-8 ...">pe-8</div>
    </div>
    <div dir="rtl">
      <div class="ps-8 ...">ps-8</div>
      <div class="pe-8 ...">pe-8</div>
    </div>
  </div>

Page disha par nirbhar styles par zyada control ke liye LTR aur RTL modifiers ki taraf bhi ishara karta hai.

  • Logical block start/end: pbs-8 / pbe-8 padding-block-start / padding-block-end set karte hain, jo writing mode ke hisaab se top ya bottom se judte hain:
html
  <div class="pbs-8 ...">pbs-8</div>
  • Arbitrary value: p-[5px], px-[...], pb-[...] — <div class="p-[5px] ...">
  • CSS variable: <div class="p-(--my-padding) ..."> (= p-[var(--my-padding)]).
  • Responsive: <div class="py-4 md:py-8 ...">
  • Customise karna: p-<number>, px-*, py-*, ps-*, pe-*, pbs-*, pbe-*, pt-*, pr-*, pb-*, pl-* sab --spacing se chalte hain: @theme { --spacing: 1px; } (spacing scale ke liye theme variable documentation dekho).
  • Interview ki baatein: padding element ke andar hoti hai — ye element ke background/border area ko badhati hai aur kabhi collapse nahi hoti (margins ke vipreet). px/py logical properties (padding-inline/padding-block) par bane bhautik-axis shorthands hain, jabki ps/pe/pbs/pbe poori tarah disha ke hisaab se hain — RTL-safe layouts ke liye inhe pl/pr ki jagah istemal karo. Padding percentages (arbitrary values) containing block ki chaudaai ke hisaab se hal hote hain, top/bottom padding ke liye bhi.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/padding
← Previous61 · place-self→ Next63 · margin
63Spacing

margin

Is section me hum margin ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities kisi element ki margin (margin and its logical properties). ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
m-<number>margin: calc(var(--spacing) * <number>);
-m-<number>margin: calc(var(--spacing) * -<number>);
m-automargin: auto;
m-pxmargin: 1px;
-m-pxmargin: -1px;
m-(<custom-property>)margin: var(<custom-property>);
m-[<value>]margin: <value>;
mx-<number>margin-inline: calc(var(--spacing) * <number>);
-mx-<number>margin-inline: calc(var(--spacing) * -<number>);
mx-automargin-inline: auto;
(and by the same pattern: my-*, mt-*, mr-*, mb-*, ml-*, ms-*, me-*, mbs-*, mbe-*, each with a negative - form and an auto form where applicable)
  • Chaaron taraf: m-4, m-8:
html
  <div class="m-8 ...">m-8</div>
  • Ek taraf: mt-6, mr-4, mb-8, ml-2:
html
  <div class="mt-6 ...">mt-6</div><div class="mr-4 ...">mr-4</div><div class="mb-8 ...">mb-8</div><div class="ml-2 ...">ml-2</div>
  • Horizontal (left-right): mx-4, mx-8 — margin-inline:
html
  <div class="mx-8 ...">mx-8</div>

mx-auto standard block-centring utility hai (ek tay chaudaai ke saath).

  • Vertical (upar-neeche): my-4, my-8 — margin-block:
html
  <div class="my-8 ...">my-8</div>
  • Negative margins: class ke aage dash lagakar use negative value me badlo. Example: -mt-8 kisi element ko pichhle ke upar kheench leta hai:
html
  <div class="h-16 w-36 bg-sky-400 opacity-20 ..."></div><div class="-mt-8 bg-sky-300 ...">-mt-8</div>
  • Logical inline start/end: ms-4 / me-8 margin-inline-start / margin-inline-end set karte hain (LTR/RTL ke hisaab se, padding ke ps/pe jaisa hi demo aakaar):
html
  <div>
    <div dir="ltr">
      <div class="ms-8 ...">ms-8</div>
      <div class="me-8 ...">me-8</div>
    </div>
    <div dir="rtl">
      <div class="ms-8 ...">ms-8</div>
      <div class="me-8 ...">me-8</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  • Logical block start/end: mbs-* / mbe-* margin-block-start / margin-block-end set karte hain:
html
  <div class="mbs-8 ...">mbs-8</div>
  • Space-between utilities (space-x-* / space-y-*) — is page par documented hain, koi alag page nahi: space-x-4, space-y-8 elements ke beech ki jagah control karte hain:
html
  <div class="flex space-x-4 ..."><div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div></div>

Agar elements ulte order me hon (flex-row-reverse / flex-col-reverse), to space-x-reverse / space-y-reverse jodo taaki jagah sahi taraf pade:

html
  <div class="flex flex-row-reverse space-x-4 space-x-reverse ..."><div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div></div>

Page par batayi gayi seemayein: space utilities asal me aakhiri ko chhodkar har item par margin jodne ka ek shortcut hi hain; ye grids, wrapping layouts, ya jatil custom order wale children ke liye NAHI bani hain — wahan iske bajaye gap utilities istemal karo, ya har element par margin jodo aur parent par usse milta negative margin lagao. Ye divide utilities ke saath kaam karne ke liye bhi NAHI bani hain — uske liye, bachon par margin/padding utilities jodo.

  • Arbitrary value: m-[5px], mx-[...], mb-[...] — <div class="m-[5px] ...">
  • CSS variable: <div class="m-(--my-margin) ..."> (= m-[var(--my-margin)]).
  • Responsive: <div class="mt-4 md:mt-8 ...">
  • Customise karna: m-*, mx-*, my-*, ms-*, me-*, mbs-*, mbe-*, mt-*, mr-*, mb-*, ml-* --spacing se chalte hain: @theme { --spacing: 1px; }.
  • Interview ki baatein: margins element ke bahar hote hain; vertical margins block siblings ke beech collapse ho jate hain (padding kabhi nahi karti); margin: auto khali jagah sokh leta hai — mx-auto kisi block ko centre karta hai, ml-auto/mr-auto kisi flex item ko door wali taraf dhakel-te hain, aur m-auto flex/grid me dono axes par centre karta hai. Negative margins classic overlap/pull-up technique hai. space-x/space-y banam gap ek pasandeeda chaal hai: gap flex/grid spacing ke liye aadhunik jawab hai; space-* upar di gayi seemaon wala ek margin hack hai.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/margin
← Previous62 · padding→ Next64 · width
64Sizing

width

Is section me hum width ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities kisi element ki width set karne ke liye hain (width).

ClassStyles
w-<number>width: calc(var(--spacing) * <number>);
w-<fraction>width: calc(<fraction> * 100%);
w-3xswidth: var(--container-3xs); /* 16rem (256px) */
w-2xswidth: var(--container-2xs); /* 18rem (288px) */
w-xswidth: var(--container-xs); /* 20rem (320px) */
w-smwidth: var(--container-sm); /* 24rem (384px) */
w-mdwidth: var(--container-md); /* 28rem (448px) */
w-lgwidth: var(--container-lg); /* 32rem (512px) */
w-xlwidth: var(--container-xl); /* 36rem (576px) */
w-2xlwidth: var(--container-2xl); /* 42rem (672px) */
(plus, per the prose: w-full, w-auto, w-screen, w-lvw, w-svw, w-dvw, and the size-* utilities)
  • Fixed (spacing scale): w-24, w-64 wagera — w-96, w-80, w-64, w-48, w-40, w-32, w-24:
html
  <div class="w-96 ...">w-96</div><div class="w-80 ...">w-80</div><div class="w-64 ...">w-64</div><div class="w-48 ...">w-48</div><div class="w-40 ...">w-40</div><div class="w-32 ...">w-32</div><div class="w-24 ...">w-24</div>
  • Percentage / fractions: w-full, w-1/2, w-2/5 wagera — aadhe, teesre, chauthe, paanchve, chhathe hisse:
html
  <div class="flex ..."><div class="w-1/2 ...">w-1/2</div><div class="w-1/2 ...">w-1/2</div></div>
  <div class="flex ..."><div class="w-2/5 ...">w-2/5</div><div class="w-3/5 ...">w-3/5</div></div>
  <div class="flex ..."><div class="w-1/3 ...">w-1/3</div><div class="w-2/3 ...">w-2/3</div></div>
  <div class="flex ..."><div class="w-1/4 ...">w-1/4</div><div class="w-3/4 ...">w-3/4</div></div>
  <div class="flex ..."><div class="w-1/5 ...">w-1/5</div><div class="w-4/5 ...">w-4/5</div></div>
  <div class="flex ..."><div class="w-1/6 ...">w-1/6</div><div class="w-5/6 ...">w-5/6</div></div>
  <div class="w-full ...">w-full</div>
  • Container scale: w-sm, w-xl etc. — w-xl, w-lg, w-md, w-sm, w-xs, w-2xs, w-3xs.
  • Viewport width: w-screen poori viewport chaudaai tak phailta hai:
html
  <div class="w-screen"><!-- ... --></div>

w-lvw, w-svw, w-dvw bhi large, small, ya dynamic viewport width se milte hain.

  • Width hatana: w-auto kisi shart ke neeche (jaise kisi breakpoint par) di gayi width hata deta hai:
html
  <div class="w-full md:w-auto"><!-- ... --></div>
  • Dono dimensions ek saath: size-px, size-4, size-full width AUR height dono ek saath set karte hain — size-16, size-20, size-24, size-32, size-40:
html
  <div class="size-16 ...">size-16</div><div class="size-20 ...">size-20</div><div class="size-24 ...">size-24</div><div class="size-32 ...">size-32</div><div class="size-40 ...">size-40</div>
  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): <div class="w-[5px] ...">
  • CSS variable: <div class="w-(--my-width) ..."> (= w-[var(--my-width)]).
  • Responsive: <div class="w-1/2 md:w-full ...">
  • Customise karna: w-<number> aur size-<number> --spacing se chalte hain: @theme { --spacing: 1px; }.
  • Interview ki baatein: w-full = containing block ka 100%; w-screen = 100vw, jo vertical scrollbar maujood hone par horizontal overflow kara sakta hai (100vw me scrollbar ki chaudaai shaamil hoti hai) — page ke andar full-bleed layouts ke liye w-full ko prathmikta do. Percentage widths containing block ki chaudaai ke hisaab se hal hoti hain. size-* square wala shortcut hai; min/max ke liye koi size barabar nahi hai (min-w/min-h alag se istemal karo).
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/width

65Sizing

min-width

Is section me hum min-width ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities kisi element ki minimum width set karne ke liye hain (min-width).

ClassStyles
min-w-<number>min-width: calc(var(--spacing) * <number>);
min-w-<fraction>min-width: calc(<fraction> * 100%);
min-w-3xsmin-width: var(--container-3xs); /* 16rem (256px) */
min-w-2xsmin-width: var(--container-2xs); /* 18rem (288px) */
min-w-xsmin-width: var(--container-xs); /* 20rem (320px) */
min-w-smmin-width: var(--container-sm); /* 24rem (384px) */
min-w-mdmin-width: var(--container-md); /* 28rem (448px) */
min-w-lgmin-width: var(--container-lg); /* 32rem (512px) */
min-w-xlmin-width: var(--container-xl); /* 36rem (576px) */
min-w-2xlmin-width: var(--container-2xl); /* 42rem (672px) */
(plus, per the prose: min-w-full, min-w-0 — see the responsive example)
  • Fixed: min-w-24, min-w-64 — min-w-80, min-w-64, min-w-48, min-w-40, min-w-32, min-w-24 (docs example inhe ek w-20 parent ke andar dikhata hai, to ye apne parent se overflow karte hain — minimum jeet-ta hai):
html
  <div class="w-20 ...">
    <div class="min-w-80 ...">min-w-80</div>
    <div class="min-w-64 ...">min-w-64</div>
    <div class="min-w-48 ...">min-w-48</div>
    <div class="min-w-40 ...">min-w-40</div>
    <div class="min-w-32 ...">min-w-32</div>
    <div class="min-w-24 ...">min-w-24</div>
  </div>
  • Percentage: min-w-full, min-w-1/2, min-w-2/5 — e.g. min-w-3/4 vs w-full:
html
  <div class="flex ..."><div class="min-w-3/4 ...">min-w-3/4</div><div class="w-full ...">w-full</div></div>
  • Container scale: min-w-sm, min-w-xl — min-w-lg, min-w-md, min-w-sm, min-w-xs, min-w-2xs, min-w-3xs (inside a w-40 parent in the docs example).
  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): <div class="min-w-[220px] ...">
  • CSS variable: <div class="min-w-(--my-min-width) ..."> (= min-w-[var(--my-min-width)]).
  • Responsive: <div class="w-24 min-w-full md:min-w-0 ..."> — mobile par poori minimum width, md se upar koi minimum nahi.
  • Customise karna: min-w-<number> --spacing se chalta hai: @theme { --spacing: 1px; }.
  • Interview ki baatein: jab dono takrayein to min-width width ko override karta hai (bada jeet-ta hai). min-w-0 un flex/grid children ke liye zaroori theek hai jo sikudne se inkaar karte hain (flex item me text truncation): flex items default roop se min-width: auto hote hain, matlab wo apne content size se neeche nahi sikud sakte. min-w-full kisi child ko kam se kam uske parent jitna chauda karne ke liye bhi istemal hota hai.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/min-width

max-width

Is section me hum max-width ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities kisi element ki maximum width set karne ke liye hain (max-width).

ClassStyles
max-w-<number>max-width: calc(var(--spacing) * <number>);
max-w-<fraction>max-width: calc(<fraction> * 100%);
max-w-3xsmax-width: var(--container-3xs); /* 16rem (256px) */
max-w-2xsmax-width: var(--container-2xs); /* 18rem (288px) */
max-w-xsmax-width: var(--container-xs); /* 20rem (320px) */
max-w-smmax-width: var(--container-sm); /* 24rem (384px) */
max-w-mdmax-width: var(--container-md); /* 28rem (448px) */
max-w-lgmax-width: var(--container-lg); /* 32rem (512px) */
max-w-xlmax-width: var(--container-xl); /* 36rem (576px) */
max-w-2xlmax-width: var(--container-2xl); /* 42rem (672px) */
(plus, per the prose: max-w-full, max-w-9/10 etc., and the container utility)
  • Fixed (tay size): max-w-24, max-w-64 — max-w-96, max-w-80, max-w-64, max-w-48, max-w-40, max-w-32, max-w-24, each on a w-full element (resize the example to see the cap):
html
  <div class="w-full max-w-96 ...">max-w-96</div><div class="w-full max-w-80 ...">max-w-80</div><div class="w-full max-w-64 ...">max-w-64</div><div class="w-full max-w-48 ...">max-w-48</div><div class="w-full max-w-40 ...">max-w-40</div><div class="w-full max-w-32 ...">max-w-32</div><div class="w-full max-w-24 ...">max-w-24</div>
  • Percentage: max-w-full, max-w-1/2, max-w-2/5 — max-w-9/10, max-w-3/4, max-w-1/2, max-w-1/3 on w-full elements.
  • Container scale: max-w-sm, max-w-xl — e.g. <div class="max-w-md ...">
  • container utility (is page par documented): element ki maximum width ko current breakpoint ki min-width se milata hai — poori tarah fluid viewport ke bajaye screen sizes ke ek tay set ke hisaab se design karne ke liye:
html
  <div class="container"><!-- ... --></div>

Note: dusre frameworks ke containers ke vipreet, Tailwind ka container apne aap centre NAHI hota aur isme koi andar-bani horizontal padding NAHI hai — inhe khud jodo:

html
  <div class="container mx-auto px-4"><!-- ... --></div>
  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): <div class="max-w-[220px] ...">
  • CSS variable: <div class="max-w-(--my-max-width) ..."> (= max-w-[var(--my-max-width)]).
  • Responsive: <div class="max-w-sm md:max-w-lg ...">
  • Customise karna: max-w-<number> --spacing se chalta hai: @theme { --spacing: 1px; }.
  • Interview ki baatein: max-w-* + w-full standard padhne-yogya-line-length / centre-column pattern hai (w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto). max-width width ko cap karta hai; chhota jeet-ta hai. container wali chaal (koi auto-centring nahi, koi padding nahi) ek classic interview/trivia point hai.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/max-width

Is section me hum height ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities kisi element ki height set karne ke liye hain (height).

ClassStyles
h-<number>height: calc(var(--spacing) * <number>);
h-<fraction>height: calc(<fraction> * 100%);
h-autoheight: auto;
h-pxheight: 1px;
h-fullheight: 100%;
h-screenheight: 100vh;
h-dvhheight: 100dvh;
h-dvwheight: 100dvw;
h-lvhheight: 100lvh;
h-lvwheight: 100lvw;
(plus, per the prose: h-svh, and the size-* utilities)
  • Fixed (tay size): h-24, h-64 — h-96, h-80, h-64, h-48, h-40, h-32, h-24:
html
  <div class="h-96 ...">h-96</div><div class="h-80 ...">h-80</div><div class="h-64 ...">h-64</div><div class="h-48 ...">h-48</div><div class="h-40 ...">h-40</div><div class="h-32 ...">h-32</div><div class="h-24 ...">h-24</div>
  • Percentage: h-full, h-1/2, h-2/5 — h-full, h-9/10, h-3/4, h-1/2, h-1/3:
html
  <div class="h-full ...">h-full</div><div class="h-9/10 ...">h-9/10</div><div class="h-3/4 ...">h-3/4</div><div class="h-1/2 ...">h-1/2</div><div class="h-1/3 ...">h-1/3</div>
  • Viewport height:
    • h-screen — viewport ki poori unchaai (100vh):
html
    <div class="h-screen"><!-- ... --></div>
  • h-dvh — viewport ki poori unchaai, jo browser UI ke phailne ya sikudne ke saath badalti hai (dynamic viewport height — badlav dekhne ke liye viewport scroll karo):
html
    <div class="h-dvh"><!-- ... --></div>
  • h-lvh — viewport ki sabse badi sambhav unchaai:
html
    <div class="h-lvh"><!-- ... --></div>
  • h-svh — viewport ki sabse chhoti sambhav unchaai:
html
    <div class="h-svh"><!-- ... --></div>
  • Dono dimensions: size-px, size-4, size-full — size-16, size-20, size-24, size-32, size-40 (width page wala wahi example).
  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): <div class="h-[32rem] ...">
  • CSS variable: <div class="h-(--my-height) ..."> (= h-[var(--my-height)]).
  • Responsive: <div class="h-1/2 md:h-full ...">
  • Customise karna: h-<number> aur size-<number> --spacing se chalte hain: @theme { --spacing: 1px; }.
  • Interview ki baatein: h-full sirf tab kaam karta hai jab parent ki ek tay unchaai ho — percentage heights parent ki unchaai ke hisaab se hal hoti hain, aur height: auto wale parents h-full ko gira (collapse) dete hain (sabse aam height bug). Mobile par, 100vh me browser chrome ke neeche ka hissa bhi shaamil hota hai, to content chhup sakta hai; h-dvh aadhunik theek hai, h-svh/h-lvh small/large charam hain. Tailwind me h-screen = 100vh hai (100dvh nahi).
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/height

html
  <div class="h-96 ...">
    <div class="h-full max-h-80 ...">max-h-80</div>
    <div class="h-full max-h-64 ...">max-h-64</div>

  • Customise karna: max-h-<number> --spacing se chalta hai: @theme { --spacing: 1px; }.

inline-size

Is section me hum inline-size ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities kisi element ki inline size set karne ke liye hain (inline-size) — the logical-property equivalent of width. In horizontal writing mode, inline size = width; in vertical writing mode, inline size = height.

ClassStyles
inline-<number>inline-size: calc(var(--spacing) * <number>);
inline-<fraction>inline-size: calc(<fraction> * 100%);
inline-3xsinline-size: var(--container-3xs); /* 16rem (256px) */
inline-2xsinline-size: var(--container-2xs); /* 18rem (288px) */
inline-xsinline-size: var(--container-xs); /* 20rem (320px) */
inline-sminline-size: var(--container-sm); /* 24rem (384px) */
inline-mdinline-size: var(--container-md); /* 28rem (448px) */
inline-lginline-size: var(--container-lg); /* 32rem (512px) */
inline-xlinline-size: var(--container-xl); /* 36rem (576px) */
inline-2xlinline-size: var(--container-2xl); /* 42rem (672px) */
(plus, per the prose: inline-full, inline-auto, inline-screen)
  • Fixed (tay size): inline-24, inline-64 — inline-96, inline-80, inline-64, inline-48, inline-40, inline-32.
  • Percentage: inline-full, inline-1/2, inline-2/5 — halves/thirds/fifths/full, same flex-row demo shape as the width page.
  • Container scale: inline-sm, inline-xl — inline-xl, inline-lg, inline-md, inline-sm, inline-xs, inline-2xs, inline-3xs.
  • Viewport: inline-screen viewport ki poori inline size tak phailta hai:
html
  <div class="inline-screen"><!-- ... --></div>
  • Size hatana: inline-auto kisi shart ke neeche di gayi inline size hata deta hai:
html
  <div class="inline-full md:inline-auto"><!-- ... --></div>
  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): <div class="inline-[5px] ...">
  • CSS variable: <div class="inline-(--my-inline-size) ..."> (= inline-[var(--my-inline-size)]).
  • Responsive: <div class="inline-1/2 md:inline-full ...">
  • Customise karna: inline-<number> --spacing se chalta hai: @theme { --spacing: 1px; }.
  • Interview ki baatein: logical properties (inline-size/block-size) bhautik screen ke bajaye writing mode ko follow karti hain — wahi stylesheet horizontal aur vertical scripts (jaise Japanese vertical text) aur RTL ke liye kaam karti hai. LTR horizontal text me, inline-* ≡ w-* aur block-* ≡ h-*; fark sirf dusre writing modes me dikhta hai. Inhe tab istemal karo jab writing-mode se azaad components bana rahe ho.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/inline-size
← Previous69 · max-height→ Next71 · min-inline-size
71Sizing

min-inline-size

Is section me hum min-inline-size ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities kisi element ki minimum inline size set karne ke liye hain (min-inline-size) — the logical equivalent of min-width.

ClassStyles
min-inline-<number>min-inline-size: calc(var(--spacing) * <number>);
min-inline-<fraction>min-inline-size: calc(<fraction> * 100%);
min-inline-3xsmin-inline-size: var(--container-3xs); /* 16rem (256px) */
min-inline-2xsmin-inline-size: var(--container-2xs); /* 18rem (288px) */
min-inline-xsmin-inline-size: var(--container-xs); /* 20rem (320px) */
min-inline-smmin-inline-size: var(--container-sm); /* 24rem (384px) */
min-inline-mdmin-inline-size: var(--container-md); /* 28rem (448px) */
min-inline-lgmin-inline-size: var(--container-lg); /* 32rem (512px) */
min-inline-xlmin-inline-size: var(--container-xl); /* 36rem (576px) */
min-inline-2xlmin-inline-size: var(--container-2xl); /* 42rem (672px) */
(plus, per the prose: min-inline-full, min-inline-0 — see the responsive example)
  • Fixed (tay size): min-inline-24, min-inline-64 — min-inline-80, min-inline-64, min-inline-48, min-inline-40, min-inline-32, min-inline-24 (inside an inline-20 parent in the docs example).
  • Percentage: min-inline-full, min-inline-1/2, min-inline-2/5 — e.g. min-inline-3/4 vs inline-full.
  • Container scale: min-inline-sm, min-inline-xl — min-inline-lg, min-inline-md, min-inline-sm, min-inline-xs, min-inline-2xs, min-inline-3xs (inside an inline-40 parent).
  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): <div class="min-inline-[220px] ...">
  • CSS variable: <div class="min-inline-(--my-min-inline-size) ..."> (= min-inline-[var(--my-min-inline-size)]).
  • Responsive: <div class="inline-24 min-inline-full md:min-inline-0 ...">
  • Customise karna: min-inline-<number> --spacing se chalta hai: @theme { --spacing: 1px; }.
  • Interview ki baatein: min-w-* ki logical judwa, min-inline-0 wali flex/grid sikudne ki theek samet (writing-mode safe). Wahi usool: minimum set ki gayi inline size par jeet-ta hai.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/min-inline-size
