Ye utilities kisi element ki maximum inline size set karne ke liye hain (max-inline-size) — the logical equivalent of max-width.

ClassStyles
max-inline-<number>max-inline-size: calc(var(--spacing) * <number>);
max-inline-<fraction>max-inline-size: calc(<fraction> * 100%);
max-inline-3xsmax-inline-size: var(--container-3xs); /* 16rem (256px) */
max-inline-2xsmax-inline-size: var(--container-2xs); /* 18rem (288px) */
max-inline-xsmax-inline-size: var(--container-xs); /* 20rem (320px) */
max-inline-smmax-inline-size: var(--container-sm); /* 24rem (384px) */
max-inline-mdmax-inline-size: var(--container-md); /* 28rem (448px) */
max-inline-lgmax-inline-size: var(--container-lg); /* 32rem (512px) */
max-inline-xlmax-inline-size: var(--container-xl); /* 36rem (576px) */
max-inline-2xlmax-inline-size: var(--container-2xl); /* 42rem (672px) */
(plus, per the prose: max-inline-full)
  • Fixed (tay size): max-inline-24, max-inline-64 — max-inline-96, max-inline-80, max-inline-64, max-inline-48, max-inline-40, max-inline-32, each on an inline-full element (resize to see the cap).
  • Percentage: max-inline-full, max-inline-1/2, max-inline-2/5 — max-inline-9/10, max-inline-3/4, max-inline-1/2, max-inline-1/3 on inline-full elements.
  • Container scale: max-inline-sm, max-inline-xl — e.g. <div class="max-inline-md ...">
  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): <div class="max-inline-[220px] ...">
  • CSS variable: <div class="max-inline-(--my-max-inline-size) ..."> (= max-inline-[var(--my-max-inline-size)]).
  • Responsive: <div class="max-inline-sm md:max-inline-lg ...">
  • Customise karna: max-inline-<number> --spacing se chalta hai: @theme { --spacing: 1px; }.
  • Interview ki baatein: max-w-* ki logical judwa; cap set ki gayi inline size par jeet-ti hai. Wahi centre-column pattern writing-mode ki suraksha ke saath kaam karta hai: inline-full max-inline-7xl mx-auto (container-scale ke barabar wale ke saath).

73Sizing

block-size

Is section me hum block-size ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities kisi element ki block size set karne ke liye hain (block-size) — the logical-property equivalent of height. In horizontal writing mode, block size = height; in vertical writing mode, block size = width.

ClassStyles
block-<number>block-size: calc(var(--spacing) * <number>);
block-<fraction>block-size: calc(<fraction> * 100%);
block-autoblock-size: auto;
block-pxblock-size: 1px;
block-fullblock-size: 100%;
block-screenblock-size: 100vh;
block-dvhblock-size: 100dvh;
block-dvwblock-size: 100dvw;
block-lvhblock-size: 100lvh;
block-lvwblock-size: 100lvw;
(plus, per the prose: block-svh)
  • Fixed (tay size): block-24, block-64 — block-96, block-80, block-64, block-48, block-40, block-32, block-24.
  • Percentage: block-full, block-1/2, block-2/5 — block-full, block-9/10, block-3/4, block-1/2, block-1/3.
  • Viewport: block-screen (viewport ka poora block size, 100vh):
html
  <div class="block-screen"><!-- ... --></div>

block-dvh — viewport ka poora block size, jo browser UI ke phailne/sikudne ke saath badalta hai:

html
  <div class="block-dvh"><!-- ... --></div>

block-lvh — viewport ka sabse bada sambhav size; block-svh — sabse chhota sambhav size:

html
  <div class="block-lvh"><!-- ... --></div>
  <div class="block-svh"><!-- ... --></div>
  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): <div class="block-[32rem] ...">
  • CSS variable: <div class="block-(--my-block-size) ..."> (= block-[var(--my-block-size)]).
  • Responsive: <div class="block-1/2 md:block-full ...">
  • Customise karna: block-<number> --spacing se chalte hain: @theme { --spacing: 1px; }.
  • Interview ki baatein: h-* ki logical judwa. Seekhne walon ke liye naam ka jaal note karo: utility block-* hai (block size), block display utility nahi — akela block display: block set karta hai, jabki block-24 block-size set karta hai. h-full wali wahi percentage-height savdhaani: parent ka tay block size chahiye.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/block-size

76Typography

font-family

Is section me hum font-family ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities font family of an element. ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
font-sansfont-family: var(--font-sans); — -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', 'Noto Sans', Arial, sans-serif, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji', 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Noto Color Emoji'
font-seriffont-family: var(--font-serif); — ui-serif, Georgia, Cambria, 'Times New Roman', Times, serif
font-monofont-family: var(--font-mono); — ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', 'Courier New', monospace
font-(family-name:<custom-property>)font-family: var(<custom-property>);
font-[<value>]font-family: <value>;

Basic usage:

html
<p class="font-sans ...">The quick brown fox ...</p>
<p class="font-serif ...">The quick brown fox ...</p>
<p class="font-mono ...">The quick brown fox ...</p>

Arbitrary value (underscores spaces ban jate hain):

html
<p class="font-[Open_Sans] ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

CSS-variable shorthand (var() apne aap jod deta hai; font-[family-name:var(--my-font)] ke barabar):

html
<p class="font-(family-name:--my-font) ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

Responsive variant:

html
<p class="font-sans md:font-serif ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

@theme se customise karna — --font-* variables define karo; utility ka naam variable ke naam ke hisaab se hota hai:

css
@theme {
  --font-display: "Oswald", sans-serif;
}
html
<div class="font-display"><!-- ... --></div>

Kisi family ke liye default font-feature / font-variation settings uske saath bundle ki ja sakti hain:

css
@theme {
  --font-display: "Oswald", sans-serif;
  --font-display--font-feature-settings: "cv02", "cv03", "cv04", "cv11";
  --font-display--font-variation-settings: "opsz" 32;
}

@font-face se custom font load karna:

css
@font-face {
  font-family: Oswald;
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 200 700;
  font-display: swap;
  src: url("/fonts/Oswald.woff2") format("woff2");
}

Google Fonts se load karna: @import CSS file ke sabse upar hona chahiye, @import "tailwindcss" se pehle, kyunki browsers ko @import statements baaki saare rules se pehle chahiye hote hain (aur Tailwind import compiled CSS me inline ho jata hai):

css
@import url("https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Roboto&display=swap");
@import "tailwindcss";
@theme {
  --font-roboto: "Roboto", sans-serif;
}

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: font-sans/font-serif/font-mono hi teen andar-bani families hain; iske alawa kuch bhi @theme --font-* (v4) maangta hai — koi config file wala step nahi hai. Font tabhi dikhne me badalta hai jab wo asal me load ho (@font-face ya koi font service); sirf --font-display ghoshit karna font download nahi karta. @import ka order asal bug ka kaaran hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/font-family
← Previous75 · max-block-size→ Next77 · font-size
77Typography

font-size

Is section me hum font-size ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities font size of an element. Each size also sets a default line-height (via --text-<size>--line-height). ko control karne ke liye hain.

Classfont-sizeDefault line-height
text-xs0.75rem (12px)calc(1 / 0.75)
text-sm0.875rem (14px)calc(1.25 / 0.875)
text-base1rem (16px)calc(1.5 / 1)
text-lg1.125rem (18px)calc(1.75 / 1.125)
text-xl1.25rem (20px)calc(1.75 / 1.25)
text-2xl1.5rem (24px)calc(2 / 1.5)
text-3xl1.875rem (30px)calc(2.25 / 1.875)
text-4xl2.25rem (36px)calc(2.5 / 2.25)
text-5xl3rem (48px)1
text-6xl3.75rem (60px)1
text-7xl4.5rem (72px)1
text-8xl6rem (96px)1
text-9xl8rem (128px)1
text-(length:<custom-property>)font-size: var(<custom-property>);—
text-[<value>]font-size: <value>;—

Basic usage:

html
<p class="text-sm ...">The quick brown fox ...</p>
<p class="text-base ...">The quick brown fox ...</p>
<p class="text-lg ...">The quick brown fox ...</p>
<p class="text-xl ...">The quick brown fox ...</p>
<p class="text-2xl ...">The quick brown fox ...</p>

Slash syntax se size AUR line-height ek saath set karna — text-<size>/<number> jahan number ko --spacing se guna kiya jata hai (line-height page dekho). Docs ke examples: text-sm/6, text-sm/7, text-sm/8:

html
<p class="text-sm/6 ...">So I started to walk into the water...</p>
<p class="text-sm/7 ...">So I started to walk into the water...</p>
<p class="text-sm/8 ...">So I started to walk into the water...</p>

Arbitrary value aur CSS-variable forms:

html
<p class="text-[14px] ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>
<p class="text-(length:--my-text-size) ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

text-(length:--my-text-size) text-[length:var(--my-text-size)] ka shorthand hai.

Responsive variant:

html
<p class="text-sm md:text-base ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

@theme se customise karna (--text-* variables; utility ka naam variable ke naam ke hisaab se hota hai):

css
@theme {
  --text-tiny: 0.625rem;
}
html
<div class="text-tiny"><!-- ... --></div>

Ek custom size default line-height, letter-spacing aur font-weight bhi saath le sakta hai:

css
@theme {
  --text-tiny: 0.625rem;
  --text-tiny--line-height: 1.5rem;
  --text-tiny--letter-spacing: 0.125rem;
  --text-tiny--font-weight: 500;
}

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: text-base (16px) default body size hai; text-5xl aur upar ki line-height 1 hoti hai (tight, display headings ke liye). Slash form text-sm/6 opacity modifier NAHI hai (text-blue-600/50 ke vipreet) — size ke baad iska matlab line-height hai. Har text-<size> ek line-height set karta hai jab tak override na ho, to size badalne se spacing achanak badal sakti hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/font-size
← Previous76 · font-family→ Next78 · font-smoothing
78Typography

font-smoothing

Is section me hum font-smoothing ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities font smoothing of an element. ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
antialiased-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
subpixel-antialiased-webkit-font-smoothing: auto; -moz-osx-font-smoothing: auto;

Basic usage:

html
<p class="antialiased ...">The quick brown fox ...</p>
<p class="subpixel-antialiased ...">The quick brown fox ...</p>

Responsive variant:

html
<p class="antialiased md:subpixel-antialiased ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: ye ek rendering ishara hai, font badlav nahi — antialiased (grayscale) text ko patla/halka dikhata hai, khaas taur par macOS par; subpixel-antialiased browser default hai (subpixel rendering). Ye sirf dikhayi gayi vendor-prefixed properties se WebKit/Gecko ko prabhavit karta hai; koi standard font-smoothing CSS property nahi hai. Aksar <body> par globally lagaya jata hai; chhote text par zyada istemal readability ghata sakta hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/font-smoothing
← Previous77 · font-size→ Next79 · font-style
79Typography

font-style

Is section me hum font-style ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities style of text. ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
italicfont-style: italic;
not-italicfont-style: normal;

Basic usage:

html
<p class="italic ...">The quick brown fox ...</p>
<p class="not-italic ...">The quick brown fox ...</p>

Responsive variant:

html
<p class="italic md:not-italic ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: sirf do utilities; not-italic viraasat me mile/breakpoint italic ko hatane ke liye hai (jaise italic md:not-italic). Koi oblique utility nahi hai — zaroorat pade to arbitrary value istemal karo. Note karo italic ek CSS font-style value bhi hai, font-weight ya font-family se ulajhna nahi hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/font-style

font-weight

Is section me hum font-weight ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities font weight of an element. ko control karne ke liye hain.

Classfont-weight
font-thin100
font-extralight200
font-light300
font-normal400
font-medium500
font-semibold600
font-bold700
font-extrabold800
font-black900
font-(<custom-property>)font-weight: var(<custom-property>);
font-[<value>]font-weight: <value>;

Basic usage:

html
<p class="font-light ...">The quick brown fox ...</p>
<p class="font-normal ...">The quick brown fox ...</p>
<p class="font-medium ...">The quick brown fox ...</p>
<p class="font-semibold ...">The quick brown fox ...</p>
<p class="font-bold ...">The quick brown fox ...</p>

Arbitrary value (variable fonts ke liye kaam ka, jaise weight 1000) aur CSS-variable forms:

html
<p class="font-[1000] ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>
<p class="font-(weight:--my-font-weight) ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

font-(weight:--my-font-weight) font-[weight:var(--my-font-weight)] ka shorthand hai.

Responsive variant:

html
<p class="font-normal md:font-bold ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

@theme se customise karna (--font-weight-* variables):

css
@theme {
  --font-weight-extrablack: 1000;
}

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: ek hi font-* prefix font-family (font-sans), font-weight (font-bold) aur font-stretch (font-stretch-expanded) teeno share karte hain — value pehchan karata hai. Weight tabhi render hota hai jab load kiye gaye font me asal me wo weight ho; warna browser sabse paas wale weight ko banata/fallback karta hai, to sirf 400/700 wale font par font-black bold jaisa hi dikhta hai. font-normal (400) reset utility hai.

font-stretch

Is section me hum font-stretch ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities — selecting the width of a font face (the CSS font-stretch property — condensed vs expanded)..

Classfont-stretch
font-stretch-ultra-condensedultra-condensed (50%)
font-stretch-extra-condensedextra-condensed (62.5%)
font-stretch-condensedcondensed (75%)
font-stretch-semi-condensedsemi-condensed (87.5%)
font-stretch-normalnormal (100%)
font-stretch-semi-expandedsemi-expanded (112.5%)
font-stretch-expandedexpanded (125%)
font-stretch-extra-expandedextra-expanded (150%)
font-stretch-ultra-expandedultra-expanded (200%)
font-stretch-<percentage>font-stretch: <percentage>;
font-stretch-(<custom-property>)font-stretch: var(<custom-property>);
font-stretch-[<value>]font-stretch: <value>;

Basic usage:

html
<p class="font-stretch-extra-condensed">The quick brown fox...</p>
<p class="font-stretch-condensed">The quick brown fox...</p>
<p class="font-stretch-normal">The quick brown fox...</p>
<p class="font-stretch-expanded">The quick brown fox...</p>
<p class="font-stretch-extra-expanded">The quick brown fox...</p>

Percentage form:

html
<p class="font-stretch-50%">The quick brown fox...</p>
<p class="font-stretch-100%">The quick brown fox...</p>
<p class="font-stretch-150%">The quick brown fox...</p>

Arbitrary value aur CSS-variable forms:

html
<p class="font-stretch-[66.66%] ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>
<p class="font-stretch-(--my-font-width) ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

Responsive variant:

html
<div class="font-stretch-normal md:font-stretch-expanded ..."><!-- ... --></div>

Page par batayi gayi khaas savdhaani: "Ye sirf un fonts par lagu hota hai jinke paas kai chaudaai variations uplabdh hon, warna browser sabse paas wala match chunta hai." Interview / aam galti ki baatein: font-stretch glyphs ki chaudaai ke baare me hai, letter-spacing (tracking-*) nahi aur font-weight bhi nahi. Ek aam single-width font par utility kuch dikhai nahi deti — ek aam "ye kaam kyun nahi kar raha?" wala pal. wdth axis wale variable fonts iske mukhya asal use case hain.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/font-stretch
← Previous80 · font-weight→ Next82 · font-variant-numeric
82Typography

font-variant-numeric

Is section me hum font-variant-numeric ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities variant of numbers (CSS font-variant-numeric). ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
normal-numsfont-variant-numeric: normal;
ordinalfont-variant-numeric: ordinal;
slashed-zerofont-variant-numeric: slashed-zero;
lining-numsfont-variant-numeric: lining-nums;
oldstyle-numsfont-variant-numeric: oldstyle-nums;
proportional-numsfont-variant-numeric: proportional-nums;
tabular-numsfont-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
diagonal-fractionsfont-variant-numeric: diagonal-fractions;
stacked-fractionsfont-variant-numeric: stacked-fractions;

Har ek kya karta hai (sab ko feature support karne wala font chahiye):

  • ordinal — ordinal markers ke liye khaas glyphs: 1st.
html
  <p class="ordinal ...">1st</p>
  • slashed-zero — ek zero jiske beech se slash guzarta hai: 0.
html
  <p class="slashed-zero ...">0</p>
  • lining-nums — baseline par align ki gayi figures: 1234567890.
html
  <p class="lining-nums ...">1234567890</p>
  • oldstyle-nums — figures jahan kuch numbers ke descenders hote hain: 1234567890.
html
  <p class="oldstyle-nums ...">1234567890</p>
  • proportional-nums — proportional (badalti) chaudaai wali figures: 12121 / 90909 align NAHI hoti.
html
  <p class="proportional-nums ...">12121</p>
  <p class="proportional-nums ...">90909</p>
  • tabular-nums — ek samaan/tabular chaudaai wali figures: 12121 / 90909 columns me align HO jati hain.
html
  <p class="tabular-nums ...">12121</p>
  <p class="tabular-nums ...">90909</p>
  • diagonal-fractions — slash se alag numbers diagonal fractions ban jate hain: 1/2 3/4 5/6.
html
  <p class="diagonal-fractions ...">1/2 3/4 5/6</p>
  • stacked-fractions — wahi, stacked fractions ke roop me: 1/2 3/4 5/6.
html
  <p class="stacked-fractions ...">1/2 3/4 5/6</p>

Composability — utilities judti hain; docs ka canonical example ek price table hai jisme slashed-zero tabular-nums ek saath istemal hote hain taaki amounts align hon aur zeroes me koi uljhan na ho:

html
<dl class="...">
  <dt class="...">Subtotal</dt>
  <dd class="text-right slashed-zero tabular-nums ...">$100.00</dd>
  <dt class="...">Tax</dt>
  <dd class="text-right slashed-zero tabular-nums ...">$14.50</dd>
  <dt class="...">Total</dt>
  <dd class="text-right slashed-zero tabular-nums ...">$114.50</dd>
</dl>

Reset:

html
<p class="slashed-zero tabular-nums md:normal-nums ..."><!-- ... --></p>

Responsive variant:

html
<p class="proportional-nums md:tabular-nums ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: tabular-nums tables, prices, timers aur dashboards ke liye sabse upyukt hai — ye values badalne par numbers ko kudne se rokta hai. lining-nums banam oldstyle-nums baseline/descender ka fark hai. Inme se koi kaam nahi karta agar font me OpenType feature na ho; browser chupchaap kuch nahi karta. font-feature-settings se uljho mat (nichle star ka escape hatch, agla page).

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/font-variant-numeric
← Previous81 · font-stretch→ Next83 · font-feature-settings
83Typography

font-feature-settings

Is section me hum font-feature-settings ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities advanced typographic features (CSS font-feature-settings — the low-level OpenType escape hatch). ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
font-features-[<value>]font-feature-settings: <value>;
font-features-(<custom-property>)font-feature-settings: var(<custom-property>);

Note: is page par koi naam wali andar-bani utilities NAHI hain — sirf arbitrary-value aur CSS-variable forms hain. Basic usage (ek feature, 'smcp' = small caps):

html
<p class="font-features-['smcp'] ...">This text uses small caps.</p>

Kai features, comma se alag:

html
<p class="font-features-['smcp','onum'] ...">This text uses small caps and oldstyle numbers.</p>

CSS-variable form:

html
<p class="font-features-(--my-features) ..."><!-- ... --></p>

Responsive variant:

html
<p class="font-features-['tnum'] md:font-features-['smcp'] ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: jab koi upar-star wali utility maujood ho to use istemal karo (ordinal, tabular-nums, lining-nums, wagera); font-feature-settings un features ke liye hai jinke liye koi samarpit utility nahi (jaise smcp, tnum). Feature tags quotes me 4-akshar wale OpenType tags hain. Ye font-family ke saath bhi judta hai: kisi family ki default feature settings @theme me --font-<name>--font-feature-settings se set ki ja sakti hain (font-family page dekho). font-feature-settings set karna soochibaddh features ke liye font ke defaults ko override karta hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/font-feature-settings
← Previous82 · font-variant-numeric→ Next84 · letter-spacing
84Typography

letter-spacing

Is section me hum letter-spacing ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye section asal docs ko taaza padhkar verify kiya gaya hai.

Ye utilities tracking, or letter spacing, of an element. ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
tracking-tighterletter-spacing: var(--tracking-tighter); /* -0.05em */
tracking-tightletter-spacing: var(--tracking-tight); /* -0.025em */
tracking-normalletter-spacing: var(--tracking-normal); /* 0em */
tracking-wideletter-spacing: var(--tracking-wide); /* 0.025em */
tracking-widerletter-spacing: var(--tracking-wider); /* 0.05em */
tracking-widestletter-spacing: var(--tracking-widest); /* 0.1em */
tracking-(<custom-property>)letter-spacing: var(<custom-property>);
tracking-[<value>]letter-spacing: <value>;

How it works

  • tracking-tight / tracking-normal / tracking-wide letter spacing set karte hain; negative naam wale values (tighter/tight) aksharon ko paas kheench-te hain, positive values (wide/wider/widest) unhe phaila dete hain.
  • Negative values: class ke aage dash lagao, jaise -tracking-2 — sirf tab kaam ka jab scale ko numbers me customise kiya gaya ho (default naam wala scale negation ke liye upyukt nahi hai).
  • @theme se custom scale: @theme { --tracking-1: 0em; --tracking-2: 0.025em; --tracking-3: 0.05em; --tracking-4: 0.1em; } phir tracking-1 … tracking-4 istemal karo.
  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): tracking-[.25em]; CSS variable shorthand: tracking-(--my-tracking) (= tracking-[var(--my-tracking)]).
  • Responsive: tracking-tight md:tracking-wide.
  • @theme { --tracking-tightest: -0.075em; } se ek custom naam wali utility jodo → tracking-tightest markup me kaam karti hai.

Aam galtiyaan / interview points

  • "Tracking" letter spacing ke liye typographic shabd hai; Tailwind utilities ka naam tracking-* rakhta hai, letter-spacing-* nahi.
  • Values em me hain, to ye font size ke saath scale hote hain — tracking-widest (0.1em) bade text par aanupaatik roop se bada hota hai.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/letter-spacing
← Previous83 · font-feature-settings→ Next85 · line-clamp
85Typography

line-clamp

Is section me hum line-clamp ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities — clamping text to a specific number of lines (multi-line truncation with an ellipsis)..

ClassStyles
line-clamp-<number>overflow: hidden; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; -webkit-line-clamp: <number>;
line-clamp-noneoverflow: visible; display: block; -webkit-box-orient: horizontal; -webkit-line-clamp: unset;
line-clamp-(<custom-property>)overflow: hidden; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; -webkit-line-clamp: var(<custom-property>);
line-clamp-[<value>]overflow: hidden; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; -webkit-line-clamp: <value>;

Basic usage — kisi card ke excerpt ko 3 lines ke baad kaato (docs example ek blog card hai: date "Mar 10, 2020", heading "Boost your conversion rate", excerpt paragraph):

html
<article>
  <time>Mar 10, 2020</time>
  <h2>Boost your conversion rate</h2>
  <p class="line-clamp-3">
    Nulla dolor velit adipisicing duis excepteur esse in duis nostrud occaecat mollit incididunt deserunt sunt. Ut ut sunt laborum ex occaecat eu tempor labore enim adipisicing minim ad. Est in quis eu dolore occaecat excepteur fugiat dolore nisi aliqua fugiat enim ut cillum. Labore enim duis nostrud eu. Est ut eiusmod consequat irure quis deserunt ex. Enim laboris dolor magna pariatur. Dolor et ad sint voluptate sunt elit mollit officia ad enim sit consectetur enim.
  </p>
  <div>
    <img src="/img/lindsay.jpg" />
    Lindsay Walton
  </div>
</article>

Kisi breakpoint par clamp hatana:

html
<p class="line-clamp-3 lg:line-clamp-none"><!-- ... --></p>

Arbitrary value aur CSS-variable forms:

html
<p class="line-clamp-[calc(var(--characters)/100)] ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>
<p class="line-clamp-(--my-line-count) ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

line-clamp-(--my-line-count) line-clamp-[var(--my-line-count)] ka shorthand hai.

Responsive variant:

html
<div class="line-clamp-3 md:line-clamp-4 ..."><!-- ... --></div>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: line-clamp-N MULTI-line truncation ke liye hai; ek line ke liye truncate istemal karo (text-overflow page dekho). Andar ye ab bhi -webkit-line-clamp / -webkit-box mechanism istemal karta hai, to ise utility dwara di gayi display: -webkit-box chahiye — usi element par display override mat karo. line-clamp-none reset hai, aam taur par kisi breakpoint ke saath joda jata hai (lg:line-clamp-none desktop par poora text dikhane ke liye).

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/line-clamp
← Previous84 · letter-spacing→ Next86 · line-height
86Typography

line-height

Is section me hum line-height ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities leading, or line height, of an element. (Tailwind calls line-height "leading".) ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
text-<size>/<number>font-size: <size>; line-height: calc(var(--spacing) * <number>);
text-<size>/(<custom-property>)font-size: <size>; line-height: var(<custom-property>);
text-<size>/[<value>]font-size: <size>; line-height: <value>;
leading-noneline-height: 1;
leading-<number>line-height: calc(var(--spacing) * <number>);
leading-(<custom-property>)line-height: var(<custom-property>);
leading-[<value>]line-height: <value>;

Font-size + line-height ek saath (font-size page bhi dekho):

html
<p class="text-base/6 ...">So I started to walk into the water...</p>
<p class="text-base/7 ...">So I started to walk into the water...</p>
<p class="text-base/8 ...">So I started to walk into the water...</p>

Docs note: har font-size utility ek default line height bhi set karti hai jab koi di na gayi ho; un values ke liye font-size documentation dekho.

leading-<number> se swatantra line-height — number ko --spacing se guna kiya jata hai (default --spacing: 0.25rem, to leading-6 = 1.5rem):

html
<p class="text-sm leading-6">So I started to walk into the water...</p>
<p class="text-sm leading-7">So I started to walk into the water...</p>
<p class="text-sm leading-8">So I started to walk into the water...</p>

leading-none — line-height font size ke barabar (bade headings ke liye kaam ki):

html
<p class="text-2xl leading-none ...">The quick brown fox...</p>

Arbitrary value aur CSS-variable forms:

html
<p class="leading-[1.5] ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>
<p class="leading-(--my-line-height) ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

leading-(--my-line-height) leading-[var(--my-line-height)] ka shorthand hai.

Responsive variant:

html
<p class="leading-5 md:leading-6 ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

Customise karna: leading-<number> --spacing theme variable se chalta hai:

css
@theme {
  --spacing: 1px;
}

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: leading-6 6px NAHI hai — ye calc(var(--spacing) * 6) hai. leading-none (1) banam leading-tight/snug/normal/relaxed/loose — note: yahan laya gaya v4 docs page apni table me sirf leading-none, leading-<number>, variable aur arbitrary forms deta hai; naam wale leading-tight wagera is page ki table me NAHI hain. Slash syntax text-sm/6 size aur leading ko ek class me jod deta hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/line-height
← Previous85 · line-clamp→ Next87 · list-style-image
87Typography

list-style-image

Is section me hum list-style-image ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities marker images for list items (CSS list-style-image). ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
list-image-[<value>]list-style-image: <value>;
list-image-(<custom-property>)list-style-image: var(<custom-property>);
list-image-nonelist-style-image: none;

Basic usage — bullet ke roop me ek checkmark image (docs example list: "5 cups chopped Porcini mushrooms", "1/2 cup of olive oil", "3lb of celery"):

html
<ul class="list-image-[url(/img/checkmark.png)]">
  <li>5 cups chopped Porcini mushrooms</li>
  <!-- ... -->
</ul>

CSS-variable form (list-image-[var(--my-list-image)] ka shorthand):

html
<ul class="list-image-(--my-list-image)"><!-- ... --></ul>

Marker image hatana:

html
<ul class="list-image-none"><!-- ... --></ul>

Responsive variant:

html
<ul class="list-image-none md:list-image-[url(/img/checkmark.png)] ..."><!-- ... --></ul>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: koi andar-bani naam wali image utility nahi hai — sirf arbitrary url(...), ek CSS variable, ya none. Image bullet ki jagah poori tarah le leti hai; marker image ka size image khud control karti hai, koi Tailwind utility nahi. list-style-type/list-style-position ke gyaan ke saath jodo: jab dono set hon to list-image list-style-type par jeet-ta hai (CSS vyavhaar).

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/list-style-image
← Previous86 · line-height→ Next88 · list-style-position
88Typography

list-style-position

Is section me hum list-style-position ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities position of bullets and numbers in lists (CSS list-style-position). ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
list-insidelist-style-position: inside;
list-outsidelist-style-position: outside;

Basic usage (dono examples me wahi 3-item recipe list):

html
<ul class="list-inside">
  <li>5 cups chopped Porcini mushrooms</li>
  <!-- ... -->
</ul>
<ul class="list-outside">
  <li>5 cups chopped Porcini mushrooms</li>
  <!-- ... -->
</ul>
  • list-inside: marker content flow ke andar baithta hai — wrap hui lines marker ke neeche align hoti hain.
  • list-outside (default): marker bahar baithta hai — wrap hui lines text ke saath align hoti hain, hanging-indent style.

Responsive variant:

html
<ul class="list-outside md:list-inside ..."><!-- ... --></ul>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: sirf do utilities, is page par koi arbitrary form nahi. Visual fark sirf multi-line items par dikhta hai. list-inside aksar tab istemal hota hai jab list kisi sankre card ke andar ho aur bahari marker kat/overflow ho jaye.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/list-style-position
← Previous87 · list-style-image→ Next89 · list-style-type
89Typography

list-style-type

Is section me hum list-style-type ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities marker style of a list (CSS list-style-type). ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
list-disclist-style-type: disc;
list-decimallist-style-type: decimal;
list-nonelist-style-type: none;
list-(<custom-property>)list-style-type: var(<custom-property>);
list-[<value>]list-style-type: <value>;

Basic usage (docs example text: "Now this is a story all about how, my life got flipped-turned upside down / And I'd like to take a minute just sit right there / I'll tell you how I became the prince of a town called Bel-Air"):

html
<ul class="list-disc">
  <li>Now this is a story all about how, my life got flipped-turned upside down</li>
  <!-- ... -->
</ul>
<ol class="list-decimal">
  <li>Now this is a story all about how, my life got flipped-turned upside down</li>
  <!-- ... -->
</ol>
<ul class="list-none">
  <li>Now this is a story all about how, my life got flipped-turned upside down</li>
  <!-- ... -->
</ul>

Arbitrary value (koi bhi CSS list-style-type, jaise Roman numerals) aur CSS-variable forms:

html
<ol class="list-[upper-roman] ..."><!-- ... --></ol>
<ol class="list-(--my-marker) ..."><!-- ... --></ol>

list-(--my-marker) list-[var(--my-marker)] ka shorthand hai.

Responsive variant:

html
<ul class="list-none md:list-disc ..."><!-- ... --></ul>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: v4 me sirf teen naam wali utilities — disc, decimal, none. Baaki sab (square, circle, upper-roman, lower-alpha…) list-[<value>] se jata hai. list-none nav menus / custom lists ke liye standard reset hai, aur ye marker hatata hai lekin default padding/margin nahi — uske liye spacing utilities chahiye. Tailwind ka preflight kai setups me default list styles pehle hi hata deta hai, to bullets wapas pane ke liye aksar list-disc chahiye hota hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/list-style-type
← Previous88 · list-style-position→ Next90 · text-align
90Typography

text-align

Is section me hum text-align ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities alignment of text (CSS text-align). ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
text-lefttext-align: left;
text-centertext-align: center;
text-righttext-align: right;
text-justifytext-align: justify;
text-starttext-align: start;
text-endtext-align: end;

Basic usage:

html
<p class="text-left">So I started to walk into the water...</p>
<p class="text-right">So I started to walk into the water...</p>
<p class="text-center">So I started to walk into the water...</p>
<p class="text-justify">So I started to walk into the water...</p>

Logical properties — text-start / text-end logical properties istemal karte hain jo text ki disha ke hisaab se left ya right se judti hain (docs example RTL Arabic hai, dir="rtl" lang="ar", jahan text-end dikhai dene me baayein taraf align hota hai):

html
<div dir="rtl" lang="ar">
  <p class="text-end">فبدأت بالسير نحو الماء...</p>
</div>

Responsive variant:

html
<p class="text-left md:text-center ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: text-center inline content (text) ko align karta hai, ye kisi block element ko khud centre NAHI karta — uske liye mx-auto / flex istemal karo. text-start/text-end bahu-bhashi/RTL sites ke liye i18n-sahi vikalp hain; text-left/text-right bhautik hain aur RTL me nahi palatte. text-justify lines ko dono kinaron tak kheenchta hai aur sankre columns me bade shabd-gaps ("rivers") bana sakta hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/text-align
← Previous89 · list-style-type→ Next91 · color
91Typography

color

Is section me hum color ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities text color of an element (CSS color). This is the text-<color> namespace. ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
text-inheritcolor: inherit;
text-currentcolor: currentColor;
text-transparentcolor: transparent;
text-blackcolor: var(--color-black); /* #000 */
text-whitecolor: var(--color-white); /* #fff */
text-<color>-<shade> (e.g. text-red-50 … text-red-400 …)color: var(--color-<color>-<shade>); — e.g. text-red-50 = oklch(97.1% 0.013 17.38), text-red-100 = oklch(93.6% 0.032 17.717), text-red-200 = oklch(88.5% 0.062 18.334), text-red-300 = oklch(80.8% 0.114 19.571), text-red-400 = oklch(70.4% 0.191 22.216)
text-[<value>]color: <value>; (docs example text-[#50d71e])
text-(<custom-property>)color: var(<custom-property>);

Fetch par note: page ki class table jaisi aayi usme examples par jaane se pehle sirf pehli rang rows dikhi (black, white, red-50…red-400); poora palette standard --color-* scale ko follow karta hai (har rang × shades 50–950). Jo shades nahi dikhe unke liye exact oklch values mat ghado; page jo pattern sthaapit karta hai wo hai text-<color>-<shade> → var(--color-<color>-<shade>).

Basic usage (docs example me dark-mode jodi note karo):

html
<p class="text-blue-600 dark:text-sky-400">The quick brown fox...</p>

Opacity modifier — rang ke baad slash, 0–100 (docs /100, /75, /50, /25 dikhate hain):

html
<p class="text-blue-600/100 dark:text-sky-400/100">The quick brown fox...</p>
<p class="text-blue-600/75 dark:text-sky-400/75">The quick brown fox...</p>
<p class="text-blue-600/50 dark:text-sky-400/50">The quick brown fox...</p>
<p class="text-blue-600/25 dark:text-sky-400/25">The quick brown fox...</p>

Arbitrary value aur CSS-variable forms:

html
<p class="text-[#50d71e] ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>
<p class="text-(--my-color) ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

text-(--my-color) text-[var(--my-color)] ka shorthand hai.

State variant (link par hover) aur breakpoint variant:

html
<p class="...">
  Oh I gotta get on that
  <a class="underline hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-blue-400" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Internet">internet</a>,
  I'm late on everything!
</p>
<p class="text-blue-600 md:text-green-600 ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

Customising with @theme (--color-* variables):

css
@theme {
  --color-regal-blue: #243c5a;
}
html
<p class="text-regal-blue">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: text-blue-600 (rang) banam text-sm (size) banam text-left (align) — ek hi prefix, alag namespaces; Tailwind value se hal karta hai. Opacity modifier /50 colours par kaam karta hai kyunki v4 me ye andar color-mix istemal karta hai; ye text-sm/6 (line-height) wala slash NAHI hai. text-current text ko currentColor viraasat me deta hai (SVG ke paas wale text / icons ke liye kaam ka); text-inherit parent ka computed rang viraasat me leta hai; text-transparent gradient text ke liye bg-clip-text ke saath istemal hota hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/color
← Previous90 · text-align→ Next92 · text-decoration-line
92Typography

text-decoration-line

Is section me hum text-decoration-line ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities decoration of text (CSS text-decoration-line). ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
underlinetext-decoration-line: underline;
overlinetext-decoration-line: overline;
line-throughtext-decoration-line: line-through;
no-underlinetext-decoration-line: none;

Basic usage:

html
<p class="underline">The quick brown fox...</p>
<p class="overline">The quick brown fox...</p>
<p class="line-through">The quick brown fox...</p>
<p class="no-underline">The quick brown fox...</p>

State variant (sirf hover par underline — standard link pattern) aur breakpoint variant:

html
<p>The <a href="..." class="no-underline hover:underline ...">quick brown fox</a> jumps over the lazy dog.</p>
<a class="no-underline md:underline ..." href="..."><!-- ... --></a>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: yahan underline line hai; iske rang/style/motaai/offset agle chaar pages par alag utilities hain (decoration-*, underline-offset-*). no-underline reset hai, aam taur par un links par istemal hota hai jinhe Tailwind/browser defaults underline karte. In utilities se har element par sirf ek line type — underline overline jodne se takraav hota hai (CSS ke hisaab se aakhiri jeet-ta hai).

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/text-decoration-line
← Previous91 · color→ Next93 · text-decoration-color
93Typography

text-decoration-color

Is section me hum text-decoration-color ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities color of text decorations (CSS text-decoration-color). Prefix is decoration-, not text-. ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
decoration-inherittext-decoration-color: inherit;
decoration-currenttext-decoration-color: currentColor;
decoration-transparenttext-decoration-color: transparent;
decoration-blacktext-decoration-color: var(--color-black); /* #000 */
decoration-whitetext-decoration-color: var(--color-white); /* #fff */
decoration-<color>-<shade> (e.g. decoration-red-50 … decoration-red-400)text-decoration-color: var(--color-<color>-<shade>); — same oklch values as the color page (red-50 oklch(97.1% 0.013 17.38) … red-400 oklch(70.4% 0.191 22.216))
decoration-[<value>]text-decoration-color: <value>;
decoration-(<custom-property>)text-decoration-color: var(<custom-property>);

Color page wala wahi fetch note: laute hue text me sirf pehli rang rows dikhi thi; poora palette standard --color-* scale ko follow karta hai.

Basic usage — coloured underlines on links in a sentence (docs example: "I'm Derek, an astro-engineer based in Tattooine…"):

html
<p>
  I'm Derek, an astro-engineer based in Tattooine. I like to build X-Wings at
  <a class="underline decoration-sky-500">My Company, Inc</a>. Outside of work,
  I like to <a class="underline decoration-pink-500">watch pod-racing</a>
  and have <a class="underline decoration-indigo-500">light-saber</a> fights.
</p>

Opacity modifier (docs /30 istemal karte hain):

html
<p>
  I'm Derek, an astro-engineer based in Tattooine. I like to build X-Wings at
  <a class="underline decoration-sky-500/30">My Company, Inc</a>. Outside of work,
  I like to <a class="underline decoration-pink-500/30">watch pod-racing</a>
  and have <a class="underline decoration-indigo-500/30">light-saber</a> fights.
</p>

Arbitrary value aur CSS-variable forms:

html
<p class="decoration-[#50d71e] ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>
<p class="decoration-(--my-color) ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

decoration-(--my-color) decoration-[var(--my-color)] ka shorthand hai.

State aur breakpoint variants:

html
<p>The <a href="..." class="underline hover:decoration-pink-500 ...">quick brown fox</a> jumps over the lazy dog.</p>
<p class="underline decoration-sky-600 md:decoration-blue-400 ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

@theme se customise karna (--color-* variables — text/background/border colours ke saath shared):

css
@theme {
  --color-regal-blue: #243c5a;
}
html
<p class="decoration-regal-blue">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: koi decoration-* rang usi element par decoration line (underline/overline/line-through) ke bina kuch dikhai nahi deta — ek aksar hone wala bug. decoration-* agle do pages par decoration style (decoration-dotted) aur thickness (decoration-2) ka bhi prefix hai — ek hi prefix, teen alag CSS properties, value se pehchane jate hain.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/text-decoration-color
← Previous92 · text-decoration-line→ Next94 · text-decoration-style
94Typography

text-decoration-style

Is section me hum text-decoration-style ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities style of text decorations (CSS text-decoration-style). ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
decoration-solidtext-decoration-style: solid;
decoration-doubletext-decoration-style: double;
decoration-dottedtext-decoration-style: dotted;
decoration-dashedtext-decoration-style: dashed;
decoration-wavytext-decoration-style: wavy;

Basic usage (har ek ko dikhai dene ke liye saath me underline chahiye):

html
<p class="underline decoration-solid">The quick brown fox...</p>
<p class="underline decoration-double">The quick brown fox...</p>
<p class="underline decoration-dotted">The quick brown fox...</p>
<p class="underline decoration-dashed">The quick brown fox...</p>
<p class="underline decoration-wavy">The quick brown fox...</p>

Responsive variant:

html
<p class="underline md:decoration-dashed ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: decoration-wavy classic "spelling-error" wali underline hai. Decoration-color ki tarah, decoration line ke bina style adrishya hai. decoration-double ko dono lines saaf dikhane ke liye kaafi motaai/offset chahiye.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/text-decoration-style
← Previous93 · text-decoration-color→ Next95 · text-decoration-thickness
95Typography

text-decoration-thickness

Is section me hum text-decoration-thickness ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities thickness of text decorations (CSS text-decoration-thickness). ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
decoration-<number>text-decoration-thickness: <number>px;
decoration-from-fonttext-decoration-thickness: from-font;
decoration-autotext-decoration-thickness: auto;
decoration-(length:<custom-property>)text-decoration-thickness: var(<custom-property>);
decoration-[<value>]text-decoration-thickness: <value>;

Basic usage — decoration-1, decoration-2, decoration-4 (numbers px hain):

html
<p class="underline decoration-1">The quick brown fox...</p>
<p class="underline decoration-2">The quick brown fox...</p>
<p class="underline decoration-4">The quick brown fox...</p>

Arbitrary value aur CSS-variable forms:

html
<p class="decoration-[0.25rem] ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>
<p class="decoration-(length:--my-decoration-thickness) ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

decoration-(length:--my-decoration-thickness) decoration-[length:var(--my-decoration-thickness)] ka shorthand hai.

Responsive variant:

html
<p class="underline md:decoration-4 ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: decoration-2 ka matlab yahan 2px hai (leading-6 ke vipreet, jo spacing se guna hota hai, aur underline-offset-2 ke vipreet nahi, wo bhi px hai). decoration-auto browser ko chunne deta hai; decoration-from-font font file dwara sujhayi motaai istemal karta hai (agar font deta ho to). Phir se, underline/overline/line-through ke bina adrishya.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/text-decoration-thickness
← Previous94 · text-decoration-style→ Next96 · text-underline-offset
96Typography

text-underline-offset

Is section me hum text-underline-offset ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities offset of a text underline (CSS text-underline-offset — the gap between text and underline). ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
underline-offset-<number>text-underline-offset: <number>px;
-underline-offset-<number>text-underline-offset: calc(<number>px * -1);
underline-offset-autotext-underline-offset: auto;
underline-offset-(<custom-property>)text-underline-offset: var(<custom-property>);
underline-offset-[<value>]text-underline-offset: <value>;

Basic usage — underline-offset-1, -2, -4, -8:

html
<p class="underline underline-offset-1">The quick brown fox...</p>
<p class="underline underline-offset-2">The quick brown fox...</p>
<p class="underline underline-offset-4">The quick brown fox...</p>
<p class="underline underline-offset-8">The quick brown fox...</p>

Arbitrary value aur CSS-variable forms:

html
<p class="underline-offset-[3px] ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>
<p class="underline-offset-(--my-underline-offset) ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

underline-offset-(--my-underline-offset) underline-offset-[var(--my-underline-offset)] ka shorthand hai.

Responsive variant:

html
<p class="underline md:underline-offset-4 ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: number px hai (underline-offset-4 = 4px); negative values bhi hain (-underline-offset-2 line ko aur paas/text ke andar kheenchta hai). underline-offset-auto browser default hai. Bada offset links ki readability/accessibility behtar karta hai, khaas taur par descenders ke saath. Vyavhaarik roop se sirf underlines ko prabhavit karta hai — overlines/line-through ko nahi.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/text-underline-offset
← Previous95 · text-decoration-thickness→ Next97 · text-transform
97Typography

text-transform

Is section me hum text-transform ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities capitalization of text (CSS text-transform). ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
uppercasetext-transform: uppercase;
lowercasetext-transform: lowercase;
capitalizetext-transform: capitalize;
normal-casetext-transform: none;

Basic usage:

html
<p class="uppercase">The quick brown fox ...</p>
<p class="lowercase">The quick brown fox ...</p>
<p class="capitalize">The quick brown fox ...</p>
<p class="normal-case">The quick brown fox ...</p>

normal-case par docs note: ye asli text ki casing banaye rakhta hai — "aam taur par alag-alag breakpoints par capitalization reset karne ke liye istemal hota hai".

Responsive variant:

html
<p class="capitalize md:uppercase ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: capitalize HAR shabd ke pehle akshar ko capital karta hai, sirf pehle shabd ko nahi. Ye poori tarah visual hai — neeche ka text (aur jo copy hota hai / screen reader padhta hai / search ko jata hai) nahi badalta, to data ki shuddhta ke liye is par bharosa mat karo. Headings/labels par uppercase ek bahut aam design pattern hai, aam taur par tracking-* (letter-spacing) ke saath joda jata hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/text-transform
← Previous96 · text-underline-offset→ Next98 · text-overflow
98Typography

text-overflow

Is section me hum text-overflow ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities ye control karne ke liye hain ki kaise the text of an element overflows (CSS text-overflow).

ClassStyles
truncateoverflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;
text-ellipsistext-overflow: ellipsis;
text-cliptext-overflow: clip;

truncate — sab-kuch-ek-me: wrapping rokta hai AUR overflow karte text ko ellipsis (…) se kaat deta hai. Docs example lamba shabd "pneumonoultramicroscopicsilicovolcanoconiosis" hai, English dictionaries ke sabse lambe shabd ke baare me ek vaakya me:

html
<p class="truncate">The longest word in any of the major...</p>

text-ellipsis — sirf text-overflow: ellipsis set karta hai; iske kuch karne ke liye tumhe khud overflow-hidden jodna padega (aur aam taur par whitespace-nowrap):

html
<p class="overflow-hidden text-ellipsis">The longest word in any of the major...</p>

text-clip — text ko content area ki seema par kaat deta hai, bina ellipsis ke. Docs note: "Ye default browser vyavhaar hai."

html
<p class="overflow-hidden text-clip">The longest word in any of the major...</p>

Responsive variant:

html
<p class="text-ellipsis md:text-clip ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: truncate ek compound utility hai (ek class me teen declarations) — baaki dono single-property hain. text-ellipsis akela overflow: hidden aur ek seemit chaudaai / no-wrap ke bina kuch nahi karta; yehi #1 "ellipsis nahi dikh raha" bug hai. truncate sirf ek line par kaam karta hai — multi-line truncation ke liye line-clamp-* istemal karo (line-clamp page). Flex/grid layouts me truncate ko asal me sikudne ke liye aksar element par min-w-0 chahiye hota hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/text-overflow
← Previous97 · text-transform→ Next99 · text-wrap
99Typography

text-wrap

Is section me hum text-wrap ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities ye control karne ke liye hain ki kaise text wraps within an element (CSS text-wrap).

ClassStyles
text-wraptext-wrap: wrap;
text-nowraptext-wrap: nowrap;
text-balancetext-wrap: balance;
text-prettytext-wrap: pretty;
  • text-wrap — overflow karte text ko logical points par kai lines par wrap karo (aam vyavhaar, spasht roop se). Docs example ek article hai jiska heading hai "Beloved Manhattan soup stand closes" aur ek paragraph New Yorkers ke winter chill ka saamna karne ke baare me:
html
  <article class="text-wrap">
    <h3>Beloved Manhattan soup stand closes</h3>
    <p>New Yorkers are facing the winter chill...</p>
  </article>
  • text-nowrap — wrapping roko, zaroorat pade to overflow hone do:
html
  <article class="text-nowrap">
    <h3>Beloved Manhattan soup stand closes</h3>
    <p>New Yorkers are facing the winter chill...</p>
  </article>
  • text-balance — text ko lines me barabar baanto (santulit line lengths, koi tooti-phooti aakhiri line nahi). Docs example ise sirf <h3> par lagata hai:
html
  <article>
    <h3 class="text-balance">Beloved Manhattan soup stand closes</h3>
    <p>New Yorkers are facing the winter chill...</p>
  </article>

Page par performance note: "Performance ke kaaran browsers text balancing ko un blocks tak seemit rakhte hain jo ~6 lines ya usse kam ke hon, isliye ye headings ke liye sabse upyukt hai."

  • text-pretty — speed ki qeemat par behtar wrapping/layout ko prathmikta do; "Vyavhaar browsers me alag hota hai lekin aksar text block ke ant me orphans (apni line par akela shabd) rokne jaise tareeke shaamil hote hain":
html
  <article>
    <h3 class="text-pretty">Beloved Manhattan soup stand closes</h3>
    <p>New Yorkers are facing the winter chill...</p>
  </article>

Responsive variant:

html
<h1 class="text-pretty md:text-balance ..."><!-- ... --></h1>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: headings ke liye text-balance, body copy ke liye text-pretty — yehi chaaha gaya bantwara hai. text-nowrap v4 naam hai (CSS text-wrap: nowrap); purane whitespace-nowrap se mat uljhao (alag property, white-space). text-balance ~6-line browser seema ke kaaran bahut lambe blocks par kuch kaam ka nahi karta.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/text-wrap
← Previous98 · text-overflow→ Next100 · text-indent
100Typography

text-indent

Is section me hum text-indent ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities amount of empty space shown before text in a block (CSS text-indent — first-line indent). ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
indent-<number>text-indent: calc(var(--spacing) * <number>);
-indent-<number>text-indent: calc(var(--spacing) * -<number>);
indent-pxtext-indent: 1px;
-indent-pxtext-indent: -1px;
indent-(<custom-property>)text-indent: var(<custom-property>);
indent-[<value>]text-indent: <value>;

Basic usage — indent-2 / indent-8 (docs example "So I started to walk into the water…" paragraph par indent-8 istemal karta hai):

html
<p class="indent-8">So I started to walk into the water...</p>

Negative indent (aage wala dash value ko negative me badal deta hai — hanging indents ke liye istemal hota hai):

html
<p class="-indent-8">So I started to walk into the water...</p>

Arbitrary value aur CSS-variable forms:

html
<p class="indent-[50%] ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>
<p class="indent-(--my-indentation) ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

indent-(--my-indentation) indent-[var(--my-indentation)] ka shorthand hai.

Responsive variant:

html
<p class="indent-4 md:indent-8 ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: indent-<number> spacing se guna hota hai (indent-8 = calc(var(--spacing) * 8) = default roop se 2rem), 8px NAHI — tab-* aur decoration-* numbers ke vipreet. Ye kisi block ki sirf PEHLI line ko indent karta hai, poore paragraph ko nahi (poore-block indentation ke liye padding/margin istemal karo). Negative indent + padding hanging-indent ki recipe hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/text-indent
← Previous99 · text-wrap→ Next101 · tab-size
101Typography

tab-size

Is section me hum tab-size ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Tab characters ke size ko control karne ki utilities (CSS tab-size).

ClassStyles
tab-<number>tab-size: <number>;
tab-(<custom-property>)tab-size: var(<custom-property>);
tab-[<value>]tab-size: <value>;

Basic usage — tab-2 vs tab-8 on a <pre> code block (docs example: function indent() { return 'tabbed'; } with a literal tab before return):

html
<pre class="tab-2 ...">function indent() {&#10;&#9;return 'tabbed'&#10;}</pre>
<pre class="tab-8 ...">function indent() {&#10;&#9;return 'tabbed'&#10;}</pre>

Arbitrary value (ek lambaai ho sakti hai, jaise 12px) aur CSS-variable forms:

html
<pre class="tab-[12px] ..."><!-- ... --></pre>
<pre class="tab-(--my-tab-size) ..."><!-- ... --></pre>

tab-(--my-tab-size) is shorthand for tab-[var(--my-tab-size)].

Responsive variant:

html
<pre class="tab-4 md:tab-8 ..."><!-- ... --></pre>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: tab-2 ka matlab hai 2 character-widths, 2px NAHI aur spacing se guna bhi NAHI — indent-8/leading-6 se vipreet. Sirf wahan dikhai deta hai jahan shabdik tab characters maujood hon, matlab <pre>/code blocks; spaces par ye kuch nahi karta. Default browser tab size 8 hai, to code display ke liye tab-4/tab-2 aam vikalp hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/tab-size
← Previous100 · text-indent→ Next102 · vertical-align
102Typography

vertical-align

Is section me hum vertical-align ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities vertical alignment of an inline or table-cell box (CSS vertical-align). ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
align-baselinevertical-align: baseline;
align-topvertical-align: top;
align-middlevertical-align: middle;
align-bottomvertical-align: bottom;
align-text-topvertical-align: text-top;
align-text-bottomvertical-align: text-bottom;
align-subvertical-align: sub;
align-supervertical-align: super;
align-(<custom-property>)vertical-align: var(<custom-property>);
align-[<value>]vertical-align: <value>;

Docs ki paribhashayein (saare examples "The quick brown fox…" wala ek inline-block span istemal karte hain):

  • align-baseline — element ki baseline ko uske parent ki baseline ke saath align karo.
html
  <span class="inline-block align-baseline">The quick brown fox...</span>
  • align-top — element aur uske descendants ke top ko poori line ke top ke saath align karo.
html
  <span class="inline-block align-top">The quick brown fox...</span>
  • align-middle — element ke middle ko parent ki baseline aur aadhi x-height ke saath align karo.
html
  <span class="inline-block align-middle">The quick brown fox...</span>
  • align-bottom — element aur uske descendants ke bottom ko poori line ke bottom ke saath align karo.
html
  <span class="inline-block align-bottom">The quick brown fox...</span>
  • align-text-top — element ke top ko parent element ke font ke top ke saath align karo.
html
  <span class="inline-block align-text-top">The quick brown fox...</span>
  • align-text-bottom — element ke bottom ko parent element ke font ke bottom ke saath align karo.
html
  <span class="inline-block align-text-bottom">The quick brown fox...</span>

Arbitrary value aur CSS-variable forms:

html
<span class="align-[4px] ..."><!-- ... --></span>
<span class="align-(--my-alignment) ..."><!-- ... --></span>

align-(--my-alignment) align-[var(--my-alignment)] ka shorthand hai.

Responsive variant:

html
<span class="align-middle md:align-top ..."><!-- ... --></span>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: vertical-align sirf inline/inline-block/table-cell boxes par lagu hota hai — ye kisi block div ko vertically centre NAHI karta (uske liye flex items-center istemal karo). align-middle text ke paas icon align karne ki classic theek hai. align-sub/align-super <sub>/<sup> ke CSS barabar hain. align-top banam align-text-top me fark hai: "poori line ka top" banam "parent ke font ka top".

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/vertical-align
← Previous101 · tab-size→ Next103 · white-space
103Typography

white-space

Is section me hum white-space ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities kisi element ki white-space property (CSS white-space — collapsing, wrapping, and preserving spaces/newlines). ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
whitespace-normalwhite-space: normal;
whitespace-nowrapwhite-space: nowrap;
whitespace-prewhite-space: pre;
whitespace-pre-linewhite-space: pre-line;
whitespace-pre-wrapwhite-space: pre-wrap;
whitespace-break-spaceswhite-space: break-spaces;

Docs ke saare chhah examples ek hi source text istemal karte hain — "Hey everyone! It's almost 2022 and we still don't know if there are aliens living among us, or do we? Maybe the person writing this is an alien. You will never know." — source me extra spaces aur newlines ke saath, taaki fark dikhai dein:

  • whitespace-normal — text aam taur par wrap hota hai; newlines aur spaces collapse ho jate hain (default).
html
  <p class="whitespace-normal">Hey everyone!It's almost 2022       and we still don't know if there             are aliens living among us, or do we? Maybe the person writing this is an alien.You will never know.</p>
  • whitespace-nowrap — wrapping roko; newlines aur spaces collapse ho jate hain. Docs ise overflow-auto ke saath jodte hain taaki ek lambi line scroll ho:
html
  <p class="overflow-auto whitespace-nowrap">Hey everyone!It's almost 2022       and we still don't know if there             are aliens living among us, or do we? Maybe the person writing this is an alien.You will never know.</p>
  • whitespace-pre — newlines aur spaces banaye rakho; text wrap NAHI hoga (<pre> ki tarah).
html
  <p class="overflow-auto whitespace-pre">Hey everyone!It's almost 2022       and we still don't know if there             are aliens living among us, or do we? Maybe the person writing this is an alien.You will never know.</p>
  • whitespace-pre-line — newlines banaye rakho lekin spaces NAHI; text aam taur par wrap hota hai.
html
  <p class="whitespace-pre-line">Hey everyone!It's almost 2022       and we still don't know if there             are aliens living among us, or do we? Maybe the person writing this is an alien.You will never know.</p>
  • whitespace-pre-wrap — newlines aur spaces banaye rakho; text aam taur par wrap hota hai.
html
  <p class="whitespace-pre-wrap">Hey everyone!It's almost 2022       and we still don't know if there             are aliens living among us, or do we? Maybe the person writing this is an alien.You will never know.</p>
  • whitespace-break-spaces — newlines aur spaces banaye rakho; lines ke ant ki white space latkegi nahi, balki agli line par wrap hogi (pre-wrap ki tarah, bas peeche wali spaces latakne ke bajaye wrap hoti hain).
html
  <p class="whitespace-break-spaces">Hey everyone!It's almost 2022       and we still don't know if there             are aliens living among us, or do we? Maybe the person writing this is an alien.You will never know.</p>

Responsive variant:

html
<p class="whitespace-pre md:whitespace-normal ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: ek 2×3 dimagi table madad karti hai — spaces collapse banam preserve × wrap banam no-wrap, aur pre-line/break-spaces ke kinare wale cases. whitespace-nowrap ≠ text-nowrap: whitespace-nowrap white-space: nowrap hai, text-nowrap text-wrap: nowrap hai — alag properties, wrapping par milta-julta asar, aur truncate andar se white-space: nowrap istemal karta hai. whitespace-pre <pre> element ke default margins/font ke bina <pre> vyavhaar ka utility roop hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/white-space
← Previous102 · vertical-align→ Next104 · word-break
104Typography

word-break

Is section me hum word-break ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities word breaks in an element (CSS word-break). ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
break-normalword-break: normal;
break-allword-break: break-all;
break-keepword-break: keep-all;
  • break-normal — sirf aam word break points par line breaks jodo (docs example: "pneumonoultramicroscopicsilicovolcanoconiosis" wala vaakya; lamba shabd tutne ke bajaye overflow karta hai).
html
  <p class="break-normal">The longest word in any of the major...</p>
  • break-all — jab bhi zaroori ho line breaks jodo, poore shabdon ko banaye rakhne ki koshish kiye bina (lamba shabd fit hone ke liye beech me kat jata hai).
html
  <p class="break-all">The longest word in any of the major...</p>
  • break-keep — Chinese/Japanese/Korean (CJK) text par line breaks lagu hone se roko. Docs example Chinese hai: "抗衡不屈不挠 (kànghéng bùqū bùnáo) 这是一个长词，意思是不畏强暴，奋勇抗争，坚定不移，永不放弃。这个词通常用来描述那些在面对困难和挑战时坚持自己信念的人，他们克服一切困难，不屈不挠地追求自己的目标。无论遇到多大的挑战，他们都能够坚持到底，不放弃，最终获得胜利。"
html
  <p class="break-keep">抗衡不屈不挠...</p>

Docs note: "Non-CJK text ke liye break-keep utility ka vyavhaar break-normal utility jaisa hi hota hai."

Responsive variant:

html
<p class="break-normal md:break-all ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: break-all lambe bina-tute strings (URLs, hashes, lambe shabd) ke liye bhothra upkaran hai — ye kahin bhi todta hai, beech-shabd me bhi, readability ko nuksaan pahunchata hai. overflow-wrap (agla page) se vipreet, jo kisi shabd ko sirf tab todta hai jab wo warna overflow kare. break-keep sirf CJK ke liye mayne rakhta hai; Latin text ke liye ye break-normal ke mukable no-op hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/word-break
← Previous103 · white-space→ Next105 · overflow-wrap
105Typography

overflow-wrap

Is section me hum overflow-wrap ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities line breaks within words in an overflowing element (CSS overflow-wrap, formerly word-wrap). ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
wrap-break-wordoverflow-wrap: break-word;
wrap-anywhereoverflow-wrap: anywhere;
wrap-normaloverflow-wrap: normal;
  • wrap-break-word — zaroorat pade to kisi shabd ke aksharon ke beech line breaks hone do (sirf tab jab shabd overflow kare). Docs example: "pneumonoultramicroscopicsilicovolcanoconiosis" wala vaakya.
html
  <p class="wrap-break-word">The longest word in any of the major...</p>
  • wrap-anywhere — wrap-break-word jaisa hi vyavhaar karta hai, bas browser element ke intrinsic size ki ganana karte waqt beech-shabd line breaks ko bhi ginta hai. Docs ek flex profile card se samjhate hain (max-w-sm, avatar size-16 rounded-full, naam "Jay Riemenschneider", email "jason.riemenschneider@vandelayindustries.com"): wrap-break-word se lambi email flex item se overflow karti hai; wrap-anywhere se wo wrap ho jati hai:
html
  <div class="flex max-w-sm">
    <img class="size-16 rounded-full" src="/img/profile.jpg" />
    <div class="wrap-break-word">
      <p class="font-medium">Jay Riemenschneider</p>
      <p>jason.riemenschneider@vandelayindustries.com</p>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="flex max-w-sm">
    <img class="size-16 rounded-full" src="/img/profile.jpg" />
    <div class="wrap-anywhere">
      <p class="font-medium">Jay Riemenschneider</p>
      <p>jason.riemenschneider@vandelayindustries.com</p>
    </div>
  </div>

Docs note: "Ye flex containers ke andar text wrap karne ke liye kaam ka hai, jahan tumhe aam taur par child element par min-width: 0 set karna padta hai taaki wo apne content size se neeche sikud sake."

  • wrap-normal — sirf prakritik wrapping points par line breaks hone do, jaise spaces, hyphens, aur punctuation (default).
html
  <p class="wrap-normal">The longest word in any of the major...</p>

Responsive variant:

html
<p class="wrap-normal md:wrap-break-word ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: v4 ne inke naam purane break-words/break-word se badalkar wrap-break-word/wrap-anywhere kar diye — purane naam v3 wale hain. overflow-wrap: break-word banam word-break: break-all: pehla sirf tab todta hai jab koi shabd overflow kare, dusra hamesha kahin bhi todta hai. wrap-anywhere banam wrap-break-word me fark sirf intrinsic-size ki ganana me hai — aur yehi kaaran hai ki ye flex-container overflow wale case ko theek karta hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/overflow-wrap
← Previous104 · word-break→ Next106 · hyphens
106Typography

hyphens

Is section me hum hyphens ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities ye control karne ke liye hain ki kaise words should be hyphenated (CSS hyphens).

ClassStyles
hyphens-nonehyphens: none;
hyphens-manualhyphens: manual;
hyphens-autohyphens: auto;

Docs example shabd (German, Duden dictionary se): "Kraftfahrzeughaftpflichtversicherung" — 36 akshar, motor vehicle liability insurance — "Kraftfahrzeug" ke baad ek soft hyphen &shy; ghusaya gaya:

  • hyphens-none — shabdon ko hyphenate hone se roko, chahe line break sujhaav &shy; istemal ho.
html
  <p class="hyphens-none">... Kraftfahrzeug&shy;haftpflichtversicherung is a ...</p>
  • hyphens-manual — sirf wahan hyphenation points set karo jahan &shy; istemal ho. Docs note: "Ye default browser vyavhaar hai."
html
  <p class="hyphens-manual">... Kraftfahrzeug&shy;haftpflichtversicherung is a ...</p>
  • hyphens-auto — browser ko bhasha ke hisaab se hyphenation points apne aap chunne do. Docs example paragraph par lang="de" set karta hai:
html
  <p class="hyphens-auto" lang="de">... Kraftfahrzeughaftpflichtversicherung is a ...</p>

Docs note: "Line break sujhaav &shy; ko automatic hyphenation points par prathmikta milegi."

Responsive variant:

html
<p class="hyphens-none md:hyphens-auto ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: hyphens-auto ko ek sahi lang attribute chahiye — iske bina browser ko pata nahi chalta kis bhasha ke hyphenation niyam lagu karne hain, to wo kuch na bhi kare. &shy; (soft hyphen) manual ishara hai: adrishya, jab tak wahan break na ho. hyphens: auto justified text me bade gaps se bachne ke liye text-justify ka aam saathi hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/hyphens
← Previous105 · overflow-wrap→ Next107 · content
107Typography

content

Is section me hum content ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities content of the before and after pseudo-elements (CSS content). ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
content-[<value>]content: <value>;
content-(<custom-property>)content: var(<custom-property>);
content-nonecontent: none;

Note: koi naam wali content utilities nahi hain — sirf arbitrary, CSS-variable, aur none. Utility lagbhag hamesha before: / after: variants ke SAATH istemal hoti hai. Basic usage — kisi link ke baad ek external-link teer (docs example: "Higher resolution means more than just a better-quality image. With a Retina 6K display, Pro Display XDR gives you nearly 40 percent more screen real estate than a 5K display."):

html
<p>Higher resolution means more than just a better-quality image. With a
Retina 6K display, <a class="text-blue-600 after:content-['_↗']" href="...">Pro Display XDR</a>
gives you nearly 40 percent more screen real estate than a 5K display.</p>

'_↗' note karo — underscore teer se pehle wali space ko darshata hai.

attr() — kisi HTML attribute me rakhi value ka sandarbh do:

html
<p before="Hello World" class="before:content-[attr(before)] ..."><!-- ... --></p>

Arbitrary values ke liye underscore niyam (mahatvapurna): kyunki HTML me whitespace class ko khatam kar deta hai, arbitrary value me har space ko underscore se badlo:

html
<p class="before:content-['Hello_World'] ..."></p>

Asal underscore shaamil karne ke liye, use backslash se escape karo:

html
<p class="before:content-['Hello\_World']"></p>

CSS-variable form (content-[var(--my-content)] ka shorthand):

html
<p class="content-(--my-content)"></p>

Responsive variant — har breakpoint par alag pseudo-element content:

html
<p class="before:content-['Mobile'] md:before:content-['Desktop'] ..."></p>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: content ka asar sirf ::before/::after par hota hai — before:/after: ke bina ek khaali content-[...] kuch dikhai nahi deta. Underscore-for-space niyam (aur shabdik underscore ke liye \_) SAARE arbitrary values par lagu hota hai, lekin yahan sabse zyada kaat-ta hai kyunki content strings me swabhavik roop se spaces hote hain. content-none banaye gaye content ko hata deta hai (jaise kisi breakpoint par before: ko hatana). Is tareeke se ghusaya gaya content sajawati hai — screen readers aam taur par ise nazarandaaz karte hain, to matlab-wala text sirf content me mat rakho.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/content
← Previous106 · hyphens→ Next108 · background-attachment
108Backgrounds

background-attachment

Is section me hum background-attachment ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities ye control karne ke liye hain ki kaise a background image behaves when scrolling (CSS background-attachment).

ClassStyles
bg-fixedbackground-attachment: fixed;
bg-localbackground-attachment: local;
bg-scrollbackground-attachment: scroll;
  • bg-fixed — background image ko viewport ke saapeksh fix karo (page scroll hone par ye apni jagah rehta hai — parallax-style asar). Docs demo: bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ke upar ek "My trip to the summit / November 16, 2021 · 4 min read" article, nirdesh ke saath "Scroll the content to see the background image fixed in place".
html
  <div class="bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] bg-fixed ..."><!-- ... --></div>
  • bg-local — background image ko container AUR viewport ke saath scroll karo (element ka apna content scroll hone par background chalta hai). Docs demo ek scrollable box me Seinfeld "Newman" mail quote istemal karta hai: "Scroll the content to see the background image scroll with the container".
html
  <div class="bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] bg-local ..."><!-- ... --></div>
  • bg-scroll — background image ko viewport ke saath scroll karo, lekin container ke saath NAHI (background element ke saapeksh fix hai; element ke andar ke content ko scroll karna use nahi hilata). Docs demo: wahi Newman quote — "Scroll the content to see the background image fixed in the container". Ye CSS default hai.
html
  <div class="bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] bg-scroll ..."><!-- ... --></div>

Responsive variant:

html
<div class="bg-local md:bg-fixed ..."><!-- ... --></div>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: teen-tarah ka fark hi poori baat hai — fixed = viewport, local = element ke content ke saath scroll hota hai, scroll = element se juda, page ke saath chalta hai. local aur scroll ka fark sirf ek scrollable container ke andar dikhta hai (overflow-auto andar ki scrolling ke saath). bg-fixed kai mobile browsers par kukhyaat roop se janky / disabled hai (iOS Safari aitihasik roop se ise nazarandaaz karta hai) — ek aam interview aur asal-duniya ki savdhaani. Teeno examples ko dikhai dene ke liye bg-[url(...)] image chahiye; attachment akela ek saade rang par kuch nahi karta.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/background-attachment
← Previous107 · content→ Next109 · background-clip
109Backgrounds

background-clip

Is section me hum background-clip ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities bounding box of an element's background (CSS background-clip). ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
bg-clip-borderbackground-clip: border-box;
bg-clip-paddingbackground-clip: padding-box;
bg-clip-contentbackground-clip: content-box;
bg-clip-textbackground-clip: text;

Bounding-box utilities (docs demo: teen border-4 bg-indigo-500 p-3 boxes; background kramashah border ke neeche / padding kinare tak / sirf content kinare tak phailta hai):

html
<div class="border-4 bg-indigo-500 bg-clip-border p-3"></div>
<div class="border-4 bg-indigo-500 bg-clip-padding p-3"></div>
<div class="border-4 bg-indigo-500 bg-clip-content p-3"></div>

bg-clip-text — element ke background ko text ke aakaar me kaato. Canonical gradient-text recipe (note text-transparent zaroori hai — text ka rang transparent hona chahiye warna background glyphs ke peeche chhup jata hai):

html
<p class="bg-linear-to-r from-pink-500 to-violet-500 bg-clip-text text-5xl font-extrabold text-transparent ...">
  Hello world
</p>

Responsive variant:

html
<div class="bg-clip-border md:bg-clip-padding ..."><!-- ... --></div>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: bg-clip-text + ek gradient (bg-linear-to-r ...) + text-transparent sabse zyada poochha jane wala gradient-text pattern hai. bg-clip-border default hai (background border ke neeche rangta hai). Teen box values ka fark sirf tab dikhta hai jab element ke paas border aur/ya padding ho — bina border/padding ke ye ek jaise dikhte hain.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/background-clip
← Previous108 · background-attachment→ Next110 · background-color
110Backgrounds

background-color

Is section me hum background-color ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Kisi element ke background color ko control karne ki utilities (CSS background-color). Ye bg-<color> namespace hai — text colour wala wahi --color-* scale.

ClassStyles
bg-inheritbackground-color: inherit;
bg-currentbackground-color: currentColor;
bg-transparentbackground-color: transparent;
bg-blackbackground-color: var(--color-black); /* #000 */
bg-whitebackground-color: var(--color-white); /* #fff */
bg-<color>-<shade> (e.g. bg-red-50 … bg-red-400 …)background-color: var(--color-<color>-<shade>); — e.g. bg-red-50 = oklch(97.1% 0.013 17.38), bg-red-100 = oklch(93.6% 0.032 17.717), bg-red-200 = oklch(88.5% 0.062 18.334), bg-red-300 = oklch(80.8% 0.114 19.571), bg-red-400 = oklch(70.4% 0.191 22.216)
bg-[<value>]background-color: <value>;
bg-(<custom-property>)background-color: var(<custom-property>);

Color pages wala wahi fetch note: laute hue text me sirf pehli colour rows dikhi thi; poora palette standard --color-* scale ko follow karta hai.

Basic usage (teen buttons):

html
<button class="bg-blue-500 ...">Button A</button>
<button class="bg-cyan-500 ...">Button B</button>
<button class="bg-pink-500 ...">Button C</button>

Opacity modifier (docs bg-sky-500 par /100, /75, /50 dikhate hain):

html
<button class="bg-sky-500/100 ..."></button>
<button class="bg-sky-500/75 ..."></button>
<button class="bg-sky-500/50 ..."></button>

Arbitrary value aur CSS-variable forms:

html
<div class="bg-[#50d71e] ..."><!-- ... --></div>
<div class="bg-(--my-color) ..."><!-- ... --></div>

bg-(--my-color) bg-[var(--my-color)] ka shorthand hai.

State variant (hover par rang badlav) aur breakpoint variant:

html
<button class="bg-indigo-500 hover:bg-fuchsia-500 ...">Save changes</button>
<div class="bg-blue-500 md:bg-green-500 ..."><!-- ... --></div>

@theme se customise karna (--color-* variables — text, background, border, decoration, wagera me shared):

css
@theme {
  --color-regal-blue: #243c5a;
}
html
<div class="bg-regal-blue"><!-- ... --></div>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: bg-* overloaded hai — bg-blue-500 ek rang hai, bg-fixed attachment hai, bg-cover size hai, bg-center position hai, bg-linear-to-r ek image/gradient hai.
