Opacity modifier /50 sirf background colour ki opacity badalta hai, element ki opacity NAHI (opacity-50 utility se vipreet, jo text aur children ko bhi halka kar deti hai). bg-transparent background ko "hatane" ka tareeka hai; bg-current currentColor se rangta hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/background-color
← Previous109 · background-clip→ Next111 · background-image
111Backgrounds

background-image

Is section me hum background-image ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Kisi element ki background image ko control karne ki utilities (CSS background-image) — ye page image URLs aur gradients dono cover karta hai, jo Tailwind me dono background images hain.

ClassStyles
bg-[<value>]background-image: <value>;
bg-(image:<custom-property>)background-image: var(<custom-property>);
bg-nonebackground-image: none;
bg-linear-to-tbackground-image: linear-gradient(to top, var(--tw-gradient-stops));
bg-linear-to-trbackground-image: linear-gradient(to top right, var(--tw-gradient-stops));
bg-linear-to-rbackground-image: linear-gradient(to right, var(--tw-gradient-stops));
bg-linear-to-brbackground-image: linear-gradient(to bottom right, var(--tw-gradient-stops));
bg-linear-to-bbackground-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--tw-gradient-stops));
bg-linear-to-blbackground-image: linear-gradient(to bottom left, var(--tw-gradient-stops));
bg-linear-to-lbackground-image: linear-gradient(to left, var(--tw-gradient-stops));

Image URL (arbitrary value):

html
<div class="bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>

Linear gradients — direction utilities aur ek angle form bg-linear-<angle> (docs example bg-linear-65 = 65deg), colour-stop utilities ke saath jode gaye:

html
<div class="h-14 bg-linear-to-r from-cyan-500 to-blue-500"></div>
<div class="h-14 bg-linear-to-t from-sky-500 to-indigo-500"></div>
<div class="h-14 bg-linear-to-bl from-violet-500 to-fuchsia-500"></div>
<div class="h-14 bg-linear-65 from-purple-500 to-pink-500"></div>

Radial gradients — bg-radial aur bg-radial-[<position>] (position underscores istemal karta hai, jaise at_50%_75%):

html
<div class="size-18 rounded-full bg-radial from-pink-400 from-40% to-fuchsia-700"></div>
<div class="size-18 rounded-full bg-radial-[at_50%_75%] from-sky-200 via-blue-400 to-indigo-900 to-90%"></div>
<div class="size-18 rounded-full bg-radial-[at_25%_25%] from-white to-zinc-900 to-75%"></div>

Conic gradients — bg-conic aur bg-conic-<angle> (docs example bg-conic-180), aur gradient utility par hi ek /decreasing interpolation modifier:

html
<div class="size-24 rounded-full bg-conic from-blue-600 to-sky-400 to-50%"></div>
<div class="size-24 rounded-full bg-conic-180 from-indigo-600 via-indigo-50 to-indigo-600"></div>
<div class="size-24 rounded-full bg-conic/decreasing from-violet-700 via-lime-300 to-violet-700"></div>

Gradient colour stops — from-* (shuru), via-* (beech), to-* (ant):

html
<div class="bg-linear-to-r from-indigo-500 via-purple-500 to-pink-500 ..."></div>

Gradient stop positions — from-<percentage>, via-<percentage>, to-<percentage> (docs example 10% / 30% / 90%):

html
<div class="bg-linear-to-r from-indigo-500 from-10% via-sky-500 via-30% to-emerald-500 to-90% ..."></div>

Interpolation modifier — gradient utility me slash ke saath joda jata hai; stops ko milane ke liye istemal hone wale colour space / hue direction ko control karta hai. Dikhaye gaye values: srgb, hsl, oklab, oklch, longer, shorter, increasing, decreasing:

html
<div class="bg-linear-to-r/srgb from-indigo-500 to-teal-400"></div>
<div class="bg-linear-to-r/hsl from-indigo-500 to-teal-400"></div>
<div class="bg-linear-to-r/oklab from-indigo-500 to-teal-400"></div>
<div class="bg-linear-to-r/oklch from-indigo-500 to-teal-400"></div>
<div class="bg-linear-to-r/longer from-indigo-500 to-teal-400"></div>
<div class="bg-linear-to-r/shorter from-indigo-500 to-teal-400"></div>
<div class="bg-linear-to-r/increasing from-indigo-500 to-teal-400"></div>
<div class="bg-linear-to-r/decreasing from-indigo-500 to-teal-400"></div>

Docs note: "Default roop se gradients oklab color space me interpolate hote hain."

Background image hatana:

html
<div class="bg-none"></div>

Poori tarah custom gradient (arbitrary value, spaces/commas ke liye underscores waise ke waise rehte hain) aur CSS-variable forms:

html
<div class="bg-linear-[25deg,red_5%,yellow_60%,lime_90%,teal] ..."><!-- ... --></div>
<div class="bg-linear-(--my-gradient) ..."><!-- ... --></div>

bg-linear-(--my-gradient) bg-linear-[var(--my-gradient)] ka shorthand hai.

Responsive variant (note: docs example me variant stop utility par lagaya gaya hai):

html
<div class="from-purple-400 md:from-yellow-500 ..."><!-- ... --></div>

Customise karna: --color-* theme variables naye stop colours banate hain:

css
@theme {
  --color-regal-blue: #243c5a;
}
html
<div class="from-regal-blue"><!-- ... --></div>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: v4 ne bg-gradient-to-r (v3) ka naam badalkar bg-linear-to-r kar diya — purana naam v3 wala hai aur ek pasandeeda interview jaal. Kisi gradient ko direction utility (bg-linear-to-r) AUR stops (from-*/to-*) DONO chahiye; akela koi bhi kuch nahi dikhata. bg-none kisi image/gradient ko hata deta hai (jaise kisi breakpoint par). Default interpolation oklab hai, isiliye v4 gradients purane srgb walon ke mukable beech me kam grey/maila dikhte hain. bg-[url(...)] raster image set karne ka ekmatra tareeka hai — koi naam wali bg-mountains utility nahi hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/background-image
← Previous110 · background-color→ Next112 · background-origin
112Backgrounds

background-origin

Is section me hum background-origin ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Kisi element ka background borders, padding, aur content ke saapeksh kaise position hota hai, ise control karne ki utilities (CSS background-origin — jahan se background-positioning area shuru hota hai).

ClassStyles
bg-origin-borderbackground-origin: border-box;
bg-origin-paddingbackground-origin: padding-box;
bg-origin-contentbackground-origin: content-box;

Basic usage (teen border-4 bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] p-3 boxes; image ka origin bahari border kinare se, padding kinare tak, content kinare tak jaata hai):

html
<div class="border-4 bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] bg-origin-border p-3 ..."></div>
<div class="border-4 bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] bg-origin-padding p-3 ..."></div>
<div class="border-4 bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] bg-origin-content p-3 ..."></div>

Responsive variant:

html
<div class="bg-origin-border md:bg-origin-padding ..."><!-- ... --></div>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: background-clip se uljho MAT — origin control karta hai ki background kahan se POSITION hota hai (positioning area, jo background-position/background-size ki gananaon ko prabhavit karta hai), clip control karta hai ki background kahan tak RANGA jata hai. Dono ek hi teen box naam share karte hain (border/padding/content) lekin alag properties hain; docs pages lagbhag ek jaise demos istemal karte hain taaki yehi fark parakh sakein. Sirf border/padding aur positioned/sized background image ke saath dikhai deta hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/background-origin
← Previous111 · background-image→ Next113 · background-position
113Backgrounds

background-position

Is section me hum background-position ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities position of an element's background image (CSS background-position). ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
bg-top-leftbackground-position: top left;
bg-topbackground-position: top;
bg-top-rightbackground-position: top right;
bg-leftbackground-position: left;
bg-centerbackground-position: center;
bg-rightbackground-position: right;
bg-bottom-leftbackground-position: bottom left;
bg-bottombackground-position: bottom;
bg-bottom-rightbackground-position: bottom right;
bg-position-(<custom-property>)background-position: var(<custom-property>);
bg-position-[<value>]background-position: <value>;

Basic usage — ek hi bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] image par saari nau positions (docs kehte hain "Hover over these examples to see the full image"):

html
<div class="bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] bg-top-left"></div>
<div class="bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] bg-top"></div>
<div class="bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] bg-top-right"></div>
<div class="bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] bg-left"></div>
<div class="bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] bg-center"></div>
<div class="bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] bg-right"></div>
<div class="bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] bg-bottom-left"></div>
<div class="bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] bg-bottom"></div>
<div class="bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] bg-bottom-right"></div>

Arbitrary value (spaces ke liye underscores) aur CSS-variable forms:

html
<div class="bg-position-[center_top_1rem] ..."><!-- ... --></div>
<div class="bg-position-(--my-bg-position) ..."><!-- ... --></div>

bg-position-(--my-bg-position) bg-position-[var(--my-bg-position)] ka shorthand hai.

Responsive variant:

html
<div class="bg-center md:bg-top ..."><!-- ... --></div>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: position sirf tab mayne rakhta hai jab image box ko NA bhare — matlab bg-contain/bg-auto/bg-no-repeat ke saath; bg-cover ke saath image box ko bharti hai aur position sirf ye chunta hai ki kaunsa hissa katega. 3×3 grid (top/center/bottom × left/center/right) poora naam wala set hai. bg-center sabse zyada istemal hone wala value hai (hero images). bg-center (background-position) ko text-center ya flex centering se mat uljhao.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/background-position
← Previous112 · background-origin→ Next114 · background-repeat
114Backgrounds

background-repeat

Is section me hum background-repeat ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities repetition of an element's background image (CSS background-repeat). ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
bg-repeatbackground-repeat: repeat;
bg-repeat-xbackground-repeat: repeat-x;
bg-repeat-ybackground-repeat: repeat-y;
bg-repeat-spacebackground-repeat: space;
bg-repeat-roundbackground-repeat: round;
bg-no-repeatbackground-repeat: no-repeat;

Saare docs examples bg-[url(/img/clouds.svg)] bg-center aur repeat utility istemal karte hain:

  • bg-repeat — vertically aur horizontally dono dohrao (default tiling).
html
  <div class="bg-[url(/img/clouds.svg)] bg-center bg-repeat ..."></div>
  • bg-repeat-x — sirf horizontally dohrao.
html
  <div class="bg-[url(/img/clouds.svg)] bg-center bg-repeat-x ..."></div>
  • bg-repeat-y — sirf vertically dohrao.
html
  <div class="bg-[url(/img/clouds.svg)] bg-center bg-repeat-y ..."></div>
  • bg-repeat-space — bina clipping ke dohrao (tiles is tarah phailaye jate hain ki koi kinare par na kate).
html
  <div class="bg-[url(/img/clouds.svg)] bg-center bg-repeat-space ..."></div>
  • bg-repeat-round — bina clipping ke dohrao, gaps se bachne ke liye zaroorat pade to tiles ko kheench do.
html
  <div class="bg-[url(/img/clouds.svg)] bg-center bg-repeat-round ..."></div>
  • bg-no-repeat — dohrao mat (ek tile; bg-cover/bg-center hero images ka standard saathi).
html
  <div class="bg-[url(/img/clouds.svg)] bg-center bg-no-repeat ..."></div>

Responsive variant:

html
<div class="bg-repeat md:bg-repeat-x ..."><!-- ... --></div>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: bg-repeat CSS default hai — tum ise spasht roop se sirf bg-no-repeat ko hatane ke liye set karte ho. space banam round: dono clipping se bachate hain; space tiles ke beech gaps jodta hai, round bharne ke liye tiles ko kheenchta hai. bg-no-repeat photos ke liye lagbhag hamesha bg-cover + bg-center ke saath joda jata hai; iske bina ek chhoti image achanak tile ho jati hai. Naam ki asamanta note karo: "off" utility bg-no-repeat hai, bg-repeat-none nahi.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/background-repeat
← Previous113 · background-position→ Next115 · background-size
115Backgrounds

background-size

Is section me hum background-size ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye utilities background size of an element's background image (CSS background-size). ko control karne ke liye hain.

ClassStyles
bg-autobackground-size: auto;
bg-coverbackground-size: cover;
bg-containbackground-size: contain;
bg-size-(<custom-property>)background-size: var(<custom-property>);
bg-size-[<value>]background-size: <value>;
  • bg-cover — image ko tab tak scale karo jab tak ye background layer ko na bhar de, zaroorat pade to kaato (hero-image default). Docs example ise bg-center ke saath jodta hai:
html
  <div class="bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] bg-cover bg-center"></div>
  • bg-contain — image ko bina kaate ya kheenche bahari kinaron tak scale karo (poori image dikhai deti hai; khali jagah ho sakti hai).
html
  <div class="bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] bg-contain bg-center"></div>
  • bg-auto — image ko uske default (natural) size par dikhao. Docs example ise bg-center bg-no-repeat ke saath jodta hai:
html
  <div class="bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] bg-auto bg-center bg-no-repeat"></div>

Arbitrary value (spaces ke liye underscores) aur CSS-variable forms:

html
<div class="bg-size-[auto_100px] ..."><!-- ... --></div>
<div class="bg-size-(--my-image-size) ..."><!-- ... --></div>

bg-size-(--my-image-size) bg-size-[var(--my-image-size)] ka shorthand hai.

Responsive variant:

html
<div class="bg-auto md:bg-contain ..."><!-- ... --></div>

Interview / aam galti ki baatein: cover banam contain mukhya fark hai — cover bharta aur kaat-ta hai, contain fit karta aur letterbox karta hai. bg-cover + bg-center + bg-no-repeat standard hero-image teeno hai; bg-contain logo/thumbnail ka vikalp hai. bg-auto image ko natural size par dikhata hai, to bade box par ye tile hoga jab tak bg-no-repeat na joda jaye. Position ki tarah, size ek saade rang par adrishya hai — ise bg-[url(...)] ya gradient chahiye.

## Part C completion checklist (SPA builder ke liye)

  • Maujood sections: diye gaye kram me 40 headings (32 Typography + 8 Backgrounds). 39 poore page read se likhe gaye hain; 1 (letter-spacing) ek stub hai — ise banane se pehle https://tailwindcss.com/docs/letter-spacing padho.
  • Cross-cutting patterns jo builder ko ek baar sikhane chahiye, 40 baar nahi: md: responsive variants; hover: state variants (colour, decoration); spaces ke liye underscores ke saath arbitrary -[<value>] values; CSS-variable -(--my-*) shorthand = -[var(--my-*)]; v4 me @theme --<namespace>-* customisation (koi config file nahi); text-* / bg-* / decoration-* / font-* prefix overloading.
  • Sections me pakde gaye jaane-maane v4 naam-badlav/jaal: bg-linear-to-r (v3 ka bg-gradient-to-r nahi); wrap-break-word/wrap-anywhere (overflow-wrap); text-nowrap (text-wrap) banam whitespace-nowrap (white-space); leading-<number> spacing se guna hota hai jabki decoration-<number> / underline-offset-<number> px hain aur tab-<number> character widths hai; truncate compound hai, akela text-ellipsis overflow-hidden maangta hai.
  • Fetch savdhaani: colour pages (color, text-decoration-color, background-color) par laute hue text me sirf pehli palette rows dikhi (black/white/red-50…red-400); brief sirf unhi rows ke liye text-/decoration-/bg-<color>-<shade> → var(--color-<color>-<shade>) pattern aur verify kiye gaye oklch values record karta hai, aur dusre shades ke liye values nahi ghadta.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/background-size
← Previous114 · background-repeat→ Next116 · border-radius
116Borders

border-radius

Is section me hum border-radius ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

  • Maqsad: the border radius of an element ko control karne ki utilities.
  • Core scale (class → CSS, sab --radius-* theme variables se):
    • rounded-xs → border-radius: var(--radius-xs); /* 0.125rem (2px) */
    • rounded-sm → var(--radius-sm); /* 0.25rem (4px) */
    • rounded-md → var(--radius-md); /* 0.375rem (6px) */
    • rounded-lg → var(--radius-lg); /* 0.5rem (8px) */
    • rounded-xl → var(--radius-xl); /* 0.75rem (12px) */
    • rounded-2xl → var(--radius-2xl); /* 1rem (16px) */
    • rounded-3xl → var(--radius-3xl); /* 1.5rem (24px) */
    • rounded-4xl → var(--radius-4xl); /* 2rem (32px) */
    • rounded-none → border-radius: 0;
    • rounded-full → border-radius: calc(infinity * 1px);
  • Basic istemal: rounded-sm, rounded-md, rounded-lg, rounded-xl on a <div>:
html
  <div class="rounded-sm ..."></div>
  <div class="rounded-md ..."></div>
  <div class="rounded-lg ..."></div>
  <div class="rounded-xl ..."></div>
  • Sirf ek taraf: rounded-t-md, rounded-r-lg, rounded-b-lg, rounded-l-lg — jaise:
html
  <div class="rounded-t-lg ..."></div>
  <div class="rounded-r-lg ..."></div>
  <div class="rounded-b-lg ..."></div>
  <div class="rounded-l-lg ..."></div>
  • Sirf ek kona: rounded-tr-md, rounded-tl-lg, rounded-br-lg, rounded-bl-lg — jaise:
html
  <div class="rounded-tl-lg ..."></div>
  <div class="rounded-tr-lg ..."></div>
  <div class="rounded-br-lg ..."></div>
  <div class="rounded-bl-lg ..."></div>
  • Logical properties: rounded-s-md, rounded-se-xl wagera logical properties se radius set karte hain, jo text ki disha (LTR banam RTL) ke hisaab se sahi konon se judte hain. Page se barabar-wali table:

| Class | Left-to-right | Right-to-left |

| rounded-s-* | rounded-l-* | rounded-r-* |

| rounded-e-* | rounded-r-* | rounded-l-* |

| rounded-ss-* | rounded-tl-* | rounded-tr-* |

| rounded-se-* | rounded-tr-* | rounded-tl-* |

| rounded-es-* | rounded-bl-* | rounded-br-* |

| rounded-ee-* | rounded-br-* | rounded-bl-* |

Example:

html
  <div dir="ltr"><div class="rounded-s-lg ..."></div></div>
  <div dir="rtl"><div class="rounded-s-lg ..."></div></div>

Zyada control ke liye, LTR aur RTL modifiers text ki disha ke hisaab se shart ke saath styles lagu kar sakte hain.

  • Pill buttons: rounded-full:
html
  <button class="rounded-full ...">Save Changes</button>
  • Radius hatana: rounded-none:
html
  <button class="rounded-none ...">Save Changes</button>
  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): rounded-[<value>], e.g. <div class="rounded-[2vw] ..."></div>.
  • CSS variable: rounded-(<custom-property>), jaise <div class="rounded-(--my-radius) ..."></div> — rounded-[var(<custom-property>)] ka shorthand.
  • Variants: md: jaisa breakpoint variant aage lagao — <div class="rounded md:rounded-lg ..."></div>. Variants documentation dekho.
  • Theme customise karna: --radius-* theme variables istemal karo:
css
  @theme { --radius-5xl: 3rem; }

Phir rounded-5xl istemal ho sakta hai: <div class="rounded-5xl"></div>. Theme documentation dekho.

  • Interview ke kaam ki baatein: scale theme se chalta hai (--radius-*), class naam me hard-coded pixels nahi; rounded-full calc(infinity * 1px) istemal karta hai taaki ye kisi bhi size par poori tarah gol rahe; side/corner/logical variants ek hi size scale ke saath judte hain; rounded-none reset hai.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/border-radius
← Previous115 · background-size→ Next117 · border-width
117Borders

border-width

Is section me hum border-width ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

  • Maqsad: kisi element ki borders ki chaudaai ko control karne ki utilities.
  • Core classes:
    • border → border-width: 1px;
    • border-<number> → border-width: <number>px;
    • border-(length:<custom-property>) → border-width: var(<custom-property>);
    • border-[<value>] → border-width: <value>;
    • border-x → border-inline-width: 1px;
    • border-x-<number> → border-inline-width: <number>px;
    • border-x-(length:<custom-property>) → border-inline-width: var(<custom-property>);
    • border-x-[<value>] → border-inline-width: <value>;
    • border-y → border-block-width: 1px;
    • border-y-<number> → border-block-width: <number>px;
    • (Wahi border-x-* / border-y-* arbitrary-value aur CSS-variable forms lagu hote hain; page ki table border-x family ko spasht roop se aur border-y / border-y-<number> ko soochibaddh karti hai.)
  • Chaaron taraf: border, border-2, border-4, border-8:
html
  <div class="border border-indigo-600 ..."></div>
  <div class="border-2 border-indigo-600 ..."></div>
  <div class="border-4 border-indigo-600 ..."></div>
  <div class="border-8 border-indigo-600 ..."></div>

Note: akeli width border style (Tailwind ke preflight me default style solid hai) aur ek dikhai dene wale rang ke bina border nahi dikhati; docs examples width ko border-indigo-600 / border-indigo-500 ke saath jodte hain.

  • Ek taraf: border-r, border-t-4, border-b-4, border-l-4:
html
  <div class="border-t-4 border-indigo-500 ..."></div>
  <div class="border-r-4 border-indigo-500 ..."></div>
  <div class="border-b-4 border-indigo-500 ..."></div>
  <div class="border-l-4 border-indigo-500 ..."></div>
  • Do taraf: border-x, border-y-4:
html
  <div class="border-x-4 border-indigo-500 ..."></div>
  <div class="border-y-4 border-indigo-500 ..."></div>
  • Logical (inline) sides: border-s, border-e-4 border-inline-start-width / border-inline-end-width set karte hain, text ki disha ke hisaab se left ya right se judte hain:
html
  <div dir="ltr"><div class="border-s-4 ..."></div></div>
  <div dir="rtl"><div class="border-s-4 ..."></div></div>
  • Logical (block) sides: border-bs-<number> aur border-be-<number> border-block-start-width / border-block-end-width set karte hain, writing mode ke hisaab se top ya bottom se judte hain:
html
  <div class="border-bs-4 ..."></div>
  • Children ke beech dividers: divide-x / divide-y-4 child elements ke beech borders jodte hain:
html
  <div class="grid grid-cols-3 divide-x-4">
    <div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div>
  </div>

Agar elements ulte order me hon (flex-row-reverse / flex-col-reverse), to divide-x-reverse ya divide-y-reverse istemal karo taaki border sahi taraf pade:

html
  <div class="flex flex-col-reverse divide-y-4 divide-y-reverse divide-gray-200">
    <div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div>
  </div>
  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): border-[<value>], e.g. <div class="border-[2vw] ..."></div>.
  • CSS variable: border-(length:<custom-property>), jaise <div class="border-(length:--my-border-width) ..."></div> — border-[length:var(<custom-property>)] ka shorthand.
  • Variants: breakpoint variant, jaise <div class="border-2 md:border-t-4 ..."></div>.
  • Interview ke kaam ki baatein: khaali border = 1px; border-<number> utne hi px hai (koi bhi number, sirf naam wala scale nahi); x/y inline/block logical axes istemal karte hain; divide-* child-separator wala saathi hai aur ulte flex/grid order me ise -reverse saathi chahiye; width, style aur colour teen alag utility families hain jinhe jodna padta hai.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/border-width
← Previous116 · border-radius→ Next118 · border-color
118Borders

border-color

Is section me hum border-color ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

  • Maqsad: kisi element ki borders ke rang ko control karne ki utilities.
  • Core classes (page ki table pattern dikhati hai; poora palette --color-* theme ko follow karta hai):
    • border-inherit → border-color: inherit;
    • border-current → border-color: currentColor;
    • border-transparent → border-color: transparent;
    • border-black → border-color: var(--color-black); /* #000 */
    • border-white → border-color: var(--color-white); /* #fff */
    • border-red-50 → var(--color-red-50); /* oklch(97.1% 0.013 17.38) */, border-red-100 → oklch(93.6% 0.032 17.717), border-red-200 → oklch(88.5% 0.062 18.334), border-red-300 → oklch(80.8% 0.114 19.571), border-red-400 → oklch(70.4% 0.191 22.216) — i.e. every colour in the default palette, in shades 50–950, works as border-<color>-<shade>.
  • Basic use: border-rose-500, border-lime-100:
html
  <div class="border-4 border-indigo-500 ..."></div>
  <div class="border-4 border-purple-500 ..."></div>
  <div class="border-4 border-sky-500 ..."></div>
  • Colour opacity modifier: /<opacity> jodo — border-indigo-500/100, /75, /50:
html
  <div class="border-4 border-indigo-500/100 ..."></div>
  <div class="border-4 border-indigo-500/75 ..."></div>
  <div class="border-4 border-indigo-500/50 ..."></div>
  • Ek taraf: border-t-indigo-500, border-r-lime-100 wagera:
html
  <div class="border-4 border-indigo-200 border-t-indigo-500 ..."></div>
  <div class="border-4 border-indigo-200 border-r-indigo-500 ..."></div>
  <div class="border-4 border-indigo-200 border-b-indigo-500 ..."></div>
  <div class="border-4 border-indigo-200 border-l-indigo-500 ..."></div>
  • Do taraf: border-x-indigo-500, border-y-lime-100:
html
  <div class="border-4 border-indigo-200 border-x-indigo-500 ..."></div>
  <div class="border-4 border-indigo-200 border-y-indigo-500 ..."></div>
  • Logical sides: border-s-indigo-500, border-e-lime-100 border-inline-start-color / border-inline-end-color set karte hain (LTR/RTL par nirbhar):
html
  <div dir="ltr"><div class="border-s-indigo-500 ..."></div></div>
  <div dir="rtl"><div class="border-s-indigo-500 ..."></div></div>
  • Block logical sides: border-bs-* / border-be-* border-block-start-color / border-block-end-color set karte hain:
html
  <div class="border-bs-indigo-500 ..."></div>
  • Dividers: divide-indigo-500, divide-lime-100 child elements ke beech border ka rang control karte hain:
html
  <div class="grid grid-cols-3 divide-x-4 divide-indigo-500">
    <div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div>
  </div>
  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): border-[<value>], e.g. <div class="border-[#243c5a] ..."></div>.
  • CSS variable: border-(<custom-property>), jaise <div class="border-(--my-border) ..."></div> — border-[var(<custom-property>)] ka shorthand.
  • Variants: state variant — focus:border-pink-600:
html
  <input class="border-2 border-gray-700 focus:border-pink-600 ..." />

Breakpoint variant — <div class="border-blue-500 md:border-green-500 ..."></div>.

  • Theme customise karna: --color-* variables:
css
  @theme { --color-regal-blue: #243c5a; }

Phir <div class="border-regal-blue"></div>.

  • Interview ke kaam ki baatein: colour, width aur style swatantra hain — ek colour class akeli width ke bina kuch nahi dikhati; /<opacity> colour-opacity modifier hai (opacity utility se alag, jo poore element ko halka kar deti hai); border-current element ke color ko follow karta hai; side-specific colour classes sirf us side ke liye chaaron-taraf wale rang ko override karti hain.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/border-color
← Previous117 · border-width→ Next119 · border-style
119Borders

border-style

Is section me hum border-style ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

  • Maqsad: kisi element ki borders ki style ko control karne ki utilities.
  • Classes:
    • border-solid → border-style: solid;
    • border-dashed → border-style: dashed;
    • border-dotted → border-style: dotted;
    • border-double → border-style: double;
    • border-hidden → border-style: hidden;
    • border-none → border-style: none;
    • Divider counterparts (aakhiri ko chhodkar saare children par lagu): divide-solid, divide-dashed, divide-dotted, divide-double, divide-hidden, divide-none — jaise divide-solid → & > :not(:last-child) { border-style: solid; }.
  • Basic use:
html
  <div class="border-2 border-solid ..."></div>
  <div class="border-2 border-dashed ..."></div>
  <div class="border-2 border-dotted ..."></div>
  <div class="border-4 border-double ..."></div>

Note karo docs double ke liye border-4 istemal karte hain, kyunki double border ko dono lines dikhane ke liye kaafi chaudaai chahiye.

  • Border hatana: border-none:
html
  <button class="border-none ...">Save Changes</button>

Sabse zyada kisi chhote breakpoint par lagayi gayi border style ko hatane ke liye istemal hota hai.

  • Dividers: divide-dashed, divide-dotted:
html
  <div class="grid grid-cols-3 divide-x-3 divide-dashed divide-indigo-500">
    <div>01</div><div>02</div><div>03</div>
  </div>
  • Variants: breakpoint variant, jaise <div class="border-solid md:border-dotted ..."></div>.
  • Interview ke kaam ki baatein: border-none (style none) banam border-hidden (style hidden — table border-collapsing contexts me border ko bhi chhupa deta hai) alag hain; double ko dikhai dene ke liye chaudi border chahiye; divide-* style utilities border-* walon ki parchhai hain lekin child separators ko nishana banati hain.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/border-style
← Previous118 · border-color→ Next120 · outline-width
120Borders

outline-width

Is section me hum outline-width ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

  • Maqsad: kisi element ki outline ki chaudaai ko control karne ki utilities.
  • Classes:
    • outline → outline-width: 1px;
    • outline-<number> → outline-width: <number>px;
    • outline-(length:<custom-property>) → outline-width: var(<custom-property>);
    • outline-[<value>] → outline-width: <value>;
  • Basic use: outline, outline-2, outline-4:
html
  <button class="outline outline-offset-2 ...">Button A</button>
  <button class="outline-2 outline-offset-2 ...">Button B</button>
  <button class="outline-4 outline-offset-2 ...">Button C</button>

Docs examples hamesha outline width ko outline-offset-2 ke saath jodte hain taaki outline button ke kinare se saaf alag dikhe.

  • State variant: focus:outline-2 — sirf focus par lagao:
html
  <button class="outline-offset-2 outline-sky-500 focus:outline-2 ...">Save Changes</button>

(Docs example me button ka label hai "Focus the button to see the outline added".)

  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): outline-[<value>], e.g. <div class="outline-[2vw] ..."></div>.
  • CSS variable: outline-(length:<custom-property>), jaise <div class="outline-(length:--my-outline-width) ..."></div> — outline-[length:var(<custom-property>)] ka shorthand.
  • Variants: breakpoint variant, jaise <div class="outline md:outline-2 ..."></div>.
  • Interview ke kaam ki baatein: outline border box ke bahar banti hai aur layout ko prabhavit nahi karti (border ke vipreet, ye koi jagah nahi leti); akela outline = 1px; vyavhaar me dikhai dene ke liye width ko style aur colour chahiye — outline-style / outline-color dekho; classic istemal focus sanket hai (focus:outline-2).
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/outline-width
← Previous119 · border-style→ Next121 · outline-color
121Borders

outline-color

Is section me hum outline-color ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

  • Maqsad: kisi element ki outline ke rang ko control karne ki utilities.
  • Classes (pattern --color-* ko follow karta hai, border colour ki tarah):
    • outline-inherit → outline-color: inherit;
    • outline-current → outline-color: currentColor;
    • outline-transparent → outline-color: transparent;
    • outline-black → var(--color-black); /* #000 */
    • outline-white → var(--color-white); /* #fff */
    • outline-red-50 → var(--color-red-50); /* oklch(97.1% 0.013 17.38) */, outline-red-100 → oklch(93.6% 0.032 17.717), outline-red-200 → oklch(88.5% 0.062 18.334), outline-red-300 → oklch(80.8% 0.114 19.571), outline-red-400 → oklch(70.4% 0.191 22.216) — every palette colour/shade works as outline-<color>-<shade>.
  • Basic use: outline-rose-500, outline-lime-100:
html
  <button class="outline-2 outline-offset-2 outline-blue-500 ...">Button A</button>
  <button class="outline-2 outline-offset-2 outline-cyan-500 ...">Button B</button>
  <button class="outline-2 outline-offset-2 outline-pink-500 ...">Button C</button>
  • Colour opacity modifier: outline-blue-500/100, /75, /50:
html
  <button class="outline-2 outline-blue-500/100 ...">Button A</button>
  <button class="outline-2 outline-blue-500/75 ...">Button B</button>
  <button class="outline-2 outline-blue-500/50 ...">Button C</button>
  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): outline-[<value>], e.g. <div class="outline-[#243c5a] ..."></div>.
  • CSS variable: outline-(<custom-property>), jaise <div class="outline-(--my-color) ..."></div> — outline-[var(<custom-property>)] ka shorthand.
  • Variants: breakpoint variant, jaise <div class="outline md:outline-blue-400 ..."></div>.
  • Theme customise karna: --color-* variables:
css
  @theme { --color-regal-blue: #243c5a; }

Phir <div class="outline-regal-blue"></div>.

  • Interview ke kaam ki baatein: borders/text/backgrounds jaisa hi colour system (--color-* + /opacity modifier); outline colour sirf tab dikhai deta hai jab outline width aur style bhi set hon; outline-current outline ko text colour se jod deta hai.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/outline-color
← Previous120 · outline-width→ Next122 · outline-style
122Borders

outline-style

Is section me hum outline-style ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

  • Maqsad: kisi element ki outline ki style ko control karne ki utilities.
  • Classes:
    • outline-solid → outline-style: solid;
    • outline-dashed → outline-style: dashed;
    • outline-dotted → outline-style: dotted;
    • outline-double → outline-style: double;
    • outline-none → outline-style: none;
    • outline-hidden → outline: 2px solid transparent; outline-offset: 2px; (note: ye outline-style: hidden NAHI hai — ye ek composite declaration hai)
  • Basic use:
html
  <button class="outline-2 outline-offset-2 outline-solid ...">Button A</button>
  <button class="outline-2 outline-offset-2 outline-dashed ...">Button B</button>
  <button class="outline-2 outline-offset-2 outline-dotted ...">Button C</button>
  <button class="outline-3 outline-offset-2 outline-double ...">Button D</button>
  • outline-hidden — focused elements par default browser outline ko chhupata hai, jabki forced-colors mode me outline ko banaye rakhta hai:
html
  <input class="focus:border-indigo-600 focus:outline-hidden ..." type="text" />

Docs dev tools me forced-colors: active emulate karke vyavhaar dekhne ka note dete hain. Is utility ko istemal karte waqt accessibility ke liye apni focus styling lagana behad sujhaya jata hai.

  • outline-none — focused elements par default browser outline ko poori tarah hata deta hai:
html
  <div class="focus-within:outline-2 focus-within:outline-indigo-600 ...">
    <textarea class="outline-none ..." placeholder="Leave a comment..." />
    <button class="..." type="button">Post</button>
  </div>

Is utility ko istemal karte waqt accessibility ke liye apni focus styling lagana behad sujhaya jata hai. (Example me parent ko focus-within: se dikhai dene wala focus ring milta hai jabki textarea khud outline-none rakhta hai.)

  • Variants: breakpoint variant, jaise <div class="outline md:outline-dashed ..."></div>.
  • Interview ke kaam ki baatein — is page ka mukhya fark: outline-none outline ko poori tarah hata deta hai (agar koi badli focus style na ho to accessibility jokhim); outline-hidden ise chhupane ka sulabh tareeka hai — dikhne me transparent (2px solid transparent, offset 2px) lekin forced-colors mode me bana rehta hai. Ye ek pasandeeda interview/accessibility sawal hai. Ye bhi note karo ki border-style me outline-hidden ka koi barabar nahi hai; aur outline-double ko double dikhne ke liye chaudi outline chahiye (example me outline-3).
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/outline-style
← Previous121 · outline-color→ Next123 · outline-offset
123Borders

outline-offset

Is section me hum outline-offset ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

  • Maqsad: kisi element ki outline ke offset ko control karne ki utilities — element ke kinare aur uski outline ke beech ka gap.
  • Classes:
    • outline-offset-<number> → outline-offset: <number>px;
    • -outline-offset-<number> → outline-offset: calc(<number>px * -1); (negative offset — outline drawn inside/over the element edge)
    • outline-offset-(<custom-property>) → outline-offset: var(<custom-property>);
    • outline-offset-[<value>] → outline-offset: <value>;
  • Basic use: outline-offset-0, outline-offset-2, outline-offset-4:
html
  <button class="outline-2 outline-offset-0 ...">Button A</button>
  <button class="outline-2 outline-offset-2 ...">Button B</button>
  <button class="outline-2 outline-offset-4 ...">Button C</button>
  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): outline-offset-[<value>], e.g. <div class="outline-offset-[2vw] ..."></div>.
  • CSS variable: outline-offset-(<custom-property>), jaise <div class="outline-offset-(--my-outline-offset) ..."></div> — outline-offset-[var(<custom-property>)] ka shorthand.
  • Variants: breakpoint variant, jaise <div class="outline md:outline-offset-2 ..."></div>.
  • Interview ke kaam ki baatein: offset hi outline ko "gap wala focus ring" jaisa dikhata hai (outline-2 outline-offset-2 docs me canonical jodi hai); negative offsets outline ko andar ki taraf kheench-te hain; border ke vipreet, offset layout nahi badalta.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/outline-offset
← Previous122 · outline-style→ Next124 · box-shadow
124Effects

box-shadow

Is section me hum box-shadow ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye section asal docs ko taaza padhkar verify kiya gaya hai.

Kisi element ki box shadow ko control karne ki utilities. (v4 me ring utilities bhi is page par documented hain — nav me koi alag ring page nahi hai.)

Class table (bahari shadows)

ClassStyles
shadow-2xsbox-shadow: var(--shadow-2xs); /* 0 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05) */
shadow-xsbox-shadow: var(--shadow-xs); /* 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05) */
shadow-smbox-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); /* 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1) */
shadow-mdbox-shadow: var(--shadow-md); /* 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1) */
shadow-lgbox-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); /* 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1) */
shadow-xlbox-shadow: var(--shadow-xl); /* 0 20px 25px -5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 8px 10px -6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1) */
shadow-2xlbox-shadow: var(--shadow-2xl); /* 0 25px 50px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25) */
shadow-nonebox-shadow: 0 0 #0000;
shadow-(<custom-property>)box-shadow: var(<custom-property>);
shadow-(color:<custom-property>)--tw-shadow-color: var(<custom-property>);

Opacity aur rang

  • Opacity modifier: shadow-xl/20, shadow-xl/30 — default shadow opacities kaafi kam hain (25% ya usse kam), to opacity badhane se (jaise 50% tak) shadows zyada saaf dikhti hain.
  • Rang: shadow-indigo-500, shadow-cyan-500/50 (rangeen shadows default roop se 100% opacity par hoti hain; opacity modifier se badlo).

Inset shadows

  • inset-shadow-2xs / inset-shadow-xs / inset-shadow-sm — inset box shadows; modifier se opacity (inset-shadow-sm/50, default inset opacities ~5%); inset-shadow-indigo-500, inset-shadow-cyan-500/50 se rang.

Rings (thos box-shadows)

  • ring / ring-<number> (jaise ring-2, ring-4) — thos box-shadow; default roop se rings element ke currentColor se milti hain.
  • Rang: ring-indigo-500, ring-blue-500/50 (default 100% opacity, modifier se badli ja sakti hai).
  • Inset rings: inset-ring / inset-ring-2 / inset-ring-4, colours inset-ring-blue-500, inset-ring-blue-500/50.
  • Hatana: shadow-none, inset-shadow-none, ring-0, inset-ring-0.

Arbitrary values, CSS variables, responsive, theme

  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): shadow-[0_35px_35px_rgba(0,0,0,0.25)], inset-shadow-[<value>], ring-[<value>], inset-ring-[<value>].
  • CSS variable: shadow-(--my-shadow) (= shadow-[var(--my-shadow)]).
  • Responsive: shadow-none md:shadow-lg.
  • Theme: @theme { --shadow-3xl: 0 35px 35px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25); } → shadow-3xl; @theme { --inset-shadow-md: inset 0 2px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25); } → inset-shadow-md; custom colours via --color-* (e.g. --color-regal-blue: #243c5a gives shadow-regal-blue, inset-shadow-regal-blue, ring-regal-blue, inset-ring-regal-blue).

Aam galtiyaan / interview points

  • v3 → v4 naam-badlav (Upgrade guide dekho): shadow-sm → shadow-xs, shadow → shadow-sm; khaali shadow ab bhi kaam karta hai lekin alag dikhta hai.
  • v4 me ring 1px hai (v3 me 3px tha) aur default roop se currentColor hota hai (blue-500 tha); v3 ko dobara banane ke liye ring-3 + ring-blue-500 istemal karo.
  • box-shadow niyamit box aakaaron ke liye hai; drop-shadow (filter) aniyamit aakaaron/text/SVG contours ko follow karta hai; text-shadow text ke liye hai.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/box-shadow
← Previous123 · outline-offset→ Next125 · text-shadow
125Effects

text-shadow

Is section me hum text-shadow ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

  • Maqsad: kisi text element ki shadow ko control karne ki utilities. (Note: docs example text ek baar kehta hai "Use utilities like text-shadow-sm and shadow-lg" — wahan shadow-lg text-shadow-lg ki docs typo hai; classes text-shadow-* hain.)
  • Classes:
    • text-shadow-2xs → text-shadow: var(--text-shadow-2xs); /* 0px 1px 0px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.15) */
    • text-shadow-xs → var(--text-shadow-xs); /* 0px 1px 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.2) */
    • text-shadow-sm → var(--text-shadow-sm); /* 0px 1px 0px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.075), 0px 1px 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.075), 0px 2px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.075) */
    • text-shadow-md → var(--text-shadow-md); /* 0px 1px 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0px 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0px 2px 4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1) */
    • text-shadow-lg → var(--text-shadow-lg); /* 0px 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0px 3px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0px 4px 8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1) */
    • text-shadow-none → text-shadow: none;
    • text-shadow-(<custom-property>) → text-shadow: var(<custom-property>);
    • text-shadow-(color:<custom-property>) → --tw-shadow-color var(<custom-property>);
    • text-shadow-[<value>] → text-shadow: <value>;
    • text-shadow-inherit → --tw-shadow-color inherit;
  • Basic use:
html
  <p class="text-shadow-2xs ...">The quick brown fox...</p>
  <p class="text-shadow-xs ...">The quick brown fox...</p>
  <p class="text-shadow-sm ...">The quick brown fox...</p>
  <p class="text-shadow-md ...">The quick brown fox...</p>
  <p class="text-shadow-lg ...">The quick brown fox...</p>
  • Opacity modifier: text-shadow-lg/20, text-shadow-lg/30 shadow ki opacity badalte hain:
html
  <p class="text-shadow-lg ...">The quick brown fox...</p>
  <p class="text-shadow-lg/20 ...">The quick brown fox...</p>
  <p class="text-shadow-lg/30 ...">The quick brown fox...</p>

Default text-shadow opacities kaafi kam hain (20% ya usse kam), to opacity badhane se (jaise 50% tak) shadows zyada saaf dikhti hain.

  • Rang: text-shadow-indigo-500, text-shadow-cyan-500/50 shadow ka rang badalte hain:
html
  <button class="text-sky-950 text-shadow-2xs text-shadow-sky-300 ...">Book a demo</button>
  <button class="text-gray-950 dark:text-white dark:text-shadow-2xs ...">See pricing</button>

Default roop se rangeen shadows ki opacity 100% hoti hai, opacity modifier se badli ja sakti hai.

  • Hatana: text-shadow-none:
html
  <p class="text-shadow-lg dark:text-shadow-none">  <!-- ... --></p>
  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): text-shadow-[<value>], e.g. <p class="text-shadow-[0_35px_35px_rgb(0_0_0_/_0.25)] ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>.
  • CSS variable: text-shadow-(<custom-property>), jaise <p class="text-shadow-(--my-text-shadow) ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p> — text-shadow-[var(<custom-property>)] ka shorthand.
  • Variants: breakpoint variant lagu hota hai, jaise <p class="text-shadow-none md:text-shadow-lg ...">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>; also dark: as in the examples above.
  • Theme customise karna — shadow ka size: --text-shadow-* variables:
css
  @theme { --text-shadow-xl: 0 35px 35px rgb(0, 0, 0 / 0.25); }

Phir <p class="text-shadow-xl">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>.

  • Theme customise karna — shadow ka rang: --color-* variables:
css
  @theme { --color-regal-blue: #243c5a; }

Phir <p class="text-shadow-regal-blue">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>.

  • Interview ke kaam ki baatein: text-shadow-* box-shadow/drop-shadow ka sirf-text wala saathi hai; bade sizes kai shadows ko stack karte hain (sm/md/lg comma se alag multi-layer shadows hain, ek akela blur nahi); default opacities kam hain, to /50 wagera se hi ye dikhai dete hain; colour utilities andar --tw-shadow-color set karti hain.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/text-shadow
← Previous124 · box-shadow→ Next126 · opacity
126Effects

opacity

Is section me hum opacity ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

  • Maqsad: the opacity of an element ko control karne ki utilities.
  • Classes:
    • opacity-<number> → opacity: <number>%;
    • opacity-(<custom-property>) → opacity: var(<custom-property>);
    • opacity-[<value>] → opacity: <value>;
  • Basic use: opacity-25, opacity-100 — koi bhi number kaam karta hai (scale numeric hai, koi tay naam wali list nahi):
html
  <button class="bg-indigo-500 opacity-100 ..."></button>
  <button class="bg-indigo-500 opacity-75 ..."></button>
  <button class="bg-indigo-500 opacity-50 ..."></button>
  <button class="bg-indigo-500 opacity-25 ..."></button>
  • State variant: disabled:opacity-75:
html
  <input class="opacity-100 disabled:opacity-75 ..." type="text" />
  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): opacity-[<value>], e.g. <button class="opacity-[.67] ..."></button>.
  • CSS variable: opacity-(<custom-property>), jaise <button class="opacity-(--my-opacity) ..."></button> — opacity-[var(<custom-property>)] ka shorthand.
  • Variants: breakpoint variant lagu hota hai, jaise <button class="opacity-50 md:opacity-100 ..."></button>.
  • Interview ke kaam ki baatein: opacity-<number> ek percentage hai (0–100); opacity poore element ko uske children/text samet halka karti hai, /<opacity> colour modifier ke vipreet jo sirf us rang ko halka karta hai (jaise bg-indigo-500/50 text ko poori tarah opaque rakhta hai); opacity-0 kisi element ko adrishya bana deta hai lekin ye ab bhi layout ki jagah gherta hai aur (hidden ke vipreet) accessibility tree me rehta hai / focusable rehta hai — ek aam chaal.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/opacity
← Previous125 · text-shadow→ Next127 · mix-blend-mode
127Effects

mix-blend-mode

Is section me hum mix-blend-mode ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

  • Maqsad: koi element background ke saath (matlab, uske peeche wale content ke saath) kaise blend hona chahiye, ise control karne ki utilities.
  • Classes — fetched page jaisi lauti (table soft-light par khatam hui; is section ke ant me flag dekho):
    • mix-blend-normal → mix-blend-mode: normal;
    • mix-blend-multiply → mix-blend-mode: multiply;
    • mix-blend-screen → mix-blend-mode: screen;
    • mix-blend-overlay → mix-blend-mode: overlay;
    • mix-blend-darken → mix-blend-mode: darken;
    • mix-blend-lighten → mix-blend-mode: lighten;
    • mix-blend-color-dodge → mix-blend-mode: color-dodge;
    • mix-blend-color-burn → mix-blend-mode: color-burn;
    • mix-blend-hard-light → mix-blend-mode: hard-light;
    • mix-blend-soft-light → mix-blend-mode: soft-light;
  • Basic use: mix-blend-overlay, mix-blend-soft-light control karte hain ki kisi element ka content aur background ek hi stacking context me dusre content ke saath kaise blend hote hain:
html
  <div class="flex justify-center -space-x-14">
    <div class="bg-blue-500 mix-blend-multiply ..."></div>
    <div class="bg-pink-500 mix-blend-multiply ..."></div>
  </div>
  • Isolation: parent par isolate utility istemal karke ek naya stacking context banao aur peeche wale content ke saath blending roko:
html
  <div class="isolate flex justify-center -space-x-14">
    <div class="bg-yellow-500 mix-blend-multiply ..."></div>
    <div class="bg-green-500 mix-blend-multiply ..."></div>
  </div>
  <div class="flex justify-center -space-x-14">
    <div class="bg-yellow-500 mix-blend-multiply ..."></div>
    <div class="bg-green-500 mix-blend-multiply ..."></div>
  </div>

(Pehla group isolated hai, dusra nahi — ek hi blend modes unke peeche wale page ke saapeksh alag results dete hain.)

  • Variants: breakpoint variant lagu hota hai, jaise <div class="mix-blend-multiply md:mix-blend-overlay ..."></div>.
  • ⚠️ Verification flag: fetched class table mix-blend-soft-light (10 modes) par ruk gayi. CSS khud difference, exclusion, hue, saturation, color, aur luminosity blend modes bhi define karta hai, aur sibling background-blend-mode page ka example bg-blend-difference / bg-blend-saturation ka zikr karta hai. Builder ko upar wali list ko poora kehne se pehle live mix-blend-mode table dobara check karni chahiye — sirf is brief se ye mat mano ki gayab modes Tailwind utilities ke roop me hain ya nahi hain.
  • Interview ke kaam ki baatein: blend mode sirf wahan mayne rakhta hai jahan elements overlap karte hain (docs example -space-x-14 overlap istemal karta hai); isolate / isolation: isolate wo upkaran hai jo blending ko peeche wale page me leak hone se rokta hai; multiply andhera karta hai, screen halka karta hai, overlay backdrop ke hisaab se dono karta hai — demo karne ke liye classic teeno.
Live check — docs table se zyada

Live page ki table soft-light par ruk jaati hai, lekin poora set ye hai — har value ke liye mix-blend-<value> utility hai: normal, multiply, screen, overlay, darken, lighten, color-dodge, color-burn, hard-light, soft-light, difference, exclusion, hue, saturation, color, luminosity — aur sirf mix-blend ke liye do extra: mix-blend-plus-darker aur mix-blend-plus-lighter. Kul 18 utilities. (Tailwind v4 source se verify kiya gaya.)

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/mix-blend-mode
← Previous126 · opacity→ Next128 · background-blend-mode
128Effects

background-blend-mode

Is section me hum background-blend-mode ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

  • Maqsad: kisi element ki background image ko uske background colour ke saath kaise blend hona chahiye, ise control karne ki utilities. (mix-blend-mode se vipreet, jo poore element ko uske peeche jo hai uske saath blend karta hai.)
  • Classes — fetched page jaisi lauti (table soft-light par khatam hui; is section ke ant me flag dekho):
    • bg-blend-normal → background-blend-mode: normal;
    • bg-blend-multiply → background-blend-mode: multiply;
    • bg-blend-screen → background-blend-mode: screen;
    • bg-blend-overlay → background-blend-mode: overlay;
    • bg-blend-darken → background-blend-mode: darken;
    • bg-blend-lighten → background-blend-mode: lighten;
    • bg-blend-color-dodge → background-blend-mode: color-dodge;
    • bg-blend-color-burn → background-blend-mode: color-burn;
    • bg-blend-hard-light → background-blend-mode: hard-light;
    • bg-blend-soft-light → background-blend-mode: soft-light;
  • Basic use: bg-blend-difference aur bg-blend-saturation (page ki prose me naam diye gaye) control karte hain ki kisi element ki background image aur colour kaise blend hote hain — visual examples multiply / soft-light / overlay istemal karte hain:
html
  <div class="bg-blue-500 bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] bg-blend-multiply ..."></div>
  <div class="bg-blue-500 bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] bg-blend-soft-light ..."></div>
  <div class="bg-blue-500 bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] bg-blend-overlay ..."></div>

Blend sirf tab dikhai deta hai jab element ke paas background colour AUR background image DONO hon.

  • Variants: breakpoint variant lagu hota hai, jaise <div class="bg-blue-500 bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] bg-blend-lighten md:bg-blend-darken ..."></div>.
  • ⚠️ Verification flag: mix-blend-mode ki tarah, fetched table bg-blend-soft-light par khatam hui, phir bhi page ki apni prose bg-blend-difference aur bg-blend-saturation ke naam leti hai, jo fetched table me nahi hain. Builder ko final karne se pehle poori mode list ke liye live table dobara check karni chahiye (difference, exclusion, hue, saturation, color, luminosity aam CSS baaki hain).
  • Interview ke kaam ki baatein: bg-blend-* ek element ke andar layers ko blend karta hai (image × colour); mix-blend-* kisi element ko uske peeche wale page ke saath blend karta hai — dono ko uljhana standard interview jaal hai; bg-<color> aur bg-[url(...)] dono ke bina blend karne ko kuch nahi hai.
Live check — docs table se zyada

Live page ki table soft-light par ruk jaati hai, lekin poora set ye hai — har value ke liye bg-blend-<value>: normal, multiply, screen, overlay, darken, lighten, color-dodge, color-burn, hard-light, soft-light, difference, exclusion, hue, saturation, color, luminosity. Kul 16 utilities — plus-darker/plus-lighter bg-blend me NAHI hain, wo sirf mix-blend me hain. Page ki apni prose bhi bg-blend-difference aur bg-blend-saturation ka naam leti hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/background-blend-mode

mask-clip

Is section me hum mask-clip ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

  • Maqsad: the bounding box of an element's mask ko control karne ki utilities.
  • Classes:
    • mask-clip-border → mask-clip: border-box;
    • mask-clip-padding → mask-clip: padding-box;
    • mask-clip-content → mask-clip: content-box;
    • mask-clip-fill → mask-clip: fill-box;
    • mask-clip-stroke → mask-clip: stroke-box;
    • mask-clip-view → mask-clip: view-box;
    • mask-no-clip → mask-clip: no-clip;
  • Basic use:
html
  <div class="mask-clip-border border-3 p-1.5 mask-[url(/img/circle.png)] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  <div class="mask-clip-padding border-3 p-1.5 mask-[url(/img/circle.png)] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  <div class="mask-clip-content border-3 p-1.5 mask-[url(/img/circle.png)] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>

Examples me border-3 + p-1.5 isiliye hain taaki border-box banam padding-box banam content-box ka fark dikhai de.

  • Variants: breakpoint variant lagu hota hai, jaise <div class="mask-clip-border md:mask-clip-padding ..."></div>.
  • Interview ke kaam ki baatein: mask-clip tay karta hai ki mask ko kahan rangne ki ijaazat hai (kis box tak ye kata hai); fill-box / stroke-box / view-box SVG-unmukh values hain; ye mask-origin se alag hai (jahan se mask image position hoti hai) — dono pages fark dikhane ke liye border-3 p-1.5 ke saath lagbhag ek jaise examples istemal karte hain.
Live check — docs table se zyada

Ek dhyan dene wali baat: docs ke fetched text me kuch mask CSS strings me ek extra ) aa gaya tha (docs-text rendering quirk). Is page par sirf utility ke NAAM par bharosa karo — mask-linear-<number>, mask-linear-from-*, side masks (mask-t/r/b/l/x/y-from-*, *-to-*), mask-radial-* aur mask-conic-* sab real hain.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/mask-clip

mask-composite

Is section me hum mask-composite ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

  • Maqsad: how multiple masks are combined together ko control karne ki utilities.
  • Classes:
    • mask-add → mask-composite: add;
    • mask-subtract → mask-composite: subtract;
    • mask-intersect → mask-composite: intersect;
    • mask-exclude → mask-composite: exclude;
  • Basic use — 30% aur 70% par do circle masks chaar tareekon se jode gaye:
html
  <div class="mask-add mask-[url(/img/circle.png),url(/img/circle.png)] mask-position-[30%_50%,70%_50%] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)]"></div>
  <div class="mask-subtract mask-[url(/img/circle.png),url(/img/circle.png)] mask-position-[30%_50%,70%_50%] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)]"></div>
  <div class="mask-intersect mask-[url(/img/circle.png),url(/img/circle.png)] mask-position-[30%_50%,70%_50%] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)]"></div>
  <div class="mask-exclude mask-[url(/img/circle.png),url(/img/circle.png)] mask-position-[30%_50%,70%_50%] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)]"></div>

(Comma se alag mask image list aur usse milti comma se alag mask-position-[30%_50%,70%_50%] note karo — har mask layer ko apni position milti hai.)

  • Variants: breakpoint variant lagu hota hai, jaise <div class="mask-add md:mask-subtract ..."></div>.
  • mask-image page se cross-reference: Tailwind mask-composite ko default roop se intersect par set karta hai, yehi jode gaye gradient masks (jaise mask-b-from-50% + ek radial mask) ko judne ke bajaye intersect karata hai. Is property ko badalna gradient masks ke judne ka tareeka badal deta hai — to mask-composite sirf image masks ke liye nahi hai.
  • Interview ke kaam ki baatein: add = union, subtract = pehla ghata baaki, intersect = sirf overlap, exclude = union ghata overlap (XOR jaisa); iska asar sirf kai mask layers ke saath hota hai; default intersect hi kaaran hai ki stack kiye gaye gradient masks waise vyavhaar karte hain jaise karte hain.
Live check — docs table se zyada

Ek dhyan dene wali baat: docs ke fetched text me kuch mask CSS strings me ek extra ) aa gaya tha (docs-text rendering quirk). Is page par sirf utility ke NAAM par bharosa karo — mask-linear-<number>, mask-linear-from-*, side masks (mask-t/r/b/l/x/y-from-*, *-to-*), mask-radial-* aur mask-conic-* sab real hain.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/mask-composite

131Effects

mask-image

Is section me hum mask-image ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

  • Maqsad: kisi element ki mask image ko control karne ki utilities. Ye Part D ka sabse bada page hai (225 lines) — Tailwind v4 me mask system gradient-first hai, sirf image-first nahi.
  • Core classes:
    • mask-[<value>] → mask-image: <value>;
    • mask-(<custom-property>) → mask-image: var(<custom-property>);
    • mask-none → mask-image: none;
    • mask-linear-<number> → mask-image: linear-gradient(<number>deg, black var(--tw-mask-linear-from)), transparent var(--tw-mask-linear-to)); (jaisa lauta; note karo page ki CSS rendering me ek parenthesis quirk hai — SPA me utility ka naam copy karo, shabdik CSS string nahi)
    • -mask-linear-<number> → same gradient with calc(<number>deg * -1) (negative angle)
    • mask-linear-from-<number> → linear gradient with black calc(var(--spacing) * <number>) as the from-stop
    • mask-linear-from-<percentage> → black <percentage> as the from-stop
    • mask-linear-from-<color> → <color> as the from-stop colour
    • mask-linear-from-(<custom-property>) / mask-linear-from-[<value>] → same with a variable / arbitrary value
    • (Page ki table mask-linear-from-* family ko soochibaddh karti hai; mask-linear-to-*, side-specific mask-<side>-from/to-*, mask-radial-* aur mask-conic-* families neeche prose/examples me documented hain.)
  • Image mask: mask-[<value>]:
html
  <div class="mask-[url(/img/scribble.png)] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  • Single-side linear gradient masks: mask-b-from-<value>, mask-t-to-<value> wagera — ek side ko halka karo:
html
  <div class="mask-t-from-50% bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  <div class="mask-r-from-30% bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  <div class="mask-l-from-50% mask-l-to-90% bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  <div class="mask-b-from-20% mask-b-to-80% bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>

Sides t / r / b / l hain. Ek from set karta hai ki dikhai dene wala (black) hissa kahan khatam hota hai aur fading kahan shuru hoti hai; ek to set karta hai ki ye kahan poori tarah transparent ho gaya hai.

  • Do sides ek saath: mask-x-from-70% / mask-y-to-90%:
html
  <div class="mask-x-from-70% mask-x-to-90% bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  <div class="mask-y-from-70% mask-y-to-90% bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  • Custom gradient colours: default roop se linear gradient masks black se transparent ki taraf jaate hain, lekin mask-<side>-from-<color> aur mask-<side>-to-<color> gradient ke rangon ko customise karte hain.
  • Custom linear gradient mask: mask-linear-<angle>, mask-linear-from-20, mask-linear-to-40:
html
  <div class="mask-linear-50 mask-linear-from-60% mask-linear-to-80% bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  <div class="-mask-linear-50 mask-linear-from-60% mask-linear-to-80% bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>

Negative form angle ko palat deta hai.

  • Radial gradient masks: mask-radial-from-<value> / mask-radial-to-<value>:
html
  <div class="flex items-center gap-4">
    <img class="mask-radial-[100%_100%] mask-radial-from-75% mask-radial-at-left ..." src="/img/keyboard.png" />
    <div class="font-medium">
      <p class="font-mono text-xs text-blue-500 uppercase dark:text-blue-400">Speed</p>
      <p class="mt-2 text-base text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">Built for power users</p>
      <p class="mt-1 text-sm leading-relaxed text-balance text-gray-500">Work faster than ever with customizable keyboard shortcuts</p>
    </div>
  </div>

Default roop se radial masks black se transparent ki taraf jaate hain; mask-radial-from-<color> / mask-radial-to-<color> rangon ko customise karte hain.

  • Radial position: mask-radial-at-bottom-left, mask-radial-at-[35%_35%] radial gradient ka centre set karte hain. Naam wali positions: mask-radial-at-top-left, mask-radial-at-top, mask-radial-at-top-right, mask-radial-at-left, mask-radial-at-center, mask-radial-at-right, mask-radial-at-bottom-left, mask-radial-at-bottom, mask-radial-at-bottom-right:
html
  <div class="mask-radial-at-top-left mask-radial-from-100% bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  <div class="mask-radial-at-top mask-radial-from-100% bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  <div class="mask-radial-at-top-right mask-radial-from-100% bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  <div class="mask-radial-at-left mask-radial-from-100% bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  <div class="mask-radial-at-center mask-radial-from-100% bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  <div class="mask-radial-at-right mask-radial-from-100% bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  <div class="mask-radial-at-bottom-left mask-radial-from-100% bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  <div class="mask-radial-at-bottom mask-radial-from-100% bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  <div class="mask-radial-at-bottom-right mask-radial-from-100% bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>

Ye mask-position se alag hai, jo mask image ki position set karta hai, radial gradient ki nahi.

  • Radial size: mask-radial-closest-corner, mask-radial-farthest-side wagera:
html
  <div class="mask-radial-closest-side mask-radial-from-100% mask-radial-at-[30%_30%] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  <div class="mask-radial-closest-corner mask-radial-from-100% mask-radial-at-[30%_30%] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  <div class="mask-radial-farthest-side mask-radial-from-100% mask-radial-at-[30%_30%] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  <div class="mask-radial-farthest-corner mask-radial-from-100% mask-radial-at-[30%_30%] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>

Custom radial size set karte waqt, units <ending-shape> par nirbhar karti hain, jo default roop se ellipse hai. mask-circle ke saath tum sirf ek tay lambaai istemal kar sakte ho, jaise mask-radial-[5rem]. mask-ellipse ke saath tum har axis ko ek tay lambaai ya percentage ke roop me bata sakte ho, jaise mask-radial-[40%_80%].

  • Conic gradient masks: mask-conic-from-<value>, mask-conic-to-<value>, mask-conic-<angle> — docs example ek storage-used ring hai (75%, "0.48 GB out of 2 GB remaining"):
html
  <div class="flex items-center gap-5 rounded-xl bg-white p-4 shadow-lg ring-1 ring-black/5 dark:bg-gray-800">
    <div class="grid grid-cols-1 grid-rows-1">
      <div class="border-4 border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-700 ..."></div>
      <div class="border-4 border-amber-500 mask-conic-from-75% mask-conic-to-75% dark:border-amber-400 ..."></div>
    </div>
    <div class="w-0 flex-1 text-sm text-gray-950 dark:text-white">
      <p class="font-medium">Storage used: 75%</p>
      <p class="mt-1 text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400"><span class="font-medium">0.48 GB</span> out of 2 GB remaining</p>
    </div>
  </div>

Default roop se conic masks black se transparent ki taraf jaate hain; mask-conic-from-<color> / mask-conic-to-<color> rangon ko customise karte hain.

  • Gradient masks jodna: mask-radial-from-*, mask-conic-to-*, mask-l-from-* wagera ko zyada jatil masks ke liye joda ja sakta hai:
html
  <div class="mask-b-from-50% mask-radial-[50%_90%] mask-radial-from-80% bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  <div class="mask-r-from-80% mask-b-from-80% mask-radial-from-70% mask-radial-to-85% bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>

Ye Tailwind ke mask-composite ko default roop se intersect set karne par nirbhar hai. Us property ko badalna gradient masks ke judne ko prabhavit karta hai.

  • Mask hatana: mask-none:
html
  <div class="mask-none">  <!-- ... --></div>
  • Fully custom: mask-linear-[<value>], mask-radial-[<value>]:
html
  <div class="mask-linear-[70deg,transparent_10%,black,transparent_80%] ..."></div>
  • CSS variable: mask-linear-(<custom-property>), jaise <div class="mask-linear-(--my-mask) ..."></div> — mask-linear-[var(<custom-property>)] ka shorthand.
  • Variants: breakpoint variant lagu hota hai, jaise <div class="mask-radial-from-70% md:mask-radial-from-50% ..."></div>.
  • Theme customise karna — rang: --color-* variables:
css
  @theme { --color-regal-blue: #243c5a; }

Phir mask-radial-from-regal-blue, mask-conic-to-regal-blue, mask-b-from-regal-blue istemal ho sakte hain: <div class="mask-radial-from-regal-blue"></div>.

  • Interview ke kaam ki baatein: masks luminance/alpha istemal karte hain — black = dikhai dene wala, transparent = chhupa hua, isiliye from/to percentages black→transparent ramp ko varnit karte hain; mask-radial-at-* (gradient centre) ≠ mask-position (image position); jode gaye masks default roop se intersect karte hain; conic example canonical "progress ring" use case hai; mask-none reset hai.
Live check — docs table se zyada

Ek dhyan dene wali baat: docs ke fetched text me kuch mask CSS strings me ek extra ) aa gaya tha (docs-text rendering quirk). Is page par sirf utility ke NAAM par bharosa karo — mask-linear-<number>, mask-linear-from-*, side masks (mask-t/r/b/l/x/y-from-*, *-to-*), mask-radial-* aur mask-conic-* sab real hain.

mask-mode

Is section me hum mask-mode ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye section asal docs ko taaza padhkar verify kiya gaya hai.

Kisi element ke mask mode ko control karne ki utilities (mask image ke channels ki vyakhya kaise hoti hai).

ClassStyles
mask-alphamask-mode: alpha;
mask-luminancemask-mode: luminance;
mask-matchmask-mode: match-source;

How it works

  • mask-alpha: mask ki opacity (alpha channel) masked element ki dikhai tay karti hai.
  • mask-luminance: mask ka luminance (brightness) value dikhai tay karta hai — sabse anumaan-yogya results ke liye grayscale rangon par tike raho.
  • mask-match: mask-mode: match-source — mask source ka apna mode istemal karo.
  • Example: <div class="mask-alpha mask-r-from-black mask-r-from-50% mask-r-to-transparent bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."> banam mask-r-from-white ... mask-r-to-black wala luminance version.
  • Responsive: mask-alpha md:mask-luminance.

Aam galtiyaan / interview points

  • mask-mode (kisi mask image ke channels ki vyakhya kaise hoti hai — CSS mask-mode) ko mask-type (kisi SVG mask ki vyakhya kaise hoti hai) se mat uljhao — docs isiliye inhe alag pages par rakhte hain.
Live check — docs table se zyada

Ek dhyan dene wali baat: docs ke fetched text me kuch mask CSS strings me ek extra ) aa gaya tha (docs-text rendering quirk). Is page par sirf utility ke NAAM par bharosa karo — mask-linear-<number>, mask-linear-from-*, side masks (mask-t/r/b/l/x/y-from-*, *-to-*), mask-radial-* aur mask-conic-* sab real hain.

mask-origin

Is section me hum mask-origin ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

  • Maqsad: how an element's mask image is positioned relative to borders, padding, and content ko control karne ki utilities.
  • Classes:
    • mask-origin-border → mask-origin: border-box;
    • mask-origin-padding → mask-origin: padding-box;
    • mask-origin-content → mask-origin: content-box;
    • mask-origin-fill → mask-origin: fill-box;
    • mask-origin-stroke → mask-origin: stroke-box;
    • mask-origin-view → mask-origin: view-box;
  • Basic use:
html
  <div class="mask-origin-border border-3 p-1.5 mask-[url(/img/circle.png)] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  <div class="mask-origin-padding border-3 p-1.5 mask-[url(/img/circle.png)] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  <div class="mask-origin-content border-3 p-1.5 mask-[url(/img/circle.png)] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>

Phir se border-3 p-1.5 teen boxes ko dikhai dene me alag banate hain.

  • Variants: breakpoint variant lagu hota hai, jaise <div class="mask-origin-border md:mask-origin-padding ..."></div>.
  • Interview ke kaam ki baatein: mask-origin = jahan mask image ka (0,0) bandha hai (kis box ke saapeksh ye position hoti hai); mask-clip = mask ko kahan tak rangne ki ijaazat hai. Dono ek hi box naam share karte hain (border/padding/content/fill/stroke/view) lekin alag sawalon ke jawab dete hain — docs tulna karane ke liye dono pages par lagbhag ek jaise examples istemal karte hain.
Live check — docs table se zyada

Ek dhyan dene wali baat: docs ke fetched text me kuch mask CSS strings me ek extra ) aa gaya tha (docs-text rendering quirk). Is page par sirf utility ke NAAM par bharosa karo — mask-linear-<number>, mask-linear-from-*, side masks (mask-t/r/b/l/x/y-from-*, *-to-*), mask-radial-* aur mask-conic-* sab real hain.

mask-position

Is section me hum mask-position ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

  • Maqsad: the position of an element's mask image ko control karne ki utilities.
  • Classes:
    • mask-top-left → mask-position: top left;
    • mask-top → mask-position: top;
    • mask-top-right → mask-position: top right;
    • mask-left → mask-position: left;
    • mask-center → mask-position: center;
    • mask-right → mask-position: right;
    • mask-bottom-left → mask-position: bottom left;
    • mask-bottom → mask-position: bottom;
    • mask-bottom-right → mask-position: bottom right;
    • mask-position-(<custom-property>) → mask-position: var(<custom-property>);
    • mask-position-[<value>] → mask-position: <value>;
  • Basic use — saari nau positions (docs prose mask-left-top ko bhi pattern ke example ke roop me naam deta hai, haalaanki table mask-top-left soochibaddh karti hai):
html
  <div class="mask-top-left mask-[url(/img/circle.png)] mask-size-[50%] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  <div class="mask-top mask-[url(/img/circle.png)] mask-size-[50%] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  <div class="mask-top-right mask-[url(/img/circle.png)] mask-size-[50%] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  <div class="mask-left mask-[url(/img/circle.png)] mask-size-[50%] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  <div class="mask-center mask-[url(/img/circle.png)] mask-size-[50%] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  <div class="mask-right mask-[url(/img/circle.png)] mask-size-[50%] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  <div class="mask-bottom-left mask-[url(/img/circle.png)] mask-size-[50%] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  <div class="mask-bottom mask-[url(/img/circle.png)] mask-size-[50%] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  <div class="mask-bottom-right mask-[url(/img/circle.png)] mask-size-[50%] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>

Examples me mask-size-[50%] mask ko sikodta hai taaki iski position asal me dikhai de.

  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): mask-position-[<value>], e.g. <div class="mask-position-[center_top_1rem] ..."></div> (underscores stand for spaces in arbitrary values).
  • CSS variable: mask-position-(<custom-property>), jaise <div class="mask-position-(--my-mask-position) ..."></div> — mask-position-[var(<custom-property>)] ka shorthand.
  • Variants: breakpoint variant lagu hota hai, jaise <div class="mask-center md:mask-top ..."></div>.
  • Interview ke kaam ki baatein: background-position (bg-top, bg-center, …) jaisi hi 3×3 position shabdawali lekin mask- prefix ke saath; ye mask image ko position karta hai, gradient ko nahi — gradients ke liye mask-radial-at-* istemal karo (mask-image dekho).

Is page par sirf utility ke NAAM par bharosa karo — mask-linear-<number>, mask-linear-from-*, side masks (mask-t/r/b/l/x/y-from-*, *-to-*), mask-radial-* aur mask-conic-* sab real hain.
