135Effects

mask-repeat

Is section me hum mask-repeat ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

  • Maqsad: the repetition of an element's mask image ko control karne ki utilities.
  • Classes:
    • mask-repeat → mask-repeat: repeat;
    • mask-no-repeat → mask-repeat: no-repeat;
    • mask-repeat-x → mask-repeat: repeat-x;
    • mask-repeat-y → mask-repeat: repeat-y;
    • mask-repeat-space → mask-repeat: space;
    • mask-repeat-round → mask-repeat: round;
  • Dono tareekon se dohrao:
html
  <div class="mask-repeat mask-[url(/img/circle.png)] mask-size-[50px_50px] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  • Sirf horizontal:
html
  <div class="mask-repeat-x mask-[url(/img/circle.png)] mask-size-[50px_50px] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)]..."></div>
  • Vertical only:
html
  <div class="mask-repeat-y mask-[url(/img/circle.png)] mask-size-[50px_50px] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)]..."></div>
  • space — bina clipping ke dohrao (gaps tiles ke beech barabar baante jate hain, tiles resize ya kate nahi hote):
html
  <div class="mask-repeat-space mask-[url(/img/circle.png)] mask-size-[50px_50px] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  • round — bina clipping ke dohrao, gaps se bachne ke liye zaroorat pade to tiles ko kheench do:
html
  <div class="mask-repeat-round mask-[url(/img/circle.png)] mask-size-[50px_50px] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  • No repeat:
html
  <div class="mask-no-repeat mask-[url(/img/circle.png)] mask-size-[50px_50px] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>

Saare examples mask-size-[50px_50px] istemal karte hain taaki tile dikhne me dohrane ke liye kaafi chhota ho.

  • Variants: breakpoint variant lagu hota hai, jaise <div class="mask-repeat md:mask-repeat-x ..."></div>.
  • Interview ke kaam ki baatein: mask- prefix ke saath background-repeat (bg-repeat, bg-no-repeat, bg-repeat-x, bg-repeat-y, bg-repeat-space, bg-repeat-round) ki parchhai; space banam round classic fark hai — space tile size rakhta hai aur gaps jodta hai, round tiles ko kheenchta hai taaki koi gaps aur clipping na ho; saade repeat aakhiri tile ko kinare par kaat sakta hai.
Live check — docs table se zyada

Ek dhyan dene wali baat: docs ke fetched text me kuch mask CSS strings me ek extra ) aa gaya tha (docs-text rendering quirk). Is page par sirf utility ke NAAM par bharosa karo — mask-linear-<number>, mask-linear-from-*, side masks (mask-t/r/b/l/x/y-from-*, *-to-*), mask-radial-* aur mask-conic-* sab real hain.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/mask-repeat
← Previous134 · mask-position→ Next136 · mask-size
136Effects

mask-size

Is section me hum mask-size ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

  • Maqsad: the size of an element's mask image ko control karne ki utilities.
  • Classes:
    • mask-auto → mask-size: auto;
    • mask-cover → mask-size: cover;
    • mask-contain → mask-size: contain;
    • mask-size-(<custom-property>) → mask-size: var(<custom-property>);
    • mask-size-[<value>] → mask-size: <value>;
  • cover — mask image ko tab tak scale karo jab tak ye mask layer ko na bhar de, zaroorat pade to image ko kaato:
html
  <div class="mask-cover mask-[url(/img/scribble.png)] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  • contain — mask image ko bina kaate ya kheenche bahari kinaron tak scale karo:
html
  <div class="mask-contain mask-[url(/img/scribble.png)] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  • auto — mask image ko uske default (natural) size par dikhao:
html
  <div class="mask-auto mask-[url(/img/scribble.png)] bg-[url(/img/mountains.jpg)] ..."></div>
  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): mask-size-[<value>], e.g. <div class="mask-size-[auto_100px] ..."></div>.
  • CSS variable: mask-size-(<custom-property>), jaise <div class="mask-size-(--my-mask-size) ..."></div> — mask-size-[var(<custom-property>)] ka shorthand.
  • Variants: breakpoint variant lagu hota hai, jaise <div class="mask-auto md:mask-contain ..."></div>.
  • Interview ke kaam ki baatein: background-size (bg-cover / bg-contain / bg-auto) jaise hi teen keywords; cover kaat sakta hai, contain kabhi nahi kaat-ta lekin khali jagah chhod sakta hai, auto image ka intrinsic size istemal karta hai — mountains image ke upar scribble mask ke saath demo karne wala trade-off.
Live check — docs table se zyada

Ek dhyan dene wali baat: docs ke fetched text me kuch mask CSS strings me ek extra ) aa gaya tha (docs-text rendering quirk). Is page par sirf utility ke NAAM par bharosa karo — mask-linear-<number>, mask-linear-from-*, side masks (mask-t/r/b/l/x/y-from-*, *-to-*), mask-radial-* aur mask-conic-* sab real hain.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/mask-size
← Previous135 · mask-repeat→ Next137 · mask-type
137Effects

mask-type

Is section me hum mask-type ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

  • Maqsad: how an SVG mask is interpreted ko control karne ki utilities.
  • Classes (sirf do):
    • mask-type-alpha → mask-type: alpha;
    • mask-type-luminance → mask-type: luminance;
  • Basic use — ek hi blob SVG mask mountains image ke upar do tareekon se lagaya gaya:
html
  <svg>
    <mask id="blob1" class="mask-type-alpha fill-gray-700/70">
      <path d="..."></path>
    </mask>
    <image href="/img/mountains.jpg" height="100%" width="100%" mask="url(#blob1)" />
  </svg>
  <svg>
    <mask id="blob2" class="mask-type-luminance fill-gray-700/70">
      <path d="..."></path>
    </mask>
    <image href="/img/mountains.jpg" height="100%" width="100%" mask="url(#blob2)" />
  </svg>
  • Matlab: mask-type-luminance ke saath SVG mask ka luminance value dikhai tay karta hai, to grayscale rangon par tike rehne se sabse anumaan-yogya results milte hain. mask-alpha ke saath (page ki prose yahan mask-alpha likhti hai, matlab mask-type-alpha), SVG mask ki opacity masked element ki dikhai tay karti hai. Example me mask fill fill-gray-700/70 hai — 70% opacity par ek grey — to dono modes ek hi fill se dikhai dene me alag results dete hain.
  • Variants: breakpoint variant lagu hota hai, jaise <mask class="mask-type-alpha md:mask-type-luminance ..."></mask>.
  • Interview ke kaam ki baatein: mask-type SVG me <mask> elements par lagu hota hai (HTML elements par CSS mask-image par nahi); alpha = transparency tay karti hai, luminance = brightness tay karti hai — isiliye luminance ke liye greyscale fills; mask-mode se mat uljhao (ek alag page, CSS mask-image channel vyakhya).
Live check — docs table se zyada

Ek dhyan dene wali baat: docs ke fetched text me kuch mask CSS strings me ek extra ) aa gaya tha (docs-text rendering quirk). Is page par sirf utility ke NAAM par bharosa karo — mask-linear-<number>, mask-linear-from-*, side masks (mask-t/r/b/l/x/y-from-*, *-to-*), mask-radial-* aur mask-conic-* sab real hain.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/mask-type
← Previous136 · mask-size→ Next138 · blur
138Filters

blur

Is section me hum blur ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

  • Maqsad: kisi element par blur filters lagane ki utilities. Page ka title hai filter: blur().
  • Classes:
    • blur-xs → filter: blur(var(--blur-xs)); /* 4px */
    • blur-sm → filter: blur(var(--blur-sm)); /* 8px */
    • blur-md → filter: blur(var(--blur-md)); /* 12px */
    • blur-lg → filter: blur(var(--blur-lg)); /* 16px */
    • blur-xl → filter: blur(var(--blur-xl)); /* 24px */
    • blur-2xl → filter: blur(var(--blur-2xl)); /* 40px */
    • blur-3xl → filter: blur(var(--blur-3xl)); /* 64px */
    • blur-none → filter: ; (page jaisa lauta — ek khali filter value; utility blur hata deti hai)
    • blur-(<custom-property>) → filter: blur(var(<custom-property>));
    • blur-[<value>] → filter: blur(<value>);
  • Basic use:
html
  <img class="blur-none" src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  <img class="blur-sm" src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  <img class="blur-lg" src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  <img class="blur-2xl" src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): blur-[<value>], e.g. <img class="blur-[2px] ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />.
  • CSS variable: blur-(<custom-property>), jaise <img class="blur-(--my-blur) ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" /> — blur-[var(<custom-property>)] ka shorthand.
  • Variants: breakpoint variant lagu hota hai, jaise <img class="blur-none md:blur-lg ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />.
  • Theme customise karna: --blur-* variables:
css
  @theme { --blur-2xs: 2px; }

Phir <img class="blur-2xs" src="/img/mountains.jpg" />.

  • Interview ke kaam ki baatein: scale ek tay naam wala set hai (xs–3xl, 4px–64px) jisme koi khaali blur class nahi aur koi numeric blur-<number> form nahi — brightness/contrast ke vipreet, jo numeric hain; blur-none reset hai; classic asal-duniya ka istemal kisi modal ke peeche background ko blur karna / frosted-glass asar hai (aam taur par backdrop-blur-* ke saath, ek alag utility family — blur-* (element khud) ko backdrop-blur-* (uske peeche jo hai) se mat uljhao).
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/filter-blur
← Previous137 · mask-type→ Next139 · brightness
139Filters

brightness

Is section me hum brightness ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

  • Maqsad: kisi element par brightness filters lagane ki utilities. Page ka title hai filter: brightness().
  • Classes:
    • brightness-<number> → filter: brightness(<number>%);
    • brightness-(<custom-property>) → filter: brightness(var(<custom-property>));
    • brightness-[<value>] → filter: brightness(<value>);
  • Basic use: brightness-50, brightness-100 (100% = asli brightness; 100 se neeche andhera karta hai, 100 se upar roshan karta hai):
html
  <img class="brightness-50 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  <img class="brightness-100 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  <img class="brightness-125 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  <img class="brightness-200 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): brightness-[<value>], e.g. <img class="brightness-[1.75] ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" /> (a unit-less multiplier is valid here).
  • CSS variable: brightness-(<custom-property>), jaise <img class="brightness-(--my-brightness) ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" /> — brightness-[var(<custom-property>)] ka shorthand.
  • Variants: breakpoint variant lagu hota hai, jaise <img class="brightness-110 md:brightness-150 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />.
  • Interview ke kaam ki baatein: numeric percentage scale (koi bhi number), 100 = koi badlav nahi, 0 = kaala, 200 = dugna roshan; brightness-[1.75] dikhata hai ki arbitrary form ek saade multiplier ko svikaar karta hai; dusre filters ke saath jodo — Tailwind v4 me kai filter utilities ek filter property me jud jati hain.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/filter-brightness
← Previous138 · blur→ Next140 · contrast
140Filters

contrast

Is section me hum contrast ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

  • Maqsad: kisi element par contrast filters lagane ki utilities. Page ka title hai filter: contrast().
  • Classes:
    • contrast-<number> → filter: contrast(<number>%);
    • contrast-(<custom-property>) → filter: contrast(var(<custom-property>));
    • contrast-[<value>] → filter: contrast(<value>);
  • Basic use: contrast-50, contrast-100 (100% = asli; 100 se neeche grey ki taraf sapaat karta hai, 100 se upar algaav badhata hai):
html
  <img class="contrast-50 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  <img class="contrast-100 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  <img class="contrast-125 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  <img class="contrast-200 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): contrast-[<value>], e.g. <img class="contrast-[.25] ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />.
  • CSS variable: contrast-(<custom-property>), jaise <img class="contrast-(--my-contrast) ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" /> — contrast-[var(<custom-property>)] ka shorthand.
  • Variants: breakpoint variant lagu hota hai, jaise <img class="contrast-125 md:contrast-150 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />.
  • Interview ke kaam ki baatein: brightness jaisa hi numeric-percentage pattern; 0% = poori tarah grey (koi contrast nahi), 100% = aparivartit; .25 wala arbitrary example dikhata hai ki class me decimals aage zero ke bina likhe jate hain.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/filter-contrast
← Previous139 · brightness→ Next141 · drop-shadow
141Filters

drop-shadow

Is section me hum drop-shadow ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

  • Maqsad: kisi element par drop-shadow filters lagane ki utilities. Page ka title hai filter: drop-shadow().
  • Classes:
    • drop-shadow-xs → filter: drop-shadow(var(--drop-shadow-xs)); /* 0 1px 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05) */
    • drop-shadow-sm → var(--drop-shadow-sm); /* 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.15) */
    • drop-shadow-md → var(--drop-shadow-md); /* 0 3px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.12) */
    • drop-shadow-lg → var(--drop-shadow-lg); /* 0 4px 4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.15) */
    • drop-shadow-xl → var(--drop-shadow-xl); /* 0 9px 7px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1) */ (page's CSS rendering shows a missing closing paren after var(--drop-shadow-xl — copy the utility name, not the literal string)
    • drop-shadow-2xl → var(--drop-shadow-2xl); /* 0 25px 25px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.15) */
    • drop-shadow-none → filter: drop-shadow(0 0 #0000);
    • drop-shadow-(<custom-property>) → filter: drop-shadow(var(<custom-property>));
    • drop-shadow-(color:<custom-property>) → --tw-drop-shadow-color: var(<custom-property>);
    • drop-shadow-[<value>] → filter: drop-shadow(<value>);
  • Basic use: SVGs par drop-shadow-sm, drop-shadow-xl:
html
  <svg class="drop-shadow-md ...">  <!-- ... --></svg>
  <svg class="drop-shadow-lg ...">  <!-- ... --></svg>
  <svg class="drop-shadow-xl ...">  <!-- ... --></svg>

Ye aniyamit aakaaron par shadows lagane ke liye kaam ka hai, jaise text aur SVG elements. Niyamit elements par shadows lagane ke liye, docs box shadow istemal karne ko kehte hain.

  • Opacity modifier: drop-shadow-xl/25, /50:
html
  <svg class="fill-white drop-shadow-xl ...">...</svg>
  <svg class="fill-white drop-shadow-xl/25 ...">...</svg>
  <svg class="fill-white drop-shadow-xl/50 ...">...</svg>

Default drop-shadow opacities kaafi kam hain (15% ya usse kam), to opacity badhane se (jaise 50% tak) drop shadows zyada saaf dikhti hain.

  • Rang: drop-shadow-indigo-500, drop-shadow-cyan-500/50:
html
  <svg class="fill-cyan-500 drop-shadow-lg drop-shadow-cyan-500/50 ...">...</svg>
  <svg class="fill-indigo-500 drop-shadow-lg drop-shadow-indigo-500/50 ...">...</svg>

Default roop se rangeen shadows ki opacity 100% hoti hai, opacity modifier se badli ja sakti hai.

  • Hatana: drop-shadow-none:
html
  <svg class="drop-shadow-lg dark:drop-shadow-none">  <!-- ... --></svg>
  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): drop-shadow-[<value>], e.g. <svg class="drop-shadow-[0_35px_35px_rgba(0,0,0,0.25)] ..."></svg>.
  • CSS variable: drop-shadow-(<custom-property>), jaise <svg class="drop-shadow-(--my-drop-shadow) ..."></svg> — drop-shadow-[var(<custom-property>)] ka shorthand.
  • Variants: breakpoint variant lagu hota hai, jaise <svg class="drop-shadow-md md:drop-shadow-xl ..."></svg>; also dark: as above.
  • Theme customise karna — shadow ka size: --drop-shadow-* variables:
css
  @theme { --drop-shadow-3xl: 0 35px 35px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25); }

Phir <svg class="drop-shadow-3xl"></svg>.

  • Theme customise karna — shadow ka rang: --color-* variables:
css
  @theme { --color-regal-blue: #243c5a; }

Phir <svg class="drop-shadow-regal-blue"></svg>.

  • Interview ke kaam ki baatein: drop-shadow content ke alpha aakaar ko follow karta hai (text glyphs, SVG paths, transparent PNGs) — box-shadow aayatakar border box ko follow karta hai, isiliye docs aniyamit aakaaron ko drop-shadow aur niyamit boxes ko box-shadow ki taraf bhejte hain; text-shadow (sirf-text) ke saath samanantar aur text-shadow wali wahi kam-default-opacity savdhaani note karo.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/filter-drop-shadow
← Previous140 · contrast→ Next142 · grayscale
142Filters

grayscale

Is section me hum grayscale ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

  • Maqsad: kisi element par grayscale filters lagane ki utilities. Page ka title hai filter: grayscale().
  • Classes:
    • grayscale → filter: grayscale(100%);
    • grayscale-<number> → filter: grayscale(<number>%);
    • grayscale-(<custom-property>) → filter: grayscale(var(<custom-property>));
    • grayscale-[<value>] → filter: grayscale(<value>);
  • Basic use: grayscale, grayscale-75:
html
  <img class="grayscale-0 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  <img class="grayscale-25 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  <img class="grayscale-50 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  <img class="grayscale ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />

To khaali grayscale = 100% (poori tarah grey), grayscale-0 = poora rang.

  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): grayscale-[<value>], e.g. <img class="grayscale-[0.5] ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />.
  • CSS variable: grayscale-(<custom-property>), jaise <img class="grayscale-(--my-grayscale) ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" /> — grayscale-[var(<custom-property>)] ka shorthand.
  • Variants: breakpoint variant lagu hota hai, jaise <img class="grayscale md:grayscale-0 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />.
  • Interview ke kaam ki baatein: canonical hover pattern grayscale + hover:grayscale-0 hai (hover par rang) — docs ka apna md:grayscale-0 example usi vichaar ka responsive version hai; numeric form ek percentage hai, arbitrary form 0–1 decimal svikaar karta hai.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/filter-grayscale
← Previous141 · drop-shadow→ Next143 · hue-rotate
143Filters

hue-rotate

Is section me hum hue-rotate ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

  • Maqsad: kisi element par hue-rotate filters lagane ki utilities. Page ka title hai filter: hue-rotate().
  • Classes:
    • hue-rotate-<number> → filter: hue-rotate(<number>deg);
    • -hue-rotate-<number> → filter: hue-rotate(calc(<number>deg * -1));
    • hue-rotate-(<custom-property>) → filter: hue-rotate(var(<custom-property>));
    • hue-rotate-[<value>] → filter: hue-rotate(<value>);
  • Basic use: hue-rotate-90, hue-rotate-180 hue ko degrees me ghumate hain:
html
  <img class="hue-rotate-15" src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  <img class="hue-rotate-90" src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  <img class="hue-rotate-180" src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  <img class="hue-rotate-270" src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  • Negative values: -hue-rotate-15, -hue-rotate-45:
html
  <img class="-hue-rotate-15" src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  <img class="-hue-rotate-45" src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  <img class="-hue-rotate-90" src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): hue-rotate-[<value>], e.g. <img class="hue-rotate-[3.142rad] ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" /> (radians are valid — the arbitrary form is not limited to degrees).
  • CSS variable: hue-rotate-(<custom-property>), jaise <img class="hue-rotate-(--my-hue-rotate) ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" /> — hue-rotate-[var(<custom-property>)] ka shorthand.
  • Variants: breakpoint variant lagu hota hai, jaise <img class="hue-rotate-60 md:hue-rotate-0 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />.
  • Interview ke kaam ki baatein: hue rotation rangon ko colour wheel ke chaaron or ghumata hai (180° reds ko cyans me badal deta hai, wagera); negative form class par aage wala - hai, uske andar koi negative number nahi; 360° = koi dikhai dene wala badlav nahi, to values asal me modulo 360 hain.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/filter-hue-rotate
← Previous142 · grayscale→ Next144 · invert
144Filters

invert

Is section me hum invert ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

  • Maqsad: kisi element par invert filters lagane ki utilities. Page ka title hai filter: invert().
  • Classes:
    • invert → filter: invert(100%);
    • invert-<number> → filter: invert(<number>%);
    • invert-(<custom-property>) → filter: invert(var(<custom-property>));
    • invert-[<value>] → filter: invert(<value>);
  • Basic use: invert, invert-20:
html
  <img class="invert-0" src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  <img class="invert-20" src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  <img class="invert" src="/img/mountains.jpg" />

Khaali invert = 100% (poora negative); invert-0 = koi badlav nahi.

  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): invert-[<value>], e.g. <img class="invert-[.25] ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />.
  • CSS variable: invert-(<custom-property>), jaise <img class="invert-(--my-inversion) ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" /> — invert-[var(<custom-property>)] ka shorthand.
  • Variants: breakpoint variant lagu hota hai, jaise <img class="invert md:invert-0 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />.
  • Interview ke kaam ki baatein: 100% inversion photographic negative hai; aanshik inversion (jaise 20%) ek halka rang badlav hai, poora negative nahi; md:invert-0 pattern aam "sirf chhoti screens par invert karo / kisi breakpoint par hatao" istemal dikhata hai.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/filter-invert
← Previous143 · hue-rotate→ Next145 · saturate
145Filters

saturate

Is section me hum saturate ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

  • Maqsad: kisi element par saturation filters lagane ki utilities. Page ka title hai filter: saturate().
  • Classes:
    • saturate-<number> → filter: saturate(<number>%);
    • saturate-(<custom-property>) → filter: saturate(var(<custom-property>));
    • saturate-[<value>] → filter: saturate(<value>);
  • Basic use: saturate-50, saturate-100 (100% = asli saturation; 100 se neeche grey ki taraf desaturate karta hai, 100 se upar rang ko tez karta hai):
html
  <img class="saturate-50 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  <img class="saturate-100 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  <img class="saturate-150 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  <img class="saturate-200 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): saturate-[<value>], e.g. <img class="saturate-[.25] ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />.
  • CSS variable: saturate-(<custom-property>), jaise <img class="saturate-(--my-saturation) ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" /> — saturate-[var(<custom-property>)] ka shorthand.
  • Variants: breakpoint variant lagu hota hai, jaise <img class="saturate-50 md:saturate-150 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />.
  • Interview ke kaam ki baatein: saturate-0 asar me grayscale ke barabar hai (poori tarah desaturated); saturate-200 "vivid / oversaturated" look hai; brightness/contrast jaisa hi numeric-percentage pattern — teeno photo adjustment ke liye standard teeno hain, aur ye judte hain (ek image par brightness + contrast + saturate).
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/filter-saturate
← Previous144 · invert→ Next146 · sepia
146Filters

sepia

Is section me hum sepia ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

  • Maqsad: kisi element par sepia filters lagane ki utilities. Page ka title hai filter: sepia().
  • Classes:
    • sepia → filter: sepia(100%);
    • sepia-<number> → filter: sepia(<number>%);
    • sepia-(<custom-property>) → filter: sepia(var(<custom-property>));
    • sepia-[<value>] → filter: sepia(<value>);
  • Basic use: sepia, sepia-50:
html
  <img class="sepia-0" src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  <img class="sepia-50" src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  <img class="sepia" src="/img/mountains.jpg" />

Khaali sepia = 100% (poora vintage brown tone); sepia-0 = koi asar nahi.

  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): sepia-[<value>], e.g. <img class="sepia-[.25] ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />.
  • CSS variable: sepia-(<custom-property>), jaise <img class="sepia-(--my-sepia) ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" /> — sepia-[var(<custom-property>)] ka shorthand.
  • Variants: breakpoint variant lagu hota hai, jaise <img class="sepia md:sepia-0 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />.
  • Interview ke kaam ki baatein: sepia "purani photo" filter hai — ye image ko desaturate bhi karta hai aur brown ki taraf garam bhi; aanshik values (jaise sepia-50) ek halka vintage look dete hain; grayscale/invert ki tarah, khaali class ka matlab 100% hai aur -0 form reset hai.

Coverage checklist (parent orchestrator ke liye)

  • Borders 8/8 poori tarah padhe: border-radius, border-width, border-color, border-style, outline-width, outline-color, outline-style, outline-offset.
  • Effects 12/14 poori tarah padhe: text-shadow, opacity, mix-blend-mode, background-blend-mode, mask-clip, mask-composite, mask-image, mask-origin, mask-position, mask-repeat, mask-size, mask-type.
  • Effects verify NAHI hue (HTTP 429, dobara koshish nahi): box-shadow, mask-mode.
  • Filters 9/9 poori tarah padhe: blur, brightness, contrast, drop-shadow, grayscale, hue-rotate, invert, saturate, sepia.
  • Kul: 29/31 poori tarah padhe; 2/31 verify nahi hue.
  • Builder ke liye flags: (1) banane se pehle box-shadow aur mask-mode ko live dobara padho; (2) live blend-mode tables (mix-blend-mode / background-blend-mode) dobara check karo — fetched tables soft-light par khatam hui jabki examples difference/saturation ke naam lete hain; (3) mask-linear-* aur drop-shadow-xl ke liye fetched CSS strings me docs text me ek parenthesis rendering quirk hai — utility ke naam istemal karo, wo shabdik strings nahi.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/filter-sepia
← Previous145 · saturate→ Next147 · border-collapse
147Tables

border-collapse

Is section me hum border-collapse ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Table cell borders ek border me collapse hote hain ya alag rehte hain, ise control karne ki utilities (border-collapse). Sirf do classes.

ClassStyles
border-collapseborder-collapse: collapse;
border-separateborder-collapse: separate;
  • border-collapse — jab sambhav ho to paas wale cell borders ko ek border me jodo. Docs example ek State/City table hai (Indiana/Indianapolis, Ohio/Columbus, Michigan/Detroit) jisme table par border border-gray-400 aur har th/td par border border-gray-300 hai:
html
  <table class="border-collapse border border-gray-400 ...">
    <thead>
      <tr>
        <th class="border border-gray-300 ...">State</th>
        <th class="border border-gray-300 ...">City</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr>
        <td class="border border-gray-300 ...">Indiana</td>
        <td class="border border-gray-300 ...">Indianapolis</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
        <td class="border border-gray-300 ...">Ohio</td>
        <td class="border border-gray-300 ...">Columbus</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
        <td class="border border-gray-300 ...">Michigan</td>
        <td class="border border-gray-300 ...">Detroit</td>
      </tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>

Page par bataya gaya note: isme top-level <table> tag par borders ko collapse karna bhi shaamil hai.

  • border-separate — har cell ko apni alag borders dikhane par majboor karo (wahi State/City table, <table> par class border-separate).
  • Responsive: <table class="border-collapse md:border-separate ...">
  • Interview ki baatein: collapse cells ke beech ek-akal 1px lines deta hai (aam saaf-table wala look); separate dohri borders deta hai aur border-spacing ke kisi asar ke liye purv-shart hai — collapse ke saath, border-spacing nazarandaaz ho jata hai. border-collapse wo bhi hai jo Tailwind ka preflight tables par default roop se set karta hai, to border-separate opt-out hai.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/border-collapse

148Tables

border-spacing

Is section me hum border-spacing ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Table borders ke beech ki spacing ko control karne ki utilities (border-spacing). Sirf separate borders (border-separate) ke saath asar hota hai.

ClassStyles
border-spacing-<number>border-spacing: calc(var(--spacing) * <number>);
border-spacing-pxborder-spacing: 1px;
border-spacing-(<custom-property>)border-spacing: var(<custom-property>);
border-spacing-[<value>]border-spacing: <value>;
border-spacing-x-<number>border-spacing: calc(var(--spacing) * <number>) var(--tw-border-spacing-y);
border-spacing-x-pxborder-spacing: 1px var(--tw-border-spacing-y);
border-spacing-x-(<custom-property>)border-spacing: var(<custom-property>) var(--tw-border-spacing-y);
border-spacing-x-[<value>]border-spacing: <value> var(--tw-border-spacing-y);
border-spacing-y-<number>border-spacing: var(--tw-border-spacing-x) calc(var(--spacing) * <number>);
border-spacing-y-pxborder-spacing: var(--tw-border-spacing-x) 1px;
border-spacing-y-(<custom-property>)border-spacing: var(--tw-border-spacing-x) var(<custom-property>);
border-spacing-y-[<value>]border-spacing: var(--tw-border-spacing-x) <value>;
  • Example — separate borders ke saath border-spacing-2 (aur prose me border-spacing-x-3), border-collapse page wali wahi State/City table:
html
  <table class="border-separate border-spacing-2 border border-gray-400 dark:border-gray-500">
    <thead>
      <tr>
        <th class="border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600">State</th>
        <th class="border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600">City</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr>
        <td class="border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-700">Indiana</td>
        <td class="border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-700">Indianapolis</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
        <td class="border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-700">Ohio</td>
        <td class="border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-700">Columbus</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
        <td class="border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-700">Michigan</td>
        <td class="border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-700">Detroit</td>
      </tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): <table class="border-spacing-[7px] ...">
  • CSS variable: <table class="border-spacing-(--my-border-spacing) ..."> (= border-spacing-[var(--my-border-spacing)]).
  • Responsive: <table class="border-spacing-2 md:border-spacing-4 ...">
  • Customise karna: border-spacing-<number> --spacing se chalte hain: @theme { --spacing: 1px; }.
  • Interview ki baatein: border-spacing purane HTML cellspacing attribute ka CSS badlaav hai; ye borders ke beech ka gap set karta hai (padding nahi — wo cellpadding hai, matlab cell p-*). border-spacing-x-*/border-spacing-y-* axes ko swatantra roop se set karte hain (--tw-border-spacing-x/--tw-border-spacing-y variables se lagu). Ye border-collapse: collapse ke neeche chupchaap nazarandaaz ho jata hai — ek aam "meri spacing kaam kyun nahi kar rahi?" bug.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/border-spacing
← Previous147 · border-collapse→ Next149 · table-layout
149Tables

table-layout

Is section me hum table-layout ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Table layout algorithm ko control karne ki utilities (table-layout). Sirf do classes.

ClassStyles
table-autotable-layout: auto;
table-fixedtable-layout: fixed;
  • table-auto — table columns ko unke cells ke contents ke hisaab se apne aap size karo. Docs example: ek Song/Artist/Year table — "The Sliding Mr. Bones (Next Stop, Pottersville)" / Malcolm Lockyer / 1961; "Witchy Woman" / The Eagles / 1972; "Shining Star" / Earth, Wind, and Fire / 1975. Lamba song title apne column ko chauda banata hai:
html
  <table class="table-auto">
    <thead>
      <tr><th>Song</th><th>Artist</th><th>Year</th></tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><td>The Sliding Mr. Bones (Next Stop, Pottersville)</td><td>Malcolm Lockyer</td><td>1961</td></tr>
      <tr><td>Witchy Woman</td><td>The Eagles</td><td>1972</td></tr>
      <tr><td>Shining Star</td><td>Earth, Wind, and Fire</td><td>1975</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
  • table-fixed — table cells ke content ko nazarandaaz karo aur har column ke liye tay widths istemal karo (wahi Song/Artist/Year table; content ki lambaai ki parwah kiye bina columns barabar hain):
html
  <table class="table-fixed">
    <!-- same thead/tbody as above -->
  </table>

Tum kuch columns ke liye widths haath se set kar sakte ho aur baaki uplabdh chaudaai bina spasht width wale columns me barabar baant di jati hai. Pehli row me set ki gayi widths poori table ke liye column width tay karti hain.

  • Responsive: <div class="table-auto md:table-fixed ..."> (docs example classes ko ek <div> par rakhta hai; asal table par inhe <table> par istemal karo).
  • Interview ki baatein: auto (default) columns ko content ke hisaab se size karta hai — badi tables ke liye dheema kyunki browser ko layout se pehle saari rows padhni padti hain; fixed sirf pehli row se layout karta hai, to ye tez aur anumaan-yogya hai, aur bharosemand w-* column widths aur cells ke andar text truncation (truncate) ke liye zaroori hai. fixed ke saath, lamba content column ko chauda karne ke bajaye overflow/wrap hota hai.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/table-layout
← Previous148 · border-spacing→ Next150 · caption-side
150Tables

caption-side

Is section me hum caption-side ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Kisi table ke andar <caption> element ke alignment ko control karne ki utilities (caption-side). Sirf do classes.

ClassStyles
caption-topcaption-side: top;
caption-bottomcaption-side: bottom;
  • caption-top — caption ko table ke upar rakho. Docs example: ek Wrestler / Signature Move(s) table ke upar "Table 3.1: Professional wrestlers and their signature moves." — "Stone Cold" Steve Austin / Stone Cold Stunner, Lou Thesz Press; Bret "The Hitman" Hart / The Sharpshooter; Razor Ramon / Razor's Edge, Fallaway Slam:
html
  <table>
    <caption class="caption-top">
      Table 3.1: Professional wrestlers and their signature moves.
    </caption>
    <thead>
      <tr><th>Wrestler</th><th>Signature Move(s)</th></tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><td>"Stone Cold" Steve Austin</td><td>Stone Cold Stunner, Lou Thesz Press</td></tr>
      <tr><td>Bret "The Hitman" Hart</td><td>The Sharpshooter</td></tr>
      <tr><td>Razor Ramon</td><td>Razor's Edge, Fallaway Slam</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
  • caption-bottom — caption ko table ke neeche rakho (wahi table, <caption> par caption-bottom).
  • Responsive: <caption class="caption-top md:caption-bottom ...">
  • Interview ki baatein: HTML me <caption> <table> ka pehla child hona chahiye; caption-side ise sirf top/bottom le jaata hai (is utility me koi left/right nahi hai). Caption kisi table ka sulabh naam/varnan hai — screen-reader users ke liye table ke upar heading ke bajaye asal <caption> ko prathmikta do.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/caption-side
← Previous149 · table-layout→ Next151 · transition-property
151Transitions & Animation

transition-property

Is section me hum transition-property ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: kaunsi CSS properties badalne par transition (animate) hoti hain, ise control karne ki utilities. Ek transition kisi property badlav ko sirf tab animate karta hai jab wo property transition-property me soochibaddh ho — to sahi utility chunna hi hover/focus/state badlav ko turant ke bajaye smooth banata hai.

Utility classes (sab transition-timing-function: var(--default-transition-timing-function) — cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) — aur transition-duration: var(--default-transition-duration) — 150ms — set karti hain, jab tak note na ho):

Classtransition-property value
transitioncolor, background-color, border-color, outline-color, text-decoration-color, fill, stroke, --tw-gradient-from, --tw-gradient-via, --tw-gradient-to, opacity, box-shadow, transform, translate, scale, rotate, filter, -webkit-backdrop-filter, backdrop-filter, display, content-visibility, overlay, pointer-events
transition-allall
transition-colorscolor, background-color, border-color, outline-color, text-decoration-color, fill, stroke, --tw-gradient-from, --tw-gradient-via, --tw-gradient-to
transition-opacityopacity
transition-shadowbox-shadow
transition-transformtransform, translate, scale, rotate
transition-nonenone (no timing/duration set)
transition-(<custom-property>)var(<custom-property>)
transition-[<value>]<value>

Mukhya example — ek button jo hover par uthta, badhta aur rang badalta hai (ise transition aur duration/easing chahiye, jo alag utilities hain):

html
<button class="bg-blue-500 transition delay-150 duration-300 ease-in-out hover:-translate-y-1 hover:scale-110 hover:bg-indigo-500 ...">
  Save Changes
</button>

Reduced motion: motion-safe / motion-reduce variants istemal karo taaki reduced motion pasand karne wale logon ko koi (ya ek alag) transition mile:

html
<button class="transform transition hover:-translate-y-1 motion-reduce:transition-none motion-reduce:hover:transform-none ...">
  <!-- ... -->
</button>

Custom values:

  • Arbitrary: transition-[height] — koi bhi property list.
  • CSS variable shorthand: transition-(--my-properties) — transition-[var(--my-properties)] ka shorthand; var() apne aap jud jata hai.
html
<button class="transition-[height] ..."><!-- ... --></button>
<button class="transition-(--my-properties) ..."><!-- ... --></button>

Variants: breakpoint variants lagu hote hain, jaise transition-none md:transition-all (no transition on small screens, transition everything at md and up). See the variants documentation for the full list.

Aam galtiyaan / interview points:

  • transition (default) har property ko cover NAHI karta — jaise height/width iski list me nahi hain; unke liye transition-all ya transition-[height] istemal karo.
  • transition-all suvidhajanak hai lekin un properties ko animate kar sakta hai jinka tumhara iraada nahi tha (aur performance ko nuksaan pahuncha sakta hai); sabse sankri utility ko prathmikta do (transition-colors, transition-transform, …) jo asal me badalne wale ko cover kare.
  • Ek akeli transition-* utility kuch animate nahi karti — kuch ko property badalni hogi (ek hover:/focus:/state variant, JS class toggle, wagera), aur duration/easing duration-* / ease-* se aate hain.
  • Default duration 150ms hai aur default easing cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) hai (ease-in-out wala wahi curve).
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/transition-property
← Previous150 · caption-side→ Next152 · transition-behavior
152Transitions & Animation

transition-behavior

Is section me hum transition-behavior ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: CSS transitions ke vyavhaar ko control karne ki utilities — khaas taur par kya transitions un properties par shuru ho sakti hain jinke values discrete (interpolate na hone wale) hain, jaise display.

Utility classes:

ClassStyles
transition-normaltransition-behavior: normal;
transition-discretetransition-behavior: allow-discrete;

Mukhya avdhaarana — discrete transitions: Aam taur par, kisi element ko hidden se block me badalna (matlab display: none → display: block) transition nahi ho sakta — element bas aa jata hai. transition-discrete (transition-behavior: allow-discrete) ke saath, transition shuru ho sakta hai, to jaise element ke display value badalne ke dauraan ek opacity fade chal sakta hai. Docs demo: ek checkbox se toggle hone wala button (peer-has-checked:block, not-peer-has-checked:opacity-0) sirf transition-discrete version me halka hokar gayab hota hai; transition-normal ke saath ye turant gayab ho jata hai.

html
<!-- fades out (transition can start on the discrete display change) -->
<button class="hidden transition-all transition-discrete not-peer-has-checked:opacity-0 peer-has-checked:block ...">
  I fade out
</button>

Variants: breakpoint variants lagu hote hain, jaise transition-discrete md:transition-normal.

Interview points:

  • transition-behavior: allow-discrete hi display (aur dusri discrete properties jaise visibility/content-visibility/overlay) ko animatable banata hai — ye bina JS height hacks ke show/hide animate karne ka aadhunik tareeka hai.
  • Ye transition-all ke saath judta hai (ya ek transition jisme display/overlay shaamil ho) — akela transition-discrete ye nahi chunta ki kaunsi properties transition hongi.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/transition-behavior
← Previous151 · transition-property→ Next153 · transition-duration
153Transitions & Animation

transition-duration

Is section me hum transition-duration ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: CSS transitions ki duration ko control karne ki utilities, milliseconds me.

Utility classes:

ClassStyles
duration-<number>transition-duration: <number>ms;
duration-initialtransition-duration: initial;
duration-(<custom-property>)transition-duration: var(<custom-property>);
duration-[<value>]transition-duration: <value>;

Khaas baatein:

  • Number dynamic hai — koi bhi number kaam karta hai (duration-150, duration-300, duration-700, duration-0, …), aur value utne hi milliseconds hai. Koi tay scale nahi hai; duration-<number> koi bhi number svikaar karta hai.
  • Docs example — teen buttons jo sirf duration me alag hain:
html
<button class="transition duration-150 ease-in-out ...">Button A</button>
<button class="transition duration-300 ease-in-out ...">Button B</button>
<button class="transition duration-700 ease-in-out ...">Button C</button>
  • duration apne aap kuch nahi karta: ye sirf ye set karta hai ki ek transition kitni der leta hai jab ek transition-* utility aur ek property badlav maujood ho.

Reduced motion: duration-300 motion-reduce:duration-0 — reduced motion pasand karne wale users ke liye turant badlav.

html
<button type="button" class="duration-300 motion-reduce:duration-0 ..."><!-- ... --></button>

Custom values:

  • Arbitrary, kai properties ke liye comma se alag lists samet: duration-[1s,15s].
  • CSS variable shorthand: duration-(--my-duration) = duration-[var(--my-duration)].

Variants: breakpoint variants lagu hote hain, jaise duration-0 md:duration-150.

Interview ki baatein: jab koi transition-* utility istemal hoti hai to default duration 150ms hai (--default-transition-duration); duration-0 kisi transition ki timing disable karne ka pramanik tareeka hai (aksar motion-reduce: ke saath joda jata hai).

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/transition-duration
← Previous152 · transition-behavior→ Next154 · transition-timing-function
154Transitions & Animation

transition-timing-function

Is section me hum transition-timing-function ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: CSS transitions ki easing (timing function) ko control karne ki utilities — animation ka acceleration curve.

Utility classes:

ClassStyles
ease-lineartransition-timing-function: linear;
ease-intransition-timing-function: var(--ease-in); /* cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1) */
ease-outtransition-timing-function: var(--ease-out); /* cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1) */
ease-in-outtransition-timing-function: var(--ease-in-out); /* cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) */
ease-initialtransition-timing-function: initial;
ease-(<custom-property>)transition-timing-function: var(<custom-property>);
ease-[<value>]transition-timing-function: <value>;

Khaas baatein:

  • ease-in dheere shuru hota hai aur tez hota hai (screen se jaane wale elements ke liye achha); ease-out tez shuru hota hai aur dheema hota hai (aane wale elements ke liye achha); ease-in-out dheere shuru aur khatam hota hai (transition-* utilities dwara istemal default curve); ease-linear sthir speed se chalta hai.
  • Docs example:
html
<button class="duration-300 ease-in ...">Button A</button>
<button class="duration-300 ease-out ...">Button B</button>
<button class="duration-300 ease-in-out ...">Button C</button>

Custom values:

  • Arbitrary cubic-bezier: ease-[cubic-bezier(0.95,0.05,0.795,0.035)].
  • CSS variable shorthand: ease-(--my-ease) = ease-[var(--my-ease)].

Theme customise karna — ek naam wali easing jodna: ek --ease-* theme variable define karo aur utility aa jati hai:

css
@theme {
  --ease-in-expo: cubic-bezier(0.95, 0.05, 0.795, 0.035);
}
html
<button class="ease-in-expo"><!-- ... --></button>

Variants: breakpoint variants lagu hote hain, jaise ease-out md:ease-in.

Interview ki baatein: chaar naam wale curves aur unke cubic-bezier values jaano (upar); jaano ki Tailwind me default transition easing ease-in-out ka curve hai; jaano ki custom easings --ease-* theme variables se jodi jati hain, generated CSS edit karke nahi.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/transition-timing-function
← Previous153 · transition-duration→ Next155 · transition-delay
155Transitions & Animation

transition-delay

Is section me hum transition-delay ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: kisi CSS transition ke shuru hone se pehle ke delay ko control karne ki utilities, milliseconds me.

Utility classes:

ClassStyles
delay-<number>transition-delay: <number>ms;
delay-(<custom-property>)transition-delay: var(<custom-property>);
delay-[<value>]transition-delay: <value>;

Khaas baatein:

  • Dynamic number — milliseconds ki koi bhi sankhya (delay-150, delay-300, delay-700, delay-0, …).
  • Docs example — teen buttons jo alag-alag delays ke baad apna transition shuru karte hain:
html
<button class="transition delay-150 duration-300 ease-in-out ...">Button A</button>
<button class="transition delay-300 duration-300 ease-in-out ...">Button B</button>
<button class="transition delay-700 duration-300 ease-in-out ...">Button C</button>
  • Delay hi staggered/sequenced asar banata hai (jaise list items badhte delay-* ke saath ek ke baad ek animate hote hain).

Reduced motion: delay-300 motion-reduce:delay-0 — reduced motion pasand karne wale users ke liye koi stagger delay nahi.

html
<button type="button" class="delay-300 motion-reduce:delay-0 ..."><!-- ... --></button>

Custom values:

  • Arbitrary, lists samet: delay-[1s,250ms].
  • CSS variable shorthand: delay-(--my-delay) = delay-[var(--my-delay)].

Variants: breakpoint variants lagu hote hain, jaise delay-150 md:delay-300.

Interview ki baatein: delay ≠ duration — delay transition shuru hone se pehle ka intezaar hai, duration ye hai ki ye kitni der chalta hai; dono aam taur par ek hi element par transition + ease-* ke saath jode jate hain.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/transition-delay
← Previous154 · transition-timing-function→ Next156 · animation
156Transitions & Animation

animation

Is section me hum animation ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: CSS animations se elements ko animate karne ki utilities (transitions ke vipreet, jinhe state badlav chahiye — animations apne aap chalte hain, anant roop se bhi).

Andar-bane animations (har ek ek --animate-* theme variable hai jisme shorthand aur uske @keyframes hain):

ClassAnimation
animate-spinspin 1s linear infinite — @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
animate-pingping 1s cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite — @keyframes ping { 75%, 100% { transform: scale(2); opacity: 0; } }
animate-pulsepulse 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite — @keyframes pulse { 50% { opacity: 0.5; } }
animate-bouncebounce 1s infinite — @keyframes bounce { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(-25%); animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.8, 0, 1, 1); } 50% { transform: none; animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1); } }
animate-noneanimation: none;
animate-(<custom-property>)animation: var(<custom-property>);
animate-[<value>]animation: <value>;

Docs ke use cases (exact examples ke saath):

  • animate-spin — loading sanketak:
html
<button type="button" class="bg-indigo-500 ..." disabled>
  <svg class="mr-3 size-5 animate-spin ..." viewBox="0 0 24 24"><!-- ... --></svg>
  Processing…
</button>
  • animate-ping — notification badges ke liye radar-ping / ripple asar (ek thos dot ke peeche ping karta absolute span):
html
<span class="relative flex size-3">
  <span class="absolute inline-flex h-full w-full animate-ping rounded-full bg-sky-400 opacity-75"></span>
  <span class="relative inline-flex size-3 rounded-full bg-sky-500"></span>
</span>
  • animate-pulse — skeleton loaders ke liye halka fade in/out:
html
<div class="mx-auto w-full max-w-sm rounded-md border border-blue-300 p-4">
  <div class="flex animate-pulse space-x-4">
    <div class="size-10 rounded-full bg-gray-200"></div>
    <div class="flex-1 space-y-6 py-1">
      <div class="h-2 rounded bg-gray-200"></div>
      <div class="space-y-3">
        <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          <div class="col-span-2 h-2 rounded bg-gray-200"></div>
          <div class="col-span-1 h-2 rounded bg-gray-200"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="h-2 rounded bg-gray-200"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
  • animate-bounce — upar-neeche uchhalna, jaise ek "scroll down" sanketak:
html
<svg class="size-6 animate-bounce ..."><!-- ... --></svg>

Reduced motion: animation sirf tab lagao jab motion surakshit ho:

html
<button type="button" class="bg-indigo-600 ..." disabled>
  <svg class="mr-3 size-5 motion-safe:animate-spin ..." viewBox="0 0 24 24"><!-- ... --></svg>
  Processing
</button>

Custom values:

  • Arbitrary: animate-[wiggle_1s_ease-in-out_infinite] (underscores spaces ban jate hain).
  • CSS variable shorthand: animate-(--my-animation) = animate-[var(--my-animation)].

Theme me custom animation define karna — @theme ke andar @keyframes ke saath --animate-* variables:

css
@theme {
  --animate-wiggle: wiggle 1s ease-in-out infinite;

  @keyframes wiggle {
    0%, 100% { transform: rotate(-3deg); }
    50% { transform: rotate(3deg); }
  }
}
html
<div class="animate-wiggle"><!-- ... --></div>

Variants: breakpoint variants lagu hote hain, jaise animate-none md:animate-spin.

Transitions banam animations (interview point): transitions do states ke beech animate karte hain (ek trigger chahiye: hover, class change); animations keyframes se apne aap chalte hain aur anant loop kar sakte hain, isiliye spinners/pulses/bounces animate-* hain jabki hover colour changes transition-* hain.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/animation
← Previous155 · transition-delay→ Next157 · backface-visibility
157Transforms

backface-visibility

Is section me hum backface-visibility ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: 3D me element ko viewer se door ghumane par uska backface (uska ulta hissa) dikhai deta hai ya nahi, ise control karne ki utilities.

Utility classes:

ClassStyles
backface-hiddenbackface-visibility: hidden;
backface-visiblebackface-visibility: visible;

Mukhya avdhaarana: Ek 3D scene me (jaise chhah faces se bana cube), har face ka ek front aur ek back hota hai. backface-visible (default vyavhaar) ke saath, tum kisi face ka mirror wala peeche ka hissa dekh sakte ho chahe wo view se door ghuma ho; backface-hidden ke saath, door ghume faces gayab ho jate hain. Docs demo chhah faces se ek cube banata hai (translate-z-12, rotate-x-0, rotate-y-90, -rotate-y-90, rotate-x-90, -rotate-x-90, wagera) aur fark dikhata hai: backface-hidden ke saath tum sirf apni taraf wale faces dekhte ho; backface-visible ke saath tum door wale faces ke peeche bhi dekhte ho.

html
<div class="size-20 ...">
  <div class="translate-z-12 rotate-x-0 bg-sky-300/75 backface-hidden ...">1</div>
  <div class="-translate-z-12 rotate-y-18 bg-sky-300/75 backface-hidden ...">2</div>
  <div class="translate-x-12 rotate-y-90 bg-sky-300/75 backface-hidden ...">3</div>
  <div class="-translate-x-12 -rotate-y-90 bg-sky-300/75 backface-hidden ...">4</div>
  <div class="-translate-y-12 rotate-x-90 bg-sky-300/75 backface-hidden ...">5</div>
  <div class="translate-y-12 -rotate-x-90 bg-sky-300/75 backface-hidden ...">6</div>
</div>

Variants: breakpoint variants lagu hote hain, jaise backface-visible md:backface-hidden.

Interview ki baatein: classic istemal card-flip asar hai — card ke front aur back dono faces ko backface-hidden milta hai taaki sirf wo face dikhe jo abhi viewer ki taraf hai; iske bina, back face mirror hokar dikhta hai. Ye sirf 3D transforms (rotate-x/y, perspective, transform-3d) ke jod me mayne rakhta hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/backface-visibility
← Previous156 · animation→ Next158 · perspective
158Transforms

perspective

Is section me hum perspective ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: 3D space me rakhne par kisi element ke perspective ko control karne ki utilities — matlab z-plane (viewer/camera) screen se kitni door hai. Chhote values = zyada naatakiya, badha-chadha 3D vikriti; bade values = sapaat, halka 3D.

Utility classes:

ClassStyles
perspective-dramaticperspective: var(--perspective-dramatic); /* 100px */
perspective-nearperspective: var(--perspective-near); /* 300px */
perspective-normalperspective: var(--perspective-normal); /* 500px */
perspective-midrangeperspective: var(--perspective-midrange); /* 800px */
perspective-distantperspective: var(--perspective-distant); /* 1200px */
perspective-noneperspective: none;
perspective-(<custom-property>)perspective: var(<custom-property>);
perspective-[<value>]perspective: *<value>*;

Mukhya avdhaarana: "Ye kisi camera ko kisi vastu ke paas ya door le jaane jaisa hai." Docs demo ek hi cube ko perspective-dramatic banam perspective-normal ke neeche dikhata hai — dramatic mazboot roop se chhota-dikhta hai, normal shaant lagta hai. Perspective parent par jaata hai (3D-transformed children ka container), transformed element par khud nahi.

html
<div class="size-20 perspective-dramatic ...">
  <div class="translate-z-12 rotate-x-0 bg-sky-300/75 ...">1</div>
  <!-- ... other cube faces ... -->
</div>

Perspective hatana: perspective-none — <div class="perspective-none ..."><!-- ... --></div>.

Custom values:

  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): perspective-[750px].
  • CSS variable shorthand: perspective-(--my-perspective) = perspective-[var(--my-perspective)].

Theme customise karna — --perspective-* variables:

css
@theme {
  --perspective-remote: 1800px;
}
html
<div class="perspective-remote"><!-- ... --></div>

Variants: breakpoint variants lagu hote hain, jaise perspective-midrange md:perspective-dramatic.

Interview ki baatein: perspective ek parent property hai (ye children ko ek shared vanishing point deti hai); chhota px value = zyada mazboot 3D asar; bina kisi perspective ke, rotate-x/rotate-y sapaat/orthographic dikhte hain. Element par khud transform: perspective(...) se mat uljhao.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/perspective
← Previous157 · backface-visibility→ Next159 · perspective-origin
159Transforms

perspective-origin

Is section me hum perspective-origin ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: kisi element ke perspective origin ko control karne ki utilities — perspective ka vanishing point kahan sthit hai (matlab viewer kahan se dekh raha hai).

Utility classes (saari nau positions aur custom):

ClassStyles
perspective-origin-centerperspective-origin: center;
perspective-origin-topperspective-origin: top;
perspective-origin-top-rightperspective-origin: top right;
perspective-origin-rightperspective-origin: right;
perspective-origin-bottom-rightperspective-origin: bottom right;
perspective-origin-bottomperspective-origin: bottom;
perspective-origin-bottom-leftperspective-origin: bottom left;
perspective-origin-leftperspective-origin: left;
perspective-origin-top-leftperspective-origin: top left;
perspective-origin-(<custom-property>)perspective-origin: var(<custom-property>);
perspective-origin-[<value>]perspective-origin: <value>;

Mukhya avdhaarana: vanishing point origin ke saath chalta hai — docs demo ek hi cube ko perspective-origin-top-left banam perspective-origin-bottom-right ke saath dikhata hai, jo badal deta hai ki 3D gehraai kis disha me peeche jaati dikhti hai. Ye ek hi parent par perspective-* utility ke saath istemal hota hai.

html
<div class="size-20 perspective-near perspective-origin-top-left ...">
  <div class="translate-z-12 rotate-x-0 bg-sky-300/75 ...">1</div>
  <!-- ... other cube faces ... -->
</div>
<div class="size-20 perspective-near perspective-origin-bottom-right …">
  <!-- ... -->
</div>

Custom values:

  • Arbitrary (underscores spaces ban jate hain): perspective-origin-[200%_150%].
  • CSS variable shorthand: perspective-origin-(--my-perspective-origin).

Variants: breakpoint variants lagu hote hain, jaise perspective-origin-center md:perspective-origin-bottom-left.

Interview ki baatein: perspective-origin transform-origin ka 3D saathi hai — ek tay karta hai ki viewer/vanishing point kahan hai, dusra element ke apne transform ka pivot point tay karta hai. Dono ek hi nau position keywords svikaar karte hain.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/perspective-origin
← Previous158 · perspective→ Next160 · rotate
160Transforms

rotate

Is section me hum rotate ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: elements ko ghumane ki utilities, 2D me (rotate property) aur 3D me (transform se rotateX/rotateY/rotateZ).

Utility classes (fetched page me jaisi dikhi; header savdhaani dekho — fetched extraction me rotate-x-* rows dikhi lekin rotate-y-*/rotate-z-* table rows extraction me dikhai nahi di, haalaanki prose teeno axes cover karta hai):

ClassStyles
rotate-nonerotate: none;
rotate-<number>rotate: <number>deg;
-rotate-<number>rotate: calc(<number>deg * -1);
rotate-(<custom-property>)rotate: var(<custom-property>);
rotate-[<value>]rotate: <value>;
rotate-x-<number>transform: rotateX(<number>deg) var(--tw-rotate-y);
-rotate-x-<number>transform: rotateX(-<number>deg) var(--tw-rotate-y);
rotate-x-(<custom-property>)transform: rotateX(var(<custom-property>)) var(--tw-rotate-y);
rotate-x-[<value>]transform: rotateX(<value>) var(--tw-rotate-y);
rotate-y-<number>transform: var(--tw-rotate-x) rotateY(<number>deg);
(plus rotate-y-* negative/custom/arbitrary and rotate-z-* forms, per the docs prose — re-verify the full table on the live page)

2D rotation — positive (clockwise) aur negative (counterclockwise):

html
<img class="rotate-45 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
<img class="rotate-90 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
<img class="rotate-210 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
html
<img class="-rotate-45 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
<img class="-rotate-90 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
<img class="-rotate-210 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />

3D rotation — axes ko jodo:

html
<img class="rotate-x-50 rotate-z-45 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
<img class="rotate-x-15 -rotate-y-30 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
<img class="rotate-y-25 rotate-z-30 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />

Custom values:

  • Arbitrary angle units: rotate-[3.142rad].
  • CSS variable shorthand: rotate-(--my-rotation) = rotate-[var(--my-rotation)].

Variants: breakpoint variants lagu hote hain, jaise rotate-45 md:rotate-60.

Interview points:

  • rotate-<number> standalone CSS rotate property (degrees) istemal karta hai, jabki rotate-x/y/z-* transform property istemal karte hain — dono swatantra roop se judte hain, isiliye rotate-45 aur rotate-x-50 ko joda ja sakta hai.
  • Numbers dynamic hain — koi bhi degree value kaam karti hai (rotate-210, sirf 45/90/180 nahi).
  • Pivot point transform-origin (origin-*) se control hota hai; default origin centre hai.
Live check — docs table se zyada

Page ki prose khud kehti hai: rotate-x-<number>, rotate-y-<number> aur rotate-z-<number> ko saath use karke element ko 3D space me rotate kar sakte ho — jaise rotate-x-50, -rotate-y-30, rotate-z-45. Table me rotate-y-*/rotate-z-* ki saari rows nahi dikhti, lekin wo rotate-x-* wala hi pattern follow karti hain (negative, custom-property aur arbitrary forms ke saath).

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/rotate
← Previous159 · perspective-origin→ Next161 · scale
161Transforms

scale

Is section me hum scale ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: standalone CSS scale property istemal karke elements ko scale karne (bada/chhota karne) ki utilities, ek samaan ya har axis par.

Utility classes:

ClassStyles
scale-nonescale: none;
scale-<number>scale: <number>% <number>%;
-scale-<number>scale: calc(<number>% * -1) calc(<number>% * -1);
scale-(<custom-property>)scale: var(<custom-property>) var(<custom-property>);
scale-[<value>]scale: <value>;
scale-x-<number>scale: <number>% var(--tw-scale-y);
-scale-x-<number>scale: calc(<number>% * -1) var(--tw-scale-y);
scale-x-(<custom-property>)scale: var(<custom-property>) var(--tw-scale-y);
scale-x-[<value>]scale: <value> var(--tw-scale-y);
scale-y-<number>scale: var(--tw-scale-x) <number>%;
(plus scale-y-* negative/custom/arbitrary forms)

Khaas baatein:

  • Number ek percentage hai: scale-75 = asli size ka 75%, scale-100 = asli, scale-125 = 125%, scale-150 = 150%.
  • Uniform:
html
<img class="scale-75 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
<img class="scale-100 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
<img class="scale-125 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  • X-axis sirf / Y-axis sirf:
html
<img class="scale-x-75 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
<img class="scale-x-100 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
<img class="scale-x-125 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
html
<img class="scale-y-75 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
<img class="scale-y-100 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
<img class="scale-y-125 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  • Negative values mirror aur scale karte hain (element ko palat dete hain):
html
<img class="-scale-x-75 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
<img class="-scale-100 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
<img class="-scale-y-125 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />

Custom values:

  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): scale-[1.7].
  • CSS variable shorthand: scale-(--my-scale) = scale-[var(--my-scale)].

Variants: state variants pramanik demo hain — scale-95 hover:scale-120 (hover par element badhta hai). Breakpoint variants bhi lagu hote hain.

Interview ki baatein: scaling layout nahi badalta — element apna asli layout box banaye rakhta hai (saare transforms ki tarah); -scale-x-100 classic horizontal flip hai; scale-* standalone scale property istemal karta hai, to ye purani akeli transform property ke vipreet rotate-*/translate-* ke saath bina unhe mitaaye judta hai. Transitions ke liye, transition-transform ke saath jodo.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/scale
← Previous160 · rotate→ Next162 · skew
162Transforms

skew

Is section me hum skew ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: transform se elements ko skew karne ki utilities — unhe X aur/ya Y axis ke saath tedha karna.

Utility classes:

ClassStyles
skew-<number>transform: skewX(<number>deg) skewY(<number>deg);
-skew-<number>transform: skewX(-<number>deg) skewY(-<number>deg);
skew-(<custom-property>)transform: skewX(var(<custom-property>)) skewY(var(<custom-property>));
skew-[<value>]transform: skewX(<value>) skewY(<value>);
skew-x-<number>transform: skewX(<number>deg));
-skew-x-<number>transform: skewX(-<number>deg));
skew-x-(<custom-property>)transform: skewX(var(<custom-property>));
skew-x-[<value>]transform: skewX(<value>));
skew-y-<number>transform: skewY(<number>deg);
-skew-y-<number>transform: skewY(-<number>deg);
skew-y-(<custom-property>)transform: skewY(var(<custom-property>));
skew-y-[<value>]transform: skewY(<value>);

Docs ke examples:

  • Dono axes: skew-3, skew-6, skew-12 (aur negatives -skew-3, -skew-6, -skew-12).
  • X-axis only: -skew-x-12, skew-x-6, skew-x-12.
  • Y-axis sirf: -skew-y-12, skew-y-6, skew-y-12.
html
<img class="skew-3 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
<img class="skew-6 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
<img class="skew-12 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
html
<img class="-skew-x-12 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
<img class="skew-x-6 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
<img class="skew-x-12 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />

Custom values:

  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): skew-[3.142rad].
  • CSS variable shorthand: skew-(--my-skew) = skew-[var(--my-skew)].

Variants: breakpoint variants lagu hote hain, jaise skew-3 md:skew-12.

Interview ki baatein: rotate/scale/translate ke vipreet, skew-* ab bhi transform property istemal karta hai (rotate ke saath --tw-skew-x/--tw-skew-y jod se — transform-gpu/transform-cpu dekho); skewing se hi tedhe/italic-style section backgrounds aur "parallelogram" buttons bante hain; number degrees hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/skew
← Previous161 · scale→ Next163 · transform
163Transforms

transform

Is section me hum transform ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: elements ko transform karne ki utilities — nichle-star ke controls: GPU/CPU rendering majboor karna, saare transforms hatana, ya ek poori tarah custom transform value set karna. (Tailwind v4 me, rotate/scale/translate/skew zyadatar standalone CSS properties istemal karte hain; ye page transform property ko khud cover karta hai.)

Utility classes:

ClassStyles
transform-(<custom-property>)transform: var(<custom-property>);
transform-[<value>]transform: <value>;
transform-nonetransform: none;
transform-gputransform: translateZ(0) var(--tw-rotate-x) var(--tw-rotate-y) var(--tw-rotate-z) var(--tw-skew-x) var(--tw-skew-y);
transform-cputransform: var(--tw-rotate-x) var(--tw-rotate-y) var(--tw-rotate-z) var(--tw-skew-x) var(--tw-skew-y);

Khaas baatein:

  • Hardware acceleration: agar koi transition GPU dwara render hone par behtar pradarshan karta hai, to use transform-gpu se majboor karo — ye translateZ(0) jodta hai, jo element ko uski apni compositor layer par le jaata hai:
html
<div class="scale-150 transform-gpu"><!-- ... --></div>
  • transform-cpu use hata deta hai — cheezon ko CPU par wapas majboor karta hai (wahi transform chain, translateZ(0) ke bina).
  • Saare transforms ek saath hatao: transform-none, jaise skew-y-3 md:transform-none (chhoti screens par skewed, md aur upar untransformed).
html
<div class="skew-y-3 md:transform-none"><!-- ... --></div>

Custom values:

  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): transform-[matrix(1,2,3,4,5,6)].
  • CSS variable shorthand: transform-(--my-transform) = transform-[var(--my-transform)].

Interview ki baatein: translateZ(0) / transform-gpu classic "GPU compositing majboor karo" wali chaal hai, lekin iska zyada istemal memory khata hai (har promoted layer GPU memory istemal karti hai) — ise sirf wahan istemal karo jahan transition asal me atakti ho; transform-none wo reset hai jo kisi breakpoint ya state par dusri utilities dwara set rotate/skew/translate ko mita deta hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/transform
← Previous162 · skew→ Next164 · transform-origin
164Transforms

transform-origin

Is section me hum transform-origin ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: kisi element ke transformations ke liye origin (pivot point) batane ki utilities — wo bindu jiske chaaron or rotate, scale, skew wagera hote hain. Default centre hai.

Utility classes:

ClassStyles
origin-centertransform-origin: center;
origin-toptransform-origin: top;
origin-top-righttransform-origin: top right;
origin-righttransform-origin: right;
origin-bottom-righttransform-origin: bottom right;
origin-bottomtransform-origin: bottom;
origin-bottom-lefttransform-origin: bottom left;
origin-lefttransform-origin: left;
origin-top-lefttransform-origin: top left;
origin-(<custom-property>)transform-origin: var(<custom-property>);
origin-[<value>]transform-origin: <value>;

Example — ek hi rotate alag-alag origins ke saath bilkul alag dikhta hai:

html
<img class="origin-center rotate-45 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
<img class="origin-top-left rotate-12 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
<img class="origin-bottom -rotate-12 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />

Custom values:

  • Arbitrary (underscores spaces ban jate hain): origin-[33%_75%].
  • CSS variable shorthand: origin-(--my-transform-origin) = origin-[var(--my-transform-origin)].

Variants: breakpoint variants lagu hote hain, jaise origin-center md:origin-top.

Interview ki baatein: origin hi kaaran hai ki origin-top se scale hone wala dropdown apne trigger se neeche ki taraf badhta dikhta hai, jabki origin-center beech se badhta hai; origin-top-left + rotate se "hinge" asar bante hain. Note karo class prefix origin-* hai, transform-origin-* nahi.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/transform-origin
← Previous163 · transform→ Next165 · transform-style
165Transforms

transform-style

Is section me hum transform-style ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: kisi element ke children 3D space me rakhe jate hain ya nahi, ise control karne ki utilities (transform-style).

Utility classes:

ClassStyles
transform-3dtransform-style: preserve-3d;
transform-flattransform-style: flat;

Mukhya avdhaarana: transform-3d (preserve-3d) children ko apni 3D positions banaye rakhne deta hai — docs demo ek hi chhah-face cube ko transform-flat (faces ek sapaat 2D rendering me gir jate hain) banam transform-3d (ek asal cube) ke saath dikhata hai. Page se uddharan: "Iske bina, koi bhi children sirf 2D space me transform honge, 3D space me nahi."

html
<div class="size-20 transform-flat ...">
  <div class="translate-z-12 rotate-x-0 bg-sky-300/75 ...">1</div>
  <!-- ... faces 2–6 ... -->
</div>
<div class="size-20 transform-3d ...">
  <div class="translate-z-12 rotate-x-0 bg-sky-300/75 ...">1</div>
  <!-- ... faces 2–6 ... -->
</div>

Variants: breakpoint variants lagu hote hain, jaise transform-3d md:transform-flat.

Interview ki baatein: preserve-3d 3D children ke parent par jaata hai (perspective jaisa hi pattern); ye nested 3D ke liye zaroori hai — jaise ghumte container ke andar ek cube, ya translate-z-* children (translate dekho: translate-z-* ko parent par transform-3d chahiye). flat default hai aur wapas bahar nikalne ka tareeka hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/transform-style
← Previous164 · transform-origin→ Next166 · translate
166Transforms

translate

Is section me hum translate ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: standalone CSS translate property istemal karke elements ko X, Y aur Z axes ke saath translate karne (hilane) ki utilities.

Utility classes:

ClassStyles
translate-<number>translate: calc(var(--spacing) * <number>) calc(var(--spacing) * <number>);
-translate-<number>translate: calc(var(--spacing) * -<number>) calc(var(--spacing) * -<number>);
translate-<fraction>translate: calc(<fraction> * 100%) calc(<fraction> * 100%);
-translate-<fraction>translate: calc(<fraction> * -100%) calc(<fraction> * -100%);
translate-fulltranslate: 100% 100%;
-translate-fulltranslate: -100% -100%;
translate-pxtranslate: 1px 1px;
-translate-pxtranslate: -1px -1px;
translate-(<custom-property>)translate: var(<custom-property>) var(<custom-property>);
translate-[<value>]translate: <value> <value>;
(plus translate-x-*, translate-y-*, translate-z-* forms — number, fraction, px, full, negative, custom-property and arbitrary)

Khaas baatein:

  • Spacing scale (dono axes): translate-<number> dono axes par calc(var(--spacing) * <number>) se chalta hai — jaise translate-2, -translate-4, translate-8:
html
<img class="-translate-6 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
<img class="translate-2 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
<img class="translate-8 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  • Fractions (element ke apne size ka percentage, dono axes): translate-1/4, -translate-full, translate-1/2, translate-1/6:
html
<img class="-translate-1/4 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
<img class="translate-1/6 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
<img class="translate-1/2 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  • X-axis sirf: translate-x-4, translate-x-1/4, -translate-x-4, translate-x-1/2.
  • Y-axis sirf: translate-y-6, translate-y-1/3, -translate-y-4, translate-y-1/2.
  • Z-axis (3D): translate-z-6, -translate-z-12, translate-z-2, translate-z-1/2 — parent element par transform-3d chahiye:
html
<div class="transform-3d">
  <img class="-translate-z-8 rotate-x-50 rotate-z-45 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  <img class="translate-z-2 rotate-x-50 rotate-z-45 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
  <img class="translate-z-1/2 rotate-x-50 rotate-z-45 ..." src="/img/mountains.jpg" />
</div>

Custom values:

  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): translate-[3.142rad] (as shown on the page).
  • CSS variable shorthand: translate-(--my-translate) = translate-[var(--my-translate)].

Variants: breakpoint variants lagu hote hain, jaise translate-45 md:translate-60.

Interview points:

  • translate-1/2 element ke apne size ke 50% se chalta hai — classic centring chaal hai absolute left-1/2 top-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2.
  • Translate karna layout ko prabhavit nahi karta (element ki asli jagah bani rehti hai) aur GPU-friendly hai — isiliye animations me cheezon ko hilane ka sujhaya gaya tareeka translate hai (top/left/margin nahi).
  • hover:-translate-y-1 standard "hover par uthana" micro-interaction hai (transition + duration-* ke saath joda gaya).
  • Spacing-based numbers --spacing theme variable istemal karte hain, to translate-4 = calc(var(--spacing) * 4).
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/translate
← Previous165 · transform-style→ Next167 · zoom
167Transforms

zoom

Is section me hum zoom ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: CSS zoom property istemal karke elements ko scale karne ki utilities (scale ke vipreet, jo scale property istemal karta hai).

Utility classes:

ClassStyles
zoom-<number>zoom: <number>%;
zoom-(<custom-property>)zoom: var(<custom-property>);
zoom-[<value>]zoom: <value>;

Khaas baatein:

  • Number ek percentage hai: zoom-75, zoom-100, zoom-125.
html
<div class="zoom-75 ..."><!-- ... --></div>
<div class="zoom-100 ..."><!-- ... --></div>
<div class="zoom-125 ..."><!-- ... --></div>
  • zoom banam scale: zoom asal me element ka layout size badal deta hai (ye element ka size badalne jaisa vyavhaar karta hai — content naye size ke chaaron or reflow hota hai), jabki scale ek visual transform hai jo layout box ko achhoota chhodta hai. Sikhaane wala mukhya fark yehi hai.

Custom values:

  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): zoom-[1.1].
  • CSS variable shorthand: zoom-(--my-zoom) = zoom-[var(--my-zoom)].

Variants: state variants, jaise zoom-100 hover:zoom-125; breakpoint variants, jaise zoom-100 md:zoom-125.

Interview ki baatein: zoom ek nayi maanakikrit CSS property hai (browsers me lambe samay tak non-standard rahi); sirf-visual asaron ke liye scale istemal karo aur zoom tab jab scaled size ko layout me hissa lena chahiye.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/zoom
← Previous166 · translate→ Next168 · accent-color
168Interactivity

accent-color

Is section me hum accent-color ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye section asal docs ko taaza padhkar verify kiya gaya hai.

Ye utilities accented colour of a form control. ko control karne ke liye hain.

Class table (pehli rows dikhayi gayi; poora colour scale lagu hota hai)

ClassStyles
accent-inheritaccent-color: inherit;
accent-currentaccent-color: currentColor;
accent-transparentaccent-color: transparent;
accent-blackaccent-color: var(--color-black); /* #000 */
accent-whiteaccent-color: var(--color-white); /* #fff */
accent-red-50 … accent-red-400 (and the full palette)accent-color: var(--color-red-50); /* oklch(97.1% 0.013 17.38) */ etc.
accent-(<custom-property>)accent-color: var(<custom-property>);
accent-[<value>]accent-color: <value>;

How it works

  • Checked checkbox (ya radio group) par accent-pink-500 browser ke default accent colour ko override karta hai — bina custom markup ke native checkboxes aur radio buttons ko style karne ke liye kaam ka.
  • Opacity modifier: accent-purple-500/25, accent-purple-500/75 — note karo docs kehte hain accent-colour opacity ka browser support seemit hai aur is samay ye sirf Firefox me kaam karta hai.
  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): accent-[#50d71e]; CSS variable shorthand: accent-(--my-accent-color) (= accent-[var(--my-accent-color)]).
  • State variant: accent-black hover:accent-pink-500; responsive: accent-black md:accent-pink-500.
  • Theme: @theme { --color-regal-blue: #243c5a; } → accent-regal-blue works in markup.

Aam galtiyaan / interview points

  • accent-color sirf native form controls ko prabhavit karta hai (checkbox, radio, range, progress) — ye custom-bane controls ko style nahi karta.
  • Accent colour ke liye opacity modifier likhne ke samay Firefox-only hai.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/accent-color
← Previous167 · zoom→ Next169 · appearance
169Interactivity

appearance

Is section me hum appearance ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: native form-control styling ko dabane ki utilities (appearance) — <select>, checkboxes aur inputs jaise elements se browser ka andar-bana look hatana taaki tum unhe khud style kar sako.

Utility classes:

ClassStyles
appearance-noneappearance: none;
appearance-autoappearance: auto;

Khaas baatein:

  • appearance-none browser-specific styling reset karta hai. Docs example: ek native <select> banam appearance-none wala ek aur grid me upar rakha custom chevron SVG (SVG ko pointer-events-none milta hai taaki clicks select tak guzar jayein):
html
<select>
  <option>Yes</option>
  <option>No</option>
  <option>Maybe</option>
</select>
<div class="grid">
  <select class="col-start-1 row-start-1 appearance-none bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 ...">
    <option>Yes</option>
    <option>No</option>
    <option>Maybe</option>
  </select>
  <svg class="pointer-events-none col-start-1 row-start-1 ..."><!-- ... --></svg>
</div>

"Ye utility aksar custom form components banate waqt istemal hoti hai."
