  • appearance-auto default browser styling ko bahaal karta hai. Docs ka mukhya use case accessibility modes hai: appearance-none se bana custom checkbox forced-colors mode me standard browser control par wapas jana chahiye, forced-colors: variant istemal karke:
html
<label>
  <div>
    <input type="checkbox" class="appearance-none forced-colors:appearance-auto ..." />
    <svg class="invisible peer-checked:visible forced-colors:hidden ..."><!-- ... --></svg>
  </div>
  Falls back to default appearance
</label>
<label>
  <div>
    <input type="checkbox" class="appearance-none ..." />
    <svg class="invisible peer-checked:visible ..."><!-- ... --></svg>
  </div>
  Keeps custom appearance
</label>

"Ye kuch accessibility modes me standard browser controls par wapas jaane ke liye kaam ka hai."

Variants: breakpoint variants lagu hote hain, jaise appearance-auto md:appearance-none.

Interview ki baatein: appearance-none lagbhag har custom select/checkbox/radio ka pehla kadam hai; jo sahuliyat tumne hatayi use wapas jodna yaad rakho (focus styles, dropdown arrow, check mark) — bina custom arrow ke khaali appearance-none select toota hua lagta hai. Windows High Contrast / forced-colors users ke liye forced-colors:appearance-auto ke saath jodo.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/appearance
← Previous168 · accent-color→ Next170 · caret-color
170Interactivity

caret-color

Is section me hum caret-color ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: text-input cursor ke rang ko control karne ki utilities (caret — <input>/<textarea>/contenteditable ke andar chamakta insertion point).

Utility classes: caret-* ke roop me poora colour palette, aur specials:

ClassStyles
caret-inheritcaret-color: inherit;
caret-currentcaret-color: currentColor;
caret-transparentcaret-color: transparent;
caret-blackcaret-color: var(--color-black); /* #000 */
caret-whitecaret-color: var(--color-white); /* #fff */
caret-red-50 … caret-red-400 … (and every other palette colour/shade, e.g. caret-rose-500, caret-lime-600, caret-pink-500)caret-color: var(--color-<name>);

Example — ek textarea me gulabi caret (ise dekhne ke liye textarea ko focus karo):

html
<textarea class="caret-pink-500 ..."></textarea>

Custom values:

  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): caret-[#50d71e].
  • CSS variable shorthand: caret-(--my-caret-color) = caret-[var(--my-caret-color)].

Variants: breakpoint variants lagu hote hain, jaise caret-rose-500 md:caret-lime-600.

Theme customise karna — --color-* variables:

css
@theme {
  --color-regal-blue: #243c5a;
}
html
<textarea class="caret-regal-blue"></textarea>

Interview ki baatein: caret insertion cursor hai, mouse pointer nahi (wo cursor-* hai); caret-transparent caret ko chhupata hai (read-only-dikhne wale inputs ya custom caret implementations ke liye istemal); caret-current caret ko text colour follow karata hai. Ye sirf editable text me dikhta hai — ek saade <div> par ye kuch nahi karta.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/caret-color
← Previous169 · appearance→ Next171 · color-scheme
171Interactivity

color-scheme

Is section me hum color-scheme ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: kisi element ke color-scheme ko control karne ki utilities — browser ko batana ki element kaunsi colour schemes support karta hai, taaki browser uske native UI (form controls, scrollbars, date pickers, wagera) ko usi ke hisaab se light ya dark mode me render kare.

Utility classes:

ClassStyles
scheme-normalcolor-scheme: normal;
scheme-darkcolor-scheme: dark;
scheme-lightcolor-scheme: light;
scheme-light-darkcolor-scheme: light dark;
scheme-only-darkcolor-scheme: only dark;
scheme-only-lightcolor-scheme: only light;

Example — ek hi date input teen schemes ke neeche render hua (fark dekhne ke liye apni system colour scheme badal kar dekho):

html
<div class="scheme-light ..."><input type="date" /></div>
<div class="scheme-dark ..."><input type="date" /></div>
<div class="scheme-light-dark ..."><input type="date" /></div>

Mukhya fark:

  • scheme-light-dark = element dono support karta hai; browser user ki pasand ke hisaab se chunta hai.
  • scheme-only-dark / scheme-only-light = sirf wahi scheme supported hai (only keyword browser ko fallback karne se rokta hai).
  • scheme-normal = default (default vyavhaar viraasat me leta/istemal karta hai).

Variants: state variants pramanik demo hain — scheme ko <html> par rakho aur dark: se palto:

html
<html class="scheme-light dark:scheme-dark ..."><!-- ... --></html>

Interview ki baatein: color-scheme tumhare apne CSS ko style nahi karta — ye control karta hai ki browser ke andar-bane controls kaise dikhte hain (ek dark color-scheme native inputs, scrollbars aur date picker ko dark bana deta hai). Ye dark: mode ka saathi hai: <html> par scheme-light dark:scheme-dark set karo taaki native controls tumhari theme se milein. light dark (dono soochibaddh) banam only dark ek aam chaal hai — only ke bina, browser ab bhi halke controls render kar sakta hai agar ye dark na kar sake.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/color-scheme
← Previous170 · caret-color→ Next172 · cursor
172Interactivity

cursor

Is section me hum cursor ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye section asal docs ko taaza padhkar verify kiya gaya hai.

Ye utilities cursor style when hovering over an element. ko control karne ke liye hain.

Class table (fetched text me jaisi dikhi)

ClassStyles
cursor-autocursor: auto;
cursor-defaultcursor: default;
cursor-pointercursor: pointer;
cursor-waitcursor: wait;
cursor-textcursor: text;
cursor-movecursor: move;
cursor-helpcursor: help;
cursor-not-allowedcursor: not-allowed;
cursor-nonecursor: none;
cursor-context-menucursor: context-menu;

Builder ke liye flag: fetched table cursor-context-menu par khatam hoti hai, lekin page ke apne examples cursor-grab aur cursor-progress bhi istemal karte hain (<button class="cursor-progress ...">Saving...</button>), jo nikali gayi table me nahi hain. Live table me shayad aur rows hain (jaise cursor-grab, cursor-grabbing, cursor-crosshair, cursor-zoom-in/out) — final karne se pehle poori list ke liye live page dobara check karo.

How it works

  • Clickable cheezon ke liye cursor-pointer (Submit button), chal rahe kaamon ke liye cursor-progress (Saving...), disabled kaamon ke liye cursor-not-allowed (Confirm, disabled).
  • Arbitrary value: cursor-[url(hand.cur),_pointer] (custom cursor image, underscores spaces ban jate hain).
  • CSS variable shorthand: cursor-(--my-cursor) (= cursor-[var(--my-cursor)]).
  • Responsive: cursor-not-allowed md:cursor-auto.

Aam galtiyaan / interview points

  • Tailwind v4 Preflight me, buttons cursor: default istemal karte hain (pointer nahi) — agar buttons par pointer cursor chahiye to cursor-pointer spasht roop se jodo, ya ek base-layer rule lagao.
  • cursor-none cursor ko poori tarah chhupata hai — kam istemal karo (sirf custom cursor anubhavon ke liye).
Live check — docs table se zyada

Upar wali table cursor-context-menu par khatm hoti hai, lekin page ke apne examples cursor-grab aur cursor-progress bhi use karte hain — ye dono bhi valid utilities hain jo table me nahi dikhti.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/cursor
← Previous171 · color-scheme→ Next173 · field-sizing
173Interactivity

field-sizing

Is section me hum field-sizing ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: form controls ki sizing ko control karne ki utilities — kya koi form control ek tay size rakhta hai ya apne content ke hisaab se badhta/sikudta hai.

Utility classes:

ClassStyles
field-sizing-fixedfield-sizing: fixed;
field-sizing-contentfield-sizing: content;

Khaas baatein:

  • field-sizing-content — control apne content ke hisaab se apna size badalta hai. Docs example: textarea me type karo aur ye badhta hai:
html
<textarea class="field-sizing-content ..." rows="2">Latex Salesman, Vanderlay Industries</textarea>
  • field-sizing-fixed — control ek tay size istemal karta hai (default vyavhaar); typing ise resize nahi karti:
html
<textarea class="field-sizing-fixed w-80 ..." rows="2">Latex Salesman, Vanderlay Industries</textarea>

Variants: breakpoint variants lagu hote hain, jaise field-sizing-content md:field-sizing-fixed (auto-growing on mobile, fixed from md up).

html
<input class="field-sizing-content md:field-sizing-fixed ..." />

Interview ki baatein: field-sizing: content auto-growing textarea scripts ka aadhunik, bina-JS badlaav hai (pehle tumhe scrollHeight maapne wala JS chahiye tha); ye text inputs/textareas (aur dusre form controls) par lagu hota hai; rows ab bhi shuruwaati size set karta hai. Browser support is group ki zyadatar utilities se naya hai — ise progressive-enhancement case ke roop me flag karo.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/field-sizing
← Previous172 · cursor→ Next174 · pointer-events
174Interactivity

pointer-events

Is section me hum pointer-events ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: koi element pointer events (mouse/touch/pen — :hover, click, wagera) par pratikriya deta hai ya nahi, ise control karne ki utilities.

Utility classes:

ClassStyles
pointer-events-autopointer-events: auto;
pointer-events-nonepointer-events: none;

Khaas baatein:

  • pointer-events-none kisi element ko pointer events nazarandaaz karata hai. Docs demo: ek input ke upar rakha search icon — pointer-events-auto ke saath icon clicks ko rok leta hai (tum input tak click-through nahi kar sakte); pointer-events-none ke saath clicks neeche wale input tak guzar jate hain:
html
<div class="relative ...">
  <div class="pointer-events-none absolute ...">
    <svg class="absolute h-5 w-5 text-gray-400"><!-- ... --></svg>
  </div>
  <input type="text" placeholder="Search" class="..." />
</div>
  • "Pointer events ab bhi child elements par trigger honge aur target ke 'neeche' wale elements tak pass-through honge." — matlab parent par pointer-events: none un children par events disable nahi karta jo inhe dobara enable karte hain, aur neeche wala element event praapt karta hai.
  • pointer-events-auto default browser vyavhaar par wapas jaata hai — pointer-events-none parent ke andar kisi child par events dobara enable karne ke liye, ya responsive roop se istemal hota hai:
html
<div class="pointer-events-none md:pointer-events-auto ..."><!-- ... --></div>

Interview ki baatein: #1 istemal sajawati overlays hain (icons, gradients, badges) jo clickable cheezon ke upar baithe hain; #2 istemal loading ke dauraan kisi link/button ko dikhne me aur kaam me disable karna hai — lekin note karo pointer-events-none keyboard focus disable nahi karta, to accessibility ke liye ye disabled attribute ka badlaav nahi hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/pointer-events
← Previous173 · field-sizing→ Next175 · resize
175Interactivity

resize

Is section me hum resize ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: kisi element ko user kaise resize kar sakta hai, ise control karne ki utilities (textareas par drag handle wagera).

Utility classes:

ClassStyles
resize-noneresize: none;
resizeresize: both;
resize-yresize: vertical;
resize-xresize: horizontal;

Docs ke examples (har demo me textarea handle ko kheench kar dekho):

  • Dono dishayein:
html
<textarea class="resize rounded-md ..."></textarea>
  • Vertical only:
html
<textarea class="resize-y rounded-md ..."></textarea>
  • Sirf horizontal:
html
<textarea class="resize-x rounded-md ..."></textarea>
  • Resizable nahi — "Note karo ki textarea handle gayab hai":
html
<textarea class="resize-none rounded-md"></textarea>

Variants: breakpoint variants lagu hote hain, jaise resize-none md:resize.

Interview ki baatein: resize ka asar sirf tab hota hai jab element overflow kar sake (vyavhaar me ise visible ke alawa overflow chahiye, aur ye browsers me default roop se <textarea> jaise elements par lagu hota hai); resize-none kisi designed form me textarea ka size lock karne ka standard tareeka hai. Note karo khaali class resize ka matlab dono hai — koi resize-both utility naam nahi hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/resize
← Previous174 · pointer-events→ Next176 · scroll-behavior
176Interactivity

scroll-behavior

Is section me hum scroll-behavior ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: kisi element ke scroll vyavhaar ko control karne ki utilities — turant jump banam smooth animated scrolling.

Utility classes:

ClassStyles
scroll-autoscroll-behavior: auto;
scroll-smoothscroll-behavior: smooth;

Khaas baatein:

  • scroll-smooth kisi element ke andar smooth scrolling enable karta hai — sabse aam taur par <html> par lagaya jata hai taaki anchor-link jumps animate hon:
html
<html class="scroll-smooth"><!-- ... --></html>
  • "scroll-behavior set karna sirf un scroll events ko prabhavit karta hai jo browser dwara trigger hote hain." — matlab ye navigation scrolls ko prabhavit karta hai (anchor jumps, bina spasht behaviour ke scrollIntoView, find-in-page) — ye un programmatic scrolls ko animate nahi karta jo apna behaviour batate hain, aur ye user ke wheel/touch scrolling ki speed ko prabhavit nahi karta.
  • scroll-auto default (turant) vyavhaar par wapas jaata hai:
html
<html class="scroll-smooth md:scroll-auto"><!-- ... --></html>

Interview ki baatein: <html> par scroll-smooth ek-line wala smooth-scroll implementation hai, lekin prefers-reduced-motion ka samman karo — ise motion-safe:scroll-smooth me lapeto taaki reduced-motion users ko ab bhi turant jumps milein. Ise aksar scroll-margin/scroll-padding se uljhaya jata hai, jo control karte hain ki scroll kahan rukta hai, kaise wahan pahunchta hai nahi.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/scroll-behavior
← Previous175 · resize→ Next177 · scrollbar-color
177Interactivity

scrollbar-color

Is section me hum scrollbar-color ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: kisi element ke scrollbar ke rang ko control karne ki utilities — thumb (kheenchne wala hissa) aur track (wo naali jisme ye chalta hai) ke liye alag-alag. CSS scrollbar-color property se --tw-scrollbar-thumb / --tw-scrollbar-track variables ke saath lagu.

Utility classes: dono hisson ke liye poora colour palette, aur specials (fetched text me table ka sirf upari hissa dikhaya gaya tha — pattern saare palette colours me ek samaan hai):

ClassStyles
scrollbar-thumb-inherit--tw-scrollbar-thumb: inherit; scrollbar-color: var(--tw-scrollbar-thumb) var(--tw-scrollbar-track);
scrollbar-thumb-current--tw-scrollbar-thumb: currentColor; scrollbar-color: var(--tw-scrollbar-thumb) var(--tw-scrollbar-track);
scrollbar-thumb-transparent--tw-scrollbar-thumb: transparent; scrollbar-color: var(--tw-scrollbar-thumb) var(--tw-scrollbar-track);
scrollbar-thumb-black--tw-scrollbar-thumb: var(--color-black); /* #000 */ scrollbar-color: var(--tw-scrollbar-thumb) var(--tw-scrollbar-track);
scrollbar-thumb-white--tw-scrollbar-thumb: var(--color-white); /* #fff */ scrollbar-color: …
scrollbar-thumb-red-50 … scrollbar-thumb-red-400 … (every palette colour/shade, e.g. scrollbar-thumb-sky-700, scrollbar-thumb-slate-900)--tw-scrollbar-thumb: var(--color-<name>); scrollbar-color: …
scrollbar-track-*same pattern, setting --tw-scrollbar-track instead

Example — thumb aur track swatantra roop se range gaye:

html
<div class="scrollbar-thumb-sky-700 scrollbar-track-sky-100 overflow-auto ..."><!-- ... --></div>

"Tum thumb aur track ke rang swatantra roop se set kar sakte ho. Agar tum ek ko dusre ke bina set karte ho, to na-set rang default roop se transparent ho jata hai."

Opacity modifier: scrollbar colours par bhi kaam karta hai:

html
<div class="scrollbar-thumb-slate-900/60 scrollbar-track-slate-900/10 ..."><!-- ... --></div>

Custom values:

  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): scrollbar-thumb-[#0f766e] scrollbar-track-[#ccfbf1].
  • CSS variable shorthand: scrollbar-thumb-(--my-scrollbar-thumb) scrollbar-track-(--my-scrollbar-track).

Variants: state variants, jaise scrollbar-thumb-sky-700 hover:scrollbar-thumb-sky-500; breakpoint variants, jaise scrollbar-thumb-slate-900 scrollbar-track-slate-200 md:scrollbar-thumb-sky-700.

Theme customise karna — --color-* variables:

css
@theme {
  --color-regal-blue: #243c5a;
}
html
<div class="scrollbar-thumb-regal-blue"><!-- ... --></div>

Interview ki baatein: scrollbar-color scrollbars ko rangne ka standard (Firefox-supported, ab cross-browser) tareeka hai — ye sirf do rang set karta hai (thumb + track), widths ya radii nahi; WebKit-style bareek styling ke liye tumhe ab bhi ::-webkit-scrollbar pseudo-elements chahiye. Dikhai dene ke liye ek scrollable element (overflow-auto wagera) chahiye. Thumb/track ka bantwara mukhya dimagi model hai: do utilities, ek property.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/scrollbar-color
← Previous176 · scroll-behavior→ Next178 · scrollbar-width
178Interactivity

scrollbar-width

Is section me hum scrollbar-width ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: kisi element ke scrollbar ki chaudaai ko control karne ki utilities (scrollbar-width property).

Utility classes:

ClassStyles
scrollbar-autoscrollbar-width: auto;
scrollbar-thinscrollbar-width: thin;
scrollbar-nonescrollbar-width: none;

Examples:

  • Default width:
html
<div class="scrollbar-auto overflow-auto ..."><!-- ... --></div>
  • Patla scrollbar:
html
<div class="scrollbar-thin overflow-auto ..."><!-- ... --></div>
  • Chhupa hua scrollbar, phir bhi scrollable — aam "scrollbar chhupao lekin scrolling rakho" wali chaal:
html
<div class="scrollbar-none overflow-auto ..."><!-- ... --></div>

Mukhya seema (page par batayi gayi): "Ye utilities sirf browser keywords auto, thin, aur none ko support karti hain." — koi arbitrary pixel width nahi hai; CSS me scrollbar-width sirf yehi teen keywords svikaar karta hai.

Variants: breakpoint variants lagu hote hain, jaise scrollbar-none md:scrollbar-auto.

Interview ki baatein: scrollbar-none scrollbar ko scrolling disable kiye bina chhupata hai (overflow-hidden ke vipreet, jo scrolling ko poori tarah khatam kar deta hai) — horizontal carousels aur chat lists ke liye standard vikalp. Accessibility savdhaani: scrollbar chhupana us dikhai dene wale sanket ko hata deta hai ki content scrollable hai, to ise kisi dusre sanket ke saath jodo. scrollbar-thin sabse kam "ise kam mota karo" wala vikalp hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/scrollbar-width
← Previous177 · scrollbar-color→ Next179 · scrollbar-gutter
179Interactivity

scrollbar-gutter

Is section me hum scrollbar-gutter ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: gutter ko control karne ki utilities — kisi element ke scrollbar ke liye aarakshit jagah — taaki scrollbar aane ya gayab hone par content shift/jump na kare.

Utility classes:

ClassStyles
scrollbar-gutter-autoscrollbar-gutter: auto;
scrollbar-gutter-stablescrollbar-gutter: stable;
scrollbar-gutter-bothscrollbar-gutter: stable both-edges;

Khaas baatein:

  • scrollbar-gutter-stable scrollbar ke liye jagah aarakshit karta hai chahe element overflow na kar raha ho — layout apni jagah rehta hai chahe scrollbar abhi dikh raha ho ya na ho. Docs demo scrollbar-gutter-auto (scrollbar aane par content shift hota hai) banam scrollbar-gutter-stable (koi shift nahi) ki tulna karta hai:
html
<div class="scrollbar-gutter-stable overflow-auto ..."><!-- ... --></div>
  • scrollbar-gutter-both (stable both-edges) element ke dono taraf milti-julti gutter jagah aarakshit karta hai — centred layouts ke liye kaam ka taaki content asal me centre me rahe:
html
<div class="scrollbar-gutter-both overflow-auto ..."><!-- ... --></div>
  • scrollbar-gutter-auto gutter ki jagah sirf tab aarakshit karta hai jab browser aam taur par scrollbar dikhaye (default):
html
<div class="scrollbar-gutter-auto overflow-auto ..."><!-- ... --></div>

Variants: breakpoint variants lagu hote hain, jaise scrollbar-gutter-auto md:scrollbar-gutter-stable.

Interview ki baatein: ye "chhote page aur lambe page ke beech navigate karne par layout shift" (ya jab modal khulta hai aur page scrollbar gayab ho jata hai) ki theek hai — classic vaikalpik <html> par overflow-y: scroll majboor karna hai, jo hamesha scrollbar dikhata hai; scrollbar-gutter: stable jagah aarakshit karta hai bina zaroori taur par scrollbar rangye. both-edges centred-layout variant hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/scrollbar-gutter
← Previous178 · scrollbar-width→ Next180 · scroll-margin
180Interactivity

scroll-margin

Is section me hum scroll-margin ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: kisi snap container me items ke chaaron or scroll offset ko control karne ki utilities — matlab ek snapped item container ke kinare se kitni door rukta hai. (Naam ke bawajood, ye scroll-margin property hai, snap target par lagaya gaya offset — wo child jis tak scroll kiya ja raha hai.)

Utility classes (spacing-scale se chalti; table scroll-m-* / scroll-mx-* rows dikhati hai aur prose saari sides cover karta hai):

ClassStyles
scroll-m-<number>scroll-margin: calc(var(--spacing) * <number>);
-scroll-m-<number>scroll-margin: calc(var(--spacing) * -<number>);
scroll-m-pxscroll-margin: 1px;
-scroll-m-pxscroll-margin: -1px;
scroll-m-(<custom-property>)scroll-margin: var(<custom-property>);
scroll-m-[<value>]scroll-margin: <value>;
scroll-mx-<number>scroll-margin-inline: calc(var(--spacing) * <number>);
-scroll-mx-<number>scroll-margin-inline: calc(var(--spacing) * -<number>);
scroll-mx-px / -scroll-mx-pxscroll-margin-inline: 1px; / -1px;
(plus scroll-my-*, scroll-ms-*, scroll-me-*, scroll-mbs-*, scroll-mbe-*, scroll-mt-*, scroll-mr-*, scroll-mb-*, scroll-ml-* — same number/px/custom/arbitrary forms, negatives where applicable)

Khaas baatein:

  • Per-side: scroll-mt-*, scroll-mr-*, scroll-mb-*, scroll-ml-* — jaise scroll-ml-6 kisi snapped image ko ek horizontal snap container ke andar 6-unit left offset deta hai:
html
<div class="snap-x ...">
  <div class="snap-start scroll-ml-6 ..."><img src="/img/vacation-01.jpg" /></div>
  <div class="snap-start scroll-ml-6 ..."><img src="/img/vacation-02.jpg" /></div>
  <!-- ... -->
</div>
  • Negative values: - aage lagao, jaise -scroll-ml-6 snap position ko kinare se aage kheenchta hai.
  • Logical properties: scroll-ms-* / scroll-me-* scroll-margin-inline-start / -end set karte hain (text ki disha ke hisaab se left/right — docs ek hi markup ko dir="ltr" aur dir="rtl" me dikhate hain); scroll-mbs-* / scroll-mbe-* scroll-margin-block-start / -end set karte hain (writing mode ke hisaab se top/bottom). Docs disha-shart wali styles ke liye LTR/RTL modifiers ki taraf ishara karte hain.
  • Spacing scale: saari scroll-m-* / scroll-mx-* / scroll-my-* / scroll-ms-* / scroll-me-* / scroll-mbs-* / scroll-mbe-* / scroll-mt-* / scroll-mr-* / scroll-mb-* / scroll-ml-* utilities --spacing theme variable se chalti hain (@theme { --spacing: 1px; } se customise hoti hain).

Custom values:

  • Arbitrary: scroll-ml-[24rem].
  • CSS variable shorthand: scroll-ml-(--my-scroll-margin) = scroll-ml-[var(--my-scroll-margin)].

Variants: breakpoint variants lagu hote hain, jaise scroll-m-8 md:scroll-m-0.

Interview ki baatein: scroll-margin child (snap target) par jaata hai, scroll-padding container par jaata hai — in dono pages ke beech sabse zyada parakha gaya fark yehi hai. Roz ka istemal ek sticky header hai: sections ko scroll-mt-16 do taaki anchor jump heading ko fixed header ke neeche na chhupaye.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/scroll-margin
← Previous179 · scrollbar-gutter→ Next181 · scroll-padding
181Interactivity

scroll-padding

Is section me hum scroll-padding ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: kisi snap container ke andar kisi element ke scroll offset ko control karne ki utilities — matlab container ke scrollport par lagaya gaya inset, taaki snapped items container ke kinaron ke andar utni door ruken. (scroll-padding property; scroll-margin ki mirror image.)

Utility classes (spacing-scale se chalti):

ClassStyles
scroll-p-<number>scroll-padding: calc(var(--spacing) * <number>);
scroll-p-pxscroll-padding: 1px;
scroll-p-(<custom-property>)scroll-padding: var(<custom-property>);
scroll-p-[<value>]scroll-padding: <value>;
scroll-px-<number>scroll-padding-inline: calc(var(--spacing) * <number>);
scroll-px-pxscroll-padding-inline: 1px;
scroll-px-(<custom-property>) / scroll-px-[<value>]as above, for inline
scroll-py-<number>scroll-padding-block: calc(var(--spacing) * <number>);
scroll-py-pxscroll-padding-block: 1px;
(plus scroll-ps-*, scroll-pe-*, scroll-pbs-*, scroll-pbe-*, scroll-pt-*, scroll-pr-*, scroll-pb-*, scroll-pl-* — same forms; note: no negative scroll-padding utilities — padding cannot be negative)

Khaas baatein:

  • Per-side: scroll-pt-*, scroll-pr-*, scroll-pb-*, scroll-pl-* — jaise container par scroll-pl-6 har snapped child ko baayein kinare se 6 units offset karta hai:
html
<div class="snap-x scroll-pl-6 ...">
  <div class="snap-start ..."><img src="/img/vacation-01.jpg" /></div>
  <div class="snap-start ..."><img src="/img/vacation-02.jpg" /></div>
  <!-- ... -->
</div>
  • Logical properties: scroll-ps-* / scroll-pe-* = scroll-padding-inline-start / -end (disha ke hisaab se; docs dir="ltr" banam dir="rtl" dikhate hain); scroll-pbs-* / scroll-pbe-* = scroll-padding-block-start / -end (writing-mode ke hisaab se).
  • Spacing scale: saari scroll-p-* / scroll-px-* / scroll-py-* / scroll-ps-* / scroll-pe-* / scroll-pbs-* / scroll-pbe-* / scroll-pt-* / scroll-pr-* / scroll-pb-* / scroll-pl-* utilities --spacing theme variable se chalti hain (@theme { --spacing: 1px; }).

Custom values:

  • Arbitrary: scroll-pl-[24rem].
  • CSS variable shorthand: scroll-pl-(--my-scroll-padding) = scroll-pl-[var(--my-scroll-padding)].

Variants: breakpoint variants lagu hote hain, jaise scroll-p-8 md:scroll-p-0.

Interview ki baatein: scroll-padding = container par, ek value saare children ko cover karti hai (ek samaan insets ke liye achha, jaise ek carousel jo kinare se 1.5rem par rukna chahiye); scroll-margin = child par, har-item offsets (achha jab ek item ko alag offset chahiye). Scroll-margin ke vipreet, scroll-padding ka koi negative form nahi hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/scroll-padding
← Previous180 · scroll-margin→ Next182 · scroll-snap-align
182Interactivity

scroll-snap-align

Is section me hum scroll-snap-align ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: kisi element ke scroll snap alignment ko control karne ki utilities — scrolling rukne par snap container ke andar element kahan aakar rukta hai.

Utility classes:

ClassStyles
snap-startscroll-snap-align: start;
snap-endscroll-snap-align: end;
snap-centerscroll-snap-align: center;
snap-align-nonescroll-snap-align: none;

Examples (har ek vacation images ka snap-x container hai; snap point dekhne ke liye grid scroll karo):

  • Centre:
html
<div class="snap-x ...">
  <div class="snap-center ..."><img src="/img/vacation-01.jpg" /></div>
  <div class="snap-center ..."><img src="/img/vacation-02.jpg" /></div>
  <!-- ... -->
</div>
  • Start (item ka start kinara container ke start kinare ke saath align hota hai):
html
<div class="snap-x ...">
  <div class="snap-start ..."><img src="/img/vacation-01.jpg" /></div>
  <!-- ... -->
</div>
  • End (item ka end kinara container ke end kinare ke saath align hota hai):
html
<div class="snap-x ...">
  <div class="snap-end ..."><img src="/img/vacation-01.jpg" /></div>
  <!-- ... -->
</div>

Mukhya baat: snap-align children par jaata hai; snap type (snap-x wagera) container par jaata hai. Children par alignment ke bina, container ke snap type ke paas snap karne ko kuch nahi hai.

Variants: breakpoint variants lagu hote hain, jaise snap-center md:snap-start.

Interview ki baatein: snap-start carousels/galleries ke liye default vikalp hai; snap-center "beech wale card ko focus karo" UIs ke liye; snap-align-none ek akela child ko snapping se bahar karta hai jabki uske siblings ab bhi snap karte hain. "Start/end" disha ke hisaab se hain (RTL me, start = right).

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/scroll-snap-align
← Previous181 · scroll-padding→ Next183 · scroll-snap-stop
183Interactivity

scroll-snap-stop

Is section me hum scroll-snap-stop ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: user sambhav snap positions ko skip karke aage ja sakta hai ya nahi, ise control karne ki utilities — matlab kya ek tez fling ko har snap point par rukna hoga ya ye kai ke upar se ud sakta hai.

Utility classes:

ClassStyles
snap-normalscroll-snap-stop: normal;
snap-alwaysscroll-snap-stop: always;

Khaas baatein:

  • snap-always — container par snap-mandatory ke saath istemal hota hai taaki container ko hamesha kisi element par rukne par majboor kiya jaye isse pehle ki user agle item tak scroll jaari rakh sake. Har child ko snap-always milta hai (uske alignment ke saath, jaise snap-center):
html
<div class="snap-x snap-mandatory ...">
  <div class="snap-center snap-always ..."><img src="/img/vacation-01.jpg" /></div>
  <div class="snap-center snap-always ..."><img src="/img/vacation-02.jpg" /></div>
  <!-- ... -->
</div>
  • snap-normal — container ko snap positions se aage nikalne deta hai (default; ek tez swipe kai items ko paar kar sakta hai):
html
<div class="snap-x ...">
  <div class="snap-center snap-normal ..."><img src="/img/vacation-01.jpg" /></div>
  <!-- ... -->
</div>

Variants: breakpoint variants lagu hote hain, jaise snap-always md:snap-normal.

Interview ki baatein: snap-always sirf snap-mandatory ke saath mayne rakhta hai — snap-proximity ke saath browser pehle hi skip kar sakta hai; snap-mandatory + snap-always ka jod "paging" vyavhaar hai (har swipe par ek item, kabhi skip nahi), onboarding screens aur full-screen slide decks ke liye istemal hota hai. Naam ka jaal note karo: property scroll-snap-stop hai lekin classes snap-always/snap-normal hain, jo type aur align utilities ke saath snap- prefix share karti hain.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/scroll-snap-stop
← Previous182 · scroll-snap-align→ Next184 · scroll-snap-type
184Interactivity

scroll-snap-type

Is section me hum scroll-snap-type ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: kisi snap container me snap points kitni sakhti se lagu hote hain, ise control karne ki utilities — wo axis (ya axes) jo snap karti hai, aur sakhti. Ye scroll snapping ka container-side wala aadha hissa hai.

Utility classes:

ClassStyles
snap-nonescroll-snap-type: none;
snap-xscroll-snap-type: x var(--tw-scroll-snap-strictness);
snap-yscroll-snap-type: y var(--tw-scroll-snap-strictness);
snap-bothscroll-snap-type: both var(--tw-scroll-snap-strictness);
snap-mandatory--tw-scroll-snap-strictness: mandatory;
snap-proximity--tw-scroll-snap-strictness: proximity;

Khaas baatein:

  • Axis: snap-x (horizontal snapping), snap-y (vertical), snap-both (dono axes), snap-none (snapping band).
  • "Scroll snapping ke kaam karne ke liye, tumhe children par scroll snap alignment bhi set karna hoga." — akela snap-x children par snap-start/snap-center/snap-end ke bina kuch nahi karta.
  • snap-mandatory — container ko hamesha kisi snap point par rukne par majboor karta hai:
html
<div class="snap-x snap-mandatory ...">
  <div class="snap-center ..."><img src="/img/vacation-01.jpg" /></div>
  <!-- ... -->
</div>
  • snap-proximity — container un snap points par rukta hai jo paas hon (agar tum kisi snap point se door rukte ho, to ye wahi rehta hai jahan ruka — halka, kam majboor):
html
<div class="snap-x snap-proximity ...">
  <div class="snap-center ..."><img src="/img/vacation-01.jpg" /></div>
  <!-- ... -->
</div>
  • Sakhti --tw-scroll-snap-strictness variable se lagu hoti hai: snap-mandatory/snap-proximity sirf us variable ko set karte hain; snap-x/snap-y/snap-both ise istemal karte hain. To classes judti hain: snap-x snap-mandatory.

Variants: breakpoint variants lagu hote hain, jaise snap-none md:snap-x.

Interview points (poora snap system, ek set ke roop me): container ko snap-x + sakhti (snap-mandatory/snap-proximity) milti hai; children ko alignment (snap-start/snap-center/snap-end) milta hai; vaikalpik roop se skip rokne ke liye children par snap-always, offsets ke liye children par scroll-m-* / container par scroll-p-*. mandatory banam proximity classic interview fark hai: mandatory hamesha kisi snap point par rukta hai (aakramak lag sakta hai), proximity sirf tab snap karta hai jab tum kisi ke paas ruko.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/scroll-snap-type
← Previous183 · scroll-snap-stop→ Next185 · touch-action
185Interactivity

touch-action

Is section me hum touch-action ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: touchscreens par kisi element ko kaise scroll aur zoom kiya ja sakta hai, ise control karne ki utilities (touch-action) — matlab kaunse touch gestures browser swabhavik roop se sambhalta hai (panning/zooming) banam kaunse page ke JS par chhode jate hain (jaise ek custom drag ya canvas).

Utility classes:

ClassStyles
touch-autotouch-action: auto;
touch-nonetouch-action: none;
touch-pan-xtouch-action: pan-x;
touch-pan-lefttouch-action: pan-left;
touch-pan-righttouch-action: pan-right;
touch-pan-ytouch-action: pan-y;
touch-pan-uptouch-action: pan-up;
touch-pan-downtouch-action: pan-down;
touch-pinch-zoomtouch-action: pinch-zoom;
touch-manipulationtouch-action: manipulation;

Example — alag-alag touch vyavhaaron wale chaar overflow containers (touchscreen par images ko pan karke dekho):

html
<div class="h-48 w-full touch-auto overflow-auto ..."><img class="h-auto w-[150%] max-w-none" src="..." /></div>
<div class="h-48 w-full touch-none overflow-auto ..."><img class="h-auto w-[150%] max-w-none" src="..." /></div>
<div class="h-48 w-full touch-pan-x overflow-auto ..."><img class="h-auto w-[150%] max-w-none" src="..." /></div>
<div class="h-48 w-full touch-pan-y overflow-auto ..."><img class="h-auto w-[150%] max-w-none" src="..." /></div>

Mukhya fark:

  • touch-none = browser element par koi touch gestures nahi sambhalta — custom JS drag/pan/pointer handling ke liye zaroori (drawing canvases, sliders, maps, games) taaki browser page scroll karne ke liye gesture ko hijack na kare.
  • touch-pan-x / touch-pan-y = sirf horizontal / sirf vertical panning browser sambhalta hai; dusri disha JS par chhod di jati hai.
  • touch-pan-left/touch-pan-right/touch-pan-up/touch-pan-down = panning sirf usi ek disha me allowed hai.
  • touch-pinch-zoom = pinch-zoom allowed hai (raw CSS me pan values ke saath joda ja sakta hai).
  • touch-manipulation = panning + pinch-zoom, lekin koi double-tap-to-zoom nahi — standard "taps ko turant karo" utility (ye ~300ms tap delay vyavhaar hatati hai); aam taur par buttons/interactive elements par lagayi jati hai.

Variants: breakpoint variants lagu hote hain, jaise touch-pan-x md:touch-auto.

Interview ki baatein: touch-none "mera custom slider/drag mobile par page ko bhi scroll karta hai" ki theek hai; touch-manipulation double-tap zoom ke tez taps me dakhal ki theek hai. touch-action sirf touch input ko prabhavit karta hai, mouse ko nahi.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/touch-action
← Previous184 · scroll-snap-type→ Next186 · user-select
186Interactivity

user-select

Is section me hum user-select ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: user kisi element me text chun sakta hai ya nahi, ise control karne ki utilities (user-select).

Utility classes:

ClassStyles
select-noneuser-select: none;
select-textuser-select: text;
select-alluser-select: all;
select-autouser-select: auto;

Examples (demo text: "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog."):

  • Selection roko (element me aur uske children me):
html
<div class="select-none ...">The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.</div>
  • Allow selection:
html
<div class="select-text ...">The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.</div>
  • Ek click par select-all — element par click karna apne aap iska saara text chun leta hai:
html
<div class="select-all ...">The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.</div>
  • Default browser behaviour:
html
<div class="select-auto ...">The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.</div>

Variants: breakpoint variants lagu hote hain, jaise select-none md:select-all.

Interview ki baatein: select-none buttons, nav items, draggable UI aur game HUDs par standard hai (users ke tez click/drag karne par galti se text-highlight hona rokta hai); select-all copyable snippets ke liye chaal hai (code/token/coupon chunne ke liye ek baar click karo); note karo select-none keyboard ya DevTools se copying nahi rokta — ye sirf mouse/touch selection rokta hai, aur ise body copy par istemal nahi karna chahiye (ye usability aur accessibility ko nuksaan pahunchata hai).

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/user-select
← Previous185 · touch-action→ Next187 · will-change
187Interactivity

will-change

Is section me hum will-change ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye section asal docs ko taaza padhkar verify kiya gaya hai.

Ye utilities — optimising upcoming animations of elements that are expected to change..

Class table

ClassStyles
will-change-autowill-change: auto;
will-change-scrollwill-change: scroll-position;
will-change-contentswill-change: contents;
will-change-transformwill-change: transform;
will-change-<custom-property>will-change: var(<custom-property>);
will-change-[<value>]will-change: <value>;

How it works

  • will-change-scroll / will-change-contents / will-change-transform browser ko animation shuru hone se pehle use taiyaar karne ko kehte hain — jaise <div class="overflow-auto will-change-scroll">.
  • Kisi element ke badalne se thodi der pehle lagao, phir will-change-auto istemal karke iske khatam hone ke turant baad hata do.
  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): will-change-[top,left]; CSS variable shorthand: will-change-(--my-properties) (= will-change-[var(--my-properties)]).

Aam galtiyaan / interview points

  • will-change jaani-maani performance samasyaon ke liye aakhiri upaay hai. Ise zyada ya sirf samasyaon ki ummeed me istemal karne se bacho — ye page ko kam performant bana sakta hai (ye browser ko extra layers/compositing kaam banane par majboor karta hai).
  • Classic interview jawab: will-change browser ko ishara deta hai ki kya badlega taaki ye samay se pehle optimise kar sake, lekin zyada istemal ulta padta hai.
SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/will-change
← Previous186 · user-select→ Next188 · fill
188SVG

fill

Is section me hum fill ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: SVG elements ke fill ko style karne ki utilities — SVG shapes/paths ka andar ka rang (fill property).

Utility classes: fill-* ke roop me poora colour palette, aur specials (fetched text me table ka sirf upari hissa dikhaya gaya tha — pattern saare palette colours me ek samaan hai):

ClassStyles
fill-nonefill: none;
fill-inheritfill: inherit;
fill-currentfill: currentColor;
fill-transparentfill: transparent;
fill-blackfill: var(--color-black); /* #000 */
fill-whitefill: var(--color-white); /* #fff */
fill-red-50 … fill-red-300 … (every palette colour/shade, e.g. fill-indigo-500, fill-lime-600, fill-blue-500, fill-cyan-500)fill: var(--color-<name>);
fill-[<value>]fill: <value>;
fill-(<custom-property>)fill: var(<custom-property>);

Example — kisi SVG icon ke fill ko rang do:

html
<svg class="fill-blue-500 ..."><!-- ... --></svg>

"Ye Heroicons jaise icon sets ko style karne ke liye kaam ka ho sakta hai."

fill-current — fill text colour ko follow karta hai (to hover states icon ko muft me dobara rang dete hain):

html
<button class="bg-white text-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-600 hover:text-white ...">
  <svg class="size-5 fill-current ..."><!-- ... --></svg>
  Check for updates
</button>

Custom values:

  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): fill-[#243c5a].
  • CSS variable shorthand: fill-(--my-fill-color) = fill-[var(--my-fill-color)].

Variants: breakpoint variants lagu hote hain, jaise fill-cyan-500 md:fill-cyan-700.

Theme customise karna — --color-* variables:

css
@theme {
  --color-regal-blue: #243c5a;
}
html
<svg class="fill-regal-blue"><!-- ... --></svg>

Interview ki baatein: fill kisi SVG shape ke andar ko rangta hai; stroke iske outline ko rangta hai — dono swatantra hain aur aksar jode jate hain (fill-none stroke-current standard "outline icon" recipe hai). fill-current un icons ke liye mukhya chaal hai jo button/link text colour viraasat me lete hain. fill-none fill ko poori tarah hata deta hai (shape andar se khokhla/transparent ho jata hai).

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/fill
← Previous187 · will-change→ Next189 · stroke
189SVG

stroke

Is section me hum stroke ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: SVG elements ke stroke ko style karne ki utilities — SVG shapes/paths ka outline rang (stroke property).

Utility classes: stroke-* ke roop me poora colour palette, aur specials (fill-* jaisa hi pattern):

ClassStyles
stroke-nonestroke: none;
stroke-inheritstroke: inherit;
stroke-currentstroke: currentColor;
stroke-transparentstroke: transparent;
stroke-blackstroke: var(--color-black); /* #000 */
stroke-whitestroke: var(--color-white); /* #fff */
stroke-red-50 … stroke-red-300 … (every palette colour/shade, e.g. stroke-indigo-500, stroke-lime-600, stroke-cyan-500)stroke: var(--color-<name>);
stroke-[<value>]stroke: <value>;
stroke-(<custom-property>)stroke: var(<custom-property>);

Example — kisi SVG outline ko rang do:

html
<svg class="stroke-cyan-500 ..."><!-- ... --></svg>

"Ye Heroicons jaise icon sets ko style karne ke liye kaam ka ho sakta hai."

stroke-current — stroke text colour ko follow karta hai:

html
<button class="bg-white text-pink-600 hover:bg-pink-600 hover:text-white ...">
  <svg class="size-5 stroke-current ..." fill="none"><!-- ... --></svg>
  Download file
</button>

Is example me <svg> par fill="none" attribute note karo — ek outline icon aam taur par fill ko none set karta hai taaki sirf stroke dikhe.

Custom values:

  • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): stroke-[#243c5a].
  • CSS variable shorthand: stroke-(--my-stroke-color) = stroke-[var(--my-stroke-color)].

Variants: breakpoint variants lagu hote hain, jaise stroke-cyan-500 md:stroke-cyan-700.

Theme customise karna — --color-* variables:

css
@theme {
  --color-regal-blue: #243c5a;
}
html
<svg class="stroke-regal-blue"><!-- ... --></svg>

Interview ki baatein: stroke = outline colour, fill = andar ka rang, stroke-width = outline ki motaai — teen SVG styling utilities ek set banati hain. stroke-current + fill-none Heroicons-style outline icon hai; fill-current + stroke-none solid icon hai. Ek aam shuruwaati galti hai stroke-* ko ek aise SVG par set karna jiske paths me markup me koi stroke define nahi hai — utility CSS property set karti hai, jo SVG ko asal me istemal karni chahiye (bina stroke attribute wale paths phir bhi CSS stroke lete hain).

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/stroke
← Previous188 · fill→ Next190 · stroke-width
190SVG

stroke-width

Is section me hum stroke-width ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: SVG elements ki stroke width ko style karne ki utilities — outline kitni moti hai (stroke-width property).

Utility classes:

ClassStyles
stroke-<number>stroke-width: <number>;
stroke-(length:<custom-property>)stroke-width: var(<custom-property>);
stroke-[<value>]stroke-width: <value>;

Khaas baatein:

  • Dynamic number: koi bhi number kaam karta hai — stroke-1 aur stroke-2 docs examples hain, lekin stroke-0.5, stroke-1.5, stroke-3, wagera sab valid hain (number jaisa hai waisa istemal hota hai, bina unit ke, jaise SVG stroke widths hote hain):
html
<svg class="stroke-1 ..."></svg>
<svg class="stroke-2 ..."></svg>

"Ye Heroicons jaise icon sets ko style karne ke liye kaam ka ho sakta hai."

  • Naam takraav ki chetaavni (SPA builder ke liye mahatvapurna): stroke-<number> (width) aur stroke-<colour> (colour) stroke- prefix share karte hain — Tailwind inhe isse pehchanta hai ki suffix ek number hai ya rang ka naam. Inhe ek utility ke roop me mat pesh karo; ye do alag properties hain (stroke-width banam stroke).
  • Custom values:
    • Arbitrary value (apni marzi ki value): stroke-[1.5].
    • CSS variable shorthand — length: data-type prefix note karo, jo colour utilities ke saade stroke-(--...) form se alag hai: stroke-(length:--my-stroke-width) = stroke-[length:var(--my-stroke-width)].
html
<div class="stroke-[1.5] ..."><!-- ... --></div>
<div class="stroke-(length:--my-stroke-width) ..."><!-- ... --></div>

Variants: breakpoint variants lagu hote hain, jaise stroke-1 md:stroke-2.

Interview ki baatein: stroke-width SVG me bina unit ke hai (user units, default scale par asal me px); mote strokes (stroke-2) chhote icon sizes par behtar padhe jate hain; Heroicons 1.5px (outline) aur 2px variants isiliye deta hai kyunki is utility ki range yehi hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/stroke-width
← Previous189 · stroke→ Next191 · forced-color-adjust
191Accessibility

forced-color-adjust

Is section me hum forced-color-adjust ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya: forced colours me opt in aur out karne ki utilities — wo mode (jaise Windows High Contrast / forced-colors: active) jahan browser/OS page ke rangon ko readability ke liye ek seemit system palette se override kar deta hai. forced-color-adjust control karta hai ki koi element apne rang rakhe ya forced palette svikaar kare.

Utility classes:

ClassStyles
forced-color-adjust-autoforced-color-adjust: auto;
forced-color-adjust-noneforced-color-adjust: none;

Khaas baatein:

  • forced-color-adjust-none kisi element ko forced colours se bahar karta hai. "Ye un sthitiyon me kaam ka hai jahan ek seemit color palette lagu karna usability ko kharab karega." Docs example ek product colour picker hai (ek "Basic Tee", $35): rangeen swatch dots (white/gray/black circles) ko forced-colors mode me apne asal rang banaye rakhne honge, warna user nahi bata sakta ki wo kaunsa rang chun raha hai. DevTools me forced-colors: active emulate karke test karo.
html
<form>
  <img src="/img/shirt.jpg" />
  <div>
    <h3>Basic Tee</h3>
    <h3>$35</h3>
    <fieldset>
      <legend class="sr-only">Choose a color</legend>
      <div class="forced-color-adjust-none ...">
        <label>
          <input class="sr-only" type="radio" name="color-choice" value="White" />
          <span class="sr-only">White</span>
          <span class="size-6 rounded-full border border-black/10 bg-white"></span>
        </label>
        <!-- ... -->
      </div>
    </fieldset>
  </div>
</form>
  • forced-colors: variant: "Tum forced colors variant ka istemal shart ke saath styles jodne ke liye bhi kar sakte ho jab user ne forced color mode enable kiya ho." (jaise forced-colors:appearance-auto, forced-colors:hidden — appearance page dekho.) Utility aur variant saathi hain: utility opt out karti hai, variant forced mode on hone par vaikalpik styles jodta hai.
  • forced-color-adjust-auto kisi element ko majboor rangon ka paalan karata hai — forced-color-adjust-none ko hatane ke liye istemal hota hai, jaise kisi bade breakpoint par jahan ek alag control dikhaya jata hai:
html
<form>
  <fieldset class="forced-color-adjust-none lg:forced-color-adjust-auto ...">
    <legend>Choose a color:</legend>
    <select class="hidden lg:block">
      <option value="White">White</option>
      <option value="Gray">Gray</option>
      <option value="Black">Black</option>
    </select>
    <div class="lg:hidden">
      <label>
        <input class="sr-only" type="radio" name="color-choice" value="White" />
        <!-- ... -->
      </label>
      <!-- ... -->
    </div>
  </fieldset>
</form>

"Ye kaam ka ho sakta hai agar tum forced-color-adjust-none utility ko hatana chahte ho, jaise kisi badi screen size par."

Variants: breakpoint variants lagu hote hain, jaise forced-color-adjust-none md:forced-color-adjust-auto.

Interview ki baatein: forced-colors mode (Windows High Contrast) ek asal accessibility feature hai, theme nahi — ise globally disable karke kabhi "theek" mat karo; sirf un elements ke liye opt out karo jinka matlab hi unka rang hai (colour swatches, charts, status dots), aur baaki sab ko auto me rakho. Sahi jodi hai: matlab-wale-rang element par forced-color-adjust-none + aas-paas ke UI ke liye forced-colors: variant styles (jaise jab rang majboor hon to ek text label dikhao). Swatches ke saath sr-only labels (docs example ki tarah) usi sulabh pattern ka hissa hain.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/forced-color-adjust
← Previous190 · stroke-width→ Next192 · Install Tailwind CSS with Next.js
192Framework Guides

Install Tailwind CSS with Next.js

Is section me hum Install Tailwind CSS with Next.js ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya?

  • Kisi Next.js project me Tailwind CSS set up karna. Next.js iklauti badi framework guide hai jo Vite plugin ke bajaye PostCSS wala raasta istemal karti hai (Next.js Vite istemal hi nahi karta).
  • Core model (har installation page jaisa hi): Tailwind tumhare HTML/JS components ko class names ke liye scan karta hai, styles banata hai, aur unhe ek static CSS file me likhta hai — tez, lachila, zero-runtime.

Steps (6, kram se)

  1. Apna project banao — Create Next App se naya Next.js project banao:
bash
   npx create-next-app@latest my-project --typescript --eslint --app
   cd my-project
  1. Tailwind CSS install karo — tailwindcss aur @tailwindcss/postcss, saath me uska peer postcss lagao:
bash
   npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/postcss postcss
  1. PostCSS Plugins configure karo — project root me @tailwindcss/postcss plugin ke saath postcss.config.mjs banao:
js
   const config = {
     plugins: {
       "@tailwindcss/postcss": {},
     },
   };
   export default config;
  1. Tailwind CSS import karo — ./app/globals.css me ek @import jodo:
css
   @import "tailwindcss";
  1. Build process shuru karo — npm run dev chalao.
  2. Apne project me Tailwind istemal shuru karo — apne components me utility classes istemal karo, jaise page.tsx me:
tsx
   export default function Home() {
     return (
       <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold underline">
         Hello world!
       </h1>
     )
   }

Common mistakes — aksar hone wali galtiyan

  • Next.js project me Vite plugin (@tailwindcss/vite) istemal karna — Next.js ke paas koi Vite config nahi hai; sahi raasta PostCSS plugin + postcss.config.mjs hai.
  • Khud postcss peer dependency ko bhool jana (npm install ... postcss install command ka hissa hai).
  • Tailwind ko galat CSS file me import karna — page ./app/globals.css batata hai (App Router layout CSS).

Interview ki baatein: Next.js + Tailwind v4 = PostCSS plugin wala raasta; postcss.config.mjs file hi config ki satah hai (tailwind.config.js nahi — v4 me default roop se koi JS config nahi); App Router me @import "tailwindcss" globals.css me rehta hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/installation/framework-guides/nextjs
← Previous191 · forced-color-adjust→ Next193 · Install Tailwind CSS with Laravel
193Framework Guides

Install Tailwind CSS with Laravel

Is section me hum Install Tailwind CSS with Laravel ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya?

  • Kisi Laravel project me Tailwind CSS set up karna, Vite plugin wale raaste se. Framework Guides index isi Vite variant par link karta hai; page khud ek doosra variant bhi deta hai, "Using Laravel Mix" (ek sub-variant, 19 index links me se ek nahi).
  • Laravel ki khaas baat: Tailwind ki automatic content detection vendor/ ke Blade templates ya compiled views ko cover nahi karti, isliye guide CSS me saaf @source directives jodti hai.

Steps (6, kram se)

  1. Apna project banao — Laravel installer se naya Laravel project banao:
bash
   laravel new my-project
   cd my-project

(Note: upar wale code me do commands alag-alag hain.)

  1. Install Tailwind CSS — tailwindcss aur @tailwindcss/vite install karo:
bash
   npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite
  1. Vite Plugin configure karo — plugin ko apni Vite configuration (vite.config.ts) me jodo:
ts
   import { defineConfig } from 'vite'
   import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite'
   export default defineConfig({
     plugins: [
       tailwindcss(),
       // …
     ],
   })
  1. Tailwind CSS import karo — ./resources/css/app.css me ek @import jodo, saath me @source directives taaki Tailwind un Blade/PHP files ko scan kare jo warna chhoot jati:
css
   @import "tailwindcss";
   @source "../../vendor/laravel/framework/src/Illuminate/Pagination/resources/views/*.blade.php";
   @source "../../storage/framework/views/*.php";
   @source "../**/*.blade.php";
   @source "../**/*.js";
  1. Build process shuru karo — npm run dev chalao.
  2. Apne project me Tailwind istemal shuru karo — @vite Blade directive se compiled CSS ko <head> me shaamil karo, phir utility classes istemal karo (app.blade.php):
html
   @vite('resources/css/app.css')
   ...
   <h1 class="text-3xl font-bold underline">
     Hello world!
   </h1>

Common mistakes — aksar hone wali galtiyan

  • @source wali lines chhod dena: pagination views (vendor/laravel/framework/.../Pagination) aur compiled views (storage/framework/views/*.php) default scan se bahar hain, isliye unki classes chup-chaap gayab ho jayengi.
  • Yahan PostCSS wala raasta istemal karna — Laravel ki guide ek Vite-plugin guide hai; Vite plugin hi wo hai jiski Laravel ecosystem (Vite + @vite directive) ummeed karta hai.
  • Blade layout me @vite('resources/css/app.css') bhool jana — iske bina compiled CSS kabhi load hi nahi hoti.

Interview ki baatein: @source v4 ka saaf content-detection bachav-raasta hai — ye Tailwind ko default automatic detection se bahar ke paths scan karne ko kehta hai (Laravel guide iska sabse jaana example hai: vendor/ aur storage/ ke Blade templates). @vite() Blade directive wo tareeka hai jisse Laravel Vite se bani CSS ko ghusata hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/installation/framework-guides/laravel/vite
← Previous192 · Install Tailwind CSS with Next.js→ Next194 · Install Tailwind CSS with Nuxt
194Framework Guides

Install Tailwind CSS with Nuxt

Is section me hum Install Tailwind CSS with Nuxt ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya?

  • Kisi Nuxt project me Tailwind CSS set up karna, Vite plugin wale raaste se — plugin nuxt.config.ts ke andar vite.plugins key ke neeche register hota hai, kisi alag vite.config.* me nahi.
  • Nuxt ka khaas extra step (7 steps, aam 6 nahi): CSS file ko nuxt.config.ts ke css array me globally register bhi karna hota hai.

Steps (7, kram se)

  1. Apna project banao — Create Nuxt se naya Nuxt project banao:
bash
   npm create nuxt my-project
   cd my-project

(Note: upar wale code me do commands alag-alag hain.)

  1. Install Tailwind CSS — tailwindcss aur @tailwindcss/vite install karo:
bash
   npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite
  1. Vite Plugin configure karo — plugin ko apni Nuxt config (nuxt.config.ts) me jodo:
ts
   import tailwindcss from "@tailwindcss/vite";
   export default defineNuxtConfig({
     compatibilityDate: "2025-07-15",
     devtools: { enabled: true },
     vite: {
       plugins: [
         tailwindcss(),
       ],
     },
   });
  1. Tailwind CSS import karo — ./app/assets/css/main.css banao aur jodo:
css
   @import "tailwindcss";
  1. CSS file ko globally jodo — file ko nuxt.config.ts ke css array me register karo (~/ alias par dhyan do — file ./app/assets/css/main.css par rehti hai):
ts
   css: ['~/assets/css/main.css'],
  1. Build process shuru karo — npm run dev chalao.
  2. Apne project me Tailwind istemal shuru karo — components me utility classes istemal karo, jaise app.vue:
vue
   <template>
     <h1 class="text-3xl font-bold underline">
       Hello world!
     </h1>
   </template>

Common mistakes — aksar hone wali galtiyan

  • Plugin ko alag vite.config.ts me rakhna — Vite config Nuxt ke paas hai; plugin nuxt.config.ts me vite.plugins ke neeche jata hai.
  • CSS file bana lena lekin step 5 (css: [...]) bhool jana — styles kabhi globally load hi nahi hoti.
  • Galat CSS path istemal karna: file ./app/assets/css/main.css hai (Nuxt 4 ki app/ directory), jo '~/assets/css/main.css' ke roop me register hoti hai.

Interview ki baatein: Nuxt Vite ko lapeta (wrap) hua hai, isliye Tailwind ka Vite plugin defineNuxtConfig ki vite key se configure hota hai; Nuxt chahta hai ki CSS css array me ghoshit ho — kisi CSS file ke liye apne aap <link> nahi banta, jaise kisi saade Vite HTML entry me hota hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/installation/framework-guides/nuxt
← Previous193 · Install Tailwind CSS with Laravel→ Next195 · Install Tailwind CSS with SolidJS
195Framework Guides

Install Tailwind CSS with SolidJS

Is section me hum Install Tailwind CSS with SolidJS ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya?

  • Kisi SolidJS project me Tailwind CSS set up karna, Vite plugin wale raaste se. SolidJS projects ek Vite template se scaffold hote hain, isliye Solid ki khaas config ke saath standard Vite flow lagu hota hai.
  • Vite config me do plugins bagal-bagal hain: Tailwind ka aur Solid ka (vite-plugin-solid).

Steps (6, kram se)

  1. Apna project banao — degit se SolidJS Vite template se scaffold karo:
bash
   npx degit solidjs/templates/js my-project
   cd my-project

(Note: upar wale code me do commands alag-alag hain.)

  1. Install Tailwind CSS — tailwindcss aur @tailwindcss/vite install karo:
bash
   npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite
  1. Vite Plugin configure karo — dono plugins ko vite.config.ts me jodo (pehle Tailwind, phir Solid), template ki server/build settings ke saath:
ts
   import { defineConfig } from 'vite';
   import solidPlugin from 'vite-plugin-solid';
   import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite';
   export default defineConfig({
     plugins: [
       tailwindcss(),
       solidPlugin(),
     ],
     server: {
       port: 3000,
     },
     build: {
       target: 'esnext',
     },
   });
  1. Tailwind CSS import karo — ./src/index.css me ek @import jodo:
css
   @import "tailwindcss";
  1. Build process shuru karo — npm run dev chalao.
  2. Apne project me Tailwind istemal shuru karo — components me utility classes istemal karo, jaise App.jsx:
jsx
   export default function App() {
     return (
       <h1 class="text-3xl font-bold underline">
         Hello world!
       </h1>
     )
   }

Common mistakes — aksar hone wali galtiyan

  • Tailwind jodte samay Vite config se solidPlugin() hata dena — dono plugins maujood hone chahiye; template ki server.port: 3000 aur build.target: 'esnext' kaam karti config ka hissa hain.
  • SolidJS template (degit solidjs/templates/js) ke bajaye create-vite istemal karna — guide ka project aakaar usi template se aata hai.

Interview ki baatein: vite.config.ts me plugin ka kram asal baat hai — Tailwind ka plugin framework ke apne Vite plugin ke bagal me baithta hai (yahan solidPlugin(), neeche SvelteKit/Astro jaisa hi pattern). degit scaffolding (template repo clone) banam create-* CLIs — ye framework-ecosystem ka fark hai, Tailwind ka nahi.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/installation/framework-guides/solidjs
← Previous194 · Install Tailwind CSS with Nuxt→ Next196 · Install Tailwind CSS with SvelteKit
196Framework Guides

Install Tailwind CSS with SvelteKit

Is section me hum Install Tailwind CSS with SvelteKit ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya?

  • Kisi SvelteKit project me Tailwind CSS set up karna, Vite plugin wale raaste se — SvelteKit ke apne sveltekit() Vite plugin ke saath tailwindcss().
  • Svelte ka khaas extra step (7 steps): CSS file root layout component (+layout.svelte) se import hoti hai, aur component <style> blocks ko theme dekhne ke liye v4 ka @reference directive chahiye.

Steps (7, kram se)

  1. Apna project banao — Svelte CLI se naya SvelteKit project banao:
bash
   npx sv create my-project
   cd my-project

(Note: upar wale code me do commands alag-alag hain.)

  1. Install Tailwind CSS — tailwindcss aur @tailwindcss/vite install karo:
bash
   npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite
  1. Vite Plugin configure karo — dono plugins ko vite.config.ts me jodo:
ts
   import { sveltekit } from '@sveltejs/kit/vite';
   import { defineConfig } from 'vite';
   import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite';
   export default defineConfig({
     plugins: [
       tailwindcss(),
       sveltekit(),
     ],
   });
  1. Tailwind CSS import karo — ./src/app.css banao aur jodo:
css
   @import "tailwindcss";
  1. CSS file import karo — ./src/routes/+layout.svelte banao aur CSS import karo (Svelte 5 runes syntax — let { children } = $props() aur {@render children()}):
svelte
   <script>
     let { children } = $props();
     import "../app.css";
   </script>
   {@render children()}
  1. Build process shuru karo — npm run dev chalao.
  2. Apne project me Tailwind istemal shuru karo — utility classes istemal karo; kisi bhi component <style> block ke liye jise Tailwind processing chahiye, lang="postcss" aur @reference "tailwindcss" istemal karo (example global html element ko ek theme rang se style karta hai):
svelte
   <h1 class="text-3xl font-bold underline">
     Hello world!
   </h1>
   <style lang="postcss">
     @reference "tailwindcss";
     :global(html) {
       background-color: theme(--color-gray-100);
     }
   </style>

Common mistakes — aksar hone wali galtiyan

  • Step 5 bhool jana — CSS file maujood hai lekin layout use kabhi import hi nahi karta, to koi styles load nahi hoti.
  • @reference "tailwindcss" ke bina kisi Svelte <style> block ke andar theme(--color-*) ya @apply istemal karna — block ke paas apne aap koi theme context nahi hota, to Tailwind functions fail ho jate hain.
  • Layout ko puraane Svelte 4 <slot /> syntax se likhna — guide Svelte 5 ka $props() + {@render children()} istemal karti hai.

Interview points: @reference v4 directive hai jo kisi standalone stylesheet ko (yahan, ek Svelte component ke <style> block ko) bina duplicate CSS nikale theme tak pahunch deta hai — ye theme definitions ko sirf reference ke liye import karta hai. theme(--color-gray-100) CSS me kisi theme variable ko padhne ka v4 function syntax hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/installation/framework-guides/sveltekit
← Previous195 · Install Tailwind CSS with SolidJS→ Next197 · Install Tailwind CSS with Gatsby
197Framework Guides

Install Tailwind CSS with Gatsby

Is section me hum Install Tailwind CSS with Gatsby ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya?

  • Kisi Gatsby project me Tailwind CSS set up karna, PostCSS wale raaste se — Gatsby ke khaas bridge plugin gatsby-plugin-postcss ke saath, jo PostCSS ko Gatsby ki build se jodta hai.
  • Ab tak ki sabse lambi guide (8 steps): do config files (gatsby-config.js + postcss.config.js) aur ek browser-entry import (gatsby-browser.js).

Steps (8, kram se)

  1. Apna project banao — Gatsby CLI se naya Gatsby project banao:
bash
   gatsby new my-project
   cd my-project

(Note: upar wale code me do commands alag-alag hain.)

  1. Tailwind CSS install karo — PostCSS plugin, uske peers, aur Gatsby bridge plugin lagao:
bash
   npm install @tailwindcss/postcss tailwindcss postcss gatsby-plugin-postcss
  1. Gatsby PostCSS plugin chalu karo — gatsby-config.js me gatsby-plugin-postcss jodo:
js
   module.exports = {
     plugins: [
       'gatsby-plugin-postcss',
       // ...
     ],
   }
  1. PostCSS Plugins configure karo — project root me Tailwind PostCSS plugin ke saath postcss.config.js banao (dhyan do: yahan CommonJS module.exports hai, Next.js ke ESM postcss.config.mjs se alag):
js
   module.exports = {
     plugins: {
       "@tailwindcss/postcss": {},
     },
   };
  1. Tailwind CSS import karo — ./src/styles/global.css banao aur jodo:
css
   @import "tailwindcss";
  1. CSS file import karo — project root par gatsby-browser.js banao (agar maujood na ho) aur CSS import karo:
js
   import './src/styles/global.css';
  1. Build process shuru karo — gatsby develop chalao (npm run dev nahi).
  2. Apne project me Tailwind istemal shuru karo — pages me utility classes istemal karo, jaise index.js:
jsx
   export default function IndexPage() {
     return (
       <Layout>
         <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold underline">
           Hello world!
         </h1>
       </Layout>
     )
   }

Common mistakes — aksar hone wali galtiyan

  • Sirf PostCSS packages install karke gatsby-plugin-postcss bhool jana — iske bina Gatsby kabhi PostCSS chalata hi nahi, to @import "tailwindcss" kabhi process hi nahi hota.
  • Step 6 chhod dena — gatsby-browser.js Gatsby ki global browser entry hai; import ke bina CSS kabhi bundle hi nahi hoti.
  • npm run dev istemal karna — Gatsby ki dev command gatsby develop hai.

Interview ki baatein: Gatsby ko ek bridge plugin chahiye kyunki uski build pipeline plugin-based hai (gatsby-config.js); do-parat wali config (Gatsby plugin PostCSS chalu karta hai, postcss.config.js Tailwind chunta hai) kisi bhi PostCSS-based integration jaisa hi pattern hai, bas saamne framework ka apna plugin system hai. gatsby-browser.js banam gatsby-ssr.js — browser APIs (jaise global CSS imports) browser wali file me jati hain.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/installation/framework-guides/gatsby

198Framework Guides

Install Tailwind CSS with Angular

Is section me hum Install Tailwind CSS with Angular ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya?

  • Kisi Angular project me Tailwind CSS set up karna, PostCSS wale raaste se — Angular ki build PostCSS config ko ek JSON file (.postcssrc.json) se padhti hai, jo Next.js (.mjs) aur Gatsby (.js) se alag config satah hai.
  • Angular ki do khaas baatein: project --style css ke saath banna chahiye, aur install me --force lagta hai.

Steps (6, kram se)

  1. Apna project banao — Angular CLI se naya Angular project banao, stylesheet format ke roop me saaf taur par CSS chunte hue:
bash
   ng new my-project --style css
   cd my-project

(Note: upar wale code me do commands alag-alag hain.)

  1. Install Tailwind CSS — tailwindcss, @tailwindcss/postcss, aur postcss install karo, --force ke saath:
bash
   npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/postcss postcss --force

--force flag sirf is guide me hai — warna Angular ka dependency tree peer-dependency takraavon par install ko rok deta hai.

  1. PostCSS Plugins configure karo — project root me .postcssrc.json file banao:
json
   {
     "plugins": {
       "@tailwindcss/postcss": {}
     }
   }
  1. Tailwind CSS import karo — ./src/styles.css me ek @import jodo:
css
   @import "tailwindcss";
  1. Build process shuru karo — ng serve chalao.
  2. Apne project me Tailwind istemal shuru karo — component templates me utility classes istemal karo, jaise app.component.html:
html
   <h1 class="text-3xl font-bold underline">
     Hello world!
   </h1>

Common mistakes — aksar hone wali galtiyan

  • Project banate samay --style css chhod dena — phir Angular kisi dusre stylesheet format (jaise SCSS) ko default le leta hai aur styles.css ka @import "tailwindcss" mail nahi khata.
  • Install par --force chhod dena — install peer-dependency resolution par fail ho jata hai.
  • PostCSS config ka naam postcss.config.js rakhna — Angular ki toolchain .postcssrc.json dhoondhti hai.

Interview ki baatein: wahi Tailwind PostCSS plugin frameworks me teen alag config satahein leta hai — ESM .mjs (Next.js), CommonJS .js (Gatsby), JSON .postcssrc.json (Angular) — kyunki har framework ka build tool PostCSS config ko alag tareeke se dhoondhta hai. --force Angular ki bandhi toolchain aur Tailwind ke PostCSS plugin ke beech peer-dependency takraav ka sanket hai, Tailwind ki koi shart nahi.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/installation/framework-guides/angular

Install Tailwind CSS with Ruby on Rails

Is section me hum Install Tailwind CSS with Ruby on Rails ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya?

  • Kisi Ruby on Rails v8+ project me Tailwind CSS set up karna — sabse chhoti guide (4 steps) aur iklauti jo na npm istemal karti hai na manual config files: official tailwindcss-rails gem ek Rails generator se poora setup kar deta hai.
  • Gem standalone Tailwind CLI ko bundle karta hai, to is poore chakkar me koi Node build tool hai hi nahi.

Steps (4, kram se)

  1. Apna project banao — Rails CLI se naya Rails project banao:
bash
   rails new my-project
   cd my-project

(Note: upar wale code me do commands alag-alag hain.)

  1. Tailwind CSS install karo — gem jodo, phir uska install generator chalao:
bash
   bundle add tailwindcss-rails
   ./bin/rails tailwindcss:install

(Note: upar wale code me do commands alag-alag hain.) Generator CSS entrypoint banata hai aur use asset pipeline se jod deta hai — is page par koi manual @import ya plugin-config step nahi hai.

  1. Build process shuru karo — ./bin/dev chalao (Foreman-based dev script jo Rails + Tailwind watcher ko saath chalati hai).
  2. Apne project me Tailwind istemal shuru karo — ERB templates me utility classes istemal karo, jaise index.html.erb:
erb
   <h1 class="text-3xl font-bold underline">
     Hello world!
   </h1>

Common mistakes — aksar hone wali galtiyan

  • Is guide ko Rails < v8 par istemal karna — page khud ko Rails v8+ tak seemit rakhta hai; puraane Rails versions alag setup istemal karte hain.
  • Rails project me npm install tailwindcss chalana — gem wala raasta hi documented hai; gem ke andar ki standalone CLI Node toolchain ki jagah leti hai.
  • ./bin/dev ki jagah sirf rails server shuru karna — Tailwind watcher (class badlav par CSS dobara banna) sirf ./bin/dev ke neeche chalta hai.

Interview ki baatein: gem pattern (standalone Tailwind CLI binary ko lapeta hua ek framework-native package) Vite/PostCSS plugins wala hi khayal hai lekin Ruby ki parat par: build framework ki apni tooling ke paas hai, Tailwind uske andar ek binary ke roop me aata hai. ./bin/dev ek Procfile-based runner hai — ye web server aur CSS watcher dono ko saathi processes ke roop me shuru karta hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/installation/framework-guides/ruby-on-rails

Install Tailwind CSS with React Router

Is section me hum Install Tailwind CSS with React Router ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya?

  • Ek React Router (v7, framework mode) project me Tailwind CSS set up karna, Vite plugin raaste se. React Router ka framework mode Vite-based hai, to standard Vite flow lagu hota hai — ek hi config me React Router ke apne Vite plugin ke saath.
  • Vite config me teen plugins hain: Tailwind ka, React Router ka, aur vite-tsconfig-paths (TS path aliases ke liye).

Steps (6, kram se)

  1. Apna project banao — Create React Router se naya React Router project banao:
bash
   npx create-react-router@latest my-project
   cd my-project

(Note: upar wale code me do commands alag-alag hain.)

  1. Install Tailwind CSS — tailwindcss aur @tailwindcss/vite install karo:
bash
   npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite
  1. Vite Plugin configure karo — teeno plugins ko vite.config.ts me jodo:
ts
   import { reactRouter } from "@react-router/dev/vite";
   import { defineConfig } from "vite";
   import tsconfigPaths from "vite-tsconfig-paths";
   import tailwindcss from "@tailwindcss/vite";
   export default defineConfig({
     plugins: [
       tailwindcss(),
       reactRouter(),
       tsconfigPaths(),
     ],
   });
  1. Tailwind CSS import karo — ./app/app.css me ek @import jodo:
css
   @import "tailwindcss";
  1. Build process shuru karo — npm run dev chalao.
  2. Apne project me Tailwind istemal shuru karo — route components me utility classes istemal karo, jaise home.tsx:
tsx
   export default function Home() {
     return (
       <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold underline">
         Hello world!
       </h1>
     )
   }

Common mistakes — aksar hone wali galtiyan

  • Tailwind jodte samay plugin list se reactRouter() ya tsconfigPaths() hata dena — teeno plugins maujood hone chahiye; config framework ki hai, sirf Tailwind ki nahi.
  • Tailwind ko galat CSS file me import karna — guide ki entry ./app/app.css hai (React Router ki app/ directory).

Interview ki baatein: framework-mode React Router extra plugins ke saath ek Vite app hai — Tailwind install saada Vite-plugin install hai, aur framework ki sirf itni jaankari chahiye ki kaunse plugins vite.config.ts saajha karte hain aur CSS entry kahan rehti hai (./app/app.css).

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/installation/framework-guides/react-router

201Framework Guides

Install Tailwind CSS with TanStack Start

Is section me hum Install Tailwind CSS with TanStack Start ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya?

  • Ek TanStack Start project me Tailwind CSS set up karna, Vite plugin raaste se — TanStack Start ke apne tanstackStart() Vite plugin aur vite-tsconfig-paths ke saath tailwindcss().
  • TanStack ka khaas step (6 steps, koi alag "build process shuru karo" step nahi): compiled CSS root route ke head() links se load hoti hai, Vite ke ?url import se.

Steps (6, kram se)

  1. Project banao — Create Start App se naya TanStack Start project banao:
bash
   npx create-start-app@latest my-project
   cd my-project

(Note: upar wale code me do commands alag-alag hain.)

  1. Install Tailwind CSS — tailwindcss aur @tailwindcss/vite install karo:
bash
   npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite
  1. Vite Plugin configure karo — teeno plugins ko vite.config.ts me jodo:
ts
   import { tanstackStart } from '@tanstack/react-start/plugin/vite';
   import { defineConfig } from 'vite';
   import tsConfigPaths from 'vite-tsconfig-paths';
   import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite'
   export default defineConfig({
     plugins: [
       tailwindcss(),
       tanstackStart(),
       tsConfigPaths(),
     ]
   });

(Note: upar wali listing me plugin list sahi kram me hai, tailwindcss() ke baad comma samet.)

  1. Tailwind CSS import karo — ./src/styles.css me ek @import jodo:
css
   @import "tailwindcss";
  1. CSS file ko apne root route me import karo — src/routes/__root.tsx me Vite ki ?url query se CSS import karo aur use root route ke head() me stylesheet link ke roop me register karo:
tsx
   // other imports...
   import appCss from '../styles.css?url'
   export const Route = createRootRoute({
     head: () => ({
       meta: [
         // your meta tags and site config
       ],
       links: [{ rel: 'stylesheet', href: appCss }],
       // other head config
     }),
     component: RootComponent,
   })
  1. Apne project me Tailwind istemal shuru karo — file routes me utility classes istemal karo, jaise src/routes/index.tsx:
tsx
   import { createFileRoute } from '@tanstack/react-router'
   export const Route = createFileRoute('/')({
     component: App,
   })
   function App() {
     return (
       <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold underline">
         Hello World!
       </h1>
     )
   }

Common mistakes — aksar hone wali galtiyan

  • Root route me CSS ko side-effect import (import '../styles.css') ke roop me import karna — TanStack Start global CSS ko ?url import ke saath head() links array se load karta hai, kisi saade import se nahi.
  • Tailwind jodte samay Vite config se tanstackStart() ya tsConfigPaths() hata dena.
  • vite.config.ts me plugins ke beech comma bhool jana (docs ka apna rendered code use gira deta hai — dhyan se copy karo).

Interview ki baatein: ?url query Vite ka "mujhe bane hue asset ka URL do" wala import hai — TanStack Start ise isliye istemal karta hai kyunki stylesheets route ke head() me <link> tags ke roop me ghoshit hoti hain, bundler ke ghusaye jaane ke bajaye. createFileRoute('/') TanStack Router ki file-based routing hai: route file path se tay hota hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/installation/framework-guides/tanstack-start
