202Framework Guides

Install Tailwind CSS with Phoenix

Is section me hum Install Tailwind CSS with Phoenix ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya?

  • Kisi Phoenix (Elixir) project me Tailwind CSS set up karna — sabse lambi guide (10 steps) aur iklauti jo Hex package (tailwind ~> 0.3) se chalne wali standalone Tailwind CLI par bani hai, bina Node aur bina Vite/PostCSS ke.
  • Asset pipeline Phoenix ke paas hai: Tailwind esbuild ke saath ek Mix task/watcher ke roop me chalta hai, Elixir config files me configure hokar.

Steps (10, kram se)

  1. Apna project banao — naya Phoenix project banao (mix phx.new):
bash
   mix phx.new myproject
   cd myproject

(Note: upar wale code me do commands alag-alag hain.)

  1. Tailwind plugin install karo — mix.exs me Hex dependency jodo (sirf dev ke liye: runtime: Mix.env() == :dev) aur use fetch karo:
elixir
   defp deps do
     [
       # …
       {:tailwind, "~> 0.3", runtime: Mix.env() == :dev},
     ]
   end

Phir mix deps.get chalao.

  1. Tailwind plugin configure karo — config/config.exs me, Tailwind version pin karo aur input/output paths set karo:
elixir
   config :tailwind,
     version: "4.1.10",
     myproject: [
       args: ~w(
         --input=assets/css/app.css
         --output=priv/static/assets/app.css
       ),
       cd: Path.expand("..", __DIR__)
     ]
  1. Apni deployment script update karo — mix.exs ke assets.deploy alias me Tailwind build jodo (esbuild aur digest se pehle):
elixir
   "assets.deploy": [
     "tailwind myproject --minify",
     "esbuild myproject --minify",
     "phx.digest"
   ]
  1. Development me watcher chalu karo — ./config/dev.exs me esbuild watcher ke bagal me Tailwind ko watchers me jodo:
elixir
   watchers: [
     esbuild: {Esbuild, :install_and_run, [:myproject, ~w(--sourcemap=inline --watch)]},
     tailwind: {Tailwind, :install_and_run, [:myproject, ~w(--watch)]}
   ]
  1. Tailwind CSS install karo — standalone Tailwind CLI binary download karo:
bash
   mix tailwind.install
  1. Tailwind CSS import karo — ./assets/css/app.css me ek @import jodo:
css
   @import "tailwindcss";
  1. Default CSS import hatao — ./assets/js/app.js se import "../css/app.css" wali line mita do, kyunki ab Tailwind khud CSS banata hai (ye line sirf tab rakhi jati hai jab tum apni CSS pipeline chalate ho, jaise PostCSS).
  2. Build process shuru karo — mix phx.server chalao.
  3. Apne project me Tailwind istemal shuru karo — HEEx templates me utility classes istemal karo, jaise index.html.heex:
heex
    <h1 class="text-3xl font-bold underline">
      Hello world!
    </h1>

Common mistakes — aksar hone wali galtiyan

  • Step 8 chhod dena — JS bundle phir bhi CSS ko import karega, use do baar process karke.
  • dev.exs me watcher bhool jana — phir CSS sirf deploy par dobara banti hai, develop karte samay nahi.
  • mix tailwind.install bhool jana — Mix tasks maujood hain (Hex package se) lekin CLI binary khud abhi download nahi hui.
  • config.exs me Tailwind version hard-code karke use kabhi update na karna — is guide me version pin ("4.1.10") saaf taur par diya hai.

Interview ki baatein: ye standalone-CLI integration pattern hai: framework ka package manager (Hex) ek wrapper bhejta hai jo Tailwind binary download karta hai aur use Mix tasks (tailwind, tailwind.install) ke roop me deta hai; watcher model (esbuild ke bagal me ek lamba chalne wala --watch process) Vite dev server ki poori jagah le leta hai. ~w() Elixir ka word-list sigil hai; runtime: Mix.env() == :dev ka matlab hai dependency sirf dev me shuru hoti hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/installation/framework-guides/phoenix
← Previous201 · Install Tailwind CSS with TanStack Start→ Next203 · Install Tailwind CSS with Parcel

Install Tailwind CSS with Parcel

Is section me hum Install Tailwind CSS with Parcel ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya?

  • Ek Parcel project me Tailwind CSS set up karna, PostCSS raaste se — Parcel .postcssrc file (JSON, koi extension nahi) se PostCSS config apne aap dhoondh leta hai, ek aur config-surface variant.
  • Parcel ek zero-config bundler hai, isliye project setup scaffolding CLI ke bajaye haath ke shell commands se hota hai.

Steps (6, kram se)

  1. Apna project banao — project ko haath se set up karo (koi scaffolder nahi):
bash
   mkdir my-project
   cd my-project
   npm init -y
   npm install parcel
   mkdir src
   touch src/index.html

(Extraction note: fetched text ne saare chhah commands ko ek line me sama diya tha; upar wali listing inhe bahaal karti hai.)

  1. Install Tailwind CSS — tailwindcss aur @tailwindcss/vite ka PostCSS sibling install karo:
bash
   npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/postcss

Note: Next.js/Gatsby/Angular guides ke vipreet, is page ki command postcss ko alag se NAHI deti — page par jaisa hai waisa hi rakha hai.

  1. PostCSS configure karo — project root me .postcssrc file banao:
json
   {
     "plugins": {
       "@tailwindcss/postcss": {}
     }
   }
  1. Tailwind CSS import karo — ./src/index.css banao aur jodo:
css
   @import "tailwindcss";
  1. Build process shuru karo — Parcel ko HTML entry ke saath chalao:
bash
   npx parcel src/index.html
  1. Apne project me Tailwind istemal shuru karo — CSS ko <head> me link karo aur utility classes istemal karo (index.html):
html
   <link href="./index.css" type="text/css" rel="stylesheet" />
   ...
   <h1 class="text-3xl font-bold underline">
     Hello world!
   </h1>

Common mistakes — aksar hone wali galtiyan

  • PostCSS config ka naam postcss.config.js rakhna — Parcel default roop se .postcssrc (bina extension wala JSON) dhoondhta hai.
  • Entry file ke bina npx parcel chalana — Parcel ko HTML entry (src/index.html) apne argument ke roop me chahiye.
  • index.html me CSS ko absolute path se link karna — guide relative ./index.css link istemal karti hai.

Interview ki baatein: Parcel ka zero-config falsafa config ki satah par dikhta hai: .postcssrc Parcel ka apna rivaj hai (Angular ke .postcssrc.json ki tarah), aur bundler PostCSS config aur CSS entry dono ko HTML file se dhoondh leta hai — koi vite.config ya framework config file hoti hi nahi. Ab tak dikhi chaar PostCSS config satahon ki tulna karo: .mjs (Next.js), .js (Gatsby), .postcssrc.json (Angular), .postcssrc (Parcel).

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/installation/framework-guides/parcel
← Previous202 · Install Tailwind CSS with Phoenix→ Next204 · Install Tailwind CSS with Symfony
204Framework Guides

Install Tailwind CSS with Symfony

Is section me hum Install Tailwind CSS with Symfony ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya?

  • Kisi Symfony (PHP) project me Tailwind CSS set up karna, PostCSS wale raaste se — lekin Webpack Encore (Symfony ka webpack wrapper) ke zariye, to PostCSS webpack ke andar postcss-loader se chalta hai.
  • Iklauti guide jo Symfony ke default asset system ko badalti hai: step 2 AssetMapper stack ko hatakar uski jagah Webpack Encore lagata hai.

Steps (8, kram se)

  1. Apna project banao — Symfony Installer se naya Symfony webapp banao:
bash
   symfony new --webapp my-project
   cd my-project

(Note: upar wale code me do commands alag-alag hain.)

  1. Webpack Encore install karo — AssetMapper stack ki jagah Encore lao (Composer):
bash
   composer remove symfony/ux-turbo symfony/asset-mapper symfony/stimulus-bundle
   composer require symfony/webpack-encore-bundle symfony/ux-turbo symfony/stimulus-bundle

(Extraction note: fetched text ne dono composer commands ko ek line me sama diya tha; upar wali listing inhe bahaal karti hai. Turbo aur Stimulus ko hataya jata hai aur phir Encore ke upar dobara joda jata hai.)

  1. Tailwind CSS install karo — PostCSS plugin, uske peers, aur postcss-loader (wo webpack loader jo PostCSS chalata hai) lagao:
bash
   npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/postcss postcss postcss-loader
  1. PostCSS support chalu karo — webpack.config.js me PostCSS loader chalu karo:
js
   Encore
     .enablePostCssLoader();
  1. PostCSS Plugins configure karo — project root me postcss.config.mjs banao (ESM, Next.js ki tarah):
js
   export default {
     plugins: {
       "@tailwindcss/postcss": {},
     },
   };
  1. Tailwind CSS import karo — ./assets/styles/app.css me ek @import jodo, aur ek @source not exclusion:
css
   @import "tailwindcss";
   @source not "../../public";

@source not "../../public" Tailwind ko public/ directory scan NA karne ko kehta hai — iske bina, watcher ek recompile loop me phans sakta hai (bani CSS public/ me girti hai, content ke roop me scan hoti hai, rebuild trigger karti hai, …).

  1. Build process shuru karo — npm run watch chalao.
  2. Apne project me Tailwind istemal shuru karo — Encore ke Twig helper se compiled CSS ko <head> me shaamil karo aur utility classes istemal karo (base.html.twig):
twig
   {% block stylesheets %}
     {{ encore_entry_link_tags('app') }}
   {% endblock %}
   ...
   <h1 class="text-3xl font-bold underline">
     Hello world!
   </h1>

Common mistakes — aksar hone wali galtiyan

  • Step 2 ka composer remove chhod dena — AssetMapper aur Encore ek hi assets par ladte hain; guide saaf taur par ek ko dusre se badalti hai.
  • Step 3 me postcss-loader ya step 4 me .enablePostCssLoader() bhool jana — webpack phir PostCSS kabhi nahi chalata, to @import "tailwindcss" bina process hue guzar jata hai.
  • @source not "../../public" chhod dena — docs watch mode me recompile loops ko hi iske hone ki wajah batate hain.

Interview ki baatein: @source not <path> Laravel guide me dikhe @source directive ka nakaratmak roop hai — dono milkar dikhate hain ki v4 ka content-detection model include/exclude rules ka ek set hai, koi tay glob nahi. Encore pattern (webpack ke ird-gird ek framework wrapper, chained method calls se configure) Vite-plugin pattern ka PHP-ecosystem wala roop hai: bundler framework ke paas hai, Tailwind usme plug hota hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/installation/framework-guides/symfony
← Previous203 · Install Tailwind CSS with Parcel→ Next205 · Install Tailwind CSS with Meteor
205Framework Guides

Install Tailwind CSS with Meteor

Is section me hum Install Tailwind CSS with Meteor ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya?

  • Kisi Meteor project me Tailwind CSS set up karna, PostCSS wale raaste se — Meteor ke ek khaas package postcss-load-config ke saath, jo Meteor ki build ko PostCSS config file dhoondhne aur load karne ke liye chahiye.
  • Meteor ka rivaj: CSS entry ./client/main.css me rehti hai (Meteor ki client/ directory apne aap bundle hoti hai).

Steps (6, kram se)

  1. Apna project banao — naya Meteor project banao (npx se, global install se nahi):
bash
   npx meteor create my-project
   cd my-project

(Note: upar wale code me do commands alag-alag hain.)

  1. Tailwind CSS install karo — PostCSS plugin, uske peers, aur postcss-load-config lagao:
bash
   npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/postcss postcss postcss-load-config
  1. PostCSS Plugins configure karo — project root me postcss.config.mjs banao (ESM, Next.js/Symfony ki tarah):
js
   export default {
     plugins: {
       "@tailwindcss/postcss": {},
     },
   };
  1. Tailwind CSS import karo — ./client/main.css me ek @import jodo:
css
   @import "tailwindcss";
  1. Build process shuru karo — npm run start chalao.
  2. Apne project me Tailwind istemal shuru karo — components me utility classes istemal karo, jaise App.jsx (arrow-function component):
jsx
   export const App = () => (
     <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold underline">
       Hello world!
     </h1>
   )

Common mistakes — aksar hone wali galtiyan

  • postcss-load-config chhod dena — yahi wo package hai jo Meteor ke build tool ko postcss.config.mjs dhoondhne aur load karne deta hai; iske bina config ignore ho jati hai.
  • CSS entry ko src/ me rakhna — Meteor ki entry ./client/main.css hai, jise Meteor apne aap bundle karta hai; koi <link> ya import step nahi chahiye.
  • Bina npx/global install ke meteor seedha chalana — guide npx meteor create istemal karti hai.

Interview ki baatein: postcss-load-config isliye hai kyunki har build tool PostCSS config ko apne aap nahi dhoondhta — Meteor ko ek saaf loader chahiye, jabki Vite/Parcel/Angular har ek ki apni khoj hai. client/ directory Meteor ka isomorphic rivaj hai (client/ ka code sirf browser me chalta hai; CSS entry design ke hisaab se wahi rehti hai).

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/installation/framework-guides/meteor

206Framework Guides

Install Tailwind CSS with AdonisJS

Is section me hum Install Tailwind CSS with AdonisJS ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya?

  • Kisi AdonisJS (Node.js) project me Tailwind CSS set up karna, Vite plugin wale raaste se — AdonisJS ke apne adonisjs() Vite plugin ke saath tailwindcss().
  • Laravel ki tarah, AdonisJS server-rendered templates (Edge) istemal karta hai, isliye guide views directory ko scan karne ke liye ek @source directive jodti hai.

Steps (6, kram se)

  1. Apna project banao — web kit ke saath ek naya AdonisJS project banao:
bash
   npm init adonisjs@latest my-project -- --kit=web
   cd my-project

(Note: upar wale code me do commands alag-alag hain. -- --kit=web ko initializer tak pahunchata hai.)

  1. Install Tailwind CSS — tailwindcss aur @tailwindcss/vite install karo:
bash
   npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite
  1. Vite Plugin configure karo — dono plugins ko vite.config.ts me jodo:
ts
   import { defineConfig } from 'vite'
   import adonisjs from '@adonisjs/vite/client'
   import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite'
   export default defineConfig({
     plugins: [
       tailwindcss(),
       adonisjs({
         // …
       }),
     ],
   })
  1. Tailwind CSS import karo — ./resources/css/app.css me ek @import jodo, saath me Edge templates ke liye ek @source:
css
   @import "tailwindcss";
   @source "../views";

@source "../views" Laravel ki @source lines wala hi khayal hai — template files default scan se bahar rehti hain, isliye unhe ghoshit karna padta hai.

  1. Build process shuru karo — npm run dev chalao.
  2. Apne project me Tailwind istemal shuru karo — @vite Edge directive se compiled assets ko <head> me shaamil karo (dhyan do: ye CSS aur JS DONO entrypoints leta hai) aur utility classes istemal karo (home.edge):
edge
   @vite(['resources/css/app.css', 'resources/js/app.js'])
   ...
   <h1 class="text-3xl font-bold underline">
     Hello world!
   </h1>

Common mistakes — aksar hone wali galtiyan

  • @source "../views" chhod dena — Edge templates (.edge files) default roop se scan nahi hote, isliye unki classes gayab ho jati hain.
  • Banate samay --kit=web chhod dena — web kit hi wo Vite + views structure set up karti hai jis par ye guide aadharit hai.
  • @vite(...) ko sirf CSS file dena — guide resources/css/app.css aur resources/js/app.js dono deti hai.

Interview ki baatein: AdonisJS aur Laravel do @source wali guides hain — dono server-rendered frameworks hain jinke templates Vite ki default scan se bahar rehte hain, isliye dono ko saaf @source ghoshnaayein chahiye. @vite([...]) helper (AdonisJS Edge / Laravel Blade) framework ka Vite se bane assets ghusane ka tareeka hai: ye production me entrypoints ko Vite manifest se resolve karta hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/installation/framework-guides/adonisjs

207Framework Guides

Install Tailwind CSS with Ember.js

Is section me hum Install Tailwind CSS with Ember.js ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya?

  • Kisi Ember.js project me Tailwind CSS set up karna, Vite plugin wale raaste se — Embroider (Ember ka Vite-based build system) ke zariye, to Vite config me Tailwind ke saath Ember ke apne plugins bhi hote hain.
  • Ember ka khaas extra step (7 steps): HTML entry ko Embroider ki virtual CSS istemal karna band karke asal CSS file ko seedha link karna hoga, taaki Vite use process kare.

Steps (7, kram se)

  1. Apna project banao — ember-cli se naya Ember.js project banao, welcome screen ko chhodte hue:
bash
   npx ember-cli@latest new my-project --no-welcome
   cd my-project

(Note: upar wale code me do commands alag-alag hain.)

  1. Install Tailwind CSS — tailwindcss aur @tailwindcss/vite install karo:
bash
   npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite
  1. Vite Plugin configure karo — plugins ko vite.config.mjs me jodo (dhyan do: .mjs hai, .ts nahi):
js
   import { defineConfig } from 'vite';
   import { extensions, classicEmberSupport, ember } from '@embroider/vite';
   import { babel } from '@rollup/plugin-babel';
   import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite';
   export default defineConfig({
     plugins: [
       tailwindcss(),
       classicEmberSupport(),
       ember(),
       // extra plugins here
       babel({
         babelHelpers: 'runtime',
         extensions,
       }),
     ],
   });
  1. Tailwind CSS import karo — ./app/styles/app.css me ek @import jodo:
css
   @import "tailwindcss";
  1. CSS file ko link karo — ./index.html me, @embroider/virtual/app.css stylesheet link ki jagah ./app/styles/app.css ka seedha link lagao taaki Vite use process kare:
html
   {{content-for "head"}}
   <link integrity="" rel="stylesheet" href="/@embroider/virtual/vendor.css" />
   <link integrity="" rel="stylesheet" href="/app/styles/app.css" />
   {{content-for "head-footer"}}

(Note: upar wali listing asal antim haalat dikhati hai — vendor.css rakha gaya, virtual app.css hataya gaya, seedha link joda gaya.)

  1. Build process shuru karo — npm run start chalao.
  2. Apne project me Tailwind istemal shuru karo — .gjs template files me utility classes istemal karo, jaise application.gjs (Ember ka single-file component format, <template> tags ke saath):
gjs
   import { pageTitle } from 'ember-page-title';
   <template>
     {{pageTitle "MyProject"}}
     <h1 class="text-3xl font-bold underline">
       Hello world!
     </h1>
     {{outlet}}
   </template>

Common mistakes — aksar hone wali galtiyan

  • index.html me @embroider/virtual/app.css link chhod dena — virtual CSS Vite ko bypass kar deti hai, to Tailwind use kabhi process hi nahi karta; seedha /app/styles/app.css link hi step 5 ka poora maksad hai.
  • Tailwind jodte samay vite.config.mjs se classicEmberSupport(), ember() ya babel() plugin hata dena — Embroider ko teeno chahiye.
  • vite.config.ts banana — guide vite.config.mjs istemal karti hai.

Interview ki baatein: Embroider Vite ke upar Ember ki compatibility layer hai — "virtual" CSS links (/@embroider/virtual/*) classic Ember asset pipeline ke liye Embroider ke banaye hue badal (stand-ins) hain; asal file link par jana hi CSS processing ko Vite (aur isliye Tailwind) ke hawale karne ka tareeka hai. .gjs files (ek file me JS + <template>) Ember ka aadhunik component format hai, jo alag .js + .hbs files ki jagah leta hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/installation/framework-guides/emberjs

208Framework Guides

Install Tailwind CSS with Astro

Is section me hum Install Tailwind CSS with Astro ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya?

  • Kisi Astro project me Tailwind CSS set up karna, Vite plugin wale raaste se — Nuxt ki tarah, plugin framework ki apni config file (astro.config.mjs, vite.plugins ke neeche) me register hota hai, kisi alag vite.config.* me nahi.
  • Astro ke island architecture ka matlab hai CSS har page (ya har layout) ke frontmatter se import hoti hai, kisi global entry se nahi.

Steps (6, kram se)

  1. Apna project banao — create astro se naya Astro project banao:
bash
   npm create astro@latest my-project
   cd my-project

(Note: upar wale code me do commands alag-alag hain.)

  1. Install Tailwind CSS — tailwindcss aur @tailwindcss/vite install karo:
bash
   npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite
  1. Vite Plugin configure karo — plugin ko astro.config.mjs me jodo:
js
   // @ts-check
   import { defineConfig } from "astro/config";
   import tailwindcss from "@tailwindcss/vite";

   // https://astro.build/config
   export default defineConfig({
     vite: {
       plugins: [tailwindcss()],
     },
   });
  1. Tailwind CSS import karo — ./src/styles/global.css banao aur jodo:
css
   @import "tailwindcss";
  1. Build process shuru karo — npm run dev chalao.
  2. Apne project me Tailwind istemal shuru karo — page ke frontmatter me CSS import karo aur utility classes istemal karo (index.astro):
astro
   ---
   import "../styles/global.css";
   ---
   <h1 class="text-3xl font-bold underline">
     Hello world!
   </h1>

Common mistakes — aksar hone wali galtiyan

  • Plugin ko alag vite.config.* me rakhna — Vite config Astro ke paas hai; plugin astro.config.mjs me vite.plugins ke neeche jata hai (Nuxt ke nuxt.config.ts jaisa hi pattern).
  • CSS file bana lena lekin use kisi page/layout me kabhi import na karna — Astro me default roop se koi global CSS entry nahi hoti; frontmatter import hi use load karta hai.
  • Uske bajaye @tailwindcss/astro integration istemal karna — v4 guide Vite plugin ko seedha istemal karti hai; purana Astro integration ek alag (v3-zamane ka) raasta hai.

Interview ki baatein: Astro aur Nuxt do "plugin framework config me jata hai" wali guides hain — pattern ye hai: Vite framework ke paas hai, isliye Tailwind ka plugin framework config ki vite key ke neeche nest hota hai. Astro ka frontmatter import (--- import ... ---) wo tareeka hai jisse koi page apni dependencies ghoshit karta hai; CSS ko wahan (ya kisi saajha layout me) import karna hi styles ko us page par lagu karta hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/installation/framework-guides/astro

209Framework Guides

Install Tailwind CSS with Qwik

Is section me hum Install Tailwind CSS with Qwik ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya?

  • Ek Qwik project me Tailwind CSS set up karna, Vite plugin raaste se — Qwik City ke aur Qwik ke apne Vite plugins ke saath tailwindcss().
  • Qwik ki Vite config function form me likhi hai (use { command, mode } milta hai), aur scaffold empty starter template istemal karta hai.

Steps (6, kram se)

  1. Apna project banao — empty starter se naya Qwik project banao:
bash
   npm create qwik@latest empty my-project
   cd my-project

(Note: upar wale code me do commands alag-alag hain.)

  1. Install Tailwind CSS — tailwindcss aur @tailwindcss/vite install karo:
bash
   npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite
  1. Vite Plugin configure karo — plugins ko vite.config.ts me jodo (function form — config { command, mode } ka ek function hai):
ts
   import { defineConfig } from 'vite'
   import { qwikVite } from "@builder.io/qwik/optimizer";
   import { qwikCity } from "@builder.io/qwik-city/vite";
   // …
   import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite'
   export default defineConfig(({ command, mode }): UserConfig => {
     return {
       plugins: [
         tailwindcss(),
         qwikCity(),
         qwikVite(),
         tsconfigPaths(),
       ],
       // …
     }
   })
  1. Tailwind CSS import karo — ./src/global.css me ek @import jodo:
css
   @import "tailwindcss";
  1. Build process shuru karo — npm run dev chalao.
  2. Apne project me Tailwind istemal shuru karo — Qwik components me utility classes istemal karo (index.tsx, Qwik ke component$ ke saath):
tsx
   import { component$ } from '@builder.io/qwik'
   export default component$(() => {
     return (
       <h1 class="text-3xl font-bold underline">
         Hello World!
       </h1>
     )
   })

Common mistakes — aksar hone wali galtiyan

  • Tailwind jodte samay plugin list se qwikCity(), qwikVite() ya tsconfigPaths() hata dena — Qwik template ki config ko chaaron chahiye.
  • Function-form config ki jagah saada object rakh dena — template ki config defineConfig(({ command, mode }) => ...) hai; wahi aakaar rakho.
  • empty se alag kisi starter se scaffold karna — guide ka file layout (./src/global.css) empty template se aata hai.

Interview ki baatein: component$ Qwik ka resumability marker hai — $ suffix Qwik optimizer ko batata hai ki ye function aaram se (lazily) load ho sakta hai aur client par resume ho sakta hai. Guide ki config me // … ek yaad-dihani hai ki asal template config me aur bhi hai (server config, build targets) — Tailwind ka install sirf plugins array ko chhoota hai.

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/installation/framework-guides/qwik

210Framework Guides

Install Tailwind CSS with Rspack

Is section me hum Install Tailwind CSS with Rspack ko pura detail me samjhenge — saari classes, examples, code aur interview me kaam aane wali baatein, sab kuch ek jagah.

Ye hai kya?

  • Kisi Rspack project me Tailwind CSS set up karna, PostCSS wale raaste se — Rspack (Rust par bana webpack-compatible bundler) PostCSS ko postcss-loader se chalata hai, jo Rspack config me ek module rule se juda hai. Framework Guides index isi React variant par link karta hai; page ek "Using Vue" variant bhi deta hai (ek sub-variant, 19 index links me se ek nahi).
  • Iklauti guide jahan PostCSS kisi framework method call ke bajaye webpack-style module.rules entry se chalu hota hai.

Steps (7, kram se)

  1. Apna project banao — Rspack CLI se naya Rspack project banao (interactive hai — command me project ka naam nahi hota):
bash
   npm create rspack@latest
  1. Install Tailwind CSS — PostCSS plugin, uske peers, aur postcss-loader install karo:
bash
   npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/postcss postcss postcss-loader
  1. PostCSS support chalu karo — apni Rspack config me ek rule jodo jo .css files ko postcss-loader se bheje:
js
   export default defineConfig({
     // ...
     module: {
       rules: [
         {
           test: /\.css$/,
           use: ["postcss-loader"],
           type: "css",
         },
         // ...
       ],
     },
   })

(Note: prose me rspack.config.js hai lekin code-block ke label par rspack.config.ts likha hai — rule dono me wahi hai.)

  1. PostCSS Plugins configure karo — project root me postcss.config.mjs banao (ESM, Next.js/Symfony/Meteor ki tarah):
js
   export default {
     plugins: {
       "@tailwindcss/postcss": {},
     },
   };
  1. Tailwind CSS import karo — ./src/index.css me ek @import jodo:
css
   @import "tailwindcss";
  1. Build process shuru karo — npm run dev chalao.
  2. Apne project me Tailwind istemal shuru karo — components me utility classes istemal karo, jaise App.jsx:
jsx
   export default function App() {
     return (
       <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold underline">
         Hello world!
       </h1>
     )
   }

Common mistakes — aksar hone wali galtiyan

  • Step 3 chhod dena — module.rules entry ke bina, Rspack .css files ko saadi CSS maanta hai aur postcss-loader ko kabhi bulata hi nahi, to @import "tailwindcss" kabhi process hi nahi hota.
  • Rule se type: "css" chhod dena — Rspack ko loader ke saath asset type ghoshit chahiye.
  • Sirf postcss install karna, postcss-loader ke bina — loader hi webpack/Rspack ka pul hai; akela plugin bundler me kuch nahi karta.

Interview ki baatein: Rspack webpack-compatible hai, isliye uska Tailwind integration classic webpack PostCSS pattern hai (postcss-loader + postcss.config.*) — Symfony ke Encore setup jaisa hi aakaar, bas Encore wrapper ke bina. test: /\.css$/ + use: ["postcss-loader"] rule Vite plugin ke bundler-level barabar hai: ye kehta hai "har CSS file ko pehle PostCSS se guzaro".

SOURCESource: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/installation/framework-guides/rspack/react

Lab 4 — Spacing Scale Lab

  

Tailwind v4 me spacing ek hi variable se banta hai: --spacing: 0.25rem (4px). Har spacing utility usi ka multiple hai — p-4 = 4 × 0.25rem = 1rem. Slider ghumao aur khud dekho.

Calculation

  
v4 ki khaas baat: spacing scale dynamic hai — p-17 ya mt-29 jaisi classes bhi chalti hain, kyunki value config se nahi, --spacing se calculate hoti hai. v3 me sirf fixed scale ke steps chalte the.




  
LABYe lab is SPA ke docs sections par aadharit hai — har control ke peeche wali classes unke apne docs pages par detail me di hain.






  
L5Interactive Labs

  
Lab 5 — Responsive Breakpoints Lab

  

Tailwind mobile-first hai: bina prefix wali class har size par lagu hoti hai, aur sm:/md:/lg: wali classes sirf us breakpoint aur usse bade par. Neeche ke buttons se "screen size" badlo aur dekho kaunsi class jeet-ti hai.



  
TRY ITBreakpoint chuno

  

    
    
    
    
    
    
  

  

    
bg-red-500

  

  
Element ki classes (docs wala example pattern)

  
class="bg-red-500 sm:bg-orange-500 md:bg-yellow-500 lg:bg-green-500 xl:bg-blue-500 2xl:bg-purple-500"

  

  
Breakpoint values v4 ke default theme se: --breakpoint-sm: 40rem (640px), md: 48rem (768px), lg: 64rem (1024px), xl: 80rem (1280px), 2xl: 96rem (1536px). Ulta chahiye to max-md: jaise max-* variants bhi hain.

Lab 6 — State Variants Lab (hover / focus / peer / group)

  

Variants class ke aage lagte hain aur batate hain ki style kab lagu ho. Har demo ke neeche wahi classes likhi hain jo asal code me jaati hain — mouse ghumao, click karo, type karo.



  
TRY ITHar box ek variant hai

Card par hover karo — title ka rang badlega

Ye message peer-checked par dikhta hai

group = parent par hover/state, bachon par asar. peer = bagal wale sibling par asar (input ke baad wala element). Dono me target element parent/sibling ke baad hona chahiye — CSS aage ki taraf hi select kar sakta hai.

dark: variant se ek hi element ke do roop bante hain. Default v4 me dark mode system ki prefers-color-scheme setting se chalta hai. Neeche toggle se hum class-based strategy simulate kar rahe hain, jo @custom-variant dark se milti hai.

Class-based chahiye to CSS me ye ek line: @custom-variant dark (&:where(.dark, .dark *)); — phir .dark class lagte hi saari dark: styles active.

FInterviews

  
Interview FAQs — Tailwind CSS

  
Current-era interviews me Tailwind se poochhe jaane wale sabse kaam ke 36 sawaal — har jawab wahi hai jo is SPA ke docs sections me detail me samjhaya gaya hai. Kisi bhi sawaal par click karke jawab kholo.

  
Q01 Tailwind CSS kya hai? Ye Bootstrap se kaise alag hai?
Tailwind ek utility-first CSS framework hai: taiyaar components (jaise Bootstrap ke card/modal) dene ke bajaye ye chhoti single-purpose classes deta hai — p-4, flex, text-center — jinhe milakar tum apna design khud banate ho. Bootstrap me design framework tay karta hai, Tailwind me tum. Doosra bada farak: Tailwind sirf wahi CSS generate karta hai jo tumhari files me asal me use hui classes ke liye chahiye, isliye production CSS bahut chhota rehta hai aur runtime zero hai.
Q02 Utility-first approach ka matlab kya hota hai?
Har class ek hi kaam karti hai aur seedha ek (ya kuch) CSS declaration par map hoti hai: mt-4 = margin-top: 1rem. Design HTML me classes compose karke banta hai, alag CSS file me custom class likhne ke bajaye. Fayda: naming sochna nahi padta, CSS badhta nahi hai (nayi screens par wahi utilities reuse hoti hain), aur ek jagah ka change doosri jagah nahi todta.
Q03 Tailwind v4 me tailwind.config.js kyu nahi chahiye?
v4 CSS-first configuration par chala gaya hai. Jo kaam pehle JS config file karti thi — theme colors, fonts, breakpoints — wo ab CSS me @theme directive se hota hai: @theme { --color-brand-500: oklch(...); }. Config file rakhna ab bhi possible hai (@config directive se legacy config load hoti hai), lekin naye projects ke liye zaroori nahi.
Q04 Tailwind classes ko meri files me dhoondhta kaise hai?
Build time par Tailwind tumhari source files ko scan karta hai aur class-name jaise dikhne wale saare tokens nikaalta hai, phir sirf unhi ke liye CSS banata hai. v4 me ye automatic content detection hai — koi content array config nahi karna padta. Jo files auto-detect na hon (jaise kuch vendor templates), unke liye CSS me @source directive se raasta batate hain.
Q05 Dynamic class name — jaise `bg-${color}-500` — kyu kaam nahi karta?
Kyunki Tailwind file ko text ke roop me scan karta hai, code run nahi karta. bg-${color}-500 me poori class kahin likhi hi nahi hai, isliye scanner use dhoond hi nahi sakta. Hal: hamesha poori class name likho (map/object me full names rakho), ya majboori ho to @source inline(...) se safelist karo.
Q06 Arbitrary values kya hain? w-[317px] ka matlab?
Square brackets me tum seedha koi bhi CSS value de sakte ho jo scale me nahi hai: w-[317px], mt-[13px], bg-[#bada55], grid-cols-[24px_1fr] (underscores = spaces). Aur bg-(--brand-color) wala shorthand CSS variable ke liye hai — ye bg-[var(--brand-color)] ka chhota roop hai.
Q07 Variant kya hota hai? hover:, md:, dark: kaise kaam karte hain?
Variant class ke aage lagne wala prefix hai jo batata hai ki style kab lagu ho: hover:bg-sky-700 sirf hover par, md:p-8 sirf 768px+ par, dark:bg-gray-800 sirf dark mode me. Variants stack bhi hote hain: md:hover:bg-sky-700 = md screen par aur hover par. Zyada tar variants ke peeche ek media query ya pseudo-class hoti hai.
Q08 Responsive design Tailwind me mobile-first kyu kehlata hai?
Bina prefix wali class sabse chhoti screen ke liye default hai; sm: (640px), md: (768px), lg: (1024px), xl: (1280px), 2xl: (1536px) us breakpoint aur upar lagu hote hain (min-width media queries). To pehle mobile layout banao, phir badi screens ke liye override jodte jao. Ulta chahiye to max-md: variants hain.
Q09 Dark mode v4 me kaise kaam karta hai?
Default me dark: variant system ki prefers-color-scheme: dark media query se chalta hai — koi setup nahi. Agar tum button se toggle karwana chahte ho (class-based), to CSS me ek line: @custom-variant dark (&:where(.dark, .dark *)); — phir jahan .dark class hogi, wahan dark styles active hongi.
Q10 @theme kya hai aur theme variables kaise kaam karte hain?
@theme v4 ka design-token system hai. Tum CSS variables define karte ho — --color-*, --font-*, --text-*, --breakpoint-*, --spacing wagera — aur Tailwind unse utilities apne aap bana deta hai (--color-brand-500 → bg-brand-500, text-brand-500…). Ye variables asal CSS variables ke roop me :root par bhi nikalte hain, to inhe apni custom CSS me bhi use kar sakte ho.
Q11 Preflight kya hai? Ise disable kaise karte hain?
Preflight Tailwind ki base styles hai — ek opinionated CSS reset jo browsers ke beech ka farak mitata hai (margins zero, headings unstyled, images block, border-style solid wagera). Ye @import "tailwindcss" ke saath apne aap aata hai. Disable karne ke liye poori import ki jagah sirf theme + utilities import karo aur preflight wali line chhod do: @import "tailwindcss/theme.css" layer(theme); + @import "tailwindcss/utilities.css" layer(utilities);.
Q12 Vite plugin, PostCSS plugin aur CLI — teeno me se kab kaunsa?
Teeno ek hi kaam karte hain (scan → generate CSS), raasta alag hai. Vite plugin (@tailwindcss/vite) Vite-based projects ke liye sabse seamless hai. PostCSS plugin (@tailwindcss/postcss) unke liye jo pehle se PostCSS use karte hain — jaise Next.js aur Angular. CLI (@tailwindcss/cli) bina build setup ke sabse tez shuruaat hai, aur standalone executable Node ke bina bhi milta hai.
Q13 Next.js me Vite plugin kyu nahi use hota?
Kyunki Next.js Vite use hi nahi karta — uska apna build system hai jo PostCSS ko samajhta hai. Isliye Next.js guide PostCSS route deti hai: npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/postcss postcss, root me postcss.config.mjs, aur app/globals.css me @import "tailwindcss". Ye interview me aksar poochha jata hai kyunki log galti se Vite plugin laga dete hain.
Q14 @import "tailwindcss" asal me karta kya hai?
Ye ek line v4 ke chaaro hisse kheenchti hai: theme variables, Preflight (base), aur utilities — sahi cascade layers (theme, base, components, utilities) ke saath. Chaaho to har hissa alag-alag bhi import kar sakte ho (tailwindcss/theme.css, tailwindcss/preflight.css, tailwindcss/utilities.css).
Q15 @apply v4 me hai? Use karna chahiye?
Hai — @apply se utilities ko apni CSS class me ghusa sakte ho. Lekin Tailwind ki apni salah hai ki ise kam se kam use karo: zyada tar jagah HTML me utilities seedha likhna behtar hai, kyunki @apply wali class fir wahi purani problem laati hai (ek naam, chhupa hua CSS). Asli zaroorat par — jaise third-party HTML jo tum control nahi karte — tab theek hai.
Q16 Custom utility khud banani ho to? @utility kya hai?
@utility directive se tum apni utility define karte ho jo asal utilities ki tarah behave karti hai — variants (hover:, md:) ke saath: @utility text-balance { text-wrap: balance; } jaisi simple, ya functional utility jo value leti hai. Custom CSS jo utility nahi hai, wo @layer components me jaati hai.
Q17 @custom-variant kya hota hai?
Apna variant banane ka tareeka. Jaise class-based dark mode: @custom-variant dark (&:where(.dark, .dark *));. Iske baad dark: prefix tumhare diye hue selector se chalta hai. Isi se theme-based ya state-based naye variants ban sakte hain.
Q18 group-hover aur peer me kya farak hai?
group-hover: parent par group class lagao, bachon par group-hover:* — parent par hover hote hi bachon ki style badalti hai (card hover par title highlight). peer: kisi sibling par peer lagao, uske baad wale sibling par peer-focus:*/peer-checked:* — form validation messages ke liye mashhoor hai. Dono me target, source ke baad/andar hona chahiye.
Q19 Container queries Tailwind me hain?
Hain. Parent par @container class lagao, phir bachon par @sm:, @md: jaise variants — ye viewport nahi, container ki width dekhte hain. Card jaise components ke liye ye responsive design se zyada sahi hai, kyunki card sidebar me ho ya main me, apni jagah ke hisaab se badalta hai.
Q20 Spacing scale v4 me dynamic kyu kehlata hai?
Kyunki saari spacing utilities ek hi variable --spacing: 0.25rem se calculate hoti hain. p-4 = calc(var(--spacing) * 4). Isliye v3 ki fixed list (0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2…96) ki seema khatm — p-17, w-29, gap-13 sab chalte hain. --spacing badal do to poori scale ek saath badal jati hai.
Q21 text-3xl lagate hi line-height bhi kyu aa jati hai?
Font-size utilities theme me jodi ke roop me hain: --text-3xl: 1.875rem ke saath --text-3xl--line-height: 2.25rem bhi defined hai, to text-3xl dono set karta hai. Alag line-height chahiye to leading-* se override karo, ya ek hi class me text-3xl/8 likho (slash ke baad wali value line-height hai — font-size ke slash wala yehi doosra matlab hai; rangon me slash opacity hota hai).
Q22 Rangon me /50 — jaise bg-sky-500/50 — kaise kaam karta hai?
Ye opacity modifier hai: rang ki alpha value set karta hai. v4 me ye andar se CSS color-mix() se banta hai, isliye kisi bhi rang — variable wale rangon samet — par chalta hai. Arbitrary bhi de sakte ho: bg-sky-500/[71.37%] ya variable shorthand bg-cyan-400/(--my-alpha).
Q23 v4 ke rang OKLCH me kyu hain?
v4 ka default palette OKLCH colour space me define hai kyunki OKLCH zyada wide gamut (zyada chamkeele rang jo modern screens dikha sakti hain) aur perceptually uniform steps deta hai — 50 se 950 tak har step aankh ko barabar doori par lagta hai. Har parivaar ke 11 steps hain: 50 (sabse halka) se 950 (sabse gehra). Rang CSS variables ke roop me --color-* namespace me milte hain.
Q24 shadow aur drop-shadow me kya farak hai?
shadow-* = box-shadow — box ke aakaar (rectangle) ki parchaai, transparent hisso ko nahi dekhta. drop-shadow-* = filter: drop-shadow() — element ke asal aakaar (alpha channel) ki parchaai, isliye PNG/SVG ke ghume hue kinaro par bhi sahi padti hai. Icon/logo par drop-shadow, card par box-shadow.
Q25 border, ring aur outline — teenon kab use karein?
border layout ka hissa hai — jagah leta hai (box-sizing ke hisaab se). ring asal me box-shadow hai — jagah nahi leta, focus states ke liye mashhoor (focus:ring-2). outline bhi jagah nahi leta aur border-radius ko follow karta hai; accessibility ke liye outline hatana bura mana jata hai. Teeno ke width, color aur offset ki alag utilities hain.
Q26 Flexbox aur Grid — kab kaunsa?
Flexbox ek disha ke liye hai: ek row ya ek column me items sajana (navbar, button group, card ke andar ka layout). Grid do dishao ke liye hai: rows + columns ek saath control (page layout, gallery, dashboard). Mashhoor usool: content ko layout tay karna hai to flex, layout ko content tay karna hai to grid.
Q27 size-* utility kya karti hai?
size-6 ek saath width: 1.5rem aur height: 1.5rem set karta hai. Square cheezon — icons, avatars, dots — ke liye w-6 h-6 ki jagah ek chhoti class. Spacing scale par hi chalta hai, arbitrary value bhi leta hai (size-[42px]).
Q28 Play CDN kya hai? Production me use kar sakte hain?
Play CDN ek script (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tailwindcss/browser@4) hai jo browser ke andar hi Tailwind chala deta hai — bina build ke demo/prototype ke liye badhiya. Production ke liye docs khud mana karte hain: har page load par browser me CSS generate hota hai (dheema), aur offline/FOUC jaise masle hain. Production = build wala route (Vite/PostCSS/CLI).
Q29 v3 se v4 upgrade me sabse bade changes kya hain?
(1) @tailwind base/components/utilities directives khatm — ab @import "tailwindcss". (2) Config CSS-first — @theme, JS config optional. (3) Content detection automatic — content array nahi. (4) Important modifier class ke ant me: bg-red-500! (v3 me aage !bg-red-500 tha). (5) Naye browser chahiye — Safari 16.4+, Chrome 111+, Firefox 128+ (modern CSS: cascade layers, @property, color-mix). (6) Default border colour currentColor ho gaya (v3 me gray-200 tha). (7) shadow-sm→shadow-xs, rounded-sm→rounded-xs jaise renames, aur purane naam bhi chalte hain. Upgrade tool (@tailwindcss/upgrade) ye sab apne aap kar deta hai.
Q30 Important modifier v4 me kaise likhte hain?
Class ke ant me !: bg-red-500!. v3 me ye aage lagta tha (!bg-red-500) — upgrade me aksar yahi uljhan hoti hai. Zaroorat tabhi padti hai jab koi aur CSS tumhari utility ko hara rahi ho; pehle specificity/layer ki jad dekho, important aakhri hathiyaar hai.
Q31 @source directive kab chahiye hota hai?
Jab koi file automatic detection se bahar ho: (1) project root se bahar ya .gitignore me padi files jahan classes hain; (2) Laravel Blade templates jo vendor/ me hain — framework guides wahi par @source jodne ko kehte hain; (3) kisi directory ko scan se rokna ho to @source not "..."; (4) safelist ke liye @source inline("...").
Q32 Production CSS itna chhota kyu rehta hai?
Kyunki Tailwind andha-dhundh saari classes generate nahi karta — sirf wo classes banti hain jo tumhari files me asal me mili hain. Ek aam project ki final CSS aam taur par kuch KB me simat jati hai, chahe framework me hazaro utilities uplabdh hon. Saath me CSS cascade layers me aata hai, to tumhari custom CSS ke saath takrao bhi kam hota hai.
Q33 sr-only kya hai aur kyu zaroori hai?
sr-only element ko aankh se chhupata hai lekin screen readers ke liye rakhta hai — icon-only buttons par label dene ke liye zaroori (<span class="sr-only">Menu kholo</span>). Ye display: none nahi hai (wo screen reader se bhi chhupa deta); ye visually-hidden technique hai. Wapas dikhana ho to not-sr-only.
Q34 line-clamp kya karta hai?
line-clamp-3 text ko 3 lines par kaat kar ant me ellipsis (…) laga deta hai — andar se display: -webkit-box + -webkit-line-clamp + overflow: hidden ka combo ek class me. Card descriptions aur previews ke liye roz ka kaam. Hatane ke liye line-clamp-none.
Q35 Editor setup me kya-kya fayde milte hain?
Official Tailwind CSS IntelliSense extension (VS Code) class names ka autocomplete deta hai — theme ke custom rang/font samet — hover par asal CSS dikhata hai, aur galat classes par lint warning deta hai. Saath me Prettier ka Tailwind plugin classes ko official kram me sort karta hai taaki team ke saare files me class order ek jaisa rahe.
Q36 Tailwind me CSS likhna bilkul band ho jata hai kya?
Nahi. Base styles (apne fonts, default rang), components jo baar-baar aate hain, aur jo kaam utilities se nahi hota — unke liye CSS likhna padta hai, lekin jagah tay hai: base ke liye @layer base, components ke liye @layer components, custom utilities ke liye @utility. Fark ye hai ki zyada tar styling HTML me utilities se ho jati hai, to custom CSS chhota aur simta hua rehta hai.

Jo is SPA me NAHI hai — imaandari se

  
    
    
  • Laravel "Using Laravel Mix" — Laravel guide ka ek sub-variant page. 19 framework guides ki list (index) me ye alag entry nahi hai, isliye deep-read me shaamil nahi hua. Laravel ka main (Vite) guide pura shaamil hai.
    • 
    
  • Rspack "Using Vue" — Rspack guide ka sub-variant. Main Rspack guide pura shaamil hai; Vue wala variant alag se nahi padha gaya.
    • 
    
  • Colour utility pages ki poori palette rows — background-color, color, text-decoration-color, accent-color jaise pages par fetched text me sirf pehli palette rows aayi thi. Is SPA me sirf verified pattern (har rang --color-* theme value + /opacity modifier) aur verified rows hi hain — poori 26×11 palette yahan dobara nahi chhapi; wo Colors section me parivaar/step ke roop me samjhai gayi hai.
    • 
    
  • Mask pages ke literal CSS strings — docs ke text me kuch mask CSS values me extra ) ki rendering gadbad thi; yahan sirf verify kiye hue utility naam diye gaye hain, wo gadbad wali strings nahi.
    • 
    
  • Docs ke bahar ka hissa — tailwindcss.com ka blog, showcase, community aur Tailwind Plus (paid UI kits) is SPA ka scope nahi hai; scope sirf /docs hai.
    • 
  

  
Live-check corrections jo shaamil hain

  
Kuch docs pages ki tables crawler par adhoori dikhti thi; unhe live dobara verify karke is SPA me sahi kiya gaya hai — har aisi jagah par "Live check" wala note box laga hai: mix-blend-mode / background-blend-mode ka poora set, rotate-y/z, cursor-grab/progress, break-inside-column, grid-column ka col-end-* set, Preflight disable ka sahi code, aur drop-shadow-xl ka exact value.
